chapters.title: Chapter 501 -501-Casually One-Shotting
paragraphs: Daniel’s comprehension of laws had already reached an extreme level.
In the Law of Causality, the Law of Reincarnation, and the Law of Destruction, he had already reached the transcendent stage.
He had not even undergone his tribulation yet, but he had already reached such a level.
This was precisely the legendary half-step Oracle-grade.
As long as he wished to undergo the tribulation, he could instantly step into true Oracle-grade.
Many powerful cultivators deliberately remained at the half-step Oracle-grade level for an extremely long time.
Only after accumulating a sufficiently profound foundation would they finally attempt their tribulation.
After all, their goal was never merely to survive the tribulation and become an ordinary Oracle-grade expert.
They wanted to become Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses.
Daniel, however, had no need to deliberately suppress his Rank.
His foundation had already become incomparably profound.
He could undergo the tribulation anytime and anywhere.
A faint smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
"Then I’ll undergo the tribulation here."
"This place was already an excellent tribulation ground to begin with."
"Otherwise, Sophis would never have chosen this location when he attempted to break through to T9 Oracle-grade."
More importantly, Sophis had already constructed a tribulation formation here long ago.
Daniel could simply use it directly.
As long as he controlled the formation core, he could naturally seize control of the entire formation.
With that thought in mind, Daniel slowly extended his hand and once again grasped the treasure bead that served as the formation core.
The small spherical bead immediately fell into his palm.
It felt slightly cool to the touch.
Unlike before, it did not erupt with violent currents of law power.
Instead, it remained quietly within Daniel’s grasp.
Boom!
In the next instant, an enormous amount of information surged into Daniel’s mind like a bursting flood.
Most of that information concerned the formations and restrictions within this place.
There was also information regarding the treasury and several other hidden areas.
A look of delight immediately appeared on Daniel’s face.
He had never expected that immediately after completing that long journey through Sophis’s memories, he would obtain yet another enormous fortune.
The tribulation formation alone could already be considered priceless.
Although nearly ninety percent of it had been destroyed, as long as Daniel repaired even a portion of it, he would obtain an extraordinarily powerful tribulation formation.
And that was not even counting the treasury left behind by Grand Oracle Sophis.
The treasury contained the finest treasures Sophis had accumulated while traveling through countless universes and wandering across the River of Time.
It also contained the most valuable treasures he had seized from countless forbidden lands and supreme treasure grounds.
This was precisely the greatest hidden opportunity Grand Oracle Shamir had once mentioned to Daniel.
It was the most valuable place within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land that no other powerhouse had ever discovered.
And now, Daniel had taken another step toward placing all of it under his control.
He murmured softly,
"It is time to undergo the tribulation."
"It is time to become Oracle-grade."
His Law of Destruction had already been cultivated to an extreme level.
This place was also exceptionally suitable for undergoing a tribulation.
The timing, terrain, and circumstances were all in his favor.
If he still refused to undergo the tribulation now, he would only be wasting time.
However, before that, he still needed to make several preparations.
Daniel had long since reached the legendary peak half-step Oracle-grade Rank.
The difficulty of undergoing a tribulation at this Rank was far greater than that faced by an ordinary peak Divine-grade expert.
The Cosmic Tribulation he would attract would naturally also be of an extremely high level.
The higher the grade of a Cosmic Tribulation, the more destructive power it contained.
Its danger would also increase accordingly.
However, the benefits were equally enormous.
If a Divine-grade expert successfully survived a high-grade Cosmic Tribulation, then after becoming Oracle-grade, they would basically become nearly invincible among others of the same Rank.
For example, if Daniel successfully completed the tribulation and became a Tier-1 Oracle-grade expert, he would immediately become one of the strongest beings within Tier-1 Oracle-grade.
Ordinary Divine-grade experts, on the other hand, would merely become ordinary Oracle-grade cultivators after surviving their tribulations.
Moreover, the stronger Daniel became, the greater his potential became.
The greater his potential, the stronger his talent.
Naturally, the calamity he attracted would also become increasingly terrifying.
Daniel had already prepared himself mentally.
The level of his tribulation might reach an astonishing Rank.
With that thought in mind, Daniel raised his hand and opened the treasury.
Without hesitation, he branded it with his own mark.
In the next instant, a system notification rang beside his ears.
[Ding! Millionfold Boost has been triggered.]
[All treasures currently contained within the treasury will receive the Millionfold Boost.]
[Their quality has been upgraded.]
Daniel immediately turned his gaze toward the treasury.
Inside, he saw many treasures that were incomparably familiar to him.
After all, Daniel had accompanied Grand Oracle Sophis throughout an extremely long sequence of memories.
He was intimately familiar with many of Sophis’s treasures.
Looking at the countless supreme treasures filling the entire treasury, a smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
With these treasures, repairing the tribulation formation would become much easier.
Daniel had already obtained complete control over the tribulation formation.
At present, however, the formation had suffered catastrophic damage.
He thought silently,
Once this formation is repaired, it should be enough to help me survive any Cosmic Tribulation.
After all, this formation was originally prepared for the ninth Cosmic Tribulation.
The tribulation I am about to face cannot possibly compare with a ninth Cosmic Tribulation.
No one understood how Sophis had constructed this Grand Formation better than Daniel.
Daniel immediately removed a large number of treasures from the treasury.
He consumed nearly half of all the resources stored within it.
After spending some time repairing the damaged sections, he successfully restored half of the tribulation formation.
Half was already enough.
The formation had suffered such severe damage during Sophis’s tribulation that even if Grand Oracle Sophis himself were resurrected, he would not necessarily be able to restore it completely.
Even so, this half-restored formation was already incomparably precious.
Back when Sophis originally constructed it, he had consumed an enormous portion of his accumulated wealth.
The only reason Daniel could restore half of it was because he had personally experienced those memories and understood the formation in extraordinary detail.
After finishing everything, Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
Even this half of the formation was enough to guarantee that Daniel could survive almost any Great Dao Tribulation during the early stages of his cultivation path.
The tribulation formation was undoubtedly Daniel’s greatest gain from this journey through the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
He murmured,
"Since the tribulation formation has been repaired, it is time to activate it."
With that thought, Daniel immediately began activating the tribulation formation.
The formation before him slowly came to life.
Space continuously trembled.
The entire surrounding region began changing along with it.
Using this place as the source of the formation, waves of energy gradually spread outward in every direction.
Only Daniel knew that the place where he currently stood was the true core region of the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The instant the core region began trembling, the entire forbidden land started shaking with it.
Within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, countless powerhouses sensed the abnormality.
Whether Divine-grade or Oracle-grade, every expert could feel the violent changes coming from the forbidden land itself.
The disturbance was simply too obvious.
The Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had never experienced such an intense tremor before.
In the past, at most, only certain localized areas would shake.
But now, the entire forbidden land was trembling.
Even the outer regions were being affected by the disturbances originating from the core.
The chaotic currents of law power in the outer region suddenly became incomparably violent.
Many powerhouses who were attempting to enter the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land immediately turned pale with shock.
They were suddenly forced to confront terrifying torrents of law power.
At the same time, the amount of energy they needed to consume to resist those chaotic currents increased dramatically.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 -502-The Purple Tribulation
paragraphs: Some Oracle-grade experts whose strength was barely sufficient had already begun to perish under the impact of the chaotic law currents.
The terrifying situation frightened the countless experts gathered in the outer region.
Some immediately turned around and fled.
Others gritted their teeth and rushed deeper into the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land as quickly as possible.
The sudden abnormality within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land was simply too strange.
Everyone immediately began speculating about what exactly had happened inside.
For countless years, the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had never experienced any major disturbance.
Yet now, violent tremors had suddenly erupted throughout the entire region.
The shaking was so severe that it had even spread all the way to the outermost edges of the forbidden land.
The chaotic law currents began surging violently.
They became increasingly unstable and ferocious.
Many experts were now forced to consume far more Sacred Power than usual simply to protect themselves.
The numerous experts in the outer region were left in miserable states as they discussed the situation among themselves.
"What exactly is happening?"
"I come to the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land quite often, but I have never encountered anything like this before."
"Could someone have triggered one of the powerful restrictions deep inside?"
If even the outer region was shaking so violently, then the tremors inside the forbidden land were naturally even more obvious.
The interior of the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land was an independent spacetime.
At this moment, spacetime itself began to tremble.
The flow of time shifted.
Space continuously transformed.
The experts who were currently exploring the forbidden land, searching for treasures, or attempting to break through formations and restrictions were all heavily affected.
Some cultivators who had originally been standing in perfectly safe areas were suddenly teleported directly into terrifying killing formations.
The killing formations were incomparably powerful.
Countless laws erupted in an instant and directly tore those experts apart on the spot.
There were also experts who had been only moments away from obtaining valuable treasures.
Yet in the very next instant, the treasures disappeared from where they had been, vanishing without a trace.
One expert immediately cursed furiously.
"Damn it!"
"Who the hell disturbed this place?"
Elsewhere, another expert had already fallen into a desperate situation.
He had been surrounded and attacked by numerous enemies.
Just as one of them was about to land a devastating blow, the cornered expert suddenly vanished from where he stood.
The group pursuing him stared at one another in confusion.
For a moment, none of them knew what to say.
Somewhere within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, Grand Oracle Shamir slowly descended into a strange space.
Within this region stood seven or eight enormous pillars that seemed to pierce directly into the heavens.
Countless complicated patterns had been engraved across their surfaces.
Numerous laws circulated through them.
Beneath those towering pillars, many experts sat cross-legged while studying them.
Some sat on the ground and stared upward at the pillars.
Others floated in midair, carefully observing the patterns.
There were also groups of three or five experts sitting together and discussing the insights they had obtained from the pillars.
Grand Oracle Shamir nodded slightly.
This is the place.
He had visited this area before.
It was one of the more valuable regions within the forbidden land.
Even a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse could obtain meaningful gains by comprehending the mysteries here.
At that moment, however, the surrounding space suddenly began trembling.
The patterns engraved across the eight towering pillars seemed to melt.
They began flowing like liquid across the surfaces of the pillars while releasing faint waves of light.
The sudden transformation left the Oracle-grade experts who were comprehending the pillars completely dumbfounded.
Their expressions turned fearful.
"What is happening?"
"Why did the pillars suddenly change like this?"
Nothing unusual had happened here for countless years.
What was going on now?
Could one of the core formations or restrictions have been activated?
Boom!
A deafening explosion rang out.
Grand Oracle Shamir suddenly felt the entire surrounding space begin to rotate.
Spacetime continuously shifted according to some mysterious pattern.
The region had completely lost its original order.
At the same time, within the core region of the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, Daniel had already activated the tribulation formation.
In an instant, the countless chaotic law currents that had previously been rampaging through the area suddenly became orderly.
They resembled a disciplined army formation that had been completely tamed.
Daniel sensed the changes occurring around him.
His expression gradually became serious.
He began quietly sensing the Cosmic Tribulation that was about to descend.
In truth, Cosmic Tribulations had always existed within the void.
Ordinary, weak living beings simply could not perceive them.
Only experts who had reached peak Divine-grade possessed the ability to sense their existence.
Once someone sensed a Cosmic Tribulation, the tribulation would descend upon them instantly, almost like a magnet being pulled toward iron.
Even the cultivator themselves would be unable to stop it.
This was also the one and only time in a cultivator’s life when they could freely choose whether or not to summon a Cosmic Tribulation.
Afterward, every future tribulation would descend on its own.
There would be no fixed pattern.
It might arrive near the end of one’s lifespan.
Or it might descend only a hundred or a thousand years after the previous tribulation.
However, every Cosmic Tribulation would provide some form of warning before its arrival.
The Heavenly Dao was fifty, yet only forty-nine were manifested.
Even a Cosmic Tribulation would leave behind a single chance of survival.
The warning before its arrival was that slim chance of survival.
It gave powerful cultivators enough time to prepare before the Great Dao Tribulation descended.
Various treasures capable of delaying a Cosmic Tribulation were also part of that same chance of survival.
After using such treasures, a cultivator could postpone the arrival of their Cosmic Tribulation for a certain period of time.
However, anyone who relied on such a treasure would inevitably face an even stronger Cosmic Tribulation later.
That was because they had incurred a karmic debt.
And the debt they owed was to the Cosmic Tribulation itself.
Their future tribulations would therefore become incomparably dangerous.
This was one of the reasons why experts such as the Blackwater Ancestor, Grand Oracle Sirius, and the Eternal Emperor had fallen beneath Cosmic Tribulations.
Whether they were Tier-5 Oracle-grade, T7 Oracle-grade, or even an existence like the Eternal Emperor who had reached peak half-step Eternal Grade, none were guaranteed to survive.
Many of them had also used treasures to delay the arrival of their tribulations.
That choice had undoubtedly contributed to their eventual fate.
Cosmic Tribulations could be divided into seven colors according to their power.
They were:
Crimson.
Orange.
Yellow.
Green.
Cyan.
Blue.
Purple.
Most experts who possessed the potential to eventually challenge Eternal Oracle-grade would encounter a Purple Cosmic Tribulation.
Above Purple were the legendary Silver and Golden Tribulations.
Silver Cosmic Tribulations had appeared several times throughout history.
Without exception, every expert who successfully survived a Silver Cosmic Tribulation eventually reached the legendary Supreme Divine-grade during the endless passage of the River of Time.
Those existences stood eternally throughout different regions of the River of Time, gazing down upon the countless living beings below.
As for the Golden Cosmic Tribulation...
It had only ever been recorded in legends.
No one in the Endless Starfield had ever personally witnessed a Cosmic Tribulation of that level.
People had merely heard rumors about its existence and recorded those rumors in ancient texts.
Under ordinary circumstances, even a powerful Oracle-grade expert had less than a one-percent chance of successfully surviving a Blue Cosmic Tribulation.
Most ordinary Oracle-grade experts encountered Cyan Cosmic Tribulations.

Only cultivators who relied on countless treasures and external resources to forcibly raise their strength until they barely reached Oracle-grade would encounter the Crimson, Orange, Yellow, or Green levels.
These four colors represented the weakest grades of Cosmic Tribulation.
After surviving them, a cultivator might successfully break through into low-tier Oracle-grade.
However, they would never be capable of advancing into mid-tier or high-tier Oracle-grade.
The reason was simple.
The weaker the Cosmic Tribulation, the smaller the increase in Strength granted after successfully surviving it.
In other words, the stronger the Cosmic Tribulation, the more terrifying the danger.
But as long as someone managed to survive, the rewards would also become incomparably greater.
Their resulting strength would far surpass that of ordinary cultivators.
Naturally, they would become vastly more powerful than their peers.

He simply completed every preparation in silence.
At that moment, he suddenly sensed something and slowly opened his eyes.
He had felt it.
The tribulation had responded.
With the formation here assisting me, my chances of successfully surviving the tribulation should be extremely high.
At the very least, ninety-eight percent.
No matter what level of Cosmic Tribulation descends, I have nothing to fear.
Daniel had focused his entire consciousness just now and successfully sensed the Cosmic Tribulation hidden within the void.
At this moment, the tribulation was about to descend.
Daniel was incomparably confident.
Even though Cosmic Tribulations could manifest in countless different forms and he had no idea what kind of tribulation would appear before him, he remained completely calm.
From what Daniel had witnessed within Grand Oracle Sophis’s memories, Sophis had experienced countless different types of Cosmic Tribulations throughout his cultivation journey.
There had been lightning tribulations.
There had been Heart Demon Tribulations.
There had also been tribulations of earth, wind, water, and fire.
There were Great Dao Reincarnation Tribulations.
There were Cosmic Illusion Tribulations.
Their forms were endlessly varied.
Some tribulations attacked from the outside.
Others directly targeted the mind and soul.
Some focused on the Divine Soul.
Others attacked the physical body.
Although the forms were completely different, they all shared one thing in common.
They were extraordinarily difficult.
The process of surviving a tribulation was always filled with unimaginable suffering.
Otherwise, Odures’s Non-Self Tribulation and Levis’s Double-Ten Tribulation would never have been so dangerous.
It was not that the stronger someone became, the easier their tribulations would be.
On the contrary, the stronger the cultivator, the more terrifying the tribulation that descended upon them.
It was almost as though some supreme existence governing the Great Dao was personally testing every living being.
Daniel treated the approaching Cosmic Tribulation with absolute seriousness.
He waited quietly for it to descend.
As long as he crossed this threshold, he would officially become Oracle-grade.
A faint smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
"Oracle-grade..."
"I have already killed more Oracle-grade experts than I can count."
"But this is only the beginning."
"A mere Oracle-grade Rank is nothing worth fearing."
"I intend to challenge Eternal Divine-grade."
"Beyond that, I will even pursue Supreme Divine-grade."
"I will become supreme even among the supreme."
"The strongest existence in this universe."
As Daniel thought this, the law power above his head suddenly became violent.
The Cosmic Tribulation was about to descend.
Daniel’s expression instantly became incomparably serious.
He could clearly sense that his Cosmic Tribulation was arriving.
At that exact moment, an enormous change suddenly swept through the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
Every living being within the region was shocked.
Because a Cosmic Tribulation was about to descend, strange phenomena suddenly appeared throughout spacetime.
Daniel was the first to sense the abnormality.
The entire surrounding spacetime suddenly erupted with brilliant radiance.
Purple.
The entire phenomenon was purple.
At the same time—
Boom!
A deep hum reverberated through the universe.
Every Oracle-grade expert heard a deafening explosion beside their ears.
It felt as though an unimaginably terrifying law bomb had detonated directly beside them.
In the next instant, purple radiance appeared throughout spacetime.
It spread across the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land almost instantly.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Two figures appeared at once.
Supreme Saint Miral.
And Kru.
A trace of battle intent flashed through Kru’s eyes.
He smiled.
"Daniel should be preparing to undergo his tribulation."
"Master, is Daniel actually attracting a Purple Cosmic Tribulation?"
Supreme Saint Miral shook his head.
"No."
"Before a Cosmic Tribulation truly descends, its form may still change."
"No one can say for certain yet."
"For example, when you underwent your own tribulation, you attracted a Silver Tribulation."
"Daniel possesses an extraordinarily deep foundation."
"Since he has managed to reach this point, there is no reason his performance should be inferior to yours."
Silver?
Kru’s tribulation had actually been the legendary Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
That was an extraordinarily high-level tribulation.
Only those who possessed the potential to reach Eternal Grade—or even Supreme Divine-grade—were qualified to attract such a tribulation.
Kru had successfully survived a Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
Meanwhile, the phenomenon currently appearing above Daniel was still only purple.
However, the Cosmic Tribulation had yet to fully descend.
Its true level had not yet revealed itself.
Throughout the forbidden land, countless experts sensed the purple phenomenon appearing within spacetime.
They were immediately shocked and began discussing it among themselves.
"Who is undergoing a tribulation here?"
"Has that person gone insane?"
"They actually chose to undergo a tribulation inside the forbidden land?"
"Who could possibly have that kind of courage?"
"This is ridiculous."
"Is that person an idiot?"
One of the most important requirements when undergoing a tribulation was ensuring one’s own safety.
A cultivator needed to complete an enormous amount of preparation in advance.
They might arrange formations and restrictions.
They might refine countless treasures and trump cards for protection.
Most importantly, they needed to choose an exceptionally suitable location.
Ideally, the location would be a natural treasure land.
Then the cultivator could borrow the law power of the treasure land to strengthen themselves and resist the corresponding tribulation.
That was why many experts deliberately searched for extraordinary treasure lands before attempting a breakthrough.
However, a forbidden land was not the same thing as an ordinary treasure land.
Although the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had once been a supreme treasure land, it had been devastated by a Cosmic Tribulation long ago.
The original formation Strength could no longer be freely controlled.
Without the support of those formations, the advantages of the treasure land could not be fully utilized.
Therefore, in the eyes of every Oracle-grade expert, this place was an extremely dangerous location for undergoing a tribulation.
It would never be considered a first choice.
Yet someone had actually ignored all common sense and chosen to undergo a tribulation here.
It seemed unbelievably foolish.
Even more shocking was the level of the approaching Cosmic Tribulation.
Purple.
That meant that if this person successfully survived, they would immediately become a top-tier Oracle-grade expert.
The surrounding experts could not help lowering their voices as they discussed the matter.
"A Purple Great Dao Tribulation?"
"Could some peerless Divine-grade powerhouse be undergoing their first tribulation?"
"If they successfully survive a Purple Tribulation, they will absolutely possess the potential to become a Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse."
"Exactly."
"Only the core geniuses of the greatest factions have any chance of attracting a Purple Cosmic Tribulation."
Grand Oracle Shamir listened to the surrounding Oracle-grade experts discussing the phenomenon.
His brows slowly furrowed.
For some reason, he had a persistent feeling that the person undergoing this tribulation might be Daniel.
Daniel was currently at peak Divine-grade.
He could undergo his tribulation at any moment.
Furthermore, when Shamir had come here in the past, the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had never experienced disturbances of this scale.
Yet after he brought Daniel here, one enormous abnormality after another began erupting.
Grand Oracle Shamir could not help thinking silently.
Could it really be you, Daniel?
Are you the one preparing to undergo the tribulation?
At the same time, outside the forbidden land, both the experts attempting to leave and those preparing to enter sensed the phenomenon of an approaching Cosmic Tribulation.
Their expressions changed slightly.
They immediately began discussing it as well.
"Damn."
"A Purple Cosmic Tribulation."
"This must be someone undergoing their first tribulation."
"Impressive."
"To actually dare undergo a tribulation inside a forbidden land..."
"That person’s confidence is far beyond ours."
"Indeed."
"With courage like that, he reminds me somewhat of a certain powerhouse from the old days."
"Heh."
"That fellow back then was simply reckless."
"Still, it looks like we cannot enter the forbidden land for now."
"If this person fails the tribulation, perhaps we will still have a chance to enter afterward."
"But if he successfully survives..."
"I am afraid the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land may undergo an enormous transformation."

chapters.title: Chapter 504 -504-Successfully Surviving the Tribulation
paragraphs: At that moment, the purple radiance suddenly began changing at a frantic pace.
Gradually, traces of silver emerged within it.
The silver continued spreading.
In only a dozen breaths, the purple radiance had been completely overtaken.
The entire surrounding spacetime was now engulfed in a vast silver haze.
The Cosmic Tribulation had officially evolved into a Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
According to legend, only experts who possessed the potential to reach Eternal Oracle-grade—or even Supreme Divine-grade—were qualified to face a tribulation of this level.
Boom!
A deafening rumble suddenly erupted.
Every expert watching the phenomenon was stunned.
What was happening?
The Purple Cosmic Tribulation they had witnessed only moments ago had already been terrifying enough.
Yet now, it had suddenly transformed into a Silver Cosmic Tribulation!
Silver!
That was an extraordinarily rare Cosmic Tribulation with terrifying destructive power.
Within the forbidden land, even Logan Oracle-grade was left dumbfounded by the sight.
He drew in a sharp breath and exclaimed,
"To think it has actually reached the Purple level."
"This Cosmic Tribulation is truly terrifying."
Grand Oracle Shamir, however, had already fallen into complete turmoil.
He immediately thought of the monstrously talented Daniel.
Among all the people he knew, perhaps only Daniel was capable of causing something this extraordinary.
He silently wondered,
"Could it really be Daniel?"
"I have this overwhelming feeling that it is him."
"After all, only a genius of his level could possibly attract such an abnormal Cosmic Tribulation."
The moment Kru saw the transformation, his expression also changed dramatically.
He cried out,
"Silver!"
"It really turned silver!"
"Master, Daniel has actually become someone chosen by a Silver Cosmic Tribulation!"
Supreme Saint Miral remained perfectly calm.
He merely smiled faintly and shook his head.
"The Cosmic Tribulation has not truly descended yet."
"There is still some time remaining."
"It may not stop at Silver."
Kru gave a bitter smile.
"That can’t be possible, right?"
"Surely the entire region won’t eventually be covered by a Golden Cosmic Tribulation?"
He swallowed hard before continuing,
"That would be Gold."
"Even the tribulation you faced back then, Master, was only half-Silver and half-Gold."
Supreme Saint Miral, however, saw the situation much more clearly.
He shook his head and sighed.
"No one can say for certain what will happen."
Outside the forbidden land, the moment the purple radiance gradually receded and the silver light appeared, the countless experts watching from afar were so shocked that their jaws nearly dropped.
Silver.
This was actually a Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
Just how rare was something like this?
The crowd immediately erupted into heated discussion.
"Cough, cough..."
"What am I looking at?"
"That’s actually a Silver-grade Cosmic Tribulation!"
"Which supreme expert is undergoing the tribulation?"
"I genuinely kneel before this person."
"I’m completely convinced now."
"To attract a Silver Cosmic Tribulation..."
"If this person survives, their future will be limitless."
Some experts were filled with boundless envy.
"Comparing oneself to others truly is enough to drive a person insane."
"I’m nowhere near this person."
"Why did I only attract a Purple Cosmic Tribulation back then?"
"I want to experience a Silver Cosmic Tribulation too."
Someone nearby immediately mocked him.
"You wish."
"You must be dreaming in the wrong position."
"That is probably why even the contents of your dreams have started malfunctioning."
Some experts had already begun transmitting news of everything happening here to powerful cultivators they knew.
In an instant, news that an unimaginably monstrous genius was undergoing a tribulation within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land rapidly spread throughout the Endless Starfield.
If this had merely been an ordinary tribulation, there would never have been such widespread attention.
The key was that this person was undergoing a Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
Silver!
Among the countless Oracle-grade experts in existence, how many had ever possessed the qualifications to attract a Cosmic Tribulation of such a high level?
Yet just as these experts proudly spread what they believed to be astonishing news, they suddenly discovered that the Silver Cosmic Tribulation was still changing.
It had not stopped.
Faint traces of golden radiance gradually began appearing throughout the vast expanse of silver light.
Although the golden glow was surrounded by silver, it remained extraordinarily dazzling.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
The rumbling continued without pause.
The Voice of the Universe appeared once again.
One thunderous sound after another exploded beside the ears of the experts inside and outside the forbidden land.
The noise was so piercing that it resembled space itself exploding.
More importantly, the Voice of the Universe was no longer restricted to the Starfall Forbidden Land.
It began appearing throughout the entire galaxy.
Rumble!
The universe itself seemed to tremble.
At that moment, countless experts across innumerable star rivers felt their bodies shake violently, no matter what they had been doing.
A strange tremor from the universe echoed beside their ears.
Many were struck by such overwhelming pressure that their legs gave way and they collapsed to the ground.
They cried out in horror,
"The Cosmic Tremor has appeared!"
"It really is the Cosmic Tremor!"
"According to legend, this phenomenon only appears when a supreme-level powerhouse undergoes a tribulation!"
"My heavens!"
"Who exactly is undergoing a tribulation?"
"How could they trigger such a terrifying phenomenon?"
"The entire star river is trembling beneath the Cosmic Tremor!"
And that was not all.
The rumbling spread throughout the entire starfield.
The Voice of the Universe gradually changed from a faint tremor into a deafening roar.
Tens of billions of experts throughout the starfield were affected by the sound.
At this moment, it was as though the entire universe were roaring.
The universe itself seemed uneasy.
Because a supreme existence was about to be born.
This moment would undoubtedly be recorded within the ancient archives of every major faction in the Endless Starfield.
After all, this was a Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
The entire universe had begun trembling because of it.
The Voice of the Universe had started as a faint whisper.
Then it became a tremor.
And finally, it evolved into a thunderous roar.
The countless phenomena continuously manifested by the Great Dao left innumerable experts completely dumbfounded.
Since the beginning of recorded history in the Endless Starfield, experts capable of creating such a massive disturbance during their very first tribulation were practically nonexistent.
There had been so few that such figures had almost become nothing more than legends.
Yet today, countless living beings were personally witnessing the birth of such a legend.
At this moment, everyone was collectively witnessing the emergence of yet another supreme powerhouse within the Endless Starfield.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The experts could no longer restrain themselves.
They summoned all kinds of treasures and began frantically crossing the void.
They wanted to reach the Abyss Forbidden Land and personally see what kind of genius was undergoing this tribulation.
The Cosmic Tribulation had yet to fully descend.
According to the latest reports, the phenomenon had already transformed into a half-Silver, half-Gold state.
"What?"
"Half-Silver and half-Gold?"
"That is far too terrifying."
"By the time we arrive, it might have changed again!"
Countless experts near the Abyss Forbidden Land were now rushing toward it at maximum speed, desperate to personally witness this historic moment.
Those farther away—even powerful experts from other universes who had received the news—were using all kinds of methods to contact those at the scene.
Everyone wanted to know the same things.
Who was this monstrous genius?
And how would the Cosmic Tribulation continue to evolve?
The entire Endless Starfield was now watching this tribulation.
Within the Abyss Forbidden Land, most of the silver radiance had already faded.
Golden light continued invading the remaining silver region.
The transformation had not stopped.
Then, in a single instant—
Boom!
The golden radiance erupted violently.
An overwhelming golden brilliance instantly swallowed every trace of silver.
The Cosmic Tribulation had completely transformed.
Gold.
It had become a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
A grade that existed only in legends.
A grade so rare that even among billions upon billions of living beings, there might not be a single individual qualified to attract it.

It had become a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
A grade that existed only in legends.
A grade so rare that even among billions upon billions of living beings, there might not be a single individual qualified to attract it.

chapters.title: Chapter 505 -505-The Tribulation Is Not Yet Over
paragraphs: Boom!
The Voice of the Universe had completely transformed into a roar.
Deafening howls continued to reverberate across spacetime.
The universe itself was roaring.
The golden phenomenon caused countless experts within the forbidden land to tremble uncontrollably.
They could no longer command their own bodies beneath the thunderous Voice of the Universe.
The roar had already reached a level that beings of their Rank were simply incapable of enduring.
The deeper one stood within the forbidden land, and the closer one was to the place where the tribulation was taking place, the greater the pressure became.
Under the roar of the universe, countless experts began trembling involuntarily.
Some even found genuine fear rising from the depths of their hearts.
Yet at the same time, they were incomparably excited.
One could even say they were overwhelmed with exhilaration.
Soon, furious shouts erupted everywhere.
"Gold!"
"It’s Gold!"
"My God!"
"It’s actually a Golden Cosmic Tribulation!"
"I’m actually fortunate enough to witness a Golden Cosmic Tribulation with my own eyes!"
"My heavens!"
"It really is Gold!"
Grand Oracle Shamir was equally stunned.
It was actually a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
When the phenomenon had first appeared as Purple, Grand Oracle Shamir had not paid much attention to it.
After all, the Cosmic Tribulation he himself had undergone had also been Purple.
But once it evolved into Silver, Grand Oracle Shamir could no longer remain calm.
His thoughts had immediately become chaotic as he began making guesses.
Could the person undergoing the tribulation be Faustus?
Silver-grade.
Among the people Shamir knew, perhaps only Faustus possessed such extraordinary strength and foundation.
However, the moment the Golden Cosmic Tribulation appeared, Grand Oracle Shamir completely lost his composure.
He immediately mobilized cosmic power and began frantically trying to contact Daniel.
"Faustus, are you there?"
"Are you the one undergoing the tribulation right now?"
"A Golden Cosmic Tribulation..."
"It has to be you, doesn’t it?"
"It must be you!"
"You have to succeed."
"The Gold-Grade Divine Mountain will be relying on you in the future."
"Faustus, you can do it!"
Even Supreme Saint Miral could no longer remain completely composed after seeing the golden halo.
His curiosity about the identity of the person undergoing the tribulation became even stronger.
Someone possessing talent of this level would undoubtedly become one of the supreme powerhouses of the Endless Starfield.
Supreme Saint Miral spoke slowly.
"As expected of someone capable of eventually reaching Supreme Saint Faustus’s level."
"An existence with the potential to challenge the universe itself."
"I already knew that Supreme Saint Faustus must have faced an extraordinarily high-level tribulation."
"But even I did not expect it to be a complete Golden Cosmic Tribulation."
When Supreme Saint Miral had undergone his own tribulation, his Cosmic Tribulation had only reached the half-Gold level.
Even that had already been an extraordinary achievement.
Yet this Faustus was clearly even more monstrous.
He had directly triggered a complete Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
Kru clenched both fists.
His entire body was trembling.
He said,
"Master, Faustus actually triggered a Golden Cosmic Tribulation."
"Is this truly the opponent you want me to challenge?"
"Master’s expectations of me are actually this high?"
"You want me to challenge someone who has survived a Golden Cosmic Tribulation?"
"As far as I know, someone who has crossed a Golden Tribulation is not an existence that the current me is capable of defeating, is he?"
Supreme Saint Miral slowly replied,
"Anyone who successfully survives a Golden Cosmic Tribulation possesses a one-hundred-percent chance of eventually reaching Eternal Grade."
"They even possess the potential to challenge god-grade with absolute certainty."
"As for Supreme god-grade..."
"In the current era, only a handful of mighty Supreme Gods, including Supreme God Faustus, are still attempting to reach that level."
"Whether any of them can successfully break through into the Supreme Rank is something no one knows."
"Even I do not possess the qualifications to attempt that level."
Kru immediately became nervous.
In terms of talent and foundation, his master was unquestionably stronger than him.
Yet even his master claimed that he lacked the qualifications to challenge that Rank.
Supreme Saint Miral immediately saw what Kru was thinking.
He explained,
"The reason is actually quite simple."
"I once suffered an extremely severe injury."
"That is why I no longer possess the ability to challenge a Rank of that level."
"However, I have already observed your thread of destiny."
"You unquestionably possess the qualifications to attempt it."
Only then did Kru breathe a sigh of relief.
At the same time, outside the forbidden land, the moment golden light completely engulfed the Cosmic Tribulation, every expert present was stunned speechless.
It was actually Gold.
Some cultivators had not even reacted yet.
They did not understand what a Golden Cosmic Tribulation represented.
They could not help asking,
"What level is Gold?"
"Exactly."
"I searched through every ancient record within my faction, but I could not find any corresponding information."
"Could Gold actually be stronger than Silver?"
An expert who understood the significance of the phenomenon immediately answered,
"A Golden Cosmic Tribulation is far more terrifying than a Silver Cosmic Tribulation."
"It can no longer be described merely as rare."
"Occurrences of this level have only occasionally appeared in historical records."
"And throughout the entire Endless Starfield, this is the only Golden Cosmic Tribulation to appear in the past several billion years."
"Every single time one appears, the entire Endless Starfield is inevitably shaken."
"It is said that anyone capable of surviving a Golden Cosmic Tribulation unquestionably possesses the potential to become Supreme Divine-grade."
Supreme Divine-grade!
The moment the surrounding experts heard those words, countless people drew in sharp breaths.
Was this some kind of joke?
That was Supreme Divine-grade!
An existence of that level had completely transcended ordinary cosmic powerhouses.
They stood at the very top of the food chain of all living beings.
They represented the absolute ceiling of strength within the Endless Starfield.
When they realized this, the gazes of countless experts immediately became burning hot as they stared toward the location of the tribulation clouds.
Previously, they had not understood the true significance of this Cosmic Tribulation.
Now, they finally did.
Naturally, their curiosity regarding the true identity of the person undergoing the tribulation became almost unbearable.
Who was it?
Who possessed the qualifications to face a Golden Cosmic Tribulation?
If this person successfully survived, they would gain the potential to directly challenge the Supreme Sage level.
And they were actually fortunate enough to witness it with their own eyes.
Within a very short period of time, news of what was happening here spread at terrifying speed toward every corner of the cosmic starry sky.
Almost immediately, the major factions throughout the Myriad Races Universe learned of the event.
The information even spread into many neighboring universes.
Experts and factions from those other universes soon received the news as well.
Within the Abyss Forbidden Land of the Myriad Races Universe, a mysterious expert was currently undergoing a tribulation.
Ordinarily, a tribulation would never attract so much attention.
Countless experts underwent tribulations every single day.
But everyone understood that this time was different.
This was a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
Gold!
News this shocking was no different from the detonation of a cosmic nuclear bomb.
Almost every powerhouse paying attention to the matter immediately received the latest information.
A mysterious expert was undergoing a tribulation.
And the tribulation they had triggered was Golden-grade.
Within the Myriad Races Universe, at the headquarters of the Gold-Grade Divine Mountain.
The leader of the Gold-Grade Divine Mountain,Xaser, stared blankly at the information he had just received.
What was going on?
Gold?
It was actually Gold?
He spoke in disbelief,
"How many eras has it been since someone within the Endless Starfield managed to trigger a Golden Cosmic Tribulation?"
"I never imagined that in this era, there would still be an expert capable of attracting a tribulation of this level."
"Who could this person possibly be?"
"If only they were an expert from my Gold-Grade Divine Mountain..."
At that exact moment,Xaser suddenly received a message from Shamir.
His expression changed drastically.
"What?!"
"The expert undergoing the tribulation is suspected to be Faustus of our Gold-Grade Divine Mountain?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 506 -506-Golden Tribulation Lightning
paragraphs: In an instant,Xaser’s emotions became impossibly complicated.
The surprise had come too quickly, like a tornado sweeping through without warning, leaving him momentarily at a complete loss.
He had never expected it to be Faustus.
He had never imagined that Faustus would actually be undergoing a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
ThenXaser began to laugh.
As time passed, the smile on his face grew wider and wider.
He exclaimed with sheer delight,
"Good! Good! Good!"
"To think that throughout the endless River of Time, my Gold-Grade Divine Mountain has finally nurtured an invincible genius capable of standing shoulder to shoulder with a Supreme Saint!"
"Faustus is unquestionably the greatest hope for the rise of my Gold-Grade Divine Mountain!"
His entire being was overwhelmed by joy, to the point that his words were beginning to come out incoherently.
Within the Myriad Races Universe, numerous factions received the news almost immediately.
A mysterious powerhouse within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land was undergoing their first tribulation.
Moreover, the grade of the tribulation was extraordinarily high.
It was a Silver Cosmic Tribulation.
The moment the major factions heard this, they were all shocked.
Yet just as they prepared to send experts inside to investigate, another piece of news arrived not long afterward.
The grade of the tribulation had risen again.
It had become Gold.
The legendary Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
This time, the entire universe erupted into complete chaos.
It was as though a colossal beast had suddenly charged into a flock of sheep, or as though a giant had abruptly appeared among a crowd of dwarves.
The phenomenon was simply too conspicuous and bizarre.
Yet no one currently knew the identity of the powerhouse undergoing the tribulation.
Even when Grand Oracle-grade experts personally attempted to deduce the heavenly secrets and karmic threads surrounding the matter, they were unable to obtain any result.
It was as though some unknown existence had directly concealed all karma related to this event, preventing anyone from peering into it.
That alone was terrifying.
The moment the Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses realized what was happening, they immediately stopped their deductions.
None of them dared risk becoming involved in the slightest.
They were afraid that the mysterious existence concealing the karma might trace their deductions backward and discover them instead.
Naturally, none dared continue probing by force.
At this moment, the roar of the Voice of the Universe had completely transformed into a cosmic bellow.
Its fluctuations had already transcended the boundaries of this universe and spread into other universes.
Within the Chaosverse, the ancestor of the Chaos Humans slowly awakened from secluded cultivation.
The moment he opened his eyes, he heard the roar of the universe echo beside his ears.
His heart immediately began pounding with alarm.
Who was undergoing a tribulation?
Could a half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse be attempting the Eternal Tribulation?
What exactly was happening?
To make even the universe itself this restless...
How terrifying!
New information soon arrived.
It turned out that within the Abyss Forbidden Land of the Myriad Races Universe, a living being undergoing their first tribulation had directly triggered a cosmic calamity of this level.
The roar of the universe had arisen because of that person’s tribulation.
The ancestor was immediately stunned.
A faint trace of envy surfaced in his heart.
He said,
"The Myriad Races Universe truly possesses extraordinary fortune."
"To think it actually managed to nurture such a heaven-defying monster."
"Why can my Chaos Humans not produce a powerhouse of this level?"
"If a genius like this appeared among my Chaos Humans, then my race would undoubtedly rise to complete prosperity."
The ancestor could not help feeling somewhat bitter.
And he was far from the only one thinking this way.
Throughout the major universes, great factions, and powerful races, countless supreme experts were now paying attention to the person currently undergoing the tribulation.
After all, this was a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
It was a road leading toward Supreme god-grade.
As long as the cultivator successfully survived it, their future would be limitless.
So what if the universe itself was roaring?
If the person could survive the tribulation and continue transforming again and again, perhaps they might ultimately become an existence surpassing even the level of the universe itself.
Within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, however, Daniel heard none of the noise outside.
His surroundings were completely silent.
The external pressure could not penetrate this region.
After all, this was a tribulation formation once constructed by a T8 Sage, specifically designed for challenging T9 Rank.
Even though the roar of the universe resounded throughout the Endless Starfield, it could not affect Daniel in the slightest.
Every other powerhouse believed that this place was absolutely unsuitable for undergoing a tribulation.
What they did not know was that there was no place more suitable for Daniel than this.
The entire Dao Ground was under his control at all times.
At this moment, Daniel was waiting for the color of the tribulation light to stabilize.
Only once the color ceased changing would it truly be time for the tribulation to descend.
Staring at the golden tribulation clouds above, Daniel drew in a deep breath.
His fighting spirit surged to an unprecedented height.
A Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
So what if it was Gold?
Even if a Cosmic Tribulation beyond Gold descended, what difference would it make?
Daniel was confident.
He believed he had a chance to overcome any predicament.
The Cosmic Tribulation was already drawing near.
Feeling its presence continuously approaching, Daniel focused every trace of his attention and prepared himself.
At that moment—
Boom!
A violent explosion suddenly rang out.
Daniel immediately sensed strange streams of energy appearing inside his body.
This energy skipped over any period of incubation and rapidly began growing stronger within him.
Daniel instantly turned his perception inward to inspect himself.
At some unknown moment, a bolt of golden lightning had appeared inside his body.
The golden lightning continued expanding.
It was a lightning tribulation erupting directly from within his body!
Daniel could not help drawing in a sharp breath.
This form of Cosmic Tribulation was truly vicious.

Under ordinary circumstances, no matter how powerful an external lightning tribulation became—even something like the Nine Heavens Purple Firmament Lightning Tribulation—it would not pose too great a threat to a high-grade Oracle-grade expert.
But this lightning tribulation had erupted directly inside his body.
That completely changed the nature of the threat.
If a cultivator was unable to use treasures or Sacred Arts to resist a lightning tribulation of this kind, their combat ability would often be immediately reduced by half.
Almost no one could withstand something like that head-on.
And this was no ordinary lightning tribulation.
It was Golden-grade.
Fortunately, the formation here had already made preparations for such a situation.
Sophis had, after all, been a T8 Lord of Life.
He possessed extremely profound mastery over the Five Element Laws.
When constructing this tribulation formation, he had already taken most types of Cosmic Tribulations into consideration.
Even a lightning tribulation erupting from within the body had been included in his preparations.
At this moment, the entire formation activated.
Countless streams of law power gradually poured into Daniel’s body.
They began forming a counterbalance against the Golden Tribulation Lightning inside him.
As more and more law power continuously washed through his body, the rapidly expanding energy of the Golden Tribulation Lightning was instantly neutralized.
And that was not all.
Under the continuous erosion of law power, the destructive might of the Golden Tribulation Lightning itself also began weakening.
Even so, the lightning still placed Daniel under immense pressure.
At that moment—
Boom!
A violent explosion suddenly erupted inside Daniel’s mind.
The Golden Tribulation Lightning within him began darting throughout his body like a golden serpent.
Wherever the lightning passed, even Daniel’s immensely powerful physical body—one that had been tempered countless times—was unable to resist it.
One had to understand that Daniel’s body contained both the Laws of Reincarnation and Spacetime.
Even when confronting a Primordial Treasure, he could rely on his physical body alone to resist it head-on.
Yet before this Golden Tribulation Lightning, his physical defenses seemed to have become completely ineffective.
The Golden Tribulation Lightning rapidly began destroying Daniel’s body.
If this had been an ordinary external lightning tribulation like those he had encountered before, Daniel would have been completely confident in simply enduring it head-on.

Even when confronting a Primordial Treasure, he could rely on his physical body alone to resist it head-on.
Yet before this Golden Tribulation Lightning, his physical defenses seemed to have become completely ineffective.
The Golden Tribulation Lightning rapidly began destroying Daniel’s body.
If this had been an ordinary external lightning tribulation like those he had encountered before, Daniel would have been completely confident in simply enduring it head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 -507-A Second Tribulation?
paragraphs: After all, an ordinary lightning tribulation would never be able to break through Daniel’s physical defenses.
But what he was facing now was a lightning tribulation erupting from within his own body.
He could not simply rely on his physical body to withstand it.
All he could do was watch as the Golden Tribulation Lightning gradually destroyed his body from the inside.
Excruciating pain began spreading through him.
Daniel clenched his teeth.
He could not help roaring inwardly.
It hurts like hell!
He felt as though his entire body was about to explode.
The Golden Tribulation Lightning was truly terrifying.
Cold sweat had already covered Daniel’s forehead.
The pain was nearly unbearable.
At that moment, the formation continued directing vast amounts of law power into his body, rapidly repairing the damage caused by the tribulation lightning.
This was one of the greatest advantages of choosing to undergo his tribulation here.
Where else could he possibly find a formation of such an extraordinary grade—one powerful enough to assist with virtually every type of Cosmic Tribulation?
Until now, Daniel had not even needed to actively use any defensive method of his own.
The instant the Golden Tribulation Lightning appeared, the formation had already weakened its power by fifty percent.
Now, while the golden lightning continuously destroyed his internal organs, the formation repaired them at the same time.
Although the speed of recovery could not quite keep pace with the rate of destruction, it was far from slow.
The Golden Tribulation Lightning possessed a tangible form and could be seen with the naked eye.
Yet in truth, it also possessed intangible characteristics.
Whether it was Daniel’s sea of consciousness, his limbs, or any other part of his body, the Golden Tribulation Lightning could travel through them at extraordinary speed without obstruction.
Everywhere it passed, it destroyed the corresponding tissues within his body.
At the same time, it left behind golden Tribulation Lightning Marks.
If Daniel successfully absorbed those marks, they would instead nourish and strengthen both his physical body and Divine Soul.
This was the hidden opportunity contained within the tribulation.
A tribulation was not composed solely of danger.
It also contained fortune.

Although Daniel’s limbs, body, and Divine Soul were currently being destroyed bit by bit, each time they were restored by the law power of the formation, the foundations of both his physical body and Divine Soul became even stronger.
This was one of the benefits granted by surviving a tribulation.
Daniel carefully sensed the transformations occurring within his body and silently thought,
"It is time to open my Sage Domain."
"At the Oracle-grade realm, the only true foundation is the Sacred Domain."
"The Sacred Soul must eventually merge with the Sacred Domain."
"Once the Sacred Domain and Divine Soul merge, the Strength of the Divine Soul will increase explosively."
"This is the unique path of Divine Soul cultivation."
With that thought, Daniel decisively opened his Sacred Domain.
The instant it appeared, it manifested at the Supreme level.
Within the vast Sacred Domain, countless bolts of Golden Tribulation Lightning also began destroying everything in sight.
The golden lightning was nearly unstoppable.
It rampaged freely throughout the Sacred Domain, annihilating everything it touched.
Normally, the recovery speed of a Sacred Domain was quite slow.
But under the support of the tribulation formation, every damaged area was restored with ease.
Daniel, however, continued waiting in silence.
He muttered inwardly,
"It is not over yet."
His tribulation was still continuing.
The Golden Tribulation Lightning was undeniably heaven-defying.
An ordinary Oracle-grade expert probably would not have been able to survive even a single second beneath its power.
But Daniel possessed the support of a Peerless Grand Formation.
It was equivalent to a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse pouring all of his life’s wealth, resources, and effort into constructing a single formation for Daniel.
And this formation had originally been designed to challenge the ninth Cosmic Tribulation.
A formation of this level was unique throughout the entire Endless Starfield.
Daniel had inherited the legacy of Grand Oracle Sophis.
Combined with his Millionfold Boost, it was as though he possessed an endless supply of formation support.
Only because of this could he remain so calm before the Golden Tribulation Lightning.
Sure enough, after the Golden Tribulation Lightning rampaged for some time, its remaining power gradually began to fade.
The pressure placed on the formation as it repaired Daniel’s body and Sacred Domain also became smaller and smaller.
When the power of the Golden Tribulation Lightning fell to less than one ten-thousandth of its original strength, Daniel decisively began the fusion process.
He started merging his Divine Soul with his Sacred Domain.
The incomparably vast Supreme Sacred Domain instantly enveloped Daniel’s entire body.
Bathed within his own Supreme Sacred Domain, Daniel felt as though his entire body had been immersed in a warm spring.
An indescribable sense of comfort spread through him.
It came directly from the deepest part of his Divine Soul.
His Divine Soul Strength began increasing at a terrifying speed.
Daniel felt his divine sense expand countless times over in an instant.
The clarity of his thoughts became billions of times greater than before.
At the same time, his Law of Reincarnation broke through within only a few seconds.
It advanced to the Ultimate stage.
His other laws, such as the Law of Causality, had not yet advanced.
At that moment, Daniel’s Divine Soul finally completed its fusion with the Sacred Domain.
His Divine Soul had become incomparably powerful.
The Supreme Sacred Domain directly transformed into a Supreme Sacred Soul.
As long as the two completely merged, this tribulation could be considered fully completed.
Once he successfully became Oracle-grade, Daniel would immediately stand among the strongest experts of that Rank.
Before long, the fusion between the Divine Soul and Sacred Domain was completed.
Daniel’s Sacred Domain slowly disappeared.
At the same time, however, his Divine Soul inherited every characteristic that had originally belonged to the Sacred Domain.
Then—
The Golden Tribulation Lightning completely dissolved.
The tribulation was over.
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
It felt as though a massive weight had finally been lifted from his heart.
He had succeeded.
This tribulation had actually been rather easy.
Daniel had not even needed to expend much effort before successfully surviving his Oracle-grade tribulation.
And now, Daniel had officially stepped into the Oracle-grade realm.
He had become a genuine Tier-1 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
He sensed the endless Strength surging throughout his body.
His Divine Soul was still continuously growing stronger.
A smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
Light flickered within his eyes.
"So this is the Strength of Oracle-grade?"
However, just as Daniel believed that his tribulation had completely ended, an unexpected change occurred.
The golden halo in the sky did not disappear.
That meant the Cosmic Tribulation itself had not vanished.
A puzzled expression appeared on Daniel’s face.
What is going on?
Didn’t I already finish the tribulation?
Why haven’t the tribulation clouds dispersed?
Does the universe really hate me that much?
I only took advantage of the situation a little.
Surely that is not enough reason to keep hunting me down like this?
While Daniel was thinking, the strange phenomenon that refused to disappear also confused the countless experts outside.
"What exactly is happening?"
Grand Oracle Shamir frowned.
"If Faustus really is the person undergoing the tribulation, then this should be his first Cosmic Tribulation."
"It should have ended very quickly."
"Why has the phenomenon still not disappeared?"
"A first tribulation normally does not last very long."
"When Grand Oracle Shamir underwent his own first tribulation, it barely took any time at all."
"And the person undergoing this tribulation is very likely Faustus."
"With Faustus’s strength, it should not take him this long."
A faint trace of worry gradually appeared within Grand Oracle Shamir’s heart.
Unable to restrain himself any longer, he once again sent Daniel a message.
"Faustus, what exactly is happening?"
"Has something unexpected occurred?"
After sending the message, Grand Oracle Shamir waited patiently for a response.
At the same time, he informed Xaser, the leader of the Gold-Grade Divine Mountain, about the situation.
Meanwhile, the phenomenon that continued lingering over the forbidden land quickly attracted the attention of even more powerful experts.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 -508-Unparalleled in the World
paragraphs: Supreme Saint Miral frowned, utterly puzzled.
"How could this happen?"
"Under normal circumstances, the first tribulation should end very quickly."
"Why has the phenomenon still not disappeared?"
Kru asked nervously,
"Master, could Faustus have failed the tribulation?"
"No, that doesn’t make sense either."
"If he had failed, shouldn’t the phenomenon have disappeared as well?"
"Why is it still there?"
Supreme Saint Miral let out a sigh.
"Faustus is an existence unlike anyone else."
"Anything related to him—even the rules of the universe itself—may change because of the karma surrounding him."
"Normally, there are only two possible outcomes to a tribulation."
"Success or failure."
"Regardless of which one occurs, the phenomenon should disappear immediately."
"But now, even after all this time, the phenomenon remains."
"There is no normal explanation for this."
"Even I can no longer see through the karma involved."
Supreme Saint Miral gave a bitter smile.
"Supreme Saint Faustus is the strongest Supreme Saint of this era."
Kru, however, silently thought to himself,
Why is Master being so modest?
Anyone capable of reaching Supreme Divine-grade must surely be favored by destiny—an existence both loved and hated by the universe itself.
Master must have received similar treatment in the past.
At the same time, countless experts inside the forbidden land were completely baffled by what was happening to Daniel.
They could no longer understand the situation.
What exactly was going on?
What had happened?
Wasn’t this supposed to be a tribulation?
Why had the phenomenon suddenly disappeared?
No.
It had not disappeared.
Wait...
Could it really be that the universe was giving this person some kind of special treatment?
How could that be possible?
Since when had the universe ever been so kind?
Not everyone was qualified to receive such "special treatment."
First, one had to possess a life tough enough to survive it.
Throughout the Endless Starfield of the Myriad Races Universe, countless powerhouses were also paying attention to the forbidden figure within the forbidden land.
When they heard about the latest abnormality, they were all astonished.
However, some half-step Eternal Grade powerhouses gradually developed a few theories.
Their experiences were far richer than those of ordinary experts.
Soon, they began speculating.
Could this be a Multiple Cosmic Tribulation?
Only a Multiple Cosmic Tribulation would explain why the phenomenon had not immediately disappeared.
It had to be a Multiple Cosmic Tribulation.
Some Eternal powerhouses silently recalled ancient records.
Ordinary Cosmic Tribulations occurred only once.
As long as a cultivator survived, their Rank would increase dramatically.
However, only the most monstrous geniuses—those capable of shaking even the universe itself—would receive the "privilege" of facing Multiple Cosmic Tribulations.
In other words, they would undergo tribulations consecutively.
One tribulation would not be enough.
The universe would continue sending more.
According to the highest known record, there had once been a cultivator who began at their first tribulation and was forced to survive three consecutive Cosmic Tribulations.
By the end, that person had directly become a Tier-3 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
That expert had been an absolute monster.
After an entire lifetime of cultivation, they eventually reached Eternal Divine-grade.
The mysterious expert inside the forbidden land of the Myriad Races Universe was most likely facing a Multiple Cosmic Tribulation as well.
With so many monstrous geniuses appearing one after another in the same era, no one knew whether living in this age was a blessing or a tragedy.
Within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, Daniel frowned as he stared at the phenomenon above.
"Why isn’t it over yet?"
He could clearly sense that another Cosmic Tribulation was about to begin.
He had already survived his first tribulation.
Yet it still was not over.
The universe actually wanted him to undergo another one.
Was there no end to this?
This was simply too much!
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
That meant if he successfully survived the second Cosmic Tribulation, his Rank would increase again.
He would directly become a Tier-2 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
He murmured,
"I wonder what form this Cosmic Tribulation will take."
"Come."
"No matter what it is, I’m not afraid."
"Universe, if you have another tribulation for me, then send it over."
Daniel directly released his aura.
His aura had become incomparably dense and powerful.
Although he was only Tier-1 Oracle-grade, his presence was already no weaker than that of any ordinary Tier-2 Oracle-grade expert.
It was terrifyingly powerful.
After completing the fusion at the Supreme Sage Rank, both Daniel’s Divine Soul and physical body had reached the absolute peak of their respective cultivation paths.
It was precisely the tempering from the Cosmic Tribulation that had allowed him to advance even further.
He was already beginning to break through his previous limitations.
Daniel felt no fear whatsoever.
In fact, there was even a hint of excitement in his heart.
Because he wanted to become stronger.
Daniel abruptly closed his eyes and waited for the Cosmic Tribulation to descend.
Within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, the tribulation phenomenon still remained.
The Cosmic Tribulation for Tier-2 Oracle-grade was about to descend.
Ordinary Oracle-grade experts would normally face only one Cosmic Tribulation at a time.
They would survive it once and complete their advancement.
Only in extremely rare cases would Multiple Cosmic Tribulations appear.
And that was exactly what Daniel was facing now.
He had only just survived his first tribulation.
Yet he was already about to face a second Cosmic Tribulation.
At that moment—
Boom!
A violent rumble suddenly erupted.
Countless terrifying flames appeared throughout spacetime.
The flames came in all colors and forms.
Among them was the legendary Spacetime Flame, known as the number-one Exotic Flame beneath the starry sky.
It was said to possess the power to burn spacetime itself until nothing remained.
There were also countless other Exotic Flames.
Karmic Flame.
Incense Flame.
Dust Flame.
Yin Flame.
Spirit Flame.
White Bone Flame.
And many more.
With only a brief glance, Daniel counted exactly eighty-one different kinds.
He immediately recognized the nature of the tribulation and raised an eyebrow.
"Could this be the Heavenly Flame Tribulation?"
The Heavenly Flame Tribulation was considered a relatively standard type of Cosmic Tribulation.
Although facing eighty-one Exotic Flames at once was already extremely difficult, the tribulation should at most reach the Silver level.
It was nowhere near the difficulty expected of a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
However, Daniel did not relax in the slightest.
He sneered.
"There is no way the Universal Will would go easy on me."
"There must be something strange hidden within this tribulation."
As the numerous flame seeds appeared, their auras suddenly began surging.
The flames expanded rapidly.
At the same time, countless Exotic Flames unexpectedly emerged inside Daniel’s body as well.
There were also exactly eighty-one of them.
What?
Daniel’s expectations had been correct.
How could a Golden Cosmic Tribulation possibly be this simple?
There it was.
This was not merely an ordinary Heavenly Flame Tribulation.
It was an overwhelmingly enhanced version—
The Heavenly Flame Sacred Tribulation.
The heavenly flames did not only exist outside his body.
They had also appeared inside him.
Internal and external flames burned simultaneously.
In terms of destructive power, this Cosmic Tribulation was unquestionably even more terrifying than the Golden Tribulation Lightning Daniel had faced earlier.
The flame seeds inside his body instantly erupted.
They attempted to completely destroy his physical body from within.
At that moment, the formation surrounding Daniel once again began displaying its power.
An endless stream of law power automatically surged into his body.
It began suppressing the Exotic Flames burning inside him.
At the same time, the formation continuously consumed Origin Power to repair the sections of Daniel’s body that were being burned away.
Above him, countless Exotic Flames continued surging.
They gathered like enormous waves of fire and crashed down toward Daniel with overwhelming force.
