chapters.title: Chapter 509 -509-The Self-Severing Tribulation
paragraphs: Daniel let out a cold snort.
With the formation supporting him, he did not need to worry too much about the Exotic Flames burning inside his body.
As for the flames outside—
He could deal with those himself.
He called out softly,
"Wheel of Reincarnation!"
"Cosmic Great Dao!"
"Three Thousand Laws—Suppress!"
A brilliant halo suddenly appeared behind Daniel’s head.
It was none other than the Wheel of Reincarnation.
According to legend, it had been formed from the spirituality left behind by an Eternal powerhouse.
In a single instant, Daniel cycled through 728 incarnations of himself across the past and future, borrowing Strength from 728 different versions of himself.
At the same time, his Cosmic Sacred Art instantly manifested.
The phantom of a galaxy appeared.
As Daniel’s strength continued increasing, his Cosmic Sacred Art had also gradually evolved.
The moment the phantom manifested, its size had already surpassed that of an ordinary galaxy.
It had even reached the scale of an entire star river.
At the same time, enormous palms appeared across the sky, blotting out everything above.
Every line upon those palms contained seemingly endless law power.
The Exotic Flames surged toward Daniel like a raging ocean.
Daniel, however, activated his Sacred Arts and chose to confront them head-on.
Countless gigantic palms spread across the void like an endless sea before violently colliding with the heavenly flames.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Terrifying explosions erupted throughout the forbidden land one after another.
The entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land began shaking violently beneath the continuous bombardment.
The enhanced version of the Heavenly Flame Sacred Tribulation was indeed terrifying.
Even the Three Thousand Laws could not completely block it.
The countless Exotic Flames produced by the Heavenly Flame Sacred Tribulation effortlessly engulfed the enormous palms Daniel had summoned.
Daniel had already expected this.
If a Golden Cosmic Tribulation could be overcome so easily, then it would never deserve to be called Golden-grade.
He called out again.
"Sacred Mark!"
The next instant, Daniel’s aura surged dramatically.
This Sacred Art originated from the Holy Golden Mountain and had been personally taught to Daniel by its master.
Daniel had never had an opportunity to use it before.
The most unique aspect of this Sacred Art was that it was divided into two stages.
Before reaching Oracle-grade, it had to be used together with the Sacred Domain.
Daniel, however, had never actually used it during that period.
After reaching Oracle-grade, the Sacred Mark could be activated independently.
This was Daniel’s first time using it.
Daniel formed a series of hand seals.
His fingers moved rapidly through the air.
Before long, a mysterious and profound totem began taking shape before him.
The totem was constructed entirely from countless streams of law power.
Within only a few breaths, it was fully formed.
A scene suddenly appeared within the totem.
Inside it was a powerhouse identical in appearance to Daniel.
That figure was also undergoing the Heavenly Flame Sacred Tribulation.
However, the outcome displayed within the totem was completely different.
Daniel stood with countless Exotic Flames beneath his feet.
His aura suppressed everything in all directions.
He raised his head and let out a thunderous roar toward the heavens, successfully overcoming the tribulation.
Whoosh!
The heavenly flames surged toward him.
Daniel spoke softly and directly hurled the totem before him into the flames.
The totem shot through the air and collided head-on with the incoming heavenly fire.
At the same instant, Daniel felt two-thirds of the energy inside his body vanish.
He drew in a deep breath.
The Sacred Mark truly consumes an absurd amount of energy.
Fortunately, someone like me never has to worry about running out.
Daniel watched as the totem collided with the Heavenly Flame Sacred Tribulation in midair.
To his surprise, the overwhelming heavenly flames were forcibly stopped by the totem.
Although the result was not quite as overwhelming as the scene depicted within the totem, it was still more than enough to block the endless sea of heavenly fire with ease.
At the same time, the formation began devoting all of its power toward eliminating the numerous Exotic Flames burning within Daniel’s body.
All eighty-one Exotic Flames had already been weakened by roughly seventy to eighty percent under the effects of the tribulation formation.
The formation could finally spare enough Strength to assist the totem in suppressing the external flames as well.
The Exotic Flames in the sky were firmly locked in place by Daniel’s totem.
They could no longer descend even another inch.
Meanwhile, the power of the formation was now being fully unleashed.
It continuously weakened the various powers contained within the heavenly flames above.
When Daniel saw this, a smile appeared on his face.
This one is definitely secured.
The second Cosmic Tribulation was not so impressive after all.
Wasn’t he still overcoming it without any real danger?
At this point, nearly all of the Exotic Flames inside Daniel’s body had already been suppressed.
Only a handful remained.
The flames outside his body were likewise being jointly restrained by the totem and the formation.
They could no longer cause any meaningful disturbance.
Sure enough, it did not take long before the heavenly flames began weakening.
They resembled dying embers gradually burning themselves out.
The moment Daniel saw this, he acted decisively.
His figure shot directly into the remaining heavenly flames.
This was the nature of tribulations.
Whatever failed to kill you would inevitably make you stronger.
Tribulations contained both danger and opportunity.
And Daniel intended to use these heavenly flames to increase his own strength.
Information regarding the Heavenly Flame Tribulation surfaced in his mind.
There were eighty-one different Exotic Flames.
Both the physical body and the Divine Soul could be tempered by them.
The second Cosmic Tribulation is almost over.
This is the perfect opportunity to quickly strengthen myself.
Having reached that conclusion, Daniel decisively mobilized his terrifying physical body and willingly allowed himself to bathe in the erosion of the Exotic Flames.
At this moment, flames were burning both inside and outside his body.
Yet Daniel felt no panic whatsoever.
He simply allowed the Exotic Flames to continuously destroy his physical body and Divine Soul.
Then he allowed the formation below to repair the damage.
In this way, a perfect balance was created.
Destruction.
Restoration.
Destruction again.
Restoration again.
During this endless cycle of destruction and repair, Daniel could clearly sense both his Divine Soul and physical body becoming stronger.
The improvement was extremely obvious.
And astonishingly fast.
A delighted smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
He silently thought,
My Law of Destruction has probably already reached the Ultimate stage because of this tribulation.
During his second Cosmic Tribulation, Daniel’s Law of Destruction had directly advanced to the Ultimate stage.
Tribulations truly were the fastest way for him to increase his strength.
Ordinary Oracle-grade experts spoke of even normal Cosmic Tribulations with fear and reverence.
None of them would behave like Daniel.
Even when facing a Golden Cosmic Tribulation, he was able to turn the calamity into an opportunity to improve himself.
More absurdly, he still appeared completely relaxed.
It was almost as though the Cosmic Tribulation he was facing was not Golden-grade at all.
For other powerhouses, a Cosmic Tribulation was a hell of unimaginable suffering.
It was a terrifying nightmare from which nine out of ten cultivators might never return.
But for Daniel—
It was a reward.
A heaven-sent opportunity.
Using the power of the formation, Daniel completely suppressed every remaining Exotic Flame.
The recovery speed of his body continued increasing.
Meanwhile, the destructive power of the Exotic Flames gradually declined.
Daniel carefully sensed the increase in his strength and murmured,
"So this is what Tier-2 Oracle-grade feels like?"
He had only just broken through to Tier-1 Oracle-grade.
And now he had already advanced to Tier-2 Oracle-grade.
The corners of Daniel’s mouth slowly curved upward.
There wouldn’t happen to be another Cosmic Tribulation after this, would there?
Whether there is or not—
Just come.
I can handle it.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 -510-Endless Tribulations!
paragraphs: Before long, the Heavenly Flame Sacred Tribulation gradually dissipated into the void.
Daniel had successfully survived the tribulation.
His Rank advanced once again, and he officially became a Tier-2 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
There had been practically no transitional period between Tier-1 and Tier-2 Oracle-grade.
In the blink of an eye, Daniel had completed another breakthrough.
Yet at that moment, the phenomenon of the Cosmic Tribulation still had not disappeared.
Daniel’s heart began pounding violently.
A trace of anticipation appeared in his eyes.
"Could there really be another one?"
He carefully sensed the birth of new Cosmic Tribulation Strength.
Sure enough, it did not take long before he detected another strange phenomenon.
A third Cosmic Tribulation was currently being born.
As for why the phenomenon surrounding this place had persisted for so long, it was most likely because the Universal Will itself was secretly interfering.
The phenomenon had already continued for an extremely long time.
Naturally, this left the countless experts watching from afar astonished.
They began discussing the situation among themselves.
"Could Golden Cosmic Tribulations really continue endlessly like this?"
"How long has this phenomenon already lasted?"
"Why hasn’t it disappeared?"
"Could it be that we are simply unworthy, so the Cosmic Tribulation cannot even be bothered to explain itself to us?"
"This has to be a Multiple Cosmic Tribulation!"
"Judging by how much time has passed, it should already be the second..."
"No."
"The third!"
"My God!"
Powerhouses from countless universes were closely monitoring the situation.
Even Eternal Grade existences had begun secretly observing the strange disturbance erupting within the Myriad Races Universe through karmic methods.
Several Eternal powerhouses directly crossed the River of Time.
They arrived from different eras and different regions of spacetime.
Although they could not truly descend onto the scene in person, a projection was more than enough for them to clearly observe everything taking place.
There were also supreme Eternal powerhouses watching the Myriad Races Universe directly from within their own supreme Dao Realms.
Some of these Eternal existences knew Daniel’s background.
Others did not.
Yet all of them could tell that the powerhouse undergoing this tribulation was anything but ordinary.
They could not help expressing their astonishment.
"A Multiple Cosmic Tribulation this terrifying..."
"The cultivator undergoing it has undoubtedly attracted the absolute hostility and rejection of this universe."
"The entire universe itself is roaring!"
"I can even faintly sense fear coming from this universe."
"It must be Supreme Saint Faustus!"
"This is the spacetime in which Supreme Saint Faustus underwent his tribulation."
"So it is Supreme Saint Faustus..."
"Then there is nothing strange about it."
"Supreme Saint Faustus has always been..."
"Haha."
"I should probably stop talking."
Within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, Daniel had only just broken through to Tier-2 when he began sensing the terrifying Strength belonging to this new Rank.
Both his Law of Reincarnation and Law of Destruction had reached the Ultimate stage during the tempering of the previous tribulations.
In other words, the only one among Daniel’s major laws that had yet to reach the Ultimate stage was the Law of Causality.
Yet the third tribulation was already approaching.
Daniel could not help feeling curious.
"What form will this one take?"
Before long, spacetime suddenly began trembling.
A figure appeared.
It looked almost exactly like Daniel.
Its height, body shape, and facial features were practically identical to his own.
The moment the figure completely manifested, Daniel immediately frowned.
Not only did the other party look exactly like him, but even the aura emanating from its body was identical to Daniel’s current state.
It almost seemed as though two Daniels—one real and one fake—were facing each other.
Daniel carefully sensed the figure that had suddenly appeared.
There was practically no difference between them.
Even the fluctuations of law power and the vitality radiating from its physical body were exactly the same.
It was even possible that this figure possessed Sacred Arts and supreme treasures identical to Daniel’s own.
Daniel finally understood.
"This is definitely the Self-Severing Tribulation!"
It was said to be one of the most difficult types of Cosmic Tribulation to overcome.
To survive the Self-Severing Tribulation, Daniel had to kill a tribulation incarnation created when the Universal Will perfectly simulated him.
As expected of a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
It truly belonged to the highest and most terrifying level of tribulations.
An ordinary Oracle-grade expert facing something this horrifying probably would not survive for even a few minutes.
Yet Daniel had successfully made it all the way here.
Even so, the third Cosmic Tribulation would not be so easy to overcome.
From this point onward, each successive tribulation would only become increasingly terrifying.
As Daniel thought this, the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation began walking toward him step by step.
It continued forward until it stopped a short distance away.
Then it stared coldly at Daniel.
Almost simultaneously, both sides spoke.
"Daniel."
"Cosmic Tribulation."
Neither side immediately used their supreme treasures.
After all, the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation had perfectly copied everything Daniel currently possessed.
Naturally, that included the Treasure Gathering Basin.
If either side used the Treasure Gathering Basin, the supreme treasures of both sides would simply counteract each other.
There would be little point.
Therefore, both sides tacitly chose not to use treasures.
Instead, they activated their Sacred Arts and began the battle directly.
Even their Sacred Arts were identical.
Every Sacred Art Daniel possessed could also be used by the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation.
The only difference was that the incarnation itself was supported by the universe.
Its raw Strength was even slightly greater than Daniel’s.
However, Daniel possessed advantages of his own.
For example, he had the support of the tribulation formation.
The formation could weaken the Strength of the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation while simultaneously amplifying Daniel himself.
The Sacred Arts of both sides began colliding violently.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Deafening explosions echoed endlessly throughout the void.
Their furious shouts rang out one after another.
"Three Thousand Sacred Arts!"
"Three Thousand Sacred Arts!"
"Sacred Mark!"
"Sacred Mark!"
"Cosmic Great Dao!"
"Cosmic Great Dao!"
During the early stages of the battle, the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation displayed overwhelming momentum.
However, its endurance was clearly insufficient.
Daniel, on the other hand, possessed the constant support of the formation.
The longer he fought, the fiercer he became.
Before long, the situation completely reversed.
Daniel began suppressing the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation instead.
At that moment, the cosmic phenomenon changed once again.
Originally, the phenomenon had merely consisted of golden radiance filling spacetime.
But now, that golden light gradually began condensing.
Bit by bit, it transformed into the shape of an enormous eye.
A terrifying pressure faintly emanated from within it.
It was the Eye of the Universe!
The phenomenon produced by Daniel’s tribulation had actually condensed directly into an Eye of the Universe.
Countless experts watching the sudden transformation were immediately stunned speechless.
Heated discussion erupted among them.
"What exactly is that eye?"
"Why did I feel my entire mind and soul tremble after merely looking at it once?"
"That’s right!"
"I’m a Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouse!"
"I can withstand even ordinary law impacts head-on."
"But after glancing at that eye, I immediately felt as though even my bloodline had been suppressed."
"It is terrifying!"
What exactly was the origin of that eye formed from the tribulation phenomenon?
Most of the experts present had no idea.
However, several ancient and experienced powerhouses immediately understood.
There was only one possibility.
It was the legendary Eye of the Universe.
They whispered among themselves,
"Has any of you ever heard of someone attracting the Eye of the Universe while undergoing a tribulation?"
"No."
"According to legend, the gaze of the Eye of the Universe only occasionally appears when someone is undergoing an Eternal Tribulation."
"Exactly!"
"But isn’t the powerhouse undergoing this tribulation only advancing into Oracle-grade for the first time?"
"Then why has the Eye of the Universe already appeared?"
Someone undergoing their first advancement into Oracle-grade had actually attracted a phenomenon that normally appeared only during an Eternal Tribulation.
And there was a reason the Eye of the Universe had manifested.
The universe itself had become wary.
Every genius possessing the potential to exceed the upper limit of the universe represented an enormous threat to the universe itself.
The Eye of the Universe appeared for precisely this reason.
Its purpose was to observe and monitor every powerhouse who possessed limitless potential.

"But isn’t the powerhouse undergoing this tribulation only advancing into Oracle-grade for the first time?"
"Then why has the Eye of the Universe already appeared?"
Someone undergoing their first advancement into Oracle-grade had actually attracted a phenomenon that normally appeared only during an Eternal Tribulation.
And there was a reason the Eye of the Universe had manifested.
The universe itself had become wary.
Every genius possessing the potential to exceed the upper limit of the universe represented an enormous threat to the universe itself.
The Eye of the Universe appeared for precisely this reason.
Its purpose was to observe and monitor every powerhouse who possessed limitless potential.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 -511-A Mere Tribulation
paragraphs: Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
At this moment, Daniel was becoming fiercer the longer the battle continued.
The Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation, on the other hand, was growing weaker and weaker.
"Sacred Mark!"
The Sacred Mark condensed into a totem and directly suppressed the Cosmic Tribulation Incarnation.
At that moment, the incarnation suddenly collapsed.
Its entire body transformed into countless streams of golden radiance that poured directly into Daniel.
Daniel could clearly sense the changes occurring within himself.
His Law of Causality advanced.
It reached the transcendent stage.
From this moment onward, Daniel’s Law of Destruction, Law of Reincarnation, and Law of Causality had all reached the transcendent stage.
And that was far from the end.
Numerous lower-grade laws within Daniel began advancing at a frantic pace.
Through repeated deductions of the Forbidden Codex, Daniel had already mastered many low-grade and mid-grade laws.
Among them was the Law of Yin and Yang, which had originally reached mid-grade.
After being tempered by this enormous opportunity, the Law of Yin and Yang quickly advanced to high-grade.
Then, from high-grade, it broke through once again and reached transcendent.
The Law of Creation experienced the same transformation.
It had originally only been mid-grade.
It first advanced to high-grade, then continued directly into the transcendent stage.
Numerous other basic laws also advanced by two entire levels.
From low-grade, they surged all the way to high-grade.
One law after another was comprehended and upgraded.
Daniel could clearly feel his overall strength increasing explosively.
This was one of the greatest benefits brought by surviving a Cosmic Tribulation.
The Self-Severing Tribulation had indeed been extremely powerful.
A Golden-grade Cosmic Self-Severing Tribulation was especially terrifying.
The tribulation incarnation itself received direct support from the universe, making its Strength even greater than that of the cultivator undergoing the tribulation.
An ordinary expert would have been crushed and erased long ago.
Yet Daniel had managed to survive with relative ease.
Naturally, the formation and restrictions had played an enormous role.
This was also one of the greatest benefits Daniel had obtained from inheriting the legacy of Grand Oracle Sophis.
This formation had originally been constructed to withstand the ninth Cosmic Tribulation.
Now, it was being used by Daniel.
Against these first three Cosmic Tribulations, it had not encountered much pressure at all.
Daniel drew in a deep breath and completely refined the golden radiance flowing into his body.
His Divine Soul and physical body strengthened simultaneously.
Tier Three!
Three consecutive advancements.
Daniel was now a Tier-3 Oracle-grade powerhouse!
He had risen through three tiers in a single continuous sequence.
He was now officially a Tier-3 expert.
His Law of Causality, Law of Reincarnation, and Law of Destruction had all reached the Ultimate stage.
His Law of Creation and Law of Yin and Yang had also reached the transcendent stage.
His physical body and Divine Soul had both undergone repeated tempering from the Cosmic Tribulations.
On the surface, they had already reached what seemed to be the absolute limit.
In other words—
Daniel had no weaknesses.
Every aspect of his abilities had already reached an extreme.
And yet...
Daniel was still not satisfied.
He had benefited greatly from experiencing the memory fragments of Grand Oracle Sophis.
He had witnessed countless dangers and storms.
The farther he traveled along this path, the more clearly he understood how dangerous his situation was becoming.
Surface-level strength meant very little.
What truly mattered was one’s foundation.
"If I have to face a fourth or fifth Cosmic Tribulation without the help of this Peerless Grand Formation, things will become much more difficult."
"The first three tribulations have already consumed a large portion of my accumulated foundation."
"Moreover, my law cultivation has advanced far too quickly."
"I have not had enough time to stabilize my foundation."
"So although I may appear extremely powerful right now, there are actually hidden dangers everywhere."
Daniel remained exceptionally calm.
During these several tribulations, the Peerless Grand Formation had contributed an enormous amount.
If he had relied purely on his own Strength, he would never have been able to overcome the tribulations so easily.
Daniel raised his head.
The Eye of the Universe still hovered across the entire spacetime above him.
And the Eye of the Universe was staring directly at him.
Its gaze was filled with coldness.
Indifference.
And wariness.
Suddenly—
The Eye of the Universe blinked.
Daniel saw it clearly.
The enormous eye had indeed blinked once.
It was only a single movement.
Yet the Peerless Grand Formation surrounding the entire region suddenly trembled.
Immediately afterward, the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land began shaking violently.
This place was the core of the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
Even a minor disturbance here could affect the entire forbidden land.
Daniel’s heart tightened.
"This is bad!"
"The universe has no shame at all."
"It actually attacked me directly."
Daniel understood immediately.
The Eye of the Universe did not merely exist to observe.
Under certain circumstances, it could directly interfere with the current spacetime.
The existence of the Peerless Grand Formation granted Daniel an enormous advantage.
It allowed him to survive all kinds of tribulations with relative ease.
How could the universe simply tolerate that forever?
Furthermore, the Peerless Grand Formation relied on favorable terrain, natural conditions, and countless treasures to provide an endless stream of energy.
But as long as something consumed energy, there would eventually come a day when that energy ran out.
Once the energy was exhausted, the Peerless Grand Formation could not continue existing forever.
Without the protection of the Peerless Grand Formation, Daniel would have to face the later Cosmic Tribulations entirely on his own.
"I need to strengthen my foundation."
Daniel looked at the Peerless Grand Formation that had just been shaken by the Eye of the Universe.
At this point, the formation was probably no longer sufficient to guarantee that Daniel could safely withstand a fourth Cosmic Tribulation.
In that case...
"My Divine Soul is a Supreme Divine Soul."
"It has no growth limit."
"My physical body also needs to be reforged and tempered again."
"So what I need now is an enormous amount of energy."
"And the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land itself is the perfect nourishment."
"The Eye of the Universe has refused to disappear because it wants to discover my weakness."
"It is like a hunter watching its prey."
"Continuously probing."
"Continuously waiting."
"The moment I reveal even the slightest weakness, the Eye of the Universe will see through it."
Having reached this conclusion, Daniel already knew what he needed to do.
He began controlling the formation.
At the same time, he mobilized his Divine Soul and began merging with the endless law power contained inside the formation.
Outside the formation, the law power was chaotic and disordered.
It was mixed, violent, and savage, like wild beasts that had never been tamed.
Inside the formation, however, the law power was gentle and orderly.
It consisted of pure Origin Laws.
It was effectively tamed Strength.
Every trace of law power inside the formation could be absorbed.
Daniel’s Supreme Divine Soul began expanding at an astonishing speed.
It continuously devoured the pure law power around it.
As the energy within the core formation began pouring outward at a frantic rate, the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land was affected.
Countless streams of natural energy were forcibly drawn toward the formation.
Massive amounts of energy continuously gathered at the core.
The natural energy throughout the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land immediately erupted into violent chaos.
Countless experts sensed the abnormality.
They were completely stunned.
"This is bad!"
"Someone is extracting the energy of the entire forbidden land!"
"Is it the expert undergoing the tribulation?"
"It doesn’t look like it!"
"A method this powerful can probably only be used by a T8 powerhouse!"
"The Sacred Origin Forbidden Land may be destroyed!"
"The most terrifying thing is that the phenomenon still hasn’t disappeared!"
"The Cosmic Tribulation may continue!"
"Hiss..."
"How long has this already lasted?"
"Don’t tell me he’s going to keep undergoing tribulations forever!"
"This is terrifying!"
"My understanding of cultivation is about to collapse!"
"Everyone else undergoes one tribulation at a time, but this powerhouse is surviving them consecutively!"
"Can you believe this?"
"I finally understand the difference between people like us and true geniuses."
Daniel was not only using the energy to strengthen his Divine Soul.
His physical body was also being reforged.
As his comprehension of laws advanced, he could now temper and reconstruct an even stronger physical body.
Naturally, this step required an even greater amount of energy.
"If I completely finish tempering my physical body as well, I’m afraid the entire Sacred Origin Forbidden Land will be drained dry by me."
A smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
Yet he still decisively chose to temper his physical body with everything he had.
The most valuable thing within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had always been the Peerless Grand Formation.
But at this point, the formation could barely continue functioning.
It might not even be capable of resisting the fourth Cosmic Tribulation.
If that was the case—
Then what was the point of keeping it?
If it was destroyed, so be it.
Having made his decision, Daniel decisively unleashed his Strength and began refining his physical body at full force.
The next instant—
The Peerless Grand Formation began operating at maximum capacity.
In only a moment, it drained an enormous portion of the energy stored throughout the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
And this action immediately caused an enormous disturbance.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 -512-A Drastic Change in the Forbidden Land
paragraphs: At this moment, countless formations and restrictive arts throughout the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land suddenly stopped functioning.
Immediately afterward, they began collapsing on a massive scale.
The countless treasures scattered throughout the forbidden land also began disintegrating one after another.
They transformed into incomparably pure energy and surged toward the Peerless Grand Formation.
Even the spiritual energy of the treasure land itself began rapidly drying up.
All of it was converted into enormous quantities of energy and absorbed by the Peerless Grand Formation.
At the formation core, the energy surrounding Daniel gradually began turning into mist.
Seven-colored clouds completely enveloped him, radiating dazzling multicolored brilliance.
The mist-like energy then rapidly liquefied, condensing into droplets of extraordinarily pure seven-colored liquid.
Each droplet was crystal clear.
And the amount of energy contained within a single drop was comparable to all the life energy required to sustain an entire small-world plane.
As time passed, those seven-colored droplets accumulated into a pool.
The pool gradually expanded into a pond.
The pond became a lake.
The lake grew into a vast river.
And the river continued spreading until, eventually, it transformed into an endless ocean.
The ocean stretched beyond sight.
Seven-colored radiance could be seen everywhere.
And more energy was still continuously gathering.
The sheer amount of energy contained within this terrifying ocean was so enormous that even the total energy reserves of an entire starfield could not compare.
Daniel’s body seemed like a sponge without any upper limit.
It hungrily devoured everything around him.
Like an infant that had been starving for days, Daniel frantically absorbed every trace of energy surrounding him.
At this moment, he had practically transformed into a black hole.
Such an enormous amount of energy continued pouring into Daniel without pause.
Yet he showed absolutely no sign of reaching his limit.
His Divine Soul continuously expanded as it absorbed the energy.
Almost every second brought tremendous growth.
Even his physical body was being reforged at the same time, greedily absorbing the terrifying energy contained within the ocean.
Daniel thoroughly enjoyed the sensation of becoming stronger every moment.
What he did not know was that the outside world had already undergone a complete transformation.
Because the core formation was frantically extracting every trace of surrounding energy, all restrictions throughout the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had completely disappeared.
At the same time, all of the treasures and opportunities that had once existed here were gone.
The forbidden land was rapidly turning into nothing more than an ordinary stretch of ground.
Countless experts who had previously been concealed by formations and restrictions were now exposed.
And among all these ordinary experts, Daniel’s location naturally became extraordinarily conspicuous.
Previously, the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land itself had concealed the region where Daniel was located.
But now, ninety percent of the entire forbidden land had already been destroyed.
Only the remaining core region still existed.
Naturally, Daniel could no longer remain completely hidden.
His location was gradually revealed.
However, because the core formation still surrounded the area, although many experts realized something was wrong, most still had no idea who exactly was undergoing the tribulation inside.
Grand Oracle Shamir stared toward the distant core region.
At this moment, his emotions were incomparably excited.
"I’m the only one who knows who is inside."
"It must be Daniel."
"It can only be him."
"The most valuable thing inside the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land was that tribulation formation."
"But now, the formation has already lost most of its usefulness."
"It may not even be able to withstand the fourth Cosmic Tribulation."
"If that is the case, there is no reason to preserve it."
"Might as well destroy it completely."
Daniel decisively began refining his physical body.
The tribulation formation immediately entered full-capacity operation.
In an instant, it drained practically all of the remaining energy throughout the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The consequences were enormous.
Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The outer region of the core formation was completely surrounded by dense seven-colored mist.
Combined with the restrictions still maintained by the formation itself, even a high-grade Oracle-grade expert could not see who was inside.
"Faustus was brought here by me."
Grand Oracle Shamir had searched everywhere but had been unable to find Daniel.
There was only one possible explanation.
The powerhouse undergoing the tribulation was definitely him.
Previously, Grand Oracle Shamir had only been speculating.
Even when reporting the matter to the Holy Golden Mountain, he had always used words such as "suspected."
But now—
He was one hundred percent certain.
The expert undergoing the tribulation was Faustus!
The strongest and most outstanding genius of the younger generation within the Holy Golden Mountain.
"The greater Faustus’s potential, the more beneficial it will be for the Holy Golden Mountain."
Grand Oracle Shamir fell into deep thought.
"Especially now."
"The spacetime of the Myriad Races Universe has already been locked."
"The flow of time has accelerated."
"The universe itself is rapidly approaching the end of its lifespan."
"The future will inevitably be filled with chaos."
"As long as Faustus remains, the Holy Golden Mountain will have a future."
Grand Oracle Shamir held a high position within the Holy Golden Mountain.
Naturally, he understood its internal situation extremely well.
At present, quite a few high-grade Oracle-grade experts were already considering leaving the Holy Golden Mountain.
After all, the Myriad Races Universe itself was about to cease existing.
Their home would soon be gone.
Naturally, they needed to find somewhere else to live.
Factions from other universes were capable of offering extremely generous conditions.
Those offers were incredibly tempting.
Even if the high-grade Oracle-grade experts chose to leave the Holy Golden Mountain, no one could truly blame them.
Even Grand Oracle Shamir himself had already begun considering a path of retreat.
There was simply no helping it.
Throughout history, universes approaching the end of their lifespan had mostly ended up this way.
Ordinary living beings could only await their fate.
But powerful experts had choices.
They could simply move to another universe.
As a result, many factions belonging to dying universes would collapse overnight.
The Holy Golden Mountain might eventually suffer the same fate.
But Daniel’s existence gave the Holy Golden Mountain hope of surviving beyond the destruction of the Myriad Races Universe.
Of course—
That depended on Daniel choosing not to leave the Holy Golden Mountain.
Meanwhile, countless experts from other universes, including Eternal Grade powerhouses, were still watching closely.
Daniel’s monstrous performance, combined with the bizarre spectacle of the Cosmic Tribulation seemingly refusing to stop until one side was destroyed, left them endlessly astonished.
Good grief.
Treatment like this was probably unprecedented throughout the entire recorded history of the Endless Starfield.
"Countless powerhouses are watching him undergo his tribulation."
"This guy’s treatment is unbelievable."
"Of course."
"Even the Eternal Ancestor of my clan is paying close attention."
"When I underwent my own tribulation, nobody cared this much."
"How could you possibly compare?"
"An existence this monstrous will inevitably affect the direction of the entire current spacetime in the future."
"Fortunately, only one or two beings like this appear across countless eras and timelines."
"If monsters like this kept appearing one after another, the rest of us might as well give up cultivating."
"The pressure would be unbearable."
Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The ocean-like energy surrounding Daniel was visibly shrinking.
Bit by bit, almost all of it was absorbed into his body.
"I’m feeling a little... bloated."
At this moment, the vast ocean of energy surrounding Daniel had completely disappeared.
Only faint mist remained.
That enormous ocean had actually been entirely devoured by him.
Daniel felt a swelling pain coming from his Divine Soul.
Even his physical body felt painfully bloated.
He almost felt as though his entire body had expanded several times over.
That was hardly surprising.
After all, the energy contained within that ocean had reached the level of an entire starfield.
It represented the combined energy reserves of a whole starfield!
One step beyond that—
Would be Universe Tier.
Just how terrifying was such an amount of energy?
And Daniel had absorbed all of it by himself.
How could he possibly not feel bloated?
At this moment, even every breath Daniel exhaled contained an enormous amount of energy.
A single breath from him could forcibly cause a Half-Saint to explode.
The energy contained within just one cycle of his breathing was enough to nurture a World Fragment until it developed into a complete small world.
That was how terrifying Daniel had become.

"The universe itself is rapidly approaching the end of its lifespan."
"The future will inevitably be filled with chaos."
"As long as Faustus remains, the Holy Golden Mountain will have a future."
Grand Oracle Shamir held a high position within the Holy Golden Mountain.
Naturally, he understood its internal situation extremely well.
At present, quite a few high-grade Oracle-grade experts were already considering leaving the Holy Golden Mountain.
After all, the Myriad Races Universe itself was about to cease existing.
Their home would soon be gone.
Naturally, they needed to find somewhere else to live.
Factions from other universes were capable of offering extremely generous conditions.
Those offers were incredibly tempting.
Even if the high-grade Oracle-grade experts chose to leave the Holy Golden Mountain, no one could truly blame them.
Even Grand Oracle Shamir himself had already begun considering a path of retreat.
There was simply no helping it.
Throughout history, universes approaching the end of their lifespan had mostly ended up this way.
Ordinary living beings could only await their fate.
But powerful experts had choices.
They could simply move to another universe.
As a result, many factions belonging to dying universes would collapse overnight.
The Holy Golden Mountain might eventually suffer the same fate.
But Daniel’s existence gave the Holy Golden Mountain hope of surviving beyond the destruction of the Myriad Races Universe.
Of course—
That depended on Daniel choosing not to leave the Holy Golden Mountain.
Meanwhile, countless experts from other universes, including Eternal Grade powerhouses, were still watching closely.
Daniel’s monstrous performance, combined with the bizarre spectacle of the Cosmic Tribulation seemingly refusing to stop until one side was destroyed, left them endlessly astonished.
Good grief.
Treatment like this was probably unprecedented throughout the entire recorded history of the Endless Starfield.
"Countless powerhouses are watching him undergo his tribulation."
"This guy’s treatment is unbelievable."
"Of course."
"Even the Eternal Ancestor of my clan is paying close attention."
"When I underwent my own tribulation, nobody cared this much."
"How could you possibly compare?"
"An existence this monstrous will inevitably affect the direction of the entire current spacetime in the future."
"Fortunately, only one or two beings like this appear across countless eras and timelines."
"If monsters like this kept appearing one after another, the rest of us might as well give up cultivating."
"The pressure would be unbearable."
Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The ocean-like energy surrounding Daniel was visibly shrinking.
Bit by bit, almost all of it was absorbed into his body.
"I’m feeling a little... bloated."
At this moment, the vast ocean of energy surrounding Daniel had completely disappeared.
Only faint mist remained.
That enormous ocean had actually been entirely devoured by him.
Daniel felt a swelling pain coming from his Divine Soul.
Even his physical body felt painfully bloated.
He almost felt as though his entire body had expanded several times over.
That was hardly surprising.
After all, the energy contained within that ocean had reached the level of an entire starfield.
It represented the combined energy reserves of a whole starfield!
One step beyond that—
Would be Universe Tier.
Just how terrifying was such an amount of energy?
And Daniel had absorbed all of it by himself.
How could he possibly not feel bloated?
At this moment, even every breath Daniel exhaled contained an enormous amount of energy.
A single breath from him could forcibly cause a Half-Saint to explode.
The energy contained within just one cycle of his breathing was enough to nurture a World Fragment until it developed into a complete small world.
That was how terrifying Daniel had become.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 -513-Shocking the Entire Universe
paragraphs: After absorbing such an enormous amount of energy, Daniel refined all of it.
Only then did the bloated, stagnant feeling inside him ease slightly.
He silently wondered,
"Just how strong am I now?"
Daniel carefully sensed the quality of his Divine Soul.
After undergoing yet another round of enhancement, that vast and terrifying Divine Soul had already reached a level where a single thought from him could destroy an entire world.
For Daniel, destroying a world now required nothing more than a thought.
Even a blade of grass or a single strand of hair, once held in Daniel’s hand, would be enough to sever an entire star river.
His physical body had also evolved to an unimaginably terrifying level.
Every movement he made now carried power capable of destroying worlds.
He did not even need to deliberately activate a Sacred Art.
Corresponding supernatural powers would naturally radiate from his every action.
Even if Daniel merely stared at a star, that star could be destroyed in an instant.
The world around it could collapse along with it.
Daniel drew in a deep breath and silently thought,
"I can even begin cultivating the Third Eye Clan’s innate Sacred Art now—the Myriad Treasure Eye."
The thought had only just appeared when Daniel’s forehead immediately began changing.
A dazzling Mystic Eye emerged directly between his brows.
The eye remained tightly closed.
Yet even without opening, endless Sacred Art pressure continuously radiated from it.
With all of its laws restrained and hidden within, the pressure became even more terrifying.
If the eye were actually opened...
No one knew just how frightening its power would become.
This third eye was both the innate talent of the Third Eye Clan and Daniel’s newest Sacred Art.
Back then, Sophis had relied heavily on cultivating this third eye to its absolute limit while at high-grade Oracle-grade.
The moment the eye opened, it could instantly kill virtually any Oracle-grade opponent of the same Rank.
It had been Sophis’s most terrifying trump card.
And now that Daniel had completely fused with the memories of Sophis, that high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse, he could clearly sense the full cultivation method of the Mystic Eye.
In other words, Daniel’s current Mystic Eye had effectively already reached the perfect state corresponding to T8 Oracle-grade.
And that was not all.
The Sacred Arts Sophis had once mastered could now also be manifested casually by Daniel.
This was one of the greatest benefits of having completely inherited the entire legacy.
With a single thought, the system panel related to the Mystic Eye appeared before him.
[Third Eye Clan Mystic Eye]
[Effects]:
[1. Crimson Light]
Using one’s blood essence and spiritual essence as the catalyst, the Mystic Eye can refract a pair of crimson rays.
The rays can inflict massive damage on a target while simultaneously replenishing the user’s own losses, restoring the user to a complete state.
[2. White Light]
Allows the user to traverse spacetime and break through restrictions.
All forms of confinement and obstruction become meaningless before it, with the upper limit determined by the user’s eyesight.
[3. Black Light]
Inflicts damage directly upon the target’s Divine Soul.
The amount of damage is equivalent to the user’s own Strength.
[4. Gray Light]
Inflicts massive damage upon the target’s physical body.
The amount of damage is likewise equivalent to the user’s own Strength.
[5. Crimson, Yellow, Green, Blue, and Purple Light]
Can imprison all actions within the user’s field of vision, rendering the target completely unable to move.
[6. Transformation at Will]
The Mystic Eye can separate from the current physical body and construct an independent Mystic Eye Body.
Its growth has no upper limit.
[Introduction]:
The Third Eye Clan’s Mystic Eye talent is both a Sacred Art and a special innate ability.
When cultivated to the absolute limit, it can break through the restrictions of the current universe and condense into an Eye of the Universe.
It may even surpass the original Eye of the Universe in strength.
Daniel had long since known every special effect of the Mystic Eye.
Aside from Sophis himself, Daniel was probably the person most familiar with it.
Throughout the history of the Third Eye Clan, no T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse had ever appeared.
Sophis had been the strongest Oracle-grade expert the Third Eye Clan had ever produced.
Daniel, however, had inherited his complete legacy.
As a result, the Mystic Eye Daniel refined emerged from the very beginning in its most perfect state.
He did not need to experiment.
He did not need to explore its cultivation path.
Daniel even knew what its T9 Oracle-grade form would look like.
Boom!
At that moment, the cosmic phenomenon changed once again.
The fourth Cosmic Tribulation was faintly beginning to form.
This time, the phenomenon was somewhat different.
It seemed to be condensing into its strongest possible state.
In other words—
This would be the final Cosmic Tribulation.
As long as Daniel survived it, this entire chain of tribulations would truly come to an end.
The Eye of the Universe began frantically absorbing the surrounding phenomenon.
The phenomenon was quickly swallowed into the eye.
Then—
The Eye of the Universe actually closed.
But at that exact moment—
An incomparably terrifying pressure erupted from it.
Countless experts watching from far away immediately felt chills rise from the depths of their souls.
The stronger they were, the more clearly they sensed the danger.
Even though the Eye of the Universe was closed, they felt as though some horrifying existence had locked its gaze onto them.
If they did not leave immediately, they might face a calamity of life and death.
Whoosh!
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The high-grade Oracle-grade experts did not dare remain.
The instant warning signs appeared in their hearts, they fled the area at maximum speed.
"This is terrifying!"
"Even when I underwent my own tribulation, I never felt pressure like this!"
"Strange."
"Why is the Cosmic Tribulation driving us away?"
"Could this tribulation be fundamentally different from the others?"
"Run!"
"Run!"
"The Universal Will has gone insane!"
In an instant, the region surrounding the core formation was completely emptied.
Within a radius of hundreds of millions of miles, Daniel became the only expert remaining.
Under the pressure of the Eye of the Universe, even high-grade Oracle-grade experts had fled without hesitation.
Now, within that enormous region, only Daniel remained.
The fourth Cosmic Tribulation was that terrifying.
Even high-grade Oracle-grade experts found it horrifying.
"I really wonder who is undergoing this tribulation."
"If I had faced something this terrifying back then, I would have dropped to my knees immediately."
"I’d be dead!"
"This is ridiculous!"
"Who could possibly withstand something like this?"
"As long as this expert survives the Cosmic Tribulation, the Endless Starfield will gain yet another terrifying tribulation-surviving powerhouse!"
Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The tightly closed Eye of the Universe suddenly opened.
Daniel had already been on full alert.
He had sensed that the Cosmic Tribulation was about to descend.
But the instant the Eye of the Universe opened—
Daniel felt the world spin around him.
Spacetime overturned.
Countless images appeared one after another.
It was as though an enormous screen had been forced directly in front of Daniel, compelling him to watch everything displayed upon it.
Daniel drew in a sharp breath.
"It’s a Heart Demon Tribulation!"
"The fourth Cosmic Tribulation is actually a Heart Demon Tribulation!"
The true strength of a powerhouse did not lie solely in powerful laws and Sacred Arts.
Nor did it lie merely in a terrifying physical body or countless tribulation treasures.
It also depended on possessing a clear Dao Heart.
A heart free from attachment.
Without flaws.
Without obstructions.
Without leakage.
Without deficiency.
Powerful laws and Sacred Arts could often be acquired.
A terrifying physical body could be tempered.
External treasures could be accumulated.
But achieving a truly clear and flawless Dao Heart was incomparably difficult.
Throughout history, countless monstrous geniuses had risen.
Some had amazed an entire era.
Others had dazzled several eras in succession.
They were incomparably powerful.
Yet before a Heart Demon Tribulation, many of them were no different from ordinary living beings.
That was precisely what made the Heart Demon Tribulation so terrifying.
The tribulation itself possessed no fixed power.
Its strength depended entirely on the cultivator’s own Dao Heart.
If the Dao Heart held no flaws, the Heart Demon Tribulation would be easy.
But if the Dao Heart contained a weakness—
Then the Heart Demon Tribulation would become an enormous boulder blocking the cultivator’s path forward.
No matter how monstrous their talent was—
No matter how dazzling they had once been—
They would not be able to cross it.
At best, they would remain trapped at that stage for the rest of their lives.
At worst—
Their Dao Heart would collapse.
Their body and Dao would perish.
And they would destroy themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 -514-Four Consecutive Tribulations
paragraphs: And this was merely an ordinary Heart Demon Tribulation.
Naturally, Daniel’s Heart Demon Tribulation would not possess the power of some ordinary Golden-grade tribulation.
The Cosmic Tribulation constructed specifically for him was bound to be an incomparably terrifying, heaven-defying existence.
Daniel silently wondered,
"What kind of Heart Demon Tribulation will appear before me?"
Just as the thought crossed his mind, Daniel suddenly realized that he had returned to the world before his rebirth.
Yes.
Everything before him felt both familiar and unfamiliar.
The surroundings were unmistakably familiar.
This was definitely Earth.
Around him were countless players who filled him with both nostalgia and despair.
There were also ruins where countless buildings had once been destroyed.
And yet—
Everything had returned to the way it once was.
Even the cold corpses that had once covered the ground were gone.
What made everything feel unfamiliar was the sheer amount of time that had passed since Daniel had last allowed himself to remember this place.
He had never imagined that the Cosmic Tribulation would recreate it all.
It had directly torn open the scars Daniel had buried deep within his memories long ago.
Daniel had once believed that he had already forgotten everything about this place.
But now, every trace of his current Strength had disappeared.
He could no longer sense any of the power he had accumulated throughout his journey.
His Oracle-grade Divine Soul.
His ultimate physical body.
His laws and Sacred Arts.
His Oracle-grade supreme treasures.
Everything was gone.
It was as though all of it had merely been part of an extremely long dream.
And only now had he finally returned to his true reality.
The magic and combat techniques he had once known remained familiar.
So did the strength he had possessed at peak god-grade.
But the mage robes...
The staffs...
Even his former pet, Beiming Bingyang...
All of them were gone.
Yet the memories were so vivid that Daniel found himself dazed for a brief moment.
Then his eyes suddenly sharpened.
He repeatedly reminded himself,
"I am Faustus."
"I am the absolute genius player who rose to the summit of the Endless Starfield."
"I am the strongest Half-Saint."
"I suppressed tribulation-level Divine-grade powerhouses."
"I survived three consecutive Cosmic Tribulations."
"I killed more Oracle-grade experts than I can even remember."
"I am Faustus."
"This is nothing more than a Heart Demon Tribulation."
"Everything here is merely a script constructed for me by the Universal Will."
But just as Daniel thought this, he faintly sensed that something was wrong.
His memories seemed to contain subtle discrepancies.
Would a Golden-grade Heart Demon Tribulation really allow him to retain all of his previous memories?
Could it possibly be that simple?
Of course not.
Daniel had already inherited the memories of a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse like Sophis.
Naturally, he had also experienced memories relating to Heart Demon Tribulations.
Back when Sophis had been advancing toward T8 Oracle-grade, he too had encountered such a Cosmic Tribulation.
During Sophis’s Heart Demon Tribulation, he had been forced to personally witness the experts of his Northern Crown Clan having their eyes gouged out before their corpses were burned.
Yet Sophis, as a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse, had relied on his extraordinary conviction and willpower to suppress his heart demons.
He successfully survived that Cosmic Tribulation and directly stepped into T8 Oracle-grade.
And Daniel?
Daniel already possessed experience with situations like this.
He immediately understood.
"So right now, I’ve effectively entered a spacetime created specifically for me."
"This spacetime is wrapped in the illusion of my previous life."
"But in reality, my Strength has not truly disappeared."
"As long as I successfully survive the tribulation, I will immediately recover everything."
"The most dangerous part is that my emotions must remain completely stable."
"If I lose control, the heart demon will truly invade me."
"Everything I see in this illusion will gradually become real."
"And when that happens, my true Dao Heart will shatter."
"I’ll die inside this Heart Demon Tribulation."
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
The Universal Will was insidious.
The reason Daniel had fought so relentlessly in this life—
The reason his motivation had seemed endless—
Was because of the trauma of his previous life.
He had watched the world collapse.
He had watched humanity approach extinction.
And he had been powerless to stop any of it.
That was precisely why, after being reborn, Daniel had possessed such endless fighting spirit.
The Universal Will wanted to strike directly at the root.
It wanted to destroy Daniel’s heart from its very foundation.
That was the sinister nature of a Cosmic Tribulation.
"So all I need to do is remain true to myself."
Daniel understood.
Other Cosmic Tribulations could be resisted through external Strength.
One could rely on treasures.
One could even endure them head-on.
But a Heart Demon Tribulation was different.
Pretending would not work.
Acting would not work.
In fact, doing so would only make things worse.
The only solution was genuine clarity of the heart.
True freedom from attachment.
Like an enlightened monk facing temptation.
Form is emptiness.
Emptiness is form.
"Emptiness."
Daniel spoke softly.
"The emptiness of this moment exists so that the future will not be empty."
If he could not truly let go now—
Then in the future, he would genuinely lose everything.
Daniel looked around once more.
This time, his heart was as still as water.
Void creatures invaded Earth.
Humanity’s armies fought desperately against them.
Countless human powerhouses died in battle.
Daniel was also a member of humanity’s forces.
Around him were comrades and fellow humans.
Some came from completely different homelands.
Some had never even known each other before this war.
But in order to save human civilization—
They now stood together.
Watching one another’s backs.
The void creatures seemed endless.
They were powerful.
Terrifying.
The human warriors fought with everything they had, willing to sacrifice their lives just to hold the line.
Wave after wave of Daniel’s comrades fell around him.
Yet Daniel remained unmoved.
Eventually, Daniel’s conspicuous, statue-like figure attracted the anger of the soldiers nearby.
"Hey!"
"Which legion are you from?"
"Why are you just standing there instead of fighting?"
A god-grade powerhouse approached and glared furiously at Daniel.
"Hmm?"
Daniel slowly raised his eyelids and gave him an indifferent glance.
Then he spoke coldly.
"Get lost."
The human powerhouse who had shouted at him immediately froze.
Then his anger erupted.
"You coward!"
"Do you even know where you are right now?"
"This is a battlefield!"
"A battlefield!"
He repeated the word several times.
His eyes had already turned bloodshot.
"Behind you is human civilization!"
"In front of you are the evil non-human races!"
"This is a place where countless humans die every single minute!"
"You are a human warrior!"
"You are supposed to be fighting for humanity!"
"You bastard!"
Daniel remained completely unmoved.
He calmly repeated,
"Get lost."
"Bastard..."
The powerhouse looked at Daniel with utter contempt.
"You’re a peak god-grade powerhouse."
"Your military rank is even higher than mine."
"And yet once you step onto the battlefield, all you know how to do is stand around like an idiot!"
"You’re not even worthy to compare with those demigods, epic-grade warriors, and legendary experts who willingly sacrifice their lives!"
"Pah!"
"I look down on you!"
Daniel ignored him.
Then—
He moved.
Daniel began walking toward the endless tide of void creatures.
But his posture did not resemble someone preparing for battle.
Instead, he walked as casually as though he were taking a leisurely stroll.
"Heart Demon Tribulation."
"I will not give you an opportunity."
Daniel walked extremely slowly.
Yet every step was incomparably firm.
He continued toward the void creatures.
All around him were sounds of slaughter.
Battle cries.
Screams.
Despair.
A void creature was killed by a group of players working together.
Its corpse crashed directly onto the ground in front of Daniel.

Daniel had already inherited the memories of a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse like Sophis.
Naturally, he had also experienced memories relating to Heart Demon Tribulations.
Back when Sophis had been advancing toward T8 Oracle-grade, he too had encountered such a Cosmic Tribulation.
During Sophis’s Heart Demon Tribulation, he had been forced to personally witness the experts of his Northern Crown Clan having their eyes gouged out before their corpses were burned.
Yet Sophis, as a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse, had relied on his extraordinary conviction and willpower to suppress his heart demons.
He successfully survived that Cosmic Tribulation and directly stepped into T8 Oracle-grade.
And Daniel?
Daniel already possessed experience with situations like this.
He immediately understood.
"So right now, I’ve effectively entered a spacetime created specifically for me."
"This spacetime is wrapped in the illusion of my previous life."
"But in reality, my Strength has not truly disappeared."
"As long as I successfully survive the tribulation, I will immediately recover everything."
"The most dangerous part is that my emotions must remain completely stable."
"If I lose control, the heart demon will truly invade me."
"Everything I see in this illusion will gradually become real."
"And when that happens, my true Dao Heart will shatter."
"I’ll die inside this Heart Demon Tribulation."
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
The Universal Will was insidious.
The reason Daniel had fought so relentlessly in this life—
The reason his motivation had seemed endless—
Was because of the trauma of his previous life.
He had watched the world collapse.
He had watched humanity approach extinction.
And he had been powerless to stop any of it.
That was precisely why, after being reborn, Daniel had possessed such endless fighting spirit.
The Universal Will wanted to strike directly at the root.
It wanted to destroy Daniel’s heart from its very foundation.
That was the sinister nature of a Cosmic Tribulation.
"So all I need to do is remain true to myself."
Daniel understood.
Other Cosmic Tribulations could be resisted through external Strength.
One could rely on treasures.
One could even endure them head-on.
But a Heart Demon Tribulation was different.
Pretending would not work.
Acting would not work.
In fact, doing so would only make things worse.
The only solution was genuine clarity of the heart.
True freedom from attachment.
Like an enlightened monk facing temptation.
Form is emptiness.
Emptiness is form.
"Emptiness."
Daniel spoke softly.
"The emptiness of this moment exists so that the future will not be empty."
If he could not truly let go now—
Then in the future, he would genuinely lose everything.
Daniel looked around once more.
This time, his heart was as still as water.
Void creatures invaded Earth.
Humanity’s armies fought desperately against them.
Countless human powerhouses died in battle.
Daniel was also a member of humanity’s forces.
Around him were comrades and fellow humans.
Some came from completely different homelands.
Some had never even known each other before this war.
But in order to save human civilization—
They now stood together.
Watching one another’s backs.
The void creatures seemed endless.
They were powerful.
Terrifying.
The human warriors fought with everything they had, willing to sacrifice their lives just to hold the line.
Wave after wave of Daniel’s comrades fell around him.
Yet Daniel remained unmoved.
Eventually, Daniel’s conspicuous, statue-like figure attracted the anger of the soldiers nearby.
"Hey!"
"Which legion are you from?"
"Why are you just standing there instead of fighting?"
A god-grade powerhouse approached and glared furiously at Daniel.
"Hmm?"
Daniel slowly raised his eyelids and gave him an indifferent glance.
Then he spoke coldly.
"Get lost."
The human powerhouse who had shouted at him immediately froze.
Then his anger erupted.
"You coward!"
"Do you even know where you are right now?"
"This is a battlefield!"
"A battlefield!"
He repeated the word several times.
His eyes had already turned bloodshot.
"Behind you is human civilization!"
"In front of you are the evil non-human races!"
"This is a place where countless humans die every single minute!"
"You are a human warrior!"
"You are supposed to be fighting for humanity!"
"You bastard!"
Daniel remained completely unmoved.
He calmly repeated,
"Get lost."
"Bastard..."
The powerhouse looked at Daniel with utter contempt.
"You’re a peak god-grade powerhouse."
"Your military rank is even higher than mine."
"And yet once you step onto the battlefield, all you know how to do is stand around like an idiot!"
"You’re not even worthy to compare with those demigods, epic-grade warriors, and legendary experts who willingly sacrifice their lives!"
"Pah!"
"I look down on you!"
Daniel ignored him.
Then—
He moved.
Daniel began walking toward the endless tide of void creatures.
But his posture did not resemble someone preparing for battle.
Instead, he walked as casually as though he were taking a leisurely stroll.
"Heart Demon Tribulation."
"I will not give you an opportunity."
Daniel walked extremely slowly.
Yet every step was incomparably firm.
He continued toward the void creatures.
All around him were sounds of slaughter.
Battle cries.
Screams.
Despair.
A void creature was killed by a group of players working together.
Its corpse crashed directly onto the ground in front of Daniel.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 -515-Who Can Rival Him?
paragraphs: Daniel did not even spare the corpse a glance.
He simply stepped over it and continued forward.
Everything about his demeanor made one thing perfectly clear—
He did not care.
His expression remained incomparably calm and relaxed.
It was almost as though he were watching some outdated comedy desperately trying to make its audience laugh, only for the entire production to come across as crude and poorly made.
His body was completely relaxed.
He did not look like someone standing in the middle of a battlefield at all.
Instead, he seemed as comfortable as if he were inside his own home.
Daniel blended into the battlefield and continued walking forward as though he were merely taking a casual stroll.
The tense, bloody atmosphere surrounding him meant nothing.
The so-called despair of the battlefield could not affect him in the slightest.
The contrast was so extreme that anyone watching would probably feel themselves going mad.
And yet Daniel merely continued walking calmly toward the void creatures.
He murmured,
"I am an Oracle-grade existence."
"I am not some ordinary peak Divine-grade."
"My Dao Heart may not be completely enlightened, but it possesses no filth, no deficiencies, and no obstructions."
"My Dao Heart contains only one thing."
"Battle."
Strictly speaking, Daniel’s Dao Heart contained many flaws.
He could become furious because of conflict.
He could lose himself in the madness of battle.
He had never truly seen through the attachments of the mortal world.
Greed.
Anger.
Obsession.
Love.
Resentment.
Hatred.
Daniel had experienced every single one of them.
Yet all of those flaws were suppressed by something else.
His gold-grade heart.
The weakness created by the Heart Demon Tribulation was attempting to break through Daniel’s gold-grade heart.
The spacetime constructed by the Cosmic Tribulation wanted Daniel to become angry.
It wanted him to sink into this illusion.
It wanted him to accomplish everything that his former self had once failed to do.
It wanted him to experience the satisfaction of changing the past.
It would even allow Daniel to become humanity’s savior if necessary.
Anything, as long as Daniel exposed the weakest point of his gold-grade heart.
But Daniel did not care.
He only wanted to fight.
If Daniel followed the script originally prepared by the Cosmic Tribulation, he might eventually become humanity’s savior.
Perhaps he would even become the greatest hero in all of human history.
An existence worshiped by countless generations.
But if he did that—
He would truly have fallen into the Cosmic Tribulation’s trap.
Daniel naturally had no intention of doing so.
Humanity did not need him to save them.
Nor did he want to become some kind of savior.
As far as Daniel was concerned, as long as he successfully survived this tribulation and became Oracle-grade, humanity would naturally continue growing stronger.
In other words—
Everything happening in this spacetime, including the war between humanity and the void creatures, was precisely what was truly obstructing humanity’s future development.
From the very beginning, Daniel had only one true opponent.
The Cosmic Tribulation itself.
Daniel continued walking forward with an indifferent expression.
He passed through the crowd and stepped over corpse after corpse.
Wherever he passed, human powerhouses gradually stopped what they were doing and stared at his departing back.
Confusion appeared on their faces.
"Why isn’t he fighting?"
"Has that guy gone insane?"
"Maybe."
"I heard every major war drives quite a few experts mad."
"Where is he even going?"
"The front is completely filled with void creatures."
"If he keeps going, he’ll die."
"Who knows?"
"Maybe he wants to die."
"He’s pretty strong, too."
"It would be a pity if someone like him really developed a heart demon and threw his life away."
"Exactly."
"He’s a peak Divine-grade powerhouse."
"For someone like that to die this way would be such a waste."
Daniel acted as though he had heard nothing.
He simply continued walking forward.
Strangely enough, although an intense battle was raging ahead, not a single creature managed to enter within three meters of Daniel.
It was as though the entire battlefield had deliberately excluded him.
Whenever a void creature noticed Daniel and attempted to attack him, a human expert would always arrive at exactly the right moment and intercept it.
The outcomes suffered by those human experts were often extraordinarily tragic.
But in Daniel’s eyes—
All of it was no different from air.
Things became even stranger after Daniel entered the territory occupied by the void creatures.
The countless void creatures seemed completely incapable of seeing him.
They did not even bother pretending anymore.
They simply walked around Daniel.
The corners of Daniel’s mouth rose into a faint smile.
He continued all the way to the center of the void creature army.
Then he floated into the air.
Sat down cross-legged.
And slowly closed his eyes.
Cultivation.
In the outside world—
The void creatures slaughtered humanity.
Earth was destroyed.
Then countless void creatures surrounded Daniel from every direction, staring at him with predatory gazes.
Yet not a single one attacked him.
At this moment, Daniel resembled a stone statue.
No one knew how much time passed.
Eventually, the figures of the countless void creatures gradually began fading.
Until they disappeared completely.
The space around Daniel cracked inch by inch.
Then shattered.
Everything returned to normal.
It was still the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
Still the center of the now-abandoned formation.
Still the region surrounded by dense mist.
Daniel slowly opened his eyes.
He could sense that the Cosmic Tribulation had ended.
At the same time, the phenomenon throughout spacetime began changing.
The Eye of the Universe stared coldly at Daniel one final time.
Then, unwillingly—
It dissipated.
The Heart Demon Tribulation had ended!
The Multiple Cosmic Tribulation had ended!
Tribulation successfully survived!
Daniel was now a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse!
"Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
Feeling his Strength increase once again, Daniel showed no surprise whatsoever.
The Heart Demon Tribulation had appeared utterly ordinary.
Anyone watching from the outside might even think—
That was it?
But only Daniel himself understood how dangerous it had truly been.
From the moment Daniel began growing stronger until now, he had spent nearly his entire journey fighting.
The Universal Will had believed it could use that to stir up Daniel’s gold-grade heart.
What it had failed to anticipate was that Daniel had already experienced a Cosmic Heart Demon Tribulation through Sophis’s inherited memories.
He already possessed experience.
That was why he had remained unmoved.
Daniel understood that his true opponent had never been the void creatures.
It was the Cosmic Tribulation itself.
As long as he successfully survived this tribulation, humanity’s player population would become stronger.
On the other hand—
If Daniel died, or even suffered significant damage, humanity would face an incomparably miserable future.
Daniel’s gold-grade Dao was not merely about fighting for the sake of fighting.
Just as destruction did not exist merely for the sake of destruction.
Destruction could exist for protection.
Daniel’s battles were the same.
He fought in order to protect.
If all he cared about was endless conflict and slaughter, then he would simply be a madman.
Not a normal person.
Among all Daniel’s tribulations, the Heart Demon Tribulation had appeared to be the easiest.
In reality—
It had been the hardest.
Fortunately, he had finally crossed this hurdle.
"It’s over."
"I successfully survived the tribulation."
"I wonder when the next Cosmic Tribulation will come."
With that thought, Daniel finally looked around.
Only now did he realize that his surroundings had completely changed.
The entire forbidden land had disappeared.
Its original appearance had been exposed.
Within a radius of hundreds of millions of miles, Daniel was the only living expert remaining.
"So it really was destroyed."
Daniel could not help laughing.
For some reason, places he visited occasionally seemed to end up like this.
Back when he entered the Evolution Realm, the same thing had happened.
In the end, the entire Evolution Realm had transformed into his Sacred Art—
Primordial Chaos.
And now the forbidden land had suffered a similar fate.
All of its essence and energy had been absorbed by him.
"Now that I’ve successfully survived the tribulation and become Oracle-grade..."
Daniel suddenly remembered the special mission.
"The special mission said that after I completed my tribulation, a powerhouse named Kru would come to challenge me."
"And Supreme Saint Miral would also appear."
"I need to defeat Kru."
"Then I must make Supreme Saint Miral take action and stop the abnormal flow of time within the Myriad Races Universe, restoring the universe to normal."
"As for the mission reward..."
"A fragment of the Universal Will."
