chapters.title: Chapter 516 -516-Returning to Earth
paragraphs: Daniel pondered for a moment.
"The mission says I need to accept his challenge."
"Looks like I can only wait for that person to come find me."
"But that works out just fine."
"I can use this opportunity to return to Earth and plant that Dao Seed there."
With that thought, Daniel disappeared from where he stood in the very next instant.
Not long after he left, Supreme Saint Miral and Kru revealed their true forms.
Kru wore an extremely serious expression.
"Master, Faustus has already reached Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
Supreme Saint Miral sensed the residual aura lingering in the air and frowned.
"Of course I know."
"If you were both at the same Rank, you definitely wouldn’t be Faustus’s opponent."
"He could crush you effortlessly."
Kru’s face immediately flushed red.
He replied awkwardly,
"Master, that was a little too hurtful."
Supreme Saint Miral gave him a meaningful look.
"It doesn’t matter."
"Wait a little longer."
"It won’t be long before I arrange another path for you."
Kru was completely confused.
Still, he could only nod.
"Understood, Master."
Within the Endless Starfield, the phenomenon over the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land finally disappeared.
In only a brief moment, every trace of it vanished completely.
Naturally, this immediately attracted the attention of countless experts.
All they knew was that the mysterious powerhouse had spent an extraordinarily long time undergoing his tribulation.
It had lasted long enough for most ordinary Oracle-grade experts to undergo four separate Cosmic Tribulations.
Yet in the end, the tribulation had finally concluded.
The fact that even the Eye of the Universe had manifested early was enough to prove just how seriously the Universal Will regarded that person—
And just how helpless it had been against him.
The mysterious expert had most likely succeeded.
Unfortunately, no one knew the identity of the person who had never revealed himself from beginning to end.
Meanwhile, Eternal Grade powerhouses had crossed spacetime and descended here.
Together, they had witnessed the moment Faustus became Oracle-grade.
Afterward, their projections quietly dispersed, while others simply departed.
Those Eternal powerhouses who knew Daniel’s identity understood exactly what kind of existence he was.
Naturally, none dared linger for long.
As for those who did not know Daniel, they lost interest once the tribulation had ended.
These Eternal powerhouses could roam the River of Time, moving freely between the past and future.
Most of them spent their time intercepting opportunities and treasures within past eras, or traveling into the future to witness the rise of one powerhouse after another.
Those who eventually grew tired of such things would sometimes retreat into the Tranquil Sea of the Great Dao to live in seclusion.
Others would choose to leave behind their inheritances.
Daniel traveled through the Endless Starfield aboard the Starlight Sacred Ark.
At this point, he could already be considered a high-level powerhouse within the Endless Starfield.
A Tier-4 Oracle-grade expert would be considered a backbone member even within a mid-sized faction.
They were an indispensable part of its core strength.
Even within top-tier factions, such a powerhouse would be capable of dominating an entire region.
However, Daniel noticed something strange.
Ever since he completed his tribulation, his level system had disappeared.
In other words—
From this moment onward, Daniel was no longer restricted by levels.
He had effectively become no different from the local inhabitants of this world.
Aside from the restrictions imposed by Rank itself, there were no longer any shackles limiting him.
Daniel murmured,
"Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"I never expected to become Oracle-grade this quickly."
"The towering mountain of Oracle-grade powerhouses that I once had to look up to..."
"I’ve already climbed halfway up."
"If neither side uses Oracle-grade Will Treasures, I should be able to crush any Tier-5 Oracle-grade opponent without much pressure."
"Even against a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse, I should be able to exchange blows."
"And naturally..."
"Killing someone of the same Rank instantly would be even easier."
Daniel possessed an extremely clear understanding of his current strength.
In the past—
Before he became Oracle-grade—
He had relied heavily on Oracle-grade Will Treasures to easily kill Oracle-grade enemies.
The Holy Golden Mountain possessed countless resources and numerous Oracle-grade powerhouses backing it.
But now—
The Myriad Races Universe was approaching the end of its lifespan.
Even Oracle-grade Will Treasures had become increasingly scarce.
No matter how many contribution points Daniel possessed, there were only so many available for exchange.
In other words—
The number of Oracle-grade Will Treasures Daniel could continue relying on was becoming extremely limited.
From now on, he might have to depend almost entirely on his own Strength when facing Oracle-grade opponents.
He would have to confront countless powerful enemies using his own Tier-4 Oracle-grade cultivation.
"It doesn’t matter."
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
"If there are no Oracle-grade Will Treasures, then so be it."
"With my own Strength, I fear no powerhouse."
"So what if they’re high-grade Oracle-grade?"
Daniel believed that he currently possessed no obvious weakness.
Even if he encountered a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse—
If he could not defeat them, he could simply leave.
He could come and go as he pleased.
"First, Earth."
"Time to go home."
Daniel’s starship continued traveling through the starry sky.
"I’ll plant the Universe Fruit Tree on Earth."
The Universe Fruit Tree was a supreme-grade Chaos Dao Seed.
With the support of the Universe Fruit Tree—
Earth was bound to undergo a heaven-shaking transformation.
At that moment, Daniel suddenly remembered that his Origin Token contained numerous unread messages.
He began checking them one by one.
"Faustus, are you the one undergoing the tribulation?"
"Faustus, reply immediately after receiving this!"
"Faustus, you have to keep going!"
"You must survive the tribulation!"
"Faustus, the future of the Holy Golden Mountain will be relying on you!"
"Faustus, hold on!"
After reading the messages, Daniel shook his head with a smile.
Grand Oracle Shamir really was...
Enthusiastic.
Still, Shamir had played a major role in helping Daniel locate the tribulation formation and inherit the legacy of high-grade Oracle Sophis.
Daniel naturally had to give him a response.
"The person undergoing the tribulation was indeed me."
"However, I currently have something to take care of and need to return to my homeland."
"I’ll head to the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters afterward."
Daniel sent the reply.
What he did not expect was for Grand Oracle Shamir to answer almost instantly.
It was as though he had been waiting beside the communication device the entire time.
"Good."
"Go quickly and return quickly."
"When you arrive at the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters, come directly to the Bronze-Grade Mountain."
"The leader wants to meet you personally."
Daniel stared at the message and blinked.
"The leader?"
"That leader who looks like an old farmer wants to meet me personally?"
"Fine."
"If he wants to meet, then I’ll meet him."
"I’ll finish my own business first."
Daniel had already guessed what had happened.
Grand Oracle Shamir must have reported the details of Daniel’s tribulation to the farmer-like leader.
And if the leader wanted to keep Daniel firmly tied to the faction, then naturally he would offer even more rewards and better treatment.
Daniel’s potential was simply too astonishing.
As long as the leader of a faction was not an idiot, they would inevitably do everything possible to keep a genius like him.
That was one of the benefits brought by Strength.
At this point, Daniel believed that even if he died—
If reviving him required paying an enormous price, the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain would still willingly bear that cost.
Earth.
The Starlight Sacred Ark was put away as soon as Daniel entered the Azure Lotus Star River.
Daniel was now an Oracle-grade powerhouse.
His speed had increased dramatically.
Even across the enormous distances of an entire star river, he no longer required much time to travel.
Soon, he arrived before Earth.
Looking at the familiar planet in front of him, a faint smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
No matter how difficult or dangerous his struggles outside became—
The moment he saw Earth, his heart immediately grew peaceful.
He still remembered the days when he had been nothing more than an ordinary person.
Back then, the time he looked forward to the most every year...
Was going home for the New Year.

"Wait a little longer."
"It won’t be long before I arrange another path for you."
Kru was completely confused.
Still, he could only nod.
"Understood, Master."
Within the Endless Starfield, the phenomenon over the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land finally disappeared.
In only a brief moment, every trace of it vanished completely.
Naturally, this immediately attracted the attention of countless experts.
All they knew was that the mysterious powerhouse had spent an extraordinarily long time undergoing his tribulation.
It had lasted long enough for most ordinary Oracle-grade experts to undergo four separate Cosmic Tribulations.
Yet in the end, the tribulation had finally concluded.
The fact that even the Eye of the Universe had manifested early was enough to prove just how seriously the Universal Will regarded that person—
And just how helpless it had been against him.
The mysterious expert had most likely succeeded.
Unfortunately, no one knew the identity of the person who had never revealed himself from beginning to end.
Meanwhile, Eternal Grade powerhouses had crossed spacetime and descended here.
Together, they had witnessed the moment Faustus became Oracle-grade.
Afterward, their projections quietly dispersed, while others simply departed.
Those Eternal powerhouses who knew Daniel’s identity understood exactly what kind of existence he was.
Naturally, none dared linger for long.
As for those who did not know Daniel, they lost interest once the tribulation had ended.
These Eternal powerhouses could roam the River of Time, moving freely between the past and future.
Most of them spent their time intercepting opportunities and treasures within past eras, or traveling into the future to witness the rise of one powerhouse after another.
Those who eventually grew tired of such things would sometimes retreat into the Tranquil Sea of the Great Dao to live in seclusion.
Others would choose to leave behind their inheritances.
Daniel traveled through the Endless Starfield aboard the Starlight Sacred Ark.
At this point, he could already be considered a high-level powerhouse within the Endless Starfield.
A Tier-4 Oracle-grade expert would be considered a backbone member even within a mid-sized faction.
They were an indispensable part of its core strength.
Even within top-tier factions, such a powerhouse would be capable of dominating an entire region.
However, Daniel noticed something strange.
Ever since he completed his tribulation, his level system had disappeared.
In other words—
From this moment onward, Daniel was no longer restricted by levels.
He had effectively become no different from the local inhabitants of this world.
Aside from the restrictions imposed by Rank itself, there were no longer any shackles limiting him.
Daniel murmured,
"Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"I never expected to become Oracle-grade this quickly."
"The towering mountain of Oracle-grade powerhouses that I once had to look up to..."
"I’ve already climbed halfway up."
"If neither side uses Oracle-grade Will Treasures, I should be able to crush any Tier-5 Oracle-grade opponent without much pressure."
"Even against a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse, I should be able to exchange blows."
"And naturally..."
"Killing someone of the same Rank instantly would be even easier."
Daniel possessed an extremely clear understanding of his current strength.
In the past—
Before he became Oracle-grade—
He had relied heavily on Oracle-grade Will Treasures to easily kill Oracle-grade enemies.
The Holy Golden Mountain possessed countless resources and numerous Oracle-grade powerhouses backing it.
But now—
The Myriad Races Universe was approaching the end of its lifespan.
Even Oracle-grade Will Treasures had become increasingly scarce.
No matter how many contribution points Daniel possessed, there were only so many available for exchange.
In other words—
The number of Oracle-grade Will Treasures Daniel could continue relying on was becoming extremely limited.
From now on, he might have to depend almost entirely on his own Strength when facing Oracle-grade opponents.
He would have to confront countless powerful enemies using his own Tier-4 Oracle-grade cultivation.
"It doesn’t matter."
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
"If there are no Oracle-grade Will Treasures, then so be it."
"With my own Strength, I fear no powerhouse."
"So what if they’re high-grade Oracle-grade?"
Daniel believed that he currently possessed no obvious weakness.
Even if he encountered a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse—
If he could not defeat them, he could simply leave.
He could come and go as he pleased.
"First, Earth."
"Time to go home."
Daniel’s starship continued traveling through the starry sky.
"I’ll plant the Universe Fruit Tree on Earth."
The Universe Fruit Tree was a supreme-grade Chaos Dao Seed.
With the support of the Universe Fruit Tree—
Earth was bound to undergo a heaven-shaking transformation.
At that moment, Daniel suddenly remembered that his Origin Token contained numerous unread messages.
He began checking them one by one.
"Faustus, are you the one undergoing the tribulation?"
"Faustus, reply immediately after receiving this!"
"Faustus, you have to keep going!"
"You must survive the tribulation!"
"Faustus, the future of the Holy Golden Mountain will be relying on you!"
"Faustus, hold on!"
After reading the messages, Daniel shook his head with a smile.
Grand Oracle Shamir really was...
Enthusiastic.
Still, Shamir had played a major role in helping Daniel locate the tribulation formation and inherit the legacy of high-grade Oracle Sophis.
Daniel naturally had to give him a response.
"The person undergoing the tribulation was indeed me."
"However, I currently have something to take care of and need to return to my homeland."
"I’ll head to the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters afterward."
Daniel sent the reply.
What he did not expect was for Grand Oracle Shamir to answer almost instantly.
It was as though he had been waiting beside the communication device the entire time.
"Good."
"Go quickly and return quickly."
"When you arrive at the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters, come directly to the Bronze-Grade Mountain."
"The leader wants to meet you personally."
Daniel stared at the message and blinked.
"The leader?"
"That leader who looks like an old farmer wants to meet me personally?"
"Fine."
"If he wants to meet, then I’ll meet him."
"I’ll finish my own business first."
Daniel had already guessed what had happened.
Grand Oracle Shamir must have reported the details of Daniel’s tribulation to the farmer-like leader.
And if the leader wanted to keep Daniel firmly tied to the faction, then naturally he would offer even more rewards and better treatment.
Daniel’s potential was simply too astonishing.
As long as the leader of a faction was not an idiot, they would inevitably do everything possible to keep a genius like him.
That was one of the benefits brought by Strength.
At this point, Daniel believed that even if he died—
If reviving him required paying an enormous price, the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain would still willingly bear that cost.
Earth.
The Starlight Sacred Ark was put away as soon as Daniel entered the Azure Lotus Star River.
Daniel was now an Oracle-grade powerhouse.
His speed had increased dramatically.
Even across the enormous distances of an entire star river, he no longer required much time to travel.
Soon, he arrived before Earth.
Looking at the familiar planet in front of him, a faint smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
No matter how difficult or dangerous his struggles outside became—
The moment he saw Earth, his heart immediately grew peaceful.
He still remembered the days when he had been nothing more than an ordinary person.
Back then, the time he looked forward to the most every year...
Was going home for the New Year.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 -517-Provoking the God Realm
paragraphs: To have somewhere to return to in life—
What a fortunate thing that was.
But at the same time, it also reminded Daniel of everything he had experienced after his rebirth.
"The God Realm?"
Daniel suddenly thought of the God Realm.
Back then, the God Realm had signed an agreement with Daniel.
Both sides had agreed to stay out of each other’s affairs from that point onward.
Of course, the God Realm had only signed the agreement because it had no other choice.
At the time, Daniel had the Holy Golden Mountain supporting him from behind, while the God Realm only had the Myriad Races Alliance.
And as Daniel continued displaying increasingly monstrous talent and terrifying potential, the God Realm gradually became more wary of him.
Back then, they genuinely wanted nothing more to do with Daniel.
That was what the God Realm thought.
But that did not mean Daniel thought the same way.
When Daniel had attacked the God Realm in the past, he too had been forced into it.
The God Realm had simply been too powerful.
It possessed numerous Divine-grade experts and even Oracle-grade existences.
At the time, Daniel had only been half god-grade.
He had been utterly incapable of doing anything to the God Realm.
But now—
Daniel had reached Oracle-grade.
The colossal existence that had once seemed utterly untouchable in his eyes—
The God Realm—
Was now nothing more than an insignificant ant.
Daniel silently thought,
"Come to think of it, the Mystic Eye in the Auric Sacred Land still seems to be occupied by the God Realm."
"I need to take it back."
"And the God Realm has done plenty of disgusting things to me in the past."
"That score needs to be settled as well."
"Once I plant this Dao Seed, I’ll go pay the God Realm a visit."
With that thought, Daniel flew directly toward Earth.
Earth was now completely different from what it had once been.
Strange, demonic-looking structures rose everywhere.
They carried the same bizarre aesthetic once described as Cthulhu-style architecture.
Magic and steel had achieved an almost perfect fusion here.
The old order and the new order existed side by side.
Earth’s governing authority had already become the Dawn Guild.
Commerce had been completely monopolized by the Dawn Chamber of Commerce.
Meanwhile, the education system had become fully dependent on the Gold-Grade Academy.
The Gold-Grade Academy was directly cultivated by the Holy Golden Mountain.
Only after graduating from the academy would members of the player population become qualified to enter the Holy Golden Mountain.
As for Daniel—
He was the Guild Master of the Dawn Guild.
He was also the President of the Dawn Chamber of Commerce.
At the same time, he was one of the founders of both the Gold-Grade Academy and the Holy Golden Mountain.
In all of Earth, Daniel was the person who stood at the very peak of authority.
Under normal circumstances, however, only Daniel’s puppet handled these mundane affairs.
That puppet possessed a fixed strength limit.
It could only remain at half god-grade.
But that made it perfect for handling ordinary worldly matters.
James and Mosi had also become teacher-elders of the academy.
At the same time, they served as Protectors of the Holy Golden Mountain and helped Daniel manage certain special matters.
In other words—
Daniel’s faction had steadily taken root on Earth all along.
And not only within the Myriad Races Universe.
Daniel had also established his own position within the Chaosverse.
If one were to use Earth terminology, then the Holy Golden Mountain had already become something equivalent to a cross-universe conglomerate.
Earth.
Daniel selected a location to plant the Universe Fruit Tree.
One had to understand that the Universe Fruit Tree, as a Dao Seed at the Primordial Supreme Treasure level, was far superior to innate Dao Seeds, Ginseng Fruit Trees, or Peach Trees of Immortality.
Even the Eternal Treasure-level Primordial Chaos Azure Lotus was several tiers inferior.
Naturally, a treasure of this level had extraordinarily strict requirements regarding where it could be planted.
Daniel could not simply choose some random location and bury it in the ground.
He had known that from the beginning.
That was why he had already prepared everything in advance.
He selected an ocean.
The people of Earth called it the Pacific Ocean.
Daniel directly mobilized his mana and activated the Law of Creation.
Infinite Sacred Power condensed out of thin air.
Above the Pacific Ocean, a vast subcontinent slowly took shape.
The entire landmass was filled with incomparably dense spiritual energy.
Dense mist surrounded it on all sides.
Even if the energy of one hundred million Earths were combined together, it still would not compare to the energy contained within this artificially created subcontinent.
Daniel continued using the Law of Creation.
Spirit beasts appeared from nothing.
Then spirit trees.
Spirit herbs.
Spirit stones.
Spirit flowers.
And countless other spiritual resources.
Afterward, Daniel activated the Law of Spacetime and accelerated the flow of time.
The newly formed subcontinent rapidly absorbed most of the dense spiritual mist surrounding it.
Its spiritual energy became even richer.
Only then did Daniel take a formation restriction out of his personal storage space.
He had exchanged for this formation from the Holy Golden Mountain.
It was powerful enough to withstand attacks from high-grade Oracle-grade experts.
There was no helping it.
The resources of the Holy Golden Mountain had already shrunk dramatically.
Even with enormous amounts of contribution points, Daniel could no longer exchange for many Oracle-grade Will Treasures.
So instead, he had spent a huge amount of resources purchasing large quantities of other top-tier treasures.
This formation was one of them.
After completing the formation and restrictions, Daniel finally took out the Universe Fruit Tree.
The Universe Fruit Tree required a treasure land in order to grow.
So Daniel simply created one himself.
An Oracle-grade powerhouse could even open up Secret Realms.
Creating a treasure land naturally was not difficult.
It merely required some resources.
[Universe Fruit] (Dao Seed)
[Grade]: Primordial Supreme Treasure
[Effects]:
[1. Upon consuming it for the first time, the user gains +100,000,000 cultivation points (Divine State Points). Each subsequent consumption reduces the effect by tenfold.]
[2. Upon consuming it for the first time, the user gains 100,000 years of lifespan. Each subsequent consumption reduces the effect by tenfold.]
[Introduction]:
The Universe Fruit Tree blooms once every 10,000 years and bears fruit once every 10,000 years.
Each cycle produces only forty-nine fruits.
After forty-nine days, the fruits fully mature and fall.
This Dao Seed can only be planted in a location that has reached the level of a treasure land...
Daniel planted the Universe Fruit Tree.
At the same time, he arranged a spacetime formation to accelerate its growth.
Originally, it would have taken twenty thousand years before the tree bore fruit.
Now—
It would only take two hundred years.
After two hundred years, the Universe Fruit Tree would mature.
Two hundred years.
That was all.
At present, the average strength of the player population had already reached half Divine-grade.
Their lifespans were measured in tens of thousands of years.
A mere hundred years would pass in the blink of an eye.
They could afford to wait.
Daniel was not in any hurry either.
Once the Dao Seed had been planted, Daniel prepared to visit the God Realm.
His puppet clone handled all mundane affairs.
His true body did not need to worry about any of them.
In the past—
If Daniel wanted to enter the God Realm, he needed to use a spatial passage.
That was because he did not know the coordinates of the God Realm.
Its location had been deliberately concealed.
But now that Daniel had become Oracle-grade—
All he needed was a single thought to perceive the locations of every plane throughout the entire star river.
With the strength of Daniel’s Divine Soul, no one in the God Realm could compare to him.
Even if they deliberately concealed the coordinates, they could not hide them from Daniel.
Naturally, he found the location with ease.
God Realm.
A figure appeared out of thin air.
In the past—
Every time Daniel entered the God Realm, his arrival would immediately be detected.
But now—
He appeared without making the slightest sound.
Even Divine-grade powerhouses noticed nothing.
As long as Daniel deliberately concealed himself, even the Oracle-grade experts of the God Realm would be unable to detect him.
However, Daniel made no attempt to hide.
Therefore, the Oracle-grade experts of the God Realm immediately sensed his arrival.
Whoosh!
Whoosh! Whoosh!
This time, several Oracle-grade powerhouses appeared at once.
The Oracle-grade expert who had attacked Daniel in the past was not among them.
Every face was unfamiliar.
But both sides understood exactly who the other was.
Among the powerhouses who appeared from the God Realm, the strongest was only Tier-3 Oracle-grade.
In Daniel’s eyes now—
That was no different from an ant.
"Faustus!"
Divinity, a Tier-3 Oracle-grade powerhouse, sensed the aura of Tier-4 Oracle-grade radiating from Daniel.
His expression immediately became wary.
"We have an agreement."
"Now that you have entered the God Realm again, are you planning to break it?"
"I advise you not to do anything foolish!"
Daniel glanced at him indifferently.
Then he spoke coldly.
"Where is the Oracle-grade expert of the God Realm?"
"I’m here to see him."

chapters.title: Chapter 518 -518-Divinity Oracle-grade
paragraphs: The Divinity powerhouse’s expression changed drastically upon hearing Daniel’s words.
He abruptly stood up and said,
"Divinity Oracle-grade is currently in seclusion."
"He is not someone a nobody like you can meet whenever you please."
"Our Divinity Oracle-grade has already reached Tier-5 Oracle-grade."
"You had better not act recklessly again."
Daniel immediately sneered.
"Tier-5 Oracle-grade?"
"Heh."
Daniel had long since lost count of how many Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts he had killed.
He had even slain powerhouses above Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
And now, a mere Oracle-grade expert from Divinity dared threaten him?
Cold light immediately flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
"I was speaking to you politely."
"And now you want to act shamelessly?"
"I’ll ask one more time."
"Where is your Oracle-grade expert?"
At that moment, the Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert could not help drawing in a sharp breath.
Cold sweat even began forming across his body.
Being stared down by someone an entire Rank above him was an incomparably terrifying feeling.
His voice trembled as he replied,
"Our Oracle-grade expert is in seclusion."
"He does not wish to see anyone."
"In seclusion?"
"He doesn’t want to see anyone?"
Daniel chuckled coldly.
"I’m afraid there’s more to it than that."
Daniel could no longer be bothered asking.
His divine power suddenly spread outward, enveloping the entirety of Divinity.
In only an instant, the several Oracle-grade experts present were completely suppressed by Daniel’s Divine Soul.
Their skin suddenly tightened.
Their muscles began trembling slightly.
It felt as though the entire environment around them had changed in an instant.
Danger was everywhere.
They had the terrifying feeling that the moment they made even the slightest movement, they would be instantly suppressed and killed.
The pressure from Daniel’s Divine Soul terrified them beyond measure.
"What is happening?"
"Is this really only the aura of a Tier-4 Oracle-grade?"
"Why didn’t I feel pressure like this even when facing a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse?"
"What kind of monster is this Faustus?"
"We’ve cultivated for so long, and we still can’t compare to him?"
"Don’t move!"
"If we move now, we’ll definitely die!"
The Oracle-grade experts of Divinity did not dare harbor even the slightest thought of resisting.
They all stood completely still like wooden statues.
Seeing them like this, Daniel revealed a cold smile.
The next moment, his voice spread throughout the entire Divinity.
"Divinity Oracle-grade."
"If you still refuse to appear..."
"I’ll erase this entire place."
"You’re welcome to gamble on whether I dare do it."
His voice immediately threw every living being within Divinity into panic.
Some even felt a trace of despair.
Even the hearts of the Divine-grade powerhouses tightened.
They could all sense just how terrifying Daniel was.
The aura of a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse was overwhelming beyond imagination.
Throughout Divinity, aside from Oracle-grade experts, there was no one capable of opposing Daniel.
If Daniel truly decided to attack—
No one here could stop him for even half a second.
Would Divinity Oracle-grade really appear because of this threat?
And more importantly—
Why had their Oracle-grade expert remained in seclusion all this time?
Suddenly, a calm voice came from deep within Divinity.
"Faustus."
The voice was flat.
Yet it carried a trace of hatred and anger.
"Faustus, you have gone too far!"
"How long do you think Divinity has tolerated you?"
"And now you actually dare come to our doorstep!"
Daniel’s eyes immediately brightened when he heard the voice.
He had already discovered the other party’s location long ago.
Divinity Oracle-grade had simply been hiding inside a certain Secret Realm.
Daniel sneered.
"If you’ve tolerated enough, then come out and fight me."
"You’re nothing more than a Divinity Oracle-grade."
"What can you possibly do to me?"
"You’ve been hiding this entire time."
"Do you not even have the courage to face me?"
Whoosh!
At that moment, a faint figure appeared.
It gradually condensed into a physical form.
But it was only a clone.
A clone of Divinity Oracle-grade.
Daniel looked at the clone and said calmly,
"You finally decided to appear."
The moment his words fell, hatred appeared across Divinity Oracle-grade’s face.
"I regret it!"
"I hate it!"
"It’s all because of you Fated Human Race!"
"If not for the Mystic Eye of your Fated Human Race, I might have already reached T9 Oracle-grade!"
Divinity Oracle-grade’s voice was filled with resentment.
"What do you want?"
"If you push me too far, then I’ll drag you down with me!"
Daniel immediately noticed something unusual in his words.
It seemed that the Mystic Eye of the Auric Divine Emperor had caused Divinity Oracle-grade to suffer enormous losses.

Daniel did not know exactly how the Mystic Eye that the Auric Divine Emperor had once handed over to the Fated Human Race in exchange for a place to settle had ended up causing such damage to Divinity Oracle-grade.
But he knew one thing.
Divinity Oracle-grade had to hand over the Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye.
"Divinity Oracle-grade."
Daniel spoke coldly.
"Hand over the Mystic Eye, and I’ll let you go."
"Otherwise..."
Divinity Oracle-grade’s eyes widened.
"Otherwise what?"
"Heh."
Daniel stared at him.
"What do you think I’ll do?"
A chill suddenly rose through Divinity Oracle-grade’s body.
By now, Divinity Oracle-grade had already learned exactly what kind of person Daniel was.
He was practically a madman.
Even before Daniel had reached god-grade, he had already been relentlessly fighting against Divinity.
If it had been any ordinary expert, Divinity would have killed them long ago.
Yet when it came to Daniel—
Divinity had always been helpless.
Now, Divinity Oracle-grade was a Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Daniel was only Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
And yet Daniel had still managed to force him into saying something as extreme as mutual destruction.
That alone showed just how wary Divinity Oracle-grade was of Daniel.
"You want the Mystic Eye?"
Divinity Oracle-grade’s heart sank.
That Mystic Eye...
Had already caused him devastating losses.
There was absolutely no way he would hand it over to Daniel.
The Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye was something Divinity Oracle-grade both loved and hated.
And he was willing to protect it at any cost.
"Dream on."
Divinity Oracle-grade sneered.
"If you want a fight, then fight!"
With that, he waved his hand.
Space shifted.
The spacetime surrounding Daniel and Divinity Oracle-grade suddenly transformed.
They appeared inside a Secret Realm.
And there—
Divinity Oracle-grade’s true body was waiting.
His true body was actually a colossal giant standing millions of zhang tall.
He sat upon an imperial throne that was likewise millions of zhang high.
Above his head floated an eye.
Its eyeball slowly rolled around.
Then locked directly onto Daniel.
Meanwhile, countless black spots covered Divinity Oracle-grade’s body.
They were actively corroding him.
Those black marks were incomparably strange.
At this moment, Divinity Oracle-grade looked down at Daniel from above.
"Faustus."
"Do you know what these black shadows covering my body are?"
Without waiting for Daniel to answer, he continued speaking on his own.
"These black shadows come from the Law Sacred Art of a half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse."
"They can corrode both the physical body and the Divine Soul."
"Once struck by this Sacred Art, there is no cure."
"Unless an Eternal powerhouse is willing to pay a certain price to completely remove it."
"Otherwise, there is only one choice."
"Endure it."
"If you cannot endure it, you die."
"And even if you do manage to withstand it, every single day you must suffer the agony of those black shadows corroding you."
"Simply dealing with that pain consumes an enormous amount of energy and concentration."
"So how could I possibly undergo another tribulation?"

He abruptly stood up and said,
"Divinity Oracle-grade is currently in seclusion."
"He is not someone a nobody like you can meet whenever you please."
"Our Divinity Oracle-grade has already reached Tier-5 Oracle-grade."
"You had better not act recklessly again."
Daniel immediately sneered.
"Tier-5 Oracle-grade?"
"Heh."
Daniel had long since lost count of how many Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts he had killed.
He had even slain powerhouses above Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
And now, a mere Oracle-grade expert from Divinity dared threaten him?
Cold light immediately flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
"I was speaking to you politely."
"And now you want to act shamelessly?"
"I’ll ask one more time."
"Where is your Oracle-grade expert?"
At that moment, the Tier-3 Oracle-grade expert could not help drawing in a sharp breath.
Cold sweat even began forming across his body.
Being stared down by someone an entire Rank above him was an incomparably terrifying feeling.
His voice trembled as he replied,
"Our Oracle-grade expert is in seclusion."
"He does not wish to see anyone."
"In seclusion?"
"He doesn’t want to see anyone?"
Daniel chuckled coldly.
"I’m afraid there’s more to it than that."
Daniel could no longer be bothered asking.
His divine power suddenly spread outward, enveloping the entirety of Divinity.
In only an instant, the several Oracle-grade experts present were completely suppressed by Daniel’s Divine Soul.
Their skin suddenly tightened.
Their muscles began trembling slightly.
It felt as though the entire environment around them had changed in an instant.
Danger was everywhere.
They had the terrifying feeling that the moment they made even the slightest movement, they would be instantly suppressed and killed.
The pressure from Daniel’s Divine Soul terrified them beyond measure.
"What is happening?"
"Is this really only the aura of a Tier-4 Oracle-grade?"
"Why didn’t I feel pressure like this even when facing a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse?"
"What kind of monster is this Faustus?"
"We’ve cultivated for so long, and we still can’t compare to him?"
"Don’t move!"
"If we move now, we’ll definitely die!"
The Oracle-grade experts of Divinity did not dare harbor even the slightest thought of resisting.
They all stood completely still like wooden statues.
Seeing them like this, Daniel revealed a cold smile.
The next moment, his voice spread throughout the entire Divinity.
"Divinity Oracle-grade."
"If you still refuse to appear..."
"I’ll erase this entire place."
"You’re welcome to gamble on whether I dare do it."
His voice immediately threw every living being within Divinity into panic.
Some even felt a trace of despair.
Even the hearts of the Divine-grade powerhouses tightened.
They could all sense just how terrifying Daniel was.
The aura of a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse was overwhelming beyond imagination.
Throughout Divinity, aside from Oracle-grade experts, there was no one capable of opposing Daniel.
If Daniel truly decided to attack—
No one here could stop him for even half a second.
Would Divinity Oracle-grade really appear because of this threat?
And more importantly—
Why had their Oracle-grade expert remained in seclusion all this time?
Suddenly, a calm voice came from deep within Divinity.
"Faustus."
The voice was flat.
Yet it carried a trace of hatred and anger.
"Faustus, you have gone too far!"
"How long do you think Divinity has tolerated you?"
"And now you actually dare come to our doorstep!"

Divinity Oracle-grade had simply been hiding inside a certain Secret Realm.
Daniel sneered.
"If you’ve tolerated enough, then come out and fight me."
"You’re nothing more than a Divinity Oracle-grade."
"What can you possibly do to me?"
"You’ve been hiding this entire time."
"Do you not even have the courage to face me?"
Whoosh!
At that moment, a faint figure appeared.
It gradually condensed into a physical form.
But it was only a clone.
A clone of Divinity Oracle-grade.
Daniel looked at the clone and said calmly,
"You finally decided to appear."
The moment his words fell, hatred appeared across Divinity Oracle-grade’s face.
"I regret it!"
"I hate it!"
"It’s all because of you Fated Human Race!"
"If not for the Mystic Eye of your Fated Human Race, I might have already reached T9 Oracle-grade!"
Divinity Oracle-grade’s voice was filled with resentment.
"What do you want?"
"If you push me too far, then I’ll drag you down with me!"
Daniel immediately noticed something unusual in his words.
It seemed that the Mystic Eye of the Auric Divine Emperor had caused Divinity Oracle-grade to suffer enormous losses.

Daniel did not know exactly how the Mystic Eye that the Auric Divine Emperor had once handed over to the Fated Human Race in exchange for a place to settle had ended up causing such damage to Divinity Oracle-grade.
But he knew one thing.
Divinity Oracle-grade had to hand over the Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye.

He was practically a madman.
Even before Daniel had reached god-grade, he had already been relentlessly fighting against Divinity.
If it had been any ordinary expert, Divinity would have killed them long ago.
Yet when it came to Daniel—
Divinity had always been helpless.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 -519-The Half-Step Eternal Curse
paragraphs: Daniel frowned when he heard this.
"A half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse?"
"An existence at that level is naturally unimaginably powerful."
"I never expected someone like that to use such a vicious method."
Divinity Oracle-grade had claimed that he once possessed the potential to reach T9 Oracle-grade.
Yet now, he was forced to endure the corrosion of those black shadows every single day.
He could barely spare any energy to prepare for another tribulation.
At that moment, Divinity Oracle-grade continued,
"Back then, I relied on this Mystic Eye to travel through the River of Time and venture into the future in search of all kinds of opportunities."
"As a Tier-5 Oracle-grade, I naturally lacked the ability to travel into extremely distant future eras by myself."
"So I needed the assistance of treasures."
"With this Mystic Eye, however, I managed to travel directly into an extraordinarily distant future."
Divinity Oracle-grade continued,
"In a forbidden land within that future era, this Mystic Eye attracted the attention of a half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse."
"He wanted to seize it by force."
"In the end, I paid an enormous price before I barely escaped from that half-step Eternal powerhouse and returned to the current era."
"But after returning, I discovered that I had already been infected by this black-shadow poison."
"I even sought help from other half-step Eternal Grade powerhouses and asked them to remove it."
"But none of them succeeded."
At this point, a strange smile suddenly appeared on Divinity Oracle-grade’s face.
"However, I later discovered a secret."
"This black-shadow poison can actually be transferred to someone else."
"Of course..."
"To do so, I would have to pay with my life."
An incomparably malicious smile spread across Divinity Oracle-grade’s face.
"Faustus, I know you possess an undying and imperishable body."
"You also have numerous clones."
"But this poison directly brands itself onto your Origin."
"No matter how many times you revive..."
"No matter how many times you self-destruct..."
"You will never be able to transfer or remove this Sacred Art left behind by a half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse."
"Unless you willingly abandon your Origin."
"And once you abandon your Origin, you will become nothing more than a crippled mortal."
"So I advise you not to push me any further."
"If you force me into a corner, then even if I have to die, I’ll make sure you spend the rest of your life as a cripple."
Daniel immediately understood.
So after saying all of that, Divinity Oracle-grade’s true purpose was simply to threaten him.
That expression of—
If you keep bullying me, I’ll drag you down with me—
Was honestly rather ridiculous.
Daniel had not expected Divinity Oracle-grade’s final trump card to be a curse placed upon him by a half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse.
Still...
That really did give him some leverage.
The curse placed on Divinity Oracle-grade had effectively become a double-edged bomb he could detonate at any moment.
It could hurt his enemy—
But it would kill him as well.
Seeing that Daniel remained silent, Divinity Oracle-grade assumed his threat had worked.
The corners of his mouth rose slightly.
"Faustus, you don’t have to believe anything I said."
"But I’m willing to bet that you don’t dare risk your life against mine."
Daniel did not answer directly.
Instead, he asked,
"I’m simply curious."
"Why would you rather die than hand over that Mystic Eye?"
"Is it really worth that much?"
Divinity Oracle-grade barely needed to think.
"Of course it is!"
"That Mystic Eye is something even a peak half-step Eternal powerhouse coveted."
"And it was itself formed from the eye of another half-step Eternal powerhouse!"
"As long as I can somehow remove this curse, I can use this supreme treasure to reach Eternal Grade!"
"I could become the first Eternal powerhouse in the entire history of Divinity!"
"And the Godkin would become the one and only supreme race at the pinnacle of the Endless Starfield!"
Daniel stared at Divinity Oracle-grade’s fanatical expression.
He could only conclude one thing.
This guy had gone insane.
He was already on the verge of death—
And he was still dreaming about becoming Eternal.
What else could that be but madness?
As for the black-shadow poison...
Daniel did indeed feel somewhat wary.
It would be a lie to say otherwise.
Anything that directly affected one’s Origin was troublesome.
Just as Divinity Oracle-grade had said, clones and immortality would be useless against it.
After all, Daniel’s undying and imperishable ability also operated through his Origin.
Moreover, the half-step Eternal powerhouse responsible for the curse was simply too high-level.
Even Daniel’s purification buff would not be able to remove it.
That made things rather troublesome.
"But I still have that mission."
Daniel suddenly remembered something.
"And an Eternal powerhouse is involved in that mission."
"As long as I accept the challenge and win, I’ll be able to ask that Eternal powerhouse to do one thing for me."
Daniel’s eyes moved slightly.
His thoughts immediately landed on Supreme Saint Miral.
"Since Divinity Oracle-grade said an Eternal powerhouse can remove the black-shadow poison..."
"Then I can simply give it a try."
"And even if the Eternal powerhouse from the mission refuses to help..."
"With my own foundation, this insignificant black-shadow poison might not matter anyway."
"After all, I’m not an ordinary Oracle-grade like Divinity Oracle-grade."
"A Law Sacred Art that causes him unbearable suffering may not have the same effect on me."
"Divinity Oracle-grade wants to gamble that I won’t dare touch him?"
"Wishful thinking."
"I’m taking the Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye."
"Not even an Eternal powerhouse can keep it from me."
"I said so."
Once Daniel reached this conclusion, every trace of hesitation disappeared.
He looked at Divinity Oracle-grade and sneered.
"Divinity Oracle-grade..."
"You almost managed to bluff me."
"But give up."
"I’m taking that Mystic Eye."
"If you want to die..."
"Then die."
Boom!
A Sacred Halo of Reincarnation suddenly appeared behind Daniel’s head.
He reached out with one hand.
The palm instantly blotted out the heavens.
The Three Thousand Worlds within his palm had now evolved into Three Thousand Galaxies.
At the same time, distinct phantoms of enormous galaxies manifested around the colossal hand and reinforced it.
An overwhelming force descended upon Divinity Oracle-grade.
The giant palm pressed downward.
It was as though the heavens themselves were collapsing.
"Sacred Halo of Reincarnation!"
"Primordial Chaos!"
"Three Thousand Worlds in My Palm!"
The heaven-covering palm had not even landed yet, but the terrifying pressure alone caused Divinity Oracle-grade’s expression to change dramatically.
Whoosh!
His body, millions of zhang tall, instantly vanished from the throne.
"Hmm?"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
A faint sneer appeared on his face.
The next instant—
The Saint-Suppressing Tower appeared.
The tower spun rapidly in midair.
Waves of law power spread outward like ripples.
Spacetime—
Sealed!
Divinity Oracle-grade reappeared elsewhere.
But now, he could not move.
The enormous palm was already descending toward him.
"Break!"
Divinity Oracle-grade gritted his teeth and activated the Mystic Eye.
The Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye floating above his head released a hazy divine radiance.
To Daniel’s surprise—
It actually shattered the spacetime seal created by the Saint-Suppressing Tower.
At the same time—
Boom!
The giant palm descended.
Divinity Oracle-grade immediately activated the Mystic Eye once again.
No matter how powerful Daniel’s giant palms were—
No matter how many appeared—
Every single one was blocked by the Mystic Eye.
"Holy Spirit Stone!"
Whoosh!
A tiny stone appeared without a sound.
It shot directly toward the back of Divinity Oracle-grade’s head.
However, Divinity Oracle-grade’s entire body was currently enveloped in the divine radiance of the Mystic Eye.
Even the Holy Spirit Stone could not approach him.
Daniel could not help feeling surprised when he saw this.
The Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye really was extraordinary.
His methods and Sacred Arts were being blocked one after another.
No wonder even a half-step Eternal powerhouse had coveted it!

chapters.title: Chapter 520 -520-Sweeping Everything Away with the Divine Spear
paragraphs: Daniel had long since resolved to obtain that Mystic Eye.
Without hesitation, he summoned his Divine Spear.
As an Oracle-grade Secret Treasure, the Divine Spear possessed extraordinarily terrifying power.
The instant it appeared, it shot directly toward the Mystic Eye.
Boom!
The Mystic Eye forcibly resisted the Divine Spear.
The two treasures collided head-on, unleashing a deafening explosion.
The surrounding Secret Realm space instantly shattered into countless fragments.
Although the space within this Secret Realm was far more stable than that of an ordinary life world, both the Divine Spear and Mystic Eye were simply too high-level.
More importantly, both sides were Oracle-grade powerhouses.
One was Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
The other was Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
When Oracle-grade powerhouses clashed, even the space of a Secret Realm could not withstand such terrifying pressure.
In an instant, it shattered like glass.
At that moment, Daniel unleashed another Sacred Art.
"Sacred Mark!"
His hands began moving like spirit serpents, rapidly forming one seal after another.
Almost instantly, a mysterious totem condensed between his hands.
Daniel directly sent it crashing toward Divinity Oracle-grade.
Divinity Oracle-grade was already wounded.
Even at his peak, he would never have been Daniel’s opponent.
In his current condition, defeating Daniel was even more impossible.
He immediately threw out a Primordial Supreme Treasure.
It resembled an enormous tortoise shell.
Although the Sacred Mark could suppress the tortoise-shell treasure in an instant, the treasure seemed to possess some unique property.
It forcibly immobilized the Sacred Mark in place.
The totem could neither advance nor escape.
It had been completely stalled.
Seeing this, a faint smile suddenly appeared on Daniel’s face.
After all—
He still had plenty of methods left.
Suddenly, the center of Daniel’s forehead split open.
A third eye appeared.
Five-colored divine light!
The next instant, five beams of light burst from Daniel’s third eye.
Orange.
Yellow.
Cyan.
Purple.
Blue.
The orange radiance instantly landed upon the tortoise-shell treasure.
In the next moment, the treasure was forcibly immobilized by Daniel’s divine light.
The yellow, cyan, blue, and purple rays then swept toward the Mystic Eye left behind by the Auric Divine Emperor in succession.
A golden radiance suddenly flared from the Mystic Eye.
The Mystic Eye immediately began trembling.
Yet surprisingly, it was not affected too severely.
Then the blue radiance swept across it.
This time, the impact was much greater.
The Mystic Eye’s aura visibly fluctuated, showing clear signs of being disturbed.
Immediately afterward, the purple radiance flashed across the Mystic Eye.
The brilliant light surrounding it instantly dimmed.
Divinity Oracle-grade’s heart skipped a beat.
"Damn it!"
He wanted to recall the Mystic Eye, but it was already too late.
Several more beams of light swept across it one after another.
The five-colored divine lights cycled endlessly, repeatedly striking the Mystic Eye.
Its aura weakened at an astonishing rate.
Soon, its radiance had become so dim that it was almost invisible.
Then—
The purple light flashed once more.
The Mystic Eye was forcibly swept out of the air!
The laws surrounding the Divine Spear immediately began circulating.
The spear descended and directly suppressed the Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye beneath it.
It was completely sealed in place and could no longer move.
At the same time, Daniel’s third eye erupted with three more colors.
Crimson.
Gray.
Black.
Divinity Oracle-grade had no way to resist these three rays except to withstand them head-on.
But this third eye had been deduced and perfected by a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Its innate Sacred Arts were terrifying beyond imagination.
Divinity Oracle-grade simply could not endure them.
Daniel directly consumed an enormous amount of mana.
Boom!
A single strike blasted Divinity Oracle-grade into a severely injured state.
Whoosh!
At that moment, the Holy Spirit Stone delivered the fatal blow.
Divinity Oracle-grade suddenly felt an intense pain at the back of his head.
Then the entire world began spinning.
His vision abruptly went black.
It turned out that the Holy Spirit Stone was particularly suited for sneak attacks.
Just now, it had smashed directly into the back of Divinity Oracle-grade’s head.

The black shadows covering his body disappeared.

This was pain that directly corroded the Origin.
It really hurt.

At the same time—
Divinity Oracle-grade’s colossal body slowly collapsed.

The powerhouse who had once accepted the Fated Human Race into his territory.
A generation’s Divinity Oracle-grade—
Dead!
Killed by Daniel.

At the same time, he reached out with one hand and directly seized the Auric Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye.

One had to understand what kind of existence Divinity Oracle-grade had been.

That alone proved just how extraordinary this Mystic Eye was.

A treasure of this kind was naturally one of the finest among the finest.

Daniel surpassed Divinity Oracle-grade in every aspect.
And not merely by a little.
By a lot.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 -521-Audrick Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye
paragraphs: After reading the information on the Audrick Divine Emperor’s Mystic Eye, Daniel finally understood.
No wonder Divinity Oracle-grade had treated this treasure as though it were his own life.
In fact, he had probably considered it even more valuable than his life itself.
It was also no wonder that even a half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse had tried to seize the Mystic Eye the moment he saw it.
The value of this treasure was indeed astonishingly high.
It absolutely deserved that level of attention.
And now—
The treasure had finally fallen into Daniel’s hands.
As long as he gathered another ten remains belonging to half-step Eternal Grade powerhouses, he would be able to directly fuse them into a Primordial Supreme Treasure-level treasure.
Daniel’s eyes flickered as various ideas began appearing in his mind.
The moment he obtained the Mystic Eye, he immediately refined it and claimed it as his own.
During the special mission spacetime, Daniel had personally seen Audrick Divine Emperor before.
According to what he knew, Audrick Divine Emperor already possessed strength at the half-step Eternal Grade.
Audrick Divine Emperor was Dorek’s maternal grandfather.
And since Daniel was Dorek’s teacher, Audrick Divine Emperor had always treated Daniel extremely well.
He had even taken the initiative to give Daniel several gifts.
Now that Daniel had obtained the other party’s Mystic Eye, his goal in coming to the God Realm was already more than half completed.
All that remained was deciding how to empty out the rest of the God Realm’s resources.
The instant Divinity Oracle-grade died, mournful wails suddenly echoed throughout the entire God Realm.
Almost every Divine-grade powerhouse in the God Realm immediately realized that their strongest expert had fallen.
They reacted almost instantly.
Their sky had collapsed.
There was no way out.
More importantly, Faustus harbored an extremely deep prejudice and hatred toward the Godkin.
Every time he returned, he would throw the God Realm into chaos.
From before he had even reached god-grade...
To half Divine-grade...
And now—
He had opposed the God Realm every step of the way.
It was simply infuriating.
Now Daniel had already reached Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
Worse still, he had killed Divinity Oracle-grade right before their eyes.
The Godkin’s hatred toward Daniel had seeped deep into their bones.
But the deeper their hatred became—
The more terrified they were of him.
Divinity Oracle-grade was dead.
The entire Godkin race wailed in grief.
Even the sky above the God Realm suddenly changed.
It went from clear to overcast.
Then from overcast to gloomy darkness.
It perfectly reflected the Mental State of the countless God Realm powerhouses.
At that moment, one of the God Realm’s Oracle-grade experts stepped forward.
"Don’t panic!"
"Don’t panic!"
"We belong to the Myriad Worlds Alliance!"
"I’ve already notified them."
"They’ll immediately send corresponding Oracle-grade powerhouses to deal with Faustus."
"All we need to do is stabilize the situation."
"Do not descend into chaos!"
The Tier-3 Oracle-grade Godkin expert still managed to remain relatively calm.
He spoke slowly,
"The Myriad Worlds Alliance has high-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses."
"No matter how strong Faustus is, he cannot possibly be their opponent."
"One move would be enough to suppress him."
"So we absolutely cannot panic now."
"Listen to my orders."
"Activate every defensive formation!"
"Raise our alert level to the maximum!"
As his orders were issued, the God Realm began operating once again.
One defensive formation after another activated.
These formations had been reinforced and modified by countless generations of Divine Emperors.
By now, they were already powerful enough to withstand high-grade Oracle-grade experts.
As the God Realm entered its highest state of alert, countless Godkin powerhouses began directing their people into Secret Realms for refuge.
Under their guidance and arrangements, large numbers of Godkin living beings quickly entered the Secret Realms.
Anything that could be taken away—
Was taken.
As for what could not be moved—
There was nothing they could do.
At that moment—
Daniel appeared outside the God Realm’s grand defensive formation.
Before him stood the God Realm, protected by the realm-guarding formation.
A seven-colored barrier completely enveloped it.
Even a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse would need to spend some effort to break through it.
Daniel looked at the formation before him.
"The God Realm moves pretty quickly."
"But you think a formation like this can stop me?"
"Heh."
Daniel sneered and summoned the Mystic Eye of Audrick Divine Emperor—
The Eye of Eternity.
The eye had already been completely refined by Daniel.
The Eye of Eternity possessed the ability to break restrictions and shatter countless methods.
Daniel poured his energy into it.
The Eye of Eternity immediately began glowing.
A hazy beam of light shot toward the God Realm’s realm-guarding formation.
Boom!
The moment the light struck the formation, the entire barrier began violently trembling.
The seven-colored radiance flickered wildly.
Daniel nodded slightly.
"The Eye of Eternity really is useful."
"At this rate, it’ll only take a few minutes to break through the God Realm’s defensive formation."
"And once that happens..."
The corners of Daniel’s mouth slowly rose.
Inside the God Realm.
The Godkin Oracle-grade experts immediately sensed that the realm-guarding formation was being destroyed.
Clearly, it would not hold for much longer.
"Why haven’t the Myriad Worlds Alliance powerhouses arrived yet?"
"If they don’t come soon, the God Realm is finished!"
"Faustus will definitely destroy the entire God Realm!"
Although they had already moved most of the Godkin population into Secret Realms, they still did not dare assume they were safe.
If Faustus discovered those Secret Realms—
The entire Godkin race might truly be finished.
The Oracle-grade experts of the Godkin were burning with anxiety.
They desperately hoped that the Oracle-grade reinforcement from the Myriad Worlds Alliance would arrive soon.
Otherwise, the God Realm was facing imminent destruction.
Daniel continued attacking the God Realm’s defensive formation.
At that moment—
His divine sense suddenly detected an urgent voice coming from an extremely distant location.
The voice traveled across an enormous distance.
"Faustus, please show mercy!"
"I am a powerhouse of the Myriad Worlds Alliance."
"Please stop."
Daniel frowned when he heard the voice.
"Myriad Worlds Alliance?"
It was a native faction of the Chaosverse.
And it possessed high-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The God Realm had joined the Myriad Worlds Alliance.
Although it did not belong to the Holy Golden Mountain, it was still a race with powerful backing.
Divinity Oracle-grade had only just died.
Yet the God Realm had already notified the Myriad Worlds Alliance.
The Myriad Worlds Alliance was a coalition formed by native great worlds and innate races.
The God Realm was one of its members.
Moreover, the God Realm held a relatively high position within the Myriad Worlds Alliance.
Naturally, the alliance had to dispatch an Oracle-grade powerhouse to support them.
However, Daniel’s reputation and background were anything but ordinary.
There were even rumors that—
The mysterious cultivator who had undergone the tribulation within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land was Faustus!
Because of this, the Myriad Worlds Alliance did not dare act too forcefully toward him.
They only dispatched a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Their hope was simply to mediate the conflict—
Or at the very least, persuade Daniel to abandon the idea of slaughtering the God Realm.
Daniel snorted coldly.
He ignored the approaching expert.
The Eye of Eternity continued attacking.
Then—
Pop!
The God Realm’s defensive formation shattered.
At that moment, nothing remained capable of stopping Daniel from entering the God Realm.
Daniel’s divine sense instantly spread across the entire realm.
With ease, it covered the whole God Realm.
"Hmm?"
Daniel immediately noticed something strange.
The entire God Realm was nearly empty.
Almost every living being had vanished.
It was as though they had all disappeared into thin air in the blink of an eye.
"They moved pretty quickly."
Daniel smiled faintly.
"But they still underestimated me."
"Eye of Eternity!"
Daniel poured an enormous amount of energy into the treasure.
The Eye of Eternity possessed an extraordinary ability to see through concealment.
Nothing could hide from it.
In only an instant, the Eye of Eternity released its radiance.
Under its illumination—
One Secret Realm after another hidden throughout the God Realm was exposed.
Even the living beings hiding inside those Secret Realms were clearly revealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 -522-Slaughtering the God Realm
paragraphs: At this moment, the living beings and powerhouses of the God Realm were like mice discovered by a cat.
They had thought they were hidden well enough.
Yet in an instant, all of them had been exposed.
They trembled uncontrollably, staring in despair as that figure gradually approached.
One of the God Realm’s Oracle-grade experts gritted his teeth and prepared to organize a group of powerhouses for a desperate final resistance.
But at that moment—
A disheveled figure suddenly appeared.
He had clearly rushed here at full speed, and was still breathing heavily when he landed directly in Daniel’s path.
Daniel merely glanced at him indifferently.
"Get out of my way."
The Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse had already been overwhelmed by Daniel’s aura.
He instinctively took a step backward before speaking.
"Faustus, all of us are living beings born from the Chaosverse."
"I hope you can show mercy."
"I know the grudge between you and the God Realm has existed for a very long time."
"But you already killed the Divine Emperor long ago."
"Logically speaking, no matter how deep the hatred between you was, it should have ended by now."
"The karma between you and the God Realm has already been severed."
"If you continue pursuing this matter, I’m afraid you may create hostility between yourself and the entire Chaosverse."

"I was sent here under orders from the Myriad Worlds Alliance to mediate the conflict between you, Oracle-grade Faustus, and the God Realm."
"I hope Oracle-grade Faustus can show mercy and spare their lives."
His attitude was already extraordinarily humble.
There was no helping it.
Daniel’s way of doing things had long since become infamous.
Especially within the Chaosverse, countless factions had already suffered because of Daniel.
Everyone knew that he was an incomparably terrifying and domineering figure—
Someone who responded to courtesy, but never to force.
Even the Myriad Worlds Alliance, which possessed high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouses, had to treat this newly risen powerhouse with a certain degree of respect.
Daniel listened quietly, his eyes flickering.
He was not particularly surprised by the other party’s attitude.
Tyrn Oracle-grade had naturally heard plenty about Daniel before.
More importantly, he knew exactly how serious the hatred between Daniel and the God Realm was.
That was why he had lowered his posture as much as possible.
He only hoped to accomplish his mission without provoking Daniel.
Once Daniel became angry, completing the mission would become even more impossible.
So Tyrn had practically come here begging, with an expression that was both sincere and helpless.
Daniel finally spoke.
"You’re Tyrn Oracle-grade, right?"
"I disagree with everything you just said."
"That Divine Emperor always enjoyed bringing disaster upon countless living beings."
"What I’m doing today is merely carrying out justice on behalf of the heavens."
"Now that the Divine Emperor has already fallen and a new Divine Emperor has yet to appear, this is precisely the God Realm’s weakest moment."
Daniel paused.
His gaze swept across everyone below.
"Since I was the one who killed the Divine Emperor..."
"Then naturally, I should take over his responsibilities and authority."
"I’ll protect the entire God Realm in his place."
"So tell me..."
"Why would I slaughter them?"
"Tyrn Oracle-grade, you have misunderstood me."
"I would never do such a thing."
After saying that, the corners of Daniel’s mouth curled into a sinister smile.
It resembled the smile of a demon.
When Tyrn Oracle-grade saw it, even he could not help trembling.
He hurriedly said,
"The God Realm is a member of the Myriad Worlds Alliance."
"As for protecting the God Realm, you can leave that to our Myriad Worlds Alliance."
"There is no need to trouble Oracle-grade Faustus personally!"
"Myriad Worlds Alliance?"
Daniel blinked.
"Where are the powerhouses of the Myriad Worlds Alliance?"
"Tyrn Oracle-grade..."
"Do you see any Myriad Worlds Alliance powerhouse here?"
Suddenly—
An ominous feeling rose in Tyrn Oracle-grade’s heart.
"This is bad!"
The thought had only just appeared when Daniel attacked.
"Divine Creation!"
Whoosh!
The Divine Creation Stele appeared.
At the same time, Daniel’s voice rang out.
"I advise you not to resist."
"Otherwise, you’ll die."
Tyrn Oracle-grade was immediately intimidated by Daniel’s words.
He truly did not dare move.
One had to understand—
When Daniel had still been a Half-Saint, he had already been the strongest Half-Saint in the recorded history of the current universe and spacetime.
After breaking through to Divine Sovereign, he had carved out an enormous reputation throughout the Chaosverse.
He had even killed numerous Oracle-grade powerhouses.
And at that time—
He had not even been Oracle-grade himself!
Now that Daniel had finally broken through to Oracle-grade—
He had instantly become Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
That perfectly matched the rumors concerning the mysterious powerhouse who had undergone the tribulation within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
An existence who had attracted a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
How could an ordinary Oracle-grade like Tyrn possibly compete with someone like that?
He could only surrender obediently.
The Divine Creation Stele possessed sealing properties.
It quickly imprisoned Tyrn Oracle-grade.
"Oracle-grade Faustus..."
"Sigh..."
Tyrn Oracle-grade sensed the numerous restrictions binding him and hesitated, wanting to speak but ultimately stopping himself.
Daniel smiled at him.
"Don’t worry."
"Just cooperate obediently."
"I won’t kill you."
Tyrn Oracle-grade asked helplessly,
"Then what exactly does Oracle-grade Faustus want?"
"What do I want?"
Daniel smiled.
"You’ll know soon enough."
As he spoke—
A third eye suddenly appeared on Daniel’s forehead.
The third eye violently erupted with five-colored divine light.
Orange.
Yellow.
Cyan.
Blue.
Purple.
The five rays of light instantly enveloped the Oracle-grade experts of the God Realm.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The several Oracle-grade experts caught within the five-colored divine light immediately lost consciousness.
Daniel directly pulled them over.
Looking at the Godkin Oracle-grade experts lying on the ground, Daniel smirked and casually waved his hand.
They immediately awakened.
"Faustus!"
The Godkin Oracle-grade experts stared at Daniel in fear.
Daniel looked at them calmly.
"Do you want to die..."
"Or do you want to live?"
"Or rather—"
"Does your God Realm want survival..."
"Or destruction?"
"You... you dare—"
One of the God Realm Oracle-grade experts was about to shout, How dare you?
Then he noticed Tyrn Oracle-grade of the Myriad Worlds Alliance, currently sealed and completely unable to move.
The rest of his words immediately died in his throat.
Faustus really did dare.
He did not even care about the Myriad Worlds Alliance.
What could the insignificant Godkin possibly possess that Faustus would not dare touch?
Survival or destruction?
"I can die!"
"Even all of us powerhouses can die!"
"But the Godkin must survive!"
"They are the seeds of our race!"
The God Realm powerhouses quickly made their decision.
"We want to live."
"Very good."
Daniel blinked.
"I can spare you."
"But you’ll have to agree to a few conditions."
"Just a tiny, tiny few."
"What conditions?"
The God Realm powerhouse asked.
He understood very clearly that the Godkin no longer possessed the strength to choose.
They could only accept whatever Daniel demanded.
"First."
"All treasuries belonging to the God Realm will be handed over to me."
"Second."
"The God Realm will belong to me."
"As for you Godkin, I’ll relocate you into a Secret Realm."
"Third."
"Of everything you obtain inside that Secret Realm..."
"I want seventy percent."
Daniel paused before adding,
"Of course, you have another option."
"All Godkin can become my slaves for three million years."
"Once the term is over..."
"I’ll release every one of you."
Daniel smiled.
"Choose."

chapters.title: Chapter 523 -523-You Reap What You Sow
paragraphs: When the God Realm powerhouses heard Daniel’s conditions, humiliation immediately appeared across their faces.
But there was nothing they could do.
They silently exchanged glances.
In each other’s eyes, they saw the same humiliation and fury.
Even Tyrn Oracle-grade, who had merely been listening from the side, could hardly bear to hear it.
He could not help complaining inwardly.
Faustus Oracle-grade was simply too ruthless.
The God Realm had existed for an incredibly long time, and its accumulated foundation was naturally enormous.
If all of its treasuries were combined, the amount of resources and wealth contained within them would probably be terrifying.
Once those resources and wealth were taken away, it would become almost impossible for the future powerhouses of the God Realm to make any meaningful progress.
Even ordinary cultivation would require them to depend on someone else’s goodwill.
Worse still, they would be forced to abandon the homeland where they had lived since birth and move into some Secret Realm they had never even heard of.
Who knew how dangerous that Secret Realm might be?
What if it contained countless deadly regions?
And even if they paid an enormous price and successfully established themselves inside the Secret Realm—
Seventy percent of everything they obtained afterward would still have to be handed over to Faustus.
Faustus would not even need to do anything.
He would simply sit back and receive an enormous supply of resources for free.
Meanwhile, the God Realm would be the one risking lives and fighting desperately, only to keep thirty percent of what they earned.
Every condition in the first option was unbelievably harsh.
Under normal circumstances, no one would ever agree to something like this.
Tyrn Oracle-grade could only sigh inwardly.
Still—
When an entire race was standing on the edge of extinction, even the harshest conditions were probably far better than the second option.
For any race, the two most important things were survival and development.
At the very least, choosing the first option would not completely sever every possibility for the Godkin to survive and grow.
Tyrn’s eyes flickered.
The truly vicious option was undoubtedly the second.
Turning the entire Godkin race into Daniel’s slaves for three million years.
Three million years!
As long as Faustus wished it, he could use those three million years to completely sever the inheritance of the Godkin race and bring the entire species under his control.
They would become nothing more than his puppets.
It might be called a three-million-year term—
But in reality, it could become permanent at any moment.
The Godkin themselves surely understood that trap perfectly well.
After all, they had once been experts in this exact sort of thing.
They had done similar things to plenty of other races in the past.
So if they were smart, they would definitely choose the first option.
At least that way, they could preserve their race.
Tyrn Oracle-grade saw the situation clearly and had already guessed their answer.
Sure enough—
The God Realm powerhouses barely needed to think.
"We choose the first option."
They did not beg.
They did not bargain.
Because they understood that they had completely lost the qualifications to negotiate.
The fact that Daniel was even offering them conditions could already be considered a mercy.
Otherwise, with a single thought, Daniel could simply wipe them all out.
He would not even need to give them a choice.
Daniel nodded with satisfaction.
"Good."
"I’ll give you some time."
"Bring me every resource contained within your treasuries as quickly as possible."
"If I discover that any of you have hidden even the slightest thing from me..."
"Don’t blame me for being ruthless."
The God Realm powerhouses did not dare delay.
They immediately turned and left.
They did not fully understand Daniel’s methods, so naturally none of them dared hide anything.
If they were discovered, the consequence could be the extinction of their entire race.
Given the choice between preserving resources and preserving their people—
Naturally, they would choose their race.
Daniel watched them leave.
Then he turned toward Tyrn Oracle-grade.
"Now it’s our turn, Tyrn Oracle-grade."
Tyrn Oracle-grade suddenly felt goosebumps rise all over his body.
After seeing how Daniel had treated the Godkin, even his voice began trembling.
"O-Oracle-grade Faustus..."
"What do you want to do?"
In the past—
Tyrn Oracle-grade had only heard rumors about Daniel’s style and methods.
He had also heard of Daniel’s many terrifying battle achievements.
But now that he had personally witnessed Daniel handling matters—
He felt chills run down his spine.
This man was practically someone who devoured people without even spitting out the bones.
Tyrn had no idea what Daniel intended to do to him.
But it probably would not be anything good.
Daniel blinked.
"You’re afraid of me?"
Tyrn instinctively wanted to deny it.
Then he swallowed.
"Yes."
He wanted to act tough.
But he simply could not.
Daniel said casually,
"Contact the Myriad Worlds Alliance."
"Tell them you fought me and were captured."
"If they want you alive, they’ll need to bring resources in exchange for your life."
Tyrn Oracle-grade stared at Daniel in stunned silence.
This—
Was this kidnapping?
Extortion?
And he was extorting the Myriad Worlds Alliance, a faction backed by high-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses?
Worse still—
He was saying all of this directly in front of the hostage!
Seeing truly was believing.
"Oracle-grade Faustus..."
"You’re even more outrageous than I imagined."
Tyrn Oracle-grade did not know whether to laugh or cry.
If this was not arrogance, then what was?
He himself was still the "hostage."
Was it really polite to discuss his ransom directly in front of him?
"What if I refuse?"
Tyrn Oracle-grade asked.
"Then I’ll carry your head to the Myriad Worlds Alliance myself."
Daniel’s voice turned cold.
"You’re welcome to gamble on whether I’ll actually do it."
Hiss—
Tyrn Oracle-grade drew in a sharp breath.
Gamble?
What kind of damn gamble was that?
Who in their right mind would gamble their own life on another person’s mood?
Tyrn Oracle-grade could only obediently take out his communication treasure and report the situation exactly as Daniel demanded.
Once he finished, Tyrn gave a bitter smile.
"An Oracle-grade powerhouse should arrive shortly."
Daniel nodded.
Then he asked,
"A Tier-4 Oracle-grade should be worth at least a few innate tribulation treasures, right?"
Tyrn Oracle-grade rolled his eyes.
Just how little did this bastard think he was worth?
He was Oracle-grade!
Tier Four, no less!
The Godkin Oracle-grade experts soon handed over their treasuries.
Daniel looked at the Godkin’s accumulated wealth—
Eighteen entire treasuries.
Even he was somewhat surprised.
The quality of the treasures stored by the Godkin was not particularly impressive.
That was understandable.
After all, their strongest expert, the Divine Emperor, had only been Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
Naturally, they would not possess too many truly supreme treasures.
But the sheer quantity was staggering.
Eighteen treasuries.
The total resources contained within them were already comparable to half of Grand Oracle Sophis’s lifetime accumulation.
One had to understand—
Grand Oracle Sophis had been a mighty T8 powerhouse.
Naturally, a faction like the Godkin could never truly compare with a T8 existence.
Yet for their accumulated wealth to equal roughly half of everything Grand Oracle Sophis had possessed was already astonishing enough.
It showed just how much wealth the God Realm had plundered and accumulated throughout its countless years of existence.
But now—
Everything countless generations of Godkin powerhouses had risked their lives to obtain over innumerable years had fallen into Daniel’s hands for free.
One could only say—
The affairs of the world were unpredictable.
Fortune changed hands in turn.
There was no such thing as a powerhouse who could remain invincible forever.
Unless—
They were an existence like an Eternal Supreme Saint, someone who had already transcended the limits of the universe itself!
[Ding! Millionfold Boost has been triggered!]
[The quality of all treasures contained within the eighteen treasuries you obtained has been upgraded!]
