[The quality of all treasures contained within the eighteen treasuries you obtained has been upgraded!]

chapters.title: Chapter 524 -524-The Exclusive Secret Realm
paragraphs: Hearing the system notification ring beside his ears, a faint smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
The Godkin truly possessed an enormous number of treasures.
Although their quality was not particularly impressive, the Millionfold Boost more than compensated for that weakness.
Daniel silently thought,
"After all these treasures received my Millionfold Boost, their total value has already surpassed Grand Oracle Sophis’s entire lifetime accumulation."
After collecting the Godkin treasuries, Daniel directly summoned his Exclusive Secret Realm.
The next instant—
The Secret Realm appeared out of thin air.
Daniel had originally obtained this Exclusive Secret Realm after completing a mission in the Evolution Realm.
The world contained within it was comparable in size to the combined total of countless worlds.
Its resources were extraordinarily abundant.
There were all kinds of living beings and races within it.
It had even given rise to powerful native cultivators of its own.
Previously, when Daniel had been traveling through the Chaosverse, he had been overwhelmed with too many affairs to personally manage this Secret Realm.
So he had simply allowed the players to freely explore and develop it.
Daniel silently thought,
"By now, the Exclusive Secret Realm already contains countless students from the Gold-Grade Academy, as well as a huge native population."
"Even the native powerhouses inside have already reached Oracle-grade."
Naturally, Daniel had a reason for sending the Godkin into the Secret Realm.
Previously, there had been no Divine-grade or Oracle-grade experts stationed inside to suppress the situation.
Now that the Godkin Oracle-grade powerhouses could enter and oversee the Secret Realm in Daniel’s place, they would be more than enough to deal severe blows to the native Oracle-grade experts there.
Furthermore—
Daniel would receive seventy percent of everything they obtained.
That was an excellent deal.
With that thought, Daniel ordered the Godkin powerhouses to relocate all the living beings of the God Realm into his Exclusive Secret Realm.
The Godkin were already exhausted.
They had once possessed their own homes and private property.
Now—
All of it belonged to someone else.
Worse still, they had to pioneer a Secret Realm for Faustus.
And the majority of everything they obtained within it would belong to Faustus.
They had no choice but to leave their homeland behind.
After all, the Divine Emperor was already dead.
There was no longer anyone among the Godkin capable of opposing Daniel.
Only after every Godkin living being entered the Secret Realm did Daniel put it away again.
That was one of the greatest benefits of possessing an Exclusive Secret Realm.
He could summon or withdraw it whenever and wherever he wanted.
Tyrn Oracle-grade silently watched everything from the side.
Only yesterday, the Godkin had still been thriving.
Yet today, they had already fallen to the status of prisoners.
Perhaps such a drastic reversal would have shocked ordinary people.
But after witnessing countless similar events throughout the Endless Starfield, Tyrn had long since become numb to it.
There were countless races throughout the Endless Starfield.
Yet true supreme powerhouses were exceedingly rare.
And those supreme powerhouses had not been born invincible.
Cases like what had happened to the Godkin were simply far too common.
Tyrn glanced at the communication treasure in his hand and suddenly said,
"Oracle-grade Faustus, the agreed time is almost here."
"Now that you’ve gotten what you wanted..."
"You can let me go, right?"
Daniel replied casually,
"Relax."
"I never lie."
"If I wasn’t going to let you go, what would I keep you here for?"
"To have dinner with me in the God Realm?"
Sure enough—
Before long, several Oracle-grade experts from the Myriad Worlds Alliance arrived from the Endless Starfield.
Quite a few had come this time.
There was even a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse personally leading the group.
Several Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts accompanied him.
In total, five Oracle-grade powerhouses from the Myriad Worlds Alliance had arrived.
The moment they entered the God Realm, they immediately saw Tyrn Oracle-grade beside Daniel.
Then their gazes shifted toward Daniel.
"Faustus."
"Hand him over."
Daniel raised his head and replied coldly,
"If you brought too little, I’m not releasing anyone."
The T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse remained expressionless.
The other Oracle-grade experts beside him also stared at Daniel with numb expressions.
They had long since heard countless stories about Faustus’s infamous reputation.
Who in the entire Chaosverse had not heard of Faustus’s many outrageous deeds?
There was no need to mention the distant past.
More recently—
Countless players belonging to Daniel’s race had swept through the small and mid-sized worlds of the Chaosverse like a plague of locusts.
They plundered resources without restraint.
The ecosystems of countless worlds had been devastated by them.
The Myriad Worlds Alliance had complained to the Holy Golden Mountain many times.
Even the leader of the Myriad Worlds Alliance had personally visited the Holy Golden Mountain to demand an explanation.
Yet nothing had changed.
Why?
Because Faustus even dared rob territories belonging to powerhouses of the Holy Golden Mountain itself.
What could anyone possibly do about him?
And now—
Faustus was suspected of having survived a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
Rumor had it that the mysterious powerhouse who underwent the tribulation within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had been none other than him.
As a result, the name Faustus had already spread beyond the universe itself.
It was now known throughout the Endless Starfield.
Almost every Oracle-grade powerhouse who paid attention to major events knew the name—
Faustus of the Myriad Races Universe.
As natives of the same Chaosverse, the experts of the Myriad Worlds Alliance naturally understood him even better.
They did not dare act arrogantly in front of Daniel.
Even though—
On paper—
Their side possessed greater Strength.
Whoosh!
A ring suddenly appeared.
One of the Myriad Worlds Alliance Oracle-grade experts waved his hand.
The ring flew forward and stopped directly in front of Daniel.
"Three treasuries."
"Three treasure mountains."
"And fifteen innate tribulation treasures."
The T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse wasted no words.
Then he continued,
"Our leader asked me to pass along a message."
"The Myriad Races Universe is approaching the end of its lifespan."
"Great chaos is about to begin."
"He hopes Oracle-grade Faustus will contribute some Strength to his homeland."
"The Myriad Worlds Alliance is willing to cooperate with Oracle-grade Faustus."
A smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
With obvious interest, he reached out and caught the ring.
At the same time—
A system notification sounded beside his ears.
[Ding! Millionfold Boost has been triggered!]
[The quality of the treasures you obtained has been upgraded!]
Daniel swept his divine sense through the ring.
It was a Sumeru Ring.
An independent world existed inside it.
Its internal space was no smaller than an ordinary life world.
Inside were—
Three treasuries.
Three treasure mountains.
And fifteen innate Primordial Supreme Treasures.
And all of this—
Was merely the "ransom" the Myriad Worlds Alliance had paid Daniel.
Daniel knew perfectly well that a single Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse was not worth this much.
To a large extent—
This was simply the Myriad Worlds Alliance attempting to curry favor with him.
The T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse had already made their position clear.
The Myriad Worlds Alliance was backing down.
They had no desire to become Daniel’s enemy.
"Very well."
Since they understood the situation, Daniel had no reason to make things difficult.
He flicked his finger.
The restrictions sealing Tyrn Oracle-grade immediately disappeared.
The moment Tyrn sensed that the restraints on his body were gone, he hurriedly moved behind the T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
He did not want to remain beside Daniel for even one more minute.
"Thank you, Oracle-grade Faustus."
The T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse forced out the words with a stiff smile.
Then he turned and left with Tyrn Oracle-grade.
Being extorted by someone—
And then having to thank the person afterward—
Was truly humiliating.
But that person was Faustus.
They could not afford to offend him.
With everything here settled, Daniel directly summoned the Starlight Sacred Ark.
He prepared to head toward the headquarters of the Holy Golden Mountain.
As for the remaining matters in the God Realm—
His puppet clone could handle them.
There was no need for Daniel to waste any more attention here.
At the very end of the Endless Tribulation Sea within the Endless Starfield—
The Ultimate Domain.
Countless Eternal powerhouses had left behind Domains here.
Over time, they formed numerous independent Domain Worlds existing outside the River of Time.
Above Secret Realms—
Were Domains.
Among them—
The Myriad Laws Domain.
At this moment, two powerhouses ended their secluded cultivation and emerged.
If Daniel had been here—
He would have immediately recognized both of them.
They were actually two of his "old acquaintances."

chapters.title: Chapter 525 -525-Old Acquaintances
paragraphs: The two old acquaintances before him were none other than two powerhouses from the Starry Sky Behemoth race—
Jones Heller and Golden Wind.
However, the aura and temperament surrounding these two Starry Sky Behemoths were completely different from before.
It was almost as though they had become entirely different people.
At the same time, their Strength had undergone astonishing improvement.
Jones Heller now radiated the aura of a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Golden Wind, meanwhile, possessed the aura of a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
At this moment, the two Oracle-grade experts had successfully entered a Domain created by an Eternal powerhouse.
A Domain could be considered a special Secret Realm that belonged exclusively to Eternal Grade existences.
Within such a space, spacetime was completely independent.
Even the rules of the universe could not interfere.
One could say that within their own Domain, an Eternal powerhouse was the absolute supreme god.
Even the rules of the universe had to step aside.
As they traveled, Jones Heller spoke to Golden Wind beside him.
"Brother Golden Wind, the Starry Sky Behemoth race truly deserves its reputation as the number-one race of the Endless Starfield."
"I can clearly feel the terrifying potential and ancient inheritance contained within this body."
A smile appeared on Jones Heller’s face.
"Only a body of this level gives us a real chance of recovering our Eternal Rank."
Golden Wind smiled as well.
"Ever since the Eternal Great Calamity appeared, countless Eternal powerhouses have fallen one after another."
"Fortunately, several of us had already made preparations in advance."
"At least we were not completely annihilated by the Eternal Calamity."
"Now that we have obtained these two Starry Sky Behemoth bodies, naturally we have a chance to rise again."
So it turned out that both Jones Heller and Golden Wind had already been possessed by other powerhouses.
They had merely continued using the original names of these physical bodies.
And the souls that had taken possession of them—
Were both Eternal Grade powerhouses who had fallen during the Eternal Killing Tribulation.
Golden Wind looked toward Jones Heller.
"Brother Jones Heller, your Destiny Universe should already have been cultivated to the absolute limit, correct?"
"You truly calculated everything perfectly."
"You even managed to scheme against the universe itself."
"Impressive."
Jones Heller modestly waved his hand.
"It was nothing more than a desperate survival method."
"The universe is far too powerful."
"Who could truly outscheme it?"
"Although we were fortunate enough to survive, all of our cultivation was destroyed."
"We had to start again from the beginning."
"That really has been troublesome."
"And even now, we have only cultivated back to around Tier-6 or Tier-7 Oracle-grade."
Jones Heller could not help letting out a long sigh.
"I wonder how long it will take before we can return to Eternal Grade."
"If the universe discovers us..."
"Then survivors like us will definitely attract even more terrifying Cosmic Tribulations."
"Our lives are hardly easy."
When the Eternal Killing Tribulation had descended, these two Eternal Grade powerhouses had already prepared escape routes.
They had chosen the bodies of two Starry Sky Behemoths as their backup vessels.
The instant the killing tribulation descended upon them, they decisively used false-death methods to escape disaster.
Afterward, they seized these two physical bodies.
They had barely managed to carve out a path to survival.
However, all of their original cultivation had been completely destroyed.
Fortunately, they had retained all of their memories.
As a result, cultivating again was almost like cheating.
Furthermore, both of them possessed Eternal powerhouse friends.
They had never lacked cultivation resources.
Thus, they had rapidly returned to Tier-6 and T7 Oracle-grade.
They did not dare undergo tribulations within the River of Time.
Doing so would immediately expose them to the universe.
Instead, they had remained inside Domains belonging to Eternal powerhouses whenever they underwent tribulations.
This was the best way to conceal the fact that they had been reborn.
However—
When the time came to undergo the Eternal Tribulation, they would have no choice but to enter the Endless Starfield and face the tribulation within the River of Time.
There was no way to avoid that step.
Once the universe discovered them at that moment, it would inevitably react violently.
And neither of them had any confidence that they would survive the Cosmic Tribulation of an enraged universe.
After all—
The first time they had broken through to Eternal Grade, surviving the Eternal Tribulation had already been a narrow escape from death.
Even now, they could not say whether they had succeeded because of luck or because of their own Strength.
Regardless—
Although they had been reborn, the path ahead remained extremely difficult.
"We’ll deal with it when the time comes."
Golden Wind Oracle-grade said,
"Myriad Laws Eternal was our friend in our previous lives."
"With his protection, at least before we reach half-step Eternal Grade, we do not need to worry about being discovered by the universe."
"Exactly."
Jones Heller Oracle-grade smiled.
"This time, the Myriad Races Universe has undergone a tremendous transformation."
"Myriad Laws Eternal intends to interfere in the affairs of the Myriad Races Universe."
"As far as I know, a Universe Core is one of the finest materials for refining Supreme Primordial Treasures."
"Myriad Laws Eternal has never enjoyed fighting."
"He prefers studying strange and unusual things."
"I imagine he wants to obtain the Universe Core of the Myriad Races Universe as well."
Golden Wind Oracle-grade nodded.
"A Universe Core is indeed an extraordinary treasure."
"Although Eternal powerhouses can create universes, a newly created universe does not possess a Universe Core."
"It must first experience the baptism of the River of Time."
"Only after billions upon billions of years can a Universe Core gradually form."
"Innately born universes like the Myriad Races Universe possess the highest-quality Universe Cores."
"Naturally, they attract the covetous gazes of many Eternal powerhouses."
Universes could be divided into two broad categories.
The first type consisted of universes created by Eternal powerhouses.
Generally speaking, only existences who had reached peak Eternal Grade or half-step Supreme Grade—that was, Supreme Divine-grade—possessed the ability to create a universe.
For example—
[Azure Saint] had created the Chaosverse.
However, universes created in this acquired manner did not initially possess Universe Cores.
They first had to undergo the passage and baptism of the River of Time.
Only after an unimaginable number of billions of years would a Universe Core gradually form.
But universes such as—
The Myriad Races Universe.
The Gods and Demons Universe.
The Rune Universe.
The Heaven-Equaling Universe.
And others like them—
Were innately born universes.
Only universes of this type naturally possessed supreme-quality Universe Cores.
And Universe Cores could be used to refine Supreme-grade treasures.
Their power was extraordinary.
"Chaos Treasures."
"Chaos Supreme Treasures."
"Eternal Spirit Treasures."
"Eternal Supreme Treasures."
"Supreme Spirit Treasures..."
Jones Heller sighed.
"Back then, we were also powerhouses who possessed countless supreme treasures."
"Yet now, neither of us even owns a single Chaos-grade treasure."
"This time, Myriad Laws Eternal will probably send us into the Myriad Races Universe."
"When that happens, he should give us some top-tier treasures."
"Naturally."
Golden Wind Oracle-grade replied,
"Myriad Laws Eternal is most skilled at treasure refinement."
"He possesses more treasures than he knows what to do with."
"Now that we have emerged from seclusion, he will undoubtedly entrust us with important responsibilities."
"With Myriad Laws Eternal helping conceal our existence, we will be able to enter the River of Time without being discovered by the universe."
"And he will certainly provide us with suitable treasures as well."
Daniel’s Starlight Sacred Ark raced through the starry sky.
The Myriad Races Universe was clearly much livelier than before.
There were noticeably more powerful experts.
Daniel silently observed his surroundings.
In the past—
Whenever he traveled, he could encounter cultivators of practically every Rank.
But now things were different.
It had become extremely difficult to encounter anyone below Divine-grade.
Almost everyone Daniel came across was either peak Divine-grade or Oracle-grade.
And the auras surrounding these experts were exceptionally fierce.
One glance was enough to tell that they were veterans who had slaughtered their way through mountains of corpses and seas of blood.
Many of them—
Were powerhouses from other universes.

"Innately born universes like the Myriad Races Universe possess the highest-quality Universe Cores."
"Naturally, they attract the covetous gazes of many Eternal powerhouses."
Universes could be divided into two broad categories.
The first type consisted of universes created by Eternal powerhouses.
Generally speaking, only existences who had reached peak Eternal Grade or half-step Supreme Grade—that was, Supreme Divine-grade—possessed the ability to create a universe.
For example—
[Azure Saint] had created the Chaosverse.
However, universes created in this acquired manner did not initially possess Universe Cores.
They first had to undergo the passage and baptism of the River of Time.
Only after an unimaginable number of billions of years would a Universe Core gradually form.
But universes such as—
The Myriad Races Universe.
The Gods and Demons Universe.
The Rune Universe.
The Heaven-Equaling Universe.
And others like them—
Were innately born universes.
Only universes of this type naturally possessed supreme-quality Universe Cores.
And Universe Cores could be used to refine Supreme-grade treasures.
Their power was extraordinary.
"Chaos Treasures."
"Chaos Supreme Treasures."
"Eternal Spirit Treasures."
"Eternal Supreme Treasures."
"Supreme Spirit Treasures..."
Jones Heller sighed.
"Back then, we were also powerhouses who possessed countless supreme treasures."
"Yet now, neither of us even owns a single Chaos-grade treasure."
"This time, Myriad Laws Eternal will probably send us into the Myriad Races Universe."
"When that happens, he should give us some top-tier treasures."
"Naturally."
Golden Wind Oracle-grade replied,
"Myriad Laws Eternal is most skilled at treasure refinement."
"He possesses more treasures than he knows what to do with."
"Now that we have emerged from seclusion, he will undoubtedly entrust us with important responsibilities."
"With Myriad Laws Eternal helping conceal our existence, we will be able to enter the River of Time without being discovered by the universe."
"And he will certainly provide us with suitable treasures as well."
Daniel’s Starlight Sacred Ark raced through the starry sky.
The Myriad Races Universe was clearly much livelier than before.
There were noticeably more powerful experts.
Daniel silently observed his surroundings.
In the past—
Whenever he traveled, he could encounter cultivators of practically every Rank.
But now things were different.
It had become extremely difficult to encounter anyone below Divine-grade.
Almost everyone Daniel came across was either peak Divine-grade or Oracle-grade.
And the auras surrounding these experts were exceptionally fierce.
One glance was enough to tell that they were veterans who had slaughtered their way through mountains of corpses and seas of blood.
Many of them—
Were powerhouses from other universes.

chapters.title: Chapter 526 -526-A Storm Is Coming
paragraphs: Daniel blinked and could not help muttering,
"What a troubled era."
He piloted the Starlight Sacred Ark through the universe in an exceptionally domineering manner.
Yet whenever powerful experts noticed this flying treasure, they immediately became cautious.
After all, only extremely powerful beings could possess a treasure of this level.
The Starlight Sacred Ark was an innate supreme treasure.
How could someone capable of using such a treasure possibly be weak?
And with Daniel traveling so brazenly, he was obviously not someone easy to provoke.
Even experts from other universes quickly avoided him when they saw this.
They might be ruthless and violent, but they still understood the rules.
The rules of the Endless Starfield were quite simple.
The stronger you were—
The more arrogant you were allowed to be.
At the same time, outside the headquarters of the Holy Golden Mountain, the Starlight Sacred Ark slowly came to a stop.
Daniel put it away.
The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters before him was now completely different from the last few times he had visited.
In the past, the headquarters had been incomparably prosperous.
Divine-grade powerhouses had been everywhere.
There had even been many Oracle-grade experts.
The entire headquarters had always been lively and flourishing.
But now—
It had become cold and deserted.
Daniel blinked and sighed.
"I never expected the situation in the Myriad Races Universe to have already become this serious."
The lifespan of the Myriad Races Universe was approaching its end.
A Cosmic Tribulation would inevitably descend.
When that happened, the entire universe would be reduced to Tribulation Ash.
Because of this, many powerful experts had already chosen to flee the Myriad Races Universe.
However, there were also countless experts from other universes who had come here specifically to search for opportunities.
In the past, the Myriad Races Universe had been tightly controlled by its great factions.
Opportunities and resources were almost never available to outsiders.
But now things were different.
The major factions were barely able to protect themselves.
They had no energy left to worry about experts from other universes.
As a result, large numbers of foreign-universe powerhouses had begun entering the Myriad Races Universe.
Daniel immediately understood why almost everyone he had encountered while traveling recently had been so powerful.
Only those with both courage and Strength would dare wander outside at a time like this without fearing ambushes or assassination.
That was why Daniel had encountered so many experts along the way.
After arriving at the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters, Daniel followed the message Grand Oracle Shamir had left for him and directly entered one of the Holy Golden Mountain’s Secret Realms.
And not just any Secret Realm.
The core Secret Realm.
Grand Oracle Shamir was still the one receiving him.
However, this time it was Shamir’s true body rather than one of the clones Daniel had encountered before.
Grand Oracle Shamir carefully looked Daniel over.
A smile appeared on his face.
"Faustus."
"You’ve improved again."
At this moment, Daniel radiated a genuine Oracle-grade aura.
When Shamir had brought him to the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, Daniel had still only been Divine-grade.
Now, however—
He had already become a genuine Oracle-grade powerhouse.
And not merely Tier One.
Tier Four.
Recalling the terrifying phenomena that had appeared within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, Grand Oracle Shamir could not help laughing.
"I knew it was you undergoing the tribulation."
"You truly never stop surprising people."
"You crossed four tribulations in one continuous sequence and directly reached Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"Throughout the Endless Starfield, people are already telling stories about you."
"You have already eclipsed every peerless genius of the current era."
"And in the future, you will undoubtedly astonish countless powerhouses across future spacetime as well."
Daniel merely smiled at Shamir’s praise.
"I also have Senior Shamir to thank."
"If you hadn’t brought me to the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, I would never have obtained the inheritance of a high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse."
"Without that inheritance and all the assistance that came with it, I might not have been able to survive the tribulation successfully."
Daniel had gained far too much from the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
So much that it was practically impossible to calculate.
The memories of Grand Oracle Sophis alone—
Were an immeasurable treasure.
And that was not even mentioning the Peerless Grand Formation.
That formation had saved Daniel an enormous amount of time, resources, and effort.
More importantly—
It had allowed him to smoothly survive his tribulations.
And those had been Golden Cosmic Tribulations.
If Daniel had needed to prepare such a formation himself, he had no idea how much wealth and effort it would have required.
In short—
If he had never entered the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, then surviving his tribulations would have been millions of times more difficult.
"Just as I expected."
Grand Oracle Shamir nodded.
"I already guessed that you must have obtained some kind of inheritance."
"For peerless geniuses like you, these ancient inheritances always seem as though they were specifically prepared for your arrival."
Shamir jokingly added,
"Ordinary Oracle-grade cultivators like us are merely supporting characters and tools for geniuses like you."
"Green leaves beside blooming flowers."
"Hahaha."
Daniel could not help laughing.
Then—
Grand Oracle Shamir’s expression suddenly became serious.
"Faustus."
"I am now going to convey an official notice on behalf of the leader."
So serious?
Daniel raised an eyebrow and nodded.
Grand Oracle Shamir spoke solemnly.
"Oracle-grade Faustus."
"By order of the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain—"
"Your treatment level has been adjusted to [Super S-Class]."
"And you are hereby appointed as a member of the Holy Golden Mountain Elder Council."
After finishing, Grand Oracle Shamir looked directly at Daniel.
Boom!
Daniel felt as though something had exploded inside his head.
Super S-Class treatment...
If he remembered correctly—
That was the highest level of treatment within the Holy Golden Mountain.
Equivalent to the treatment of a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse!
T9 Oracle-grade!
And more importantly—
A member of the Elder Council!
One had to understand—
The leaders of the Holy Golden Mountain were selected on rotation from members of the Elder Council.
This appointment...
This decision...
It was far too astonishing.
Daniel was only Tier-4 Oracle-grade!
In other words—
Daniel’s current treatment had already reached the very highest level.
And his authority within the Holy Golden Mountain had also risen to the top.
Of course, the Holy Golden Mountain itself was an extremely loose organization.
Its members were mostly bound through missions and contribution points.
Authority was not enforced in an absolute manner.
Even so—
This was still an extraordinary appointment.
Before coming here, Daniel had already expected the Holy Golden Mountain to make every effort to win him over.
What he had not expected—
Was for them to offer such an enormous price.
Hiss—
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
He looked at Grand Oracle Shamir.
"Why?"
Why was the Holy Golden Mountain willing to pay such an enormous price for him?
Daniel did not believe it was simply because of his potential.
There had to be another reason.
Sure enough—
A sharp light flashed through Grand Oracle Shamir’s eyes.
Then he sighed.
"Faustus..."
"To tell you the truth..."
Grand Oracle Shamir’s expression became bitter.
"The Holy Golden Mountain can no longer hold on."
The Holy Golden Mountain could no longer hold on?
Daniel’s heart tightened violently.
"You already know this."
Grand Oracle Shamir gave a bitter smile.
"In the past, when you used contribution points to exchange for Oracle-grade Secret Treasures, there were never many available."
"But at least you could still obtain some."
"Now, even if you have the contribution points..."
"There are practically no Oracle-grade Secret Treasures left for you to exchange."
"Because..."
"Many of the Oracle-grade experts of the Holy Golden Mountain have already terminated their agreements with the faction."
"What?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 527 -527-Sudden Upheaval
paragraphs: Daniel was stunned when he heard the news.
The last time he had come here, the Holy Golden Mountain had indeed been filled with anxiety, and many Oracle-grade powerhouses had already been considering leaving.
But Daniel had never expected things to happen this quickly.
Those Oracle-grade experts had actually already terminated their agreements with the Holy Golden Mountain.
As for Oracle-grade Secret Treasures, Daniel still had a few left from before.
But now that he had already reached Tier-4 Oracle-grade, he no longer had much use for them.
Even without Oracle-grade Secret Treasures, he could still roam the Endless Starfield freely.
That was not much of a problem.
What truly shocked Daniel was the fact that even the Holy Golden Mountain could no longer hold on.
Ever since the conclusion of the first Universe-Level Tournament, the Holy Golden Mountain had effectively become the number-one faction of the Myriad Races Universe.
And now—
Even the Holy Golden Mountain was beginning to collapse.
One could easily imagine what had happened to the other factions.
They had probably already fallen apart.
The disbanding of so many factions throughout the Myriad Races Universe was absolutely terrible news for the universe as a whole.
Seeing Daniel’s shocked expression, Grand Oracle Shamir could only give a bitter smile.
"Also..."
"The Holy Golden Mountain Elder Council can no longer even gather seven members."
Daniel’s expression changed again.
In the past, the threshold for entering the Holy Golden Mountain Elder Council had been extremely high.
Only T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses had possessed the qualifications to join.
And even after entering, they constantly faced competition from rising challengers.
Anyone weaker could be replaced at any time.
But now—
The Elder Council could not even fill seven seats.
That meant many T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses had directly chosen to leave the Holy Golden Mountain.
And that was also why Oracle-grade Secret Treasures had become increasingly difficult to obtain.
There simply were not enough powerful experts left to refine them.
Even if someone possessed endless contribution points, there were no corresponding treasures available for exchange.
Daniel shook his head and sighed.
"When the tree falls, the monkeys scatter."
"The Myriad Races Universe is that giant tree."
"And the major factions are merely monkeys clinging to its branches."
On a smaller scale—
The great factions were the branches.
And the countless living beings who depended on those factions were the monkeys.
Now that the lifespan of the Myriad Races Universe was approaching its end, its final cosmic calamity would inevitably descend.
Those high-grade Oracle-grade experts had races and clans of their own.
Many of them still wanted to challenge Eternal Grade.
Naturally, they would not remain here and wait for destruction.
There were countless universes throughout the Endless Starfield.
Why remain in a dying universe when they could simply choose one overflowing with vitality?
Moreover, high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouses already stood near the summit of the Endless Starfield.
The great universes and factions everywhere would happily offer them extremely generous treatment.
As for the Holy Golden Mountain—
To many of them, it had merely been a stepping stone along their cultivation path.
After thinking for a moment, Daniel asked,
"What is the Holy Golden Mountain planning to do now?"
Grand Oracle Shamir replied,
"Our plan is simple."
"We need to find a chance to survive."
"Our first choice is still to save the Myriad Races Universe if possible."
"After all, the Myriad Races Universe originally still had tens of millions of years of lifespan remaining."
"It might even have been close to one hundred million years."
"The only reason its remaining lifespan has become so short is because time was artificially accelerated."
Grand Oracle Shamir continued,
"That is why the leader has already gone to the Ultimate Domain."
"He is searching for an Eternal Grade powerhouse willing to act and remove the abnormal acceleration of time affecting the Myriad Races Universe."
Ultimate Domain?
Daniel was immediately puzzled.
"What kind of place is that?"
Grand Oracle Shamir explained,
"The Ultimate Domain lies beyond the Endless Tribulation Sea at the edge of the Chaos Star Sea."
"It exists independently outside the River of Time."
"Only Eternal powerhouses can truly reside there."
"Oh."
Daniel nodded.
"So it’s basically a higher-level map."
That was how he understood it.
"The leader has some past connection with an Eternal powerhouse within the Ultimate Domain."
Grand Oracle Shamir continued,
"So there is at least some hope."
"As long as the time-acceleration restriction can be removed, the Myriad Races Universe will return to normal."
"The Holy Golden Mountain will also have time to gradually recover."
Shamir paused before continuing.
"The second path is to search for a new universe."
"We have already selected several possible candidates."
"The Chaosverse is one of them."
Grand Oracle Shamir gave Daniel a meaningful look.
"You establishing a foundation in the Chaosverse was an excellent move."
Daniel smiled.
His foundation in the Chaosverse had already surpassed what he possessed in the Myriad Races Universe.
Of course—
Most of that had originally happened because of missions.
"That is the Holy Golden Mountain’s current plan."
Grand Oracle Shamir took out a token.
"This is your new Gold-Grade Token."
"Take it."
"It contains much higher-level authority than your previous one."
Daniel accepted the token.
This Gold-Grade Token was completely different from the one he had used before.
The materials used to create his previous token had been fairly ordinary.
But this one—
Was actually made from Origin Stone.
[Supreme Gold-Grade Token] (Rare)
[Restriction]: Supreme Gold-Grade Token
[Privileges]:
[1. Exclusive Gold-Grade Realm Secret Realm — Super S-Class]
[2. Free access to all Treasure Lands, Danger Zones, Forbidden Lands, Secret Realms, and other territories directly controlled by the Holy Golden Mountain.]
[3. For any Treasure Lands, Danger Zones, Forbidden Lands, Secret Realms, or similar regions in which the Holy Golden Mountain participates, the holder may apply for entry without limitation.]
[4. Receives the Holy Golden Mountain’s latest and most urgent real-time intelligence automatically. No contribution points are required for subscription.]
[5. Can directly contact any Holy Golden Mountain powerhouse below T9 Oracle-grade without consuming contribution points.]
[6. Displays the current territory controlled by the Holy Golden Mountain.]
[7. Elder Council members may issue missions of the highest level.]
[8. All Holy Golden Mountain permissions are set to the Highest Level.]
[Introduction]:
The Gold-Grade Token is the symbol of official membership within the Holy Golden Mountain.
The Supreme Gold-Grade Token grants the holder full authority throughout the Holy Golden Mountain.
Its permission level is—
[Highest Level].
Daniel carefully examined the Holy Golden Mountain token in his hand.
This single token had completely opened every layer of authority to him.
His permission level had already reached the absolute maximum.
Supreme Gold-Grade Token!
From this moment onward, Daniel was no longer some low-level member of the Holy Golden Mountain.
He had effectively become a shareholder and co-founder.
More importantly—
He was now a standing member of the board.
His authority was extraordinarily high.
When Grand Oracle Shamir saw Daniel accept the Gold-Grade Token, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He had not been worried that Daniel would accept it.
He had been worried that Daniel would refuse.
The Holy Golden Mountain had already suffered a massive decline in strength.
Even if Daniel decided to leave the faction now, it would be completely understandable.
Grand Oracle Shamir would have no way to stop him.
But Daniel had accepted the Supreme Gold-Grade Token.
That meant Daniel was still willing to remain part of the Holy Golden Mountain.
For Shamir—
That was already an excellent result.
"Faustus possesses potential capable of dazzling countless eras."
Grand Oracle Shamir silently thought,
"He will inevitably become an incomparably powerful existence in the future."
"As long as he remains with the Holy Golden Mountain, the Holy Golden Mountain is destined to rise again."
"And as a member of the Holy Golden Mountain..."
"I may also receive Faustus’s protection in the future."
With that thought, Grand Oracle Shamir continued,
"Faustus, you have now passed four Cosmic Tribulations and reached Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"At your current level, you are already capable of refining your own Divine Soul clone."
Grand Oracle Shamir explained,
"You can take your Gold-Grade Token to the headquarters’ Sacred Art archive."
"There, you may select one of the highest-level Divine Soul techniques."
"Once you cultivate a Divine Soul clone..."
"Your overall Strength will undoubtedly rise again."

"Take it."
"It contains much higher-level authority than your previous one."
Daniel accepted the token.
This Gold-Grade Token was completely different from the one he had used before.
The materials used to create his previous token had been fairly ordinary.
But this one—
Was actually made from Origin Stone.
[Supreme Gold-Grade Token] (Rare)
[Restriction]: Supreme Gold-Grade Token
[Privileges]:
Exclusive Gold-Grade Realm Secret Realm — Super S-Class]
Free access to all Treasure Lands, Danger Zones, Forbidden Lands, Secret Realms, and other territories directly controlled by the Holy Golden Mountain.]
For any Treasure Lands, Danger Zones, Forbidden Lands, Secret Realms, or similar regions in which the Holy Golden Mountain participates, the holder may apply for entry without limitation.]
Receives the Holy Golden Mountain’s latest and most urgent real-time intelligence automatically.
No contribution points are required for subscription.]
Can directly contact any Holy Golden Mountain powerhouse below T9 Oracle-grade without consuming contribution points.]
Displays the current territory controlled by the Holy Golden Mountain.]
Elder Council members may issue missions of the highest level.]
All Holy Golden Mountain permissions are set to the Highest Level.]
[Introduction]:
The Gold-Grade Token is the symbol of official membership within the Holy Golden Mountain.
The Supreme Gold-Grade Token grants the holder full authority throughout the Holy Golden Mountain.
Its permission level is—
[Highest Level].
Daniel carefully examined the Holy Golden Mountain token in his hand.
This single token had completely opened every layer of authority to him.
His permission level had already reached the absolute maximum.
Supreme Gold-Grade Token!
From this moment onward, Daniel was no longer some low-level member of the Holy Golden Mountain.
He had effectively become a shareholder and co-founder.
More importantly—
He was now a standing member of the board.
His authority was extraordinarily high.
When Grand Oracle Shamir saw Daniel accept the Gold-Grade Token, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He had not been worried that Daniel would accept it.
He had been worried that Daniel would refuse.
The Holy Golden Mountain had already suffered a massive decline in strength.
Even if Daniel decided to leave the faction now, it would be completely understandable.
Grand Oracle Shamir would have no way to stop him.
But Daniel had accepted the Supreme Gold-Grade Token.
That meant Daniel was still willing to remain part of the Holy Golden Mountain.
For Shamir—
That was already an excellent result.
"Faustus possesses potential capable of dazzling countless eras."
Grand Oracle Shamir silently thought,
"He will inevitably become an incomparably powerful existence in the future."
"As long as he remains with the Holy Golden Mountain, the Holy Golden Mountain is destined to rise again."
"And as a member of the Holy Golden Mountain..."
"I may also receive Faustus’s protection in the future."
With that thought, Grand Oracle Shamir continued,
"Faustus, you have now passed four Cosmic Tribulations and reached Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"At your current level, you are already capable of refining your own Divine Soul clone."
Grand Oracle Shamir explained,
"You can take your Gold-Grade Token to the headquarters’ Sacred Art archive."
"There, you may select one of the highest-level Divine Soul techniques."
"Once you cultivate a Divine Soul clone..."
"Your overall Strength will undoubtedly rise again."

chapters.title: Chapter 528 -528-Cultivating the Universe
paragraphs: Cultivators who followed the Divine Soul path could begin refining a personal Divine Soul clone once they reached Tier-3 Oracle-grade.
Every Divine Soul clone possessed all of the Strength of the original body.
This was one of the greatest advantages Divine Soul cultivators held over those who followed the physical-body path.
Daniel was already Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
Because his Rank had advanced far too quickly, he had not even taken the time to properly consider refining his own Divine Soul clones.
After hearing Grand Oracle Shamir’s explanation, Daniel silently thought,
"The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters really is a good choice."
The cultivation manuals used to refine Divine Soul clones were extremely important.
Only the Holy Golden Mountain could provide Daniel with truly supreme-grade manuals.
In terms of its collection of cultivation texts, the Holy Golden Mountain could unquestionably be considered one of the greatest throughout the entire Chaosverse.
Daniel immediately bid farewell to Grand Oracle Shamir.
With the Supreme Gold-Grade Token in his possession, he easily gained access to numerous cultivation manuals.
Most importantly—
Manuals specifically related to Divine Soul clone cultivation.
Even the lowest-level texts among them had been personally written by T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The strongest manual had actually been created by an Eternal Grade powerhouse.
And that Divine Soul Eternal powerhouse—
Was none other than the ancient expert who had founded the Holy Golden Mountain.
In the past, Daniel’s Rank and authority had been too low.
Naturally, he had never possessed the qualifications to access Sacred Arts and inheritances left behind by an existence of that level.
But now—
His Rank of authority had already reached the highest level.
Naturally, he could finally access the opportunities and inheritances left behind by Eternal powerhouses.
Daniel did not select only one manual.
Instead, he took a copy of every Divine Soul clone cultivation manual written by powerhouses at T9 Oracle-grade or above.
All of them had copied versions available, so taking one copy made no difference.
Daniel had never intended to blindly follow the paths walked by his predecessors.
Just as when he cultivated his physical body—
Everything had to be adapted to the individual.
Daniel read everything.
He studied everything.
But when it came time to cultivate, he only selected the parts that truly inspired him.
He intended to gather the strengths of countless schools and create a Divine Soul clone method that belonged entirely to himself.
Looking at the manuals in his hands, a faint smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
He then found a suitable Secret Realm within the Holy Golden Mountain.
The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters itself was composed of countless Secret Realms and innumerable planes.
Many of those Secret Realms had been left behind by high-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses.
One of the privileges granted by the Supreme Gold-Grade Token was unrestricted access to all of them.
Daniel immediately summoned the Time Treasure Chest.
This was a treasure he had exchanged for using contribution points during his time in the mysterious spacetime.
It naturally contained the Law of Spacetime.
When cultivating inside it, the flow of time could be accelerated by up to one hundred thousand times.
Daniel directly placed the Time Treasure Chest inside the Secret Realm and entered it.
An independent world existed within the chest.
Countless spacetime laws reinforced the interior.
The flow of time outside was completely isolated.
Daniel immediately adjusted the time ratio to its maximum setting.
An unknown number of years later—
Daniel finally finished reading all of the manuals.
He carefully organized everything he had learned and fell into deep thought.
"Refining a Divine Soul clone actually isn’t very difficult."
"However, after reading so many manuals at once, my understanding of Sacred Arts has become much deeper."
"Back when I accepted Grand Oracle Sophis’s inherited memories, I had already accumulated an unimaginably vast foundation."
"With a single thought, I could have created countless Law Sacred Arts."
"But I held myself back."
"Later, I underwent Golden Cosmic Tribulations."
"My comprehension of laws rose by another level."
"Many of my other laws also advanced to high-grade."
"My current foundation has already become impossible to calculate."
Daniel was now somewhat troubled.
Other cultivators would celebrate if they suddenly entered a state of enlightenment.
Some would even say—
If I hear the Dao in the morning, I could die content by evening.
Yet Daniel’s problem was the exact opposite.
He had experienced too many moments of enlightenment.
His comprehension had become too deep.
It felt as though a pond had already been filled to the brim and was about to overflow.
If another powerhouse experienced something like this, they would probably be willing to trade away part of their lifespan for the opportunity.
Yet Daniel found it troublesome.
"I should refine my Divine Soul clones first."
Daniel shook his head.
"Divine Soul clones are extremely useful."
"Whatever Strength or comprehension the clones gain can also directly benefit the main body."
"In the future, I can leave one clone inside the Time Treasure Mountain to cultivate year-round."
"The original body will benefit at the same time."
"Furthermore, chaos is about to descend upon the world."
"Having several clones will make handling matters much easier."
With that thought—
Daniel focused completely on refining his clones.
The process itself was relatively simple.
First—
Split apart portions of the Divine Soul.
Then use treasures to refine physical bodies.
Finally, place the separated Divine Soul fragments into the newly refined bodies.
Once that was completed, the first stage was finished.
The second stage involved modifying the physical bodies and nourishing the Divine Souls.
Because the Divine Souls of the clones and the original body came from the same source—
Every gain obtained by the Divine Soul clones could be shared with the main body.
Daniel possessed a Supreme Divine Soul.
For ordinary cultivators, splitting the Divine Soul could be extraordinarily difficult.
For Daniel—
It was comparatively simple.
Moreover, ordinary cultivators might only be capable of refining one or two clones.
At most—
Three.
Daniel, however, could potentially split off dozens.
Even hundreds.
"There’s no need to make too many."
"Enough to be useful is fine."
Daniel began by refining the physical bodies.
He possessed no shortage of treasures.
And the materials he owned were all among the finest available.
Before long—
He had refined three physical bodies.
Three clones.
That was already enough for him.
And if he ever needed more, he could refine additional ones at any time.
The most painful stage came next—
Splitting the Divine Soul.
Daniel endured the agony.
It was pain that came directly from the deepest part of the soul.
Gritting his teeth, he forcibly split off three portions of his Divine Soul.
Then he placed each fragment into one of the newly refined physical bodies.
The most important step was complete.
The next instant—
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Three figures stood before Daniel.
They looked almost identical to him.
At the same time—
All three opened their eyes.
Laws flowed within their pupils.
"Greetings, main body."
The three clones spoke simultaneously.
Daniel nodded calmly.
"You three will be called..."
"Dan Left."
"Dan Right."
"And Dan Above."
"Yes, main body."
The three clones answered in unison.
"Dan Left will remain within the Time Treasure Mountain."
Daniel continued,
"Dan Right will go to the Chaosverse."
"Dan Above will go to the God Realm within the Chaosverse."
Daniel quickly arranged their respective destinations.
The Chaosverse still required powerful experts to suppress and oversee matters.
Daniel had publicly announced that he was entering seclusion.
But if he disappeared for too long and never showed himself, it could easily create instability within his factions.
The clones possessed the same Strength as the main body.
Having one clone stationed somewhere was effectively no different from Daniel personally being there.
The God Realm possessed enormous resources.
It also controlled numerous planes.
If Dan Above went there, he could quickly reorganize everything.
At the same time, his presence would suppress any opportunists who tried to cause trouble.
As for Dan Left—
He would remain within the Time Treasure Mountain and cultivate.
Daniel waved his hand again.
He granted all three clones numerous Primordial Supreme Treasures and vast quantities of cultivation resources.
Soon afterward—
Dan Right and Dan Above departed.
After the clones left, Daniel frowned slightly.
When he had split his Divine Soul earlier, Daniel had actually been enduring two different forms of pain at the same time.
The first—
Was the agony caused by splitting the Divine Soul.
The second—
Was the pain from the black shadows corroding him.
The black-shadow poison that had once afflicted the Divine Emperor was truly terrifying.
The slightest moment of weakness—
And it would immediately exploit the opening.
Previously, Daniel had always devoted a portion of his concentration to suppressing it.
He had not expected that while splitting his Divine Soul, there would be a brief instant when his state weakened.
And the black shadows had seized precisely that opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 -529-Confronting a Half-Step Eternal Sacred Art
paragraphs: Daniel let out a muffled grunt and forcibly suppressed the black shadow.
A Sacred Art left behind by a peak half-step Eternal Grade powerhouse was indeed extremely difficult to deal with.
Even Daniel could only suppress it temporarily.
He silently thought,
"Now that I’ve refined my Divine Soul clones, the next step is to create my own Sacred Art."
"I need to create a Sacred Art that perfectly suits me."
"My foundation is more than sufficient."
"In fact, I have too much accumulated comprehension."
"The only question is how I should bring it all together."
Daniel still felt that one mind was not enough.
He needed his other three clones to meditate alongside him.
That way, it would be equivalent to four Daniels cultivating simultaneously.
They could freely create Sacred Arts and verify each other’s deductions.
Among the laws Daniel had mastered, the strongest were—
The Law of Destruction.
The Law of Causality.
The Law of Reincarnation.
The Law of Creation.
The Law of Yin and Yang.
And the Law of Time.
The remaining laws could only be considered supporting paths.
The Sacred Art Daniel intended to create would be built upon these core laws.
With that thought, Daniel immediately calmed his mind and began his deductions.
Several hundred thousand years passed in the blink of an eye.
The time ratio within the Time Treasure Mountain was 1:100,000.
Thus, only several years had actually passed in the outside world.
Inside the Time Treasure Mountain, Daniel slowly extended one hand with his palm facing upward.
At this moment, subtle changes had appeared across his palm.
Every line on his hand now contained extraordinarily dense law power.
The Strength contained within it was already comparable to that of Three Thousand Worlds in My Palm—
No.
It exceeded that Sacred Art by countless times.
Countless laws were intertwined within his palm.
The profound Law of Reincarnation.
The profound Law of Causality.
The profound Law of Destruction.
The transcendent Law of Yin and Yang.
The transcendent Law of Creation.
As well as the Law of Time and numerous other laws.
And this was only the beginning.
Daniel slowly raised his hand.
Within the phantom above his palm, Primordial Chaos suddenly appeared.
It rapidly merged into his palm.
Primordial Chaos began evolving on its own.
As the Law of Time circulated, countless living beings, countless races, and countless powerhouses were born within the Primordial Chaos in Daniel’s palm.
And every single one of those living beings—
Looked exactly like Daniel.
Then—
Countless Daniels simultaneously released terrifying Strength and reinforced the colossal palm.
In an instant, the space surrounding Daniel’s hand was torn apart.
He had not even actively unleashed the Sacred Art yet.
And yet its terrifying pressure had already suppressed and shattered the surrounding space.
Terrifying!
At the same time—
The universe began to tremble.
Within Daniel’s palm, trillions of living beings had evolved.
As Primordial Chaos continued developing on its own, still more beings identical to Daniel were born.
Then all of them released their energy simultaneously.
Within the range of Daniel’s palm, even space itself began collapsing.
He had not truly unleashed the attack yet—
And spacetime was already incapable of enduring its existence.
If he actually used it in battle...
Just how terrifying would its power become?
At that moment—
The universe trembled again.
Daniel clearly sensed a faint vibration spreading through the universe.
At first, it was only a slight twitch.
Then—
The trembling became violent.
The universe was shaking.
As the vibrations intensified, every Oracle-grade, Divine-grade, and super-god-grade powerhouse throughout the Endless Starfield suddenly sensed something abnormal.
Even ordinary mortals were overwhelmed by inexplicable fear.
It felt as though some horrifying existence had suddenly appeared.
It was utterly absurd.
Countless experts throughout the Endless Starfield simultaneously sensed the Great Dao.
The trembling of the Great Dao was immediately detected by them.
They were completely shocked.
Even powerhouses within the Ultimate Domain were startled.
"Damn it!"
"The Cosmic Tremor again?"
"What happened this time?"
Even Eternal Grade powerhouses could not immediately understand.
Only existences at their level knew just how rare it was for something to make the entire universe tremble.
Yet recently, the universe seemed to be suffering spasms.
It trembled at the slightest disturbance.
"Could some heaven-defying treasure have appeared?"
An Eternal powerhouse wondered.
"Or is another monster undergoing a tribulation?"
Another Eternal powerhouse immediately thought of Daniel.
Even the Eternal powerhouses were confused.
Naturally, ordinary Oracle-grade experts understood even less.
When the universe trembled, their own laws trembled along with it.
And that had enormous consequences.
Countless Oracle-grade experts felt their hearts pound with alarm.
"How is this possible?"
"Even the laws of the universe are trembling!"
"My own laws are being affected!"
"My God, what exactly happened?!"
"What kind of event could possibly make the entire universe tremble?!"
Just as countless powerhouses were shocked and innumerable living beings were overwhelmed—
Buzz!
Buzz!
The Cosmic Tremor appeared once again!
Throughout the Endless Starfield—
Across countless universes...
Countless starfields...
Countless star rivers...
Countless galaxies...
And among countless living beings...
Everyone felt their minds roar.
Inside the Time Treasure Mountain—
Daniel slowly curled his fingers inward one by one.
His palm finally clenched into a fist.
Crack!
A violent explosion rang out.
Rumble!
The surrounding space could no longer endure the pressure.
It shattered like countless fragments of glass.
The Law Sacred Art—
Was complete!
At the same time—
The Cosmic Tremor erupted!
A deafening roar exploded directly inside Daniel’s mind.
It was the sound of the universe itself trembling.
And then—
The rules of the universe began to change.
The change did not occur all at once.
Instead, the laws of the universe were slowly being rewritten.
One had to understand—
Even Eternal powerhouses were incapable of altering the rules of the universe.
Yet Daniel—
Had done it.
"The rules of the universe were altered because of me?"
Daniel could receive information that other powerhouses could not.
After all—
He was the cause of this change.
"It seems..."
"I added another Rank to Oracle-grade."
"Beyond Tier-1 through T9 Oracle-grade..."
"Transcendent Oracle-grade?"
"From now on, whenever a Transcendent Oracle-grade powerhouse undergoes a tribulation, the universe will manifest my figure."
"I will serve as the Lord of Tribulation Punishment."
"And I’ll receive a share of the tribulation itself."
"I’ll obtain Great Dao Tribulation Power."
"Unfortunately, I’m currently only Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"For now, I can only influence cultivators undergoing tribulations from Tier One through Tier Four."
"If I reach T9 Oracle-grade..."
"Then I’ll be able to influence all of them."
Somewhere inside a Secret Realm of the Myriad Races Universe—
Kru’s entire body was trembling.
"Master!"
"The universe is trembling."
"The Cosmic Tremor has appeared again!"
Kru carefully sensed the changes occurring throughout the universe.
"Even the rules of the universe are being rewritten!"
"Master, is there actually some powerhouse altering the rules of the universe?"
The universe was incomparably terrifying.
All living beings existed beneath its control.
Because of that—
Even Eternal powerhouses could not casually modify the fundamental rules of the universe.
Unless the universe itself chose to change them.
But to force the universe to voluntarily alter its own rules...
That should have been impossible!
And yet—
Kru could clearly sense it happening right now.
How could he possibly remain calm?
Supreme Saint Miral was also sensing the changes in the cosmic laws.
What surprised him was not the trembling of the universe.
Nor was it the Cosmic Tremor.
What truly shocked him—
Was the content of the rule being altered.
It concerned Oracle-grade.
At Supreme Saint Miral’s level, standing at the pinnacle of Eternal Divine-grade, he was capable of sensing exactly what changes were being made to the universe’s rules.
"Someone’s Strength has broken through the limitations imposed by the universe."
Supreme Saint Miral spoke while sensing the changes.
"That person has shattered the existing division of Ranks."
"In other words..."
"From this moment onward, Oracle-grade will possess an additional Rank."
Oracle-grade—
Would gain another Rank?

Within the range of Daniel’s palm, even space itself began collapsing.
He had not truly unleashed the attack yet—
And spacetime was already incapable of enduring its existence.
If he actually used it in battle...
Just how terrifying would its power become?
At that moment—
The universe trembled again.
Daniel clearly sensed a faint vibration spreading through the universe.
At first, it was only a slight twitch.
Then—
The trembling became violent.
The universe was shaking.
As the vibrations intensified, every Oracle-grade, Divine-grade, and super-god-grade powerhouse throughout the Endless Starfield suddenly sensed something abnormal.
Even ordinary mortals were overwhelmed by inexplicable fear.
It felt as though some horrifying existence had suddenly appeared.
It was utterly absurd.
Countless experts throughout the Endless Starfield simultaneously sensed the Great Dao.
The trembling of the Great Dao was immediately detected by them.
They were completely shocked.
Even powerhouses within the Ultimate Domain were startled.
"Damn it!"
"The Cosmic Tremor again?"
"What happened this time?"
Even Eternal Grade powerhouses could not immediately understand.
Only existences at their level knew just how rare it was for something to make the entire universe tremble.
Yet recently, the universe seemed to be suffering spasms.
It trembled at the slightest disturbance.
"Could some heaven-defying treasure have appeared?"
An Eternal powerhouse wondered.
"Or is another monster undergoing a tribulation?"
Another Eternal powerhouse immediately thought of Daniel.
Even the Eternal powerhouses were confused.
Naturally, ordinary Oracle-grade experts understood even less.
When the universe trembled, their own laws trembled along with it.
And that had enormous consequences.
Countless Oracle-grade experts felt their hearts pound with alarm.
"How is this possible?"
"Even the laws of the universe are trembling!"
"My own laws are being affected!"
"My God, what exactly happened?!"
"What kind of event could possibly make the entire universe tremble?!"
Just as countless powerhouses were shocked and innumerable living beings were overwhelmed—
Buzz!
Buzz!
The Cosmic Tremor appeared once again!
Throughout the Endless Starfield—
Across countless universes...
Countless starfields...
Countless star rivers...
Countless galaxies...
And among countless living beings...
Everyone felt their minds roar.
Inside the Time Treasure Mountain—
Daniel slowly curled his fingers inward one by one.
His palm finally clenched into a fist.
Crack!
A violent explosion rang out.
Rumble!
The surrounding space could no longer endure the pressure.
It shattered like countless fragments of glass.
The Law Sacred Art—
Was complete!
At the same time—
The Cosmic Tremor erupted!
A deafening roar exploded directly inside Daniel’s mind.
It was the sound of the universe itself trembling.
And then—
The rules of the universe began to change.
The change did not occur all at once.
Instead, the laws of the universe were slowly being rewritten.
One had to understand—
Even Eternal powerhouses were incapable of altering the rules of the universe.
Yet Daniel—
Had done it.
"The rules of the universe were altered because of me?"
Daniel could receive information that other powerhouses could not.
After all—
He was the cause of this change.
"It seems..."
"I added another Rank to Oracle-grade."
"Beyond Tier-1 through T9 Oracle-grade..."
"Transcendent Oracle-grade?"
"From now on, whenever a Transcendent Oracle-grade powerhouse undergoes a tribulation, the universe will manifest my figure."
"I will serve as the Lord of Tribulation Punishment."
"And I’ll receive a share of the tribulation itself."
"I’ll obtain Great Dao Tribulation Power."
"Unfortunately, I’m currently only Tier-4 Oracle-grade."
"For now, I can only influence cultivators undergoing tribulations from Tier One through Tier Four."
"If I reach T9 Oracle-grade..."
"Then I’ll be able to influence all of them."
Somewhere inside a Secret Realm of the Myriad Races Universe—
Kru’s entire body was trembling.
"Master!"
"The universe is trembling."
"The Cosmic Tremor has appeared again!"
Kru carefully sensed the changes occurring throughout the universe.
"Even the rules of the universe are being rewritten!"
"Master, is there actually some powerhouse altering the rules of the universe?"
The universe was incomparably terrifying.
All living beings existed beneath its control.
Because of that—
Even Eternal powerhouses could not casually modify the fundamental rules of the universe.
Unless the universe itself chose to change them.
But to force the universe to voluntarily alter its own rules...
That should have been impossible!
And yet—
Kru could clearly sense it happening right now.
How could he possibly remain calm?
Supreme Saint Miral was also sensing the changes in the cosmic laws.
What surprised him was not the trembling of the universe.
Nor was it the Cosmic Tremor.
What truly shocked him—
Was the content of the rule being altered.
It concerned Oracle-grade.
At Supreme Saint Miral’s level, standing at the pinnacle of Eternal Divine-grade, he was capable of sensing exactly what changes were being made to the universe’s rules.
"Someone’s Strength has broken through the limitations imposed by the universe."
Supreme Saint Miral spoke while sensing the changes.
"That person has shattered the existing division of Ranks."
"In other words..."
"From this moment onward, Oracle-grade will possess an additional Rank."
Oracle-grade—
Would gain another Rank?

chapters.title: Chapter 530 -530-One Step to Supreme
paragraphs: Just how terrifying and heaven-defying did a powerhouse have to be to reach such a level?
The Rank system of the Endless Starfield had remained unchanged for countless years.
For the most part, those Ranks were only used as reference standards.
And yet now—
A powerhouse had actually shattered the existing Rank system itself.
The universe had been forced to repair its rules and redefine the Oracle-grade Rank system.
Kru could not help feeling deep respect toward that mysterious powerhouse.
An existence capable of reaching such a level was truly one of a kind throughout eternity.
Suddenly, Kru asked,
"Master..."
"Was it Supreme Saint Faustus?"
Ever since meeting Faustus, Kru had found himself paying an unusual amount of attention to him.
And for some reason, he had a strong intuition—
This latest change was very likely related to Faustus as well.
Supreme Saint Miral replied calmly,
"It was him."
"Apart from Supreme Saint Faustus, no one in this spacetime could possibly reach such a level."
Suddenly—
His expression changed.
"No."
"The rules are being modified again!"
Supreme Saint Miral stared in shock.
"The exact contents of the rule change have appeared."
"Within Tier-1 through T9 Oracle-grade, an entirely new Rank has been added."
"This Rank is called—"
"Transcendent Oracle-grade!"
"Transcendent Oracle-grade means possessing Strength that transcends the limits of one’s current tier."
Kru muttered in disbelief,
"Transcendent Oracle-grade..."
"Strength surpassing the limits of the current Rank?"
Terrifying.
Faustus’s Strength had actually reached such an absurd level.
Supreme Saint Miral continued,
"From now on, Oracle-grade cultivators may choose to first reach Transcendent Oracle-grade before undergoing their next Cosmic Tribulation."
"However, once an Oracle-grade powerhouse reaches Transcendent Oracle-grade, the lowest-level Cosmic Tribulation they can face will be Silver."
"And they must undergo two tribulations."
"One is the normal Cosmic Tribulation."
"The other..."
"Is the Transcendence Tribulation."
"The manifestation of the Transcendence Tribulation is—"
"Faustus!"
Supreme Saint Miral’s expression changed dramatically.
He exclaimed in shock,
"So it truly was God Faustus!"
"From now on, every Oracle-grade powerhouse who undergoes a Transcendence Tribulation..."
"Will have to face a manifestation of God Faustus!"
"This achievement is unprecedented throughout history."
"It is something rarely seen across all existence."
Kru deeply agreed.
One had to understand—
Across countless ages, no one had ever achieved anything like this.
After undergoing a Cosmic Tribulation, that person had actually caused the universe to create an entirely new tribulation.
Supreme Saint Miral spoke with obvious envy.
"Every time the universe manifests Faustus during a tribulation, Faustus himself will receive a portion of Great Dao Tribulation Power."
"In other words..."
"From now on, whenever a Transcendent Oracle-grade powerhouse appears and faces the manifested Faustus—"
"Whether that cultivator succeeds or fails..."
"Faustus will still absorb the Great Dao Tribulation Power bestowed by the universe."
"That Great Dao Tribulation Power is incomparably precious."
"Even many Eternal powerhouses would envy such a thing."
"Faustus truly deserves to be the strongest Eternal Supreme Saint."
When Kru heard this, envy immediately rose in his heart.
He had followed Supreme Saint Miral across countless spacetimes.
He had challenged geniuses from innumerable eras and worlds.
Yet he had never encountered anyone as monstrous and absurd as Daniel.
There were even countless things Daniel could accomplish that Kru himself could not.
Compared with Daniel—
The talent Kru had always been so proud of almost seemed like a joke.
It was difficult to imagine that someone could actually become so powerful that the entire universe trembled because of him.
Even more absurdly—
The universe had modified its Rank rules because of him.
It had changed the very form of Cosmic Tribulations.
Before Daniel appeared, throughout the Endless Starfield and countless universes—
No one had ever achieved such a thing.
Only Daniel.
He had forcibly done it.
He had made the universe modify its rules specifically because of him.
He had even caused the cultivation Rank system itself to change!
From now on—
At the later stages of every Oracle-grade tier, powerful cultivators could continue strengthening their foundations until reaching this newly established Rank.
Transcendent Oracle-grade.
At that level, they could unleash Strength far exceeding the normal limits of their current tier.
However—
When they underwent their next breakthrough tribulation, there would now be an additional calamity.
The Faustus Tribulation!
Also known as—
The Transcendence Tribulation!
And the manifestation of this tribulation—
Would be a phantom of Faustus.
The exact difficulty of the tribulation would depend on the Strength of the cultivator undergoing it.
But there was no doubt—
It would massively increase the difficulty of breaking through.
Regardless—
Such an achievement was unprecedented throughout eternity.
Daniel himself had been the first and clearest to sense the changes to the universe’s rules.
Including the exact contents of those changes.
Supreme Saint Miral belonged to the second group.
Thanks to his own overwhelming Strength, he was able to sense the specific modifications.
After that—
The Eternal powerhouses, countless Oracle-grade experts, and Divine-grade cultivators began sensing the changes as well.
The universe directly manifested the new rules.
It allowed countless living beings and powerhouses to clearly understand what had happened.
Throughout the Endless Starfield—
The Cosmic Tremor gradually weakened.
Many Eternal powerhouses stopped focusing on the trembling itself.
Instead—
They were shocked by the reason behind it.
"The universe trembled because a powerhouse’s Strength was recognized by the universe itself?"
"And the universe voluntarily modified its rules and changed the Rank system because of him?!"
Even Eternal powerhouses could not help being stunned.
Every existence capable of reaching Eternal Grade had once been the most dazzling genius of a particular spacetime.
Before becoming Eternal—
Every one of them had dominated their era.
They had stood above all their peers.
Yet none of them had ever achieved what Daniel had just done.
The universe did not casually acknowledge any powerhouse.
Throughout the Endless Starfield, the River of Time, and countless living beings—
Everything operated under the observation and control of the universe.
To receive recognition from the universe—
Was already extraordinarily difficult.
But forcing the universe to modify its own rules?
That was on an entirely different level.
"The addition of another Cosmic Tribulation is even more outrageous."
The Eternal powerhouses were both jealous and envious.
"Doesn’t that mean the powerhouse who changed the universe has effectively become a [Secondary] Manifestation of the Universe itself?"
"From now on, every cultivator who reaches Transcendent Oracle-grade must pass through that powerhouse’s trial."
"What kind of supreme glory is that?"
Many Eternal powerhouses understood exactly what this change meant.
"This means..."
"Every cultivation manual written in the past now has a flaw."
"When the textbooks can no longer keep up with the era..."
"They must be rewritten."
"And every future cultivation textbook will have to record what happened today."
"A powerhouse gained recognition from the universe."
"He created an entirely new Rank."
"And from that moment onward, the cultivation system gained an additional stage."
The Eternal powerhouses all understood.
"It’s time to rewrite the textbooks."
"We must make sure all future cultivators keep pace with the new era."
"Now that Transcendent Oracle-grade exists..."
"We have to study it."
"Pass down my order."
"Rewrite every cultivation manual."
"Start from the most basic levels."
The influence Daniel had created—
Was far greater than he had imagined!
Countless factions suddenly realized the implications.
If they did not want to fall behind—
They had to keep up with the times.
Study Transcendent Oracle-grade.
Rewrite cultivation manuals.
Add methods for cultivating toward Transcendent Oracle-grade!
Before long—
Factions throughout the Endless Starfield began receiving summons from their ancient ancestors.
Decrees descended one after another.
Starting from the cultivation of ordinary mortals—
Their entire cultivation systems would be revised.
All for one purpose.
So that future generations might eventually reach—
Transcendent Oracle-grade!
Across countless universes—
Faction after faction simultaneously began researching, modifying, and expanding their cultivation systems.
The cosmic laws had already made the concept perfectly clear.
Transcendent Oracle-grade—
Was achieved by accumulating such an overwhelmingly powerful foundation that one’s Strength surpassed the normal limit of the current Rank.
In principle—
The concept itself was not particularly difficult to understand.
The Ultimate Domain.
Within countless Domain Worlds—
The Eternal powerhouses were initially shocked.
Then confused.
Then enlightened.
And finally—
Their expressions became urgent.
They desperately wanted to research Transcendent Oracle-grade!
They also wanted to keep pace with the changing era.
"Pass down my decree!"
"Summon every powerhouse across all cultivation tiers."
"We will research Transcendent Oracle-grade together!"
nal Tribulation Palace and stole their spoils.
He had even robbed the Eternal Tribulation Palace itself in the process.
Worse still, he had severely injured Demon Lord Myriad Hands, beating him so badly that he vomited blood in rage.
Daniel had never expected the Eternal Tribulation Palace to be this powerful.
They had actually ambushed and killed the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain within the Endless Tribulation Sea.
That must have required at least two T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
There was probably more to the matter.
Sure enough—

"Before dying, the leader also killed a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse," Grand Oracle Shamir said. "Before his death, the leader warned us that the Eternal Tribulation Palace and several factions from the Ultimate Domain intend to invade the Myriad Races Universe."
"Their objective is most likely the Universe Core."
"That is why he ordered the Holy Golden Mountain to relocate as quickly as possible."
Daniel frowned.
"The Universe Core?"
"What is that?"
Grand Oracle Shamir explained,
"The Universe Core is the concentrated essence of an entire universe."
"Under normal circumstances, no powerhouse would dare directly refine a universe in order to obtain its Universe Core."
"Not even an Eternal powerhouse would dare do so lightly."
"Because doing so would burden them with an unimaginable amount of karma."
"And that is absolutely not something an ordinary person could withstand!"
