chapters.title: Chapter 531 -531-Changes in the Endless Starfield
paragraphs: At this moment, Daniel had no idea just how much of a shock he had brought to the Endless Starfield!!!
By now, Transcendent Oracle-grade had already formed into a surging tide, and every powerhouse wanted to catch up with it.
If they failed to keep pace, they would fall behind.
And falling behind meant death.
If they wanted to survive, they had no choice but to compete relentlessly.
Daniel had directly changed the current era and influenced the eras to come.
Beginning with him, this age would affect countless powerhouses throughout the endless depths of space.
Inside the Time Treasure Chest, Daniel’s eyes gleamed sharply.
He said calmly, "I merely created a Sacred Art of my own, yet it actually caused the universe to modify its rules and add an entirely new Rank. Just how powerful must this Sacred Art itself be?"
When Daniel created the Sacred Art, he had not thought that far ahead at all.

It had simply arisen naturally because his accumulated foundation was deep enough, combined with the enormous improvement his law power had undergone during his tribulations. He had merely wanted to create a Sacred Art of his own.
He had never intended to change the universe.
A faint smile appeared on his face. It seemed this Sacred Art of his was indeed extraordinary.
Daniel had created other Sacred Arts in the past as well, such as Primordial Chaos and the Chastity Sacred Art.
But those two Sacred Arts had seemed rather ordinary by comparison.

Daniel thought to himself, "This time, I fused Three Thousand Worlds in My Palm, Primordial Chaos, and the Heaven-and-Earth Manifestation Sacred Art, together with the power of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation, the Law of Reincarnation, the Law of Causality, the Law of Destruction, the Law of Creation, the Law of Spacetime, and numerous other laws, all built upon an endless foundation of Sacred Power. That was how I created this Sacred Art."
With that thought, Daniel decided on a new name for it.
From now on, this Sacred Art would be called the Cosmic Reincarnation Body.
He would be able to use it without limit in the future, and he alone could use it.
Because of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation, this Sacred Art had to be used together with the halo. That meant no one else could ever learn it.
It was a Sacred Art exclusive to Daniel alone.
At that moment, Daniel’s clone outside received an urgent message from Grand Oracle Shamir.
The Time Treasure Mountain existed in an independent spacetime and was isolated from everything outside, so no messages could reach it directly.
However, Daniel possessed clones, and everything experienced by his clones could be shared with him.
Thus, he received the message.
The moment Daniel learned the details, he was stunned.
What was going on?
The Gold-Grade leader was dead?
Daniel was momentarily dazed by the news.
Oscar, the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain, had been a peak T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse, an existence on the verge of becoming half-step Eternal.
Yet a powerhouse of that level had actually died.
And he had died within the Ultimate Domain.
The news was truly shocking.
After all, that was a region where many Eternal powerhouses existed.
Oscar, leader of the Holy Golden Mountain, had gone to the Ultimate Domain seeking aid because the Myriad Races Universe had been locked by time.
The Holy Golden Mountain’s founder, an Eternal powerhouse, had already died long ago during the Eternal Quantitative Tribulation.
In other words, the Holy Golden Mountain had already lost its greatest backer.
And now even its leader was dead.
Dais’s eyes flickered. The Holy Golden Mountain was probably finished.

There were already very few T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses remaining in the Holy Golden Mountain. A group of them had previously fled because the lifespan of the Myriad Races Universe was nearing its end.
Now that Oscar, the pillar supporting the Holy Golden Mountain, had suddenly died, there would probably be more Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses preparing to leave.
One had to understand—
When a Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse left, they did not leave alone.
Their race, sect, descendants, and countless closely connected powerhouses would all leave with them.
In other words—
The departure of a single Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse was equivalent to the departure of numerous low- and mid-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses, along with countless Divine-grade experts.
The Holy Golden Mountain’s Strength had already shrunk severely before this.
If news of the leader’s death spread completely—
Another massive wave of powerhouses would probably no longer wish to remain.
The situation was clearly extremely urgent.
Daniel decided to bring his main body out of secluded cultivation.
He left the Dan Left clone behind to continue cultivating.
After leaving the Holy Golden Mountain Secret Realm, Daniel found Grand Oracle Shamir.
"Faustus, you’re here."
Grand Oracle Shamir looked much more haggard than before.
One had to understand—
What kind of existence was a Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse?
For someone of that level to appear haggard, they had to be utterly exhausted in both body and mind.
That was exactly Shamir’s condition.
"Senior Shamir, what exactly happened?"
Just now, Grand Oracle Shamir had only sent the message without explaining the details.
Hearing Daniel’s question, Grand Oracle Shamir said sorrowfully,
"I wasn’t the first powerhouse to receive the news either."
"The first group to learn of it were T8 Oracle-grade powerhouses such as Grand Oracle Wujiu and Grand Oracle Desolate God."
Daniel nodded.
Grand Oracle Wujiu was the leader of one of the factions backing Grand Oracle Shamir.
Grand Oracle Desolate God was the leader of the faction behind Wuzu Oracle-grade, who had once made things difficult for Daniel during the Holy Golden Mountain assessment.
"Grand Oracle Wujiu said that before Leader Oscar died, he left behind a Sacred Heart recording."
"Leader Oscar fell at the border between the Endless Tribulation Sea and the Ultimate Domain."
"The killers were several T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses from the Eternal Tribulation Palace!"
Daniel’s pupils contracted sharply.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace!!!
The strongest faction in the Endless Tribulation Sea.
It was backed by an Eternal powerhouse, possessed numerous T9 Oracle-grade experts, and commanded a vast number of Oracle-grade powerhouses.
Their sole business was raiding across the starry sky.
They wantonly plundered the resources of major universes and destroyed one plane after another.
Anyone captured by them had only two choices.
Either become a prisoner and work for them for an extremely long time—
Or die!
Back when Daniel had reached Divine Sovereign-grade—
Within the Blackwater Realm—
He had encountered one of the Eternal Tribulation Palace’s raiding teams.
Their leader had been Demon Lord Myriad Hands, a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
At the time, the Eternal Tribulation Palace had intended to plunder the Blackwater Realm belonging to the Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouse, Blackwater Ancestor.
Daniel had taken advantage of the chaos.
He followed behind the Eternal Tribulation Palace and stole their spoils.
He had even robbed the Eternal Tribulation Palace itself in the process.
Worse still, he had severely injured Demon Lord Myriad Hands, beating him so badly that he vomited blood in rage.
Daniel had never expected the Eternal Tribulation Palace to be this powerful.
They had actually ambushed and killed the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain within the Endless Tribulation Sea.
That must have required at least two T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
There was probably more to the matter.
Sure enough—

"Before dying, the leader also killed a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse," Grand Oracle Shamir said. "Before his death, the leader warned us that the Eternal Tribulation Palace and several factions from the Ultimate Domain intend to invade the Myriad Races Universe."
"Their objective is most likely the Universe Core."
"That is why he ordered the Holy Golden Mountain to relocate as quickly as possible."
Daniel frowned.
"The Universe Core?"
"What is that?"
Grand Oracle Shamir explained,
"The Universe Core is the concentrated essence of an entire universe."
"Under normal circumstances, no powerhouse would dare directly refine a universe in order to obtain its Universe Core."
"Not even an Eternal powerhouse would dare do so lightly."
"Because doing so would burden them with an unimaginable amount of karma."
"And that is absolutely not something an ordinary person could withstand!"

By now, Transcendent Oracle-grade had already formed into a surging tide, and every powerhouse wanted to catch up with it.
If they failed to keep pace, they would fall behind.
And falling behind meant death.
If they wanted to survive, they had no choice but to compete relentlessly.
Daniel had directly changed the current era and influenced the eras to come.
Beginning with him, this age would affect countless powerhouses throughout the endless depths of space.
Inside the Time Treasure Chest, Daniel’s eyes gleamed sharply.
He said calmly, "I merely created a Sacred Art of my own, yet it actually caused the universe to modify its rules and add an entirely new Rank.

It had simply arisen naturally because his accumulated foundation was deep enough, combined with the enormous improvement his law power had undergone during his tribulations.
He had merely wanted to create a Sacred Art of his own.
He had never intended to change the universe.
A faint smile appeared on his face.
It seemed this Sacred Art of his was indeed extraordinary.
Daniel had created other Sacred Arts in the past as well, such as Primordial Chaos and the Chastity Sacred Art.
But those two Sacred Arts had seemed rather ordinary by comparison.

Daniel thought to himself, "This time, I fused Three Thousand Worlds in My Palm, Primordial Chaos, and the Heaven-and-Earth Manifestation Sacred Art, together with the power of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation, the Law of Reincarnation, the Law of Causality, the Law of Destruction, the Law of Creation, the Law of Spacetime, and numerous other laws, all built upon an endless foundation of Sacred Power.
That was how I created this Sacred Art."
With that thought, Daniel decided on a new name for it.
From now on, this Sacred Art would be called the Cosmic Reincarnation Body.
He would be able to use it without limit in the future, and he alone could use it.
Because of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation, this Sacred Art had to be used together with the halo.
That meant no one else could ever learn it.
It was a Sacred Art exclusive to Daniel alone.

The Time Treasure Mountain existed in an independent spacetime and was isolated from everything outside, so no messages could reach it directly.

Thus, he received the message.

What was going on?
The Gold-Grade leader was dead?

Yet a powerhouse of that level had actually died.
And he had died within the Ultimate Domain.
The news was truly shocking.
After all, that was a region where many Eternal powerhouses existed.
Oscar, leader of the Holy Golden Mountain, had gone to the Ultimate Domain seeking aid because the Myriad Races Universe had been locked by time.
The Holy Golden Mountain’s founder, an Eternal powerhouse, had already died long ago during the Eternal Quantitative Tribulation.
In other words, the Holy Golden Mountain had already lost its greatest backer.
And now even its leader was dead.
Dais’s eyes flickered.
The Holy Golden Mountain was probably finished.
There were already very few T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses remaining in the Holy Golden Mountain.
A group of them had previously fled because the lifespan of the Myriad Races Universe was nearing its end.
Now that Oscar, the pillar supporting the Holy Golden Mountain, had suddenly died, there would probably be more Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses preparing to leave.
One had to understand—
When a Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse left, they did not leave alone.
Their race, sect, descendants, and countless closely connected powerhouses would all leave with them.
In other words—
The departure of a single Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse was equivalent to the departure of numerous low- and mid-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses, along with countless Divine-grade experts.
The Holy Golden Mountain’s Strength had already shrunk severely before this.
If news of the leader’s death spread completely—
Another massive wave of powerhouses would probably no longer wish to remain.
The situation was clearly extremely urgent.
Daniel decided to bring his main body out of secluded cultivation.
He left the Dan Left clone behind to continue cultivating.
After leaving the Holy Golden Mountain Secret Realm, Daniel found Grand Oracle Shamir.
"Faustus, you’re here."
Grand Oracle Shamir looked much more haggard than before.
One had to understand—
What kind of existence was a Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse?
For someone of that level to appear haggard, they had to be utterly exhausted in both body and mind.
That was exactly Shamir’s condition.
"Senior Shamir, what exactly happened?"
Just now, Grand Oracle Shamir had only sent the message without explaining the details.
Hearing Daniel’s question, Grand Oracle Shamir said sorrowfully,
"I wasn’t the first powerhouse to receive the news either."

chapters.title: Chapter 532 -532-Alarming the Eternal Powerhouses
paragraphs: Supreme Saint Miral continued explaining, "Aside from the Eternal powerhouses native to this universe, other Eternal powerhouses would likewise never allow them to do such a thing. Once a Universe Core appears, it means that the universe is about to enter the final stage of destruction."
"Moreover, the final Universe Core can only be refined before the universe reaches the end of its tribulation cycle."
"That is why even Eternal powerhouses find it extremely difficult to obtain such a treasure."
"But once they obtain a Universe Core, they will undoubtedly be able to refine even more terrifying treasures from it."
After listening to Supreme Saint Miral’s explanation, realization appeared on Daniel’s face.
"So that’s how it is."
"I never expected universes to actually possess something like a Universe Core."
"Just from the name alone, you can tell it’s anything but ordinary. And the conditions required to refine one are unbelievably harsh."
"You have to sacrifice every living being and everything within an entire universe, while also ensuring the refinement doesn’t take place under the watch of the Eye of the Universe."
"And if the Universe Core has to be refined before the Cosmic Tribulation descends..."
"Then what Leader Oscar said makes sense."
The Holy Golden Mountain was currently the strongest faction in the Myriad Gods Universe.
However, the Eternal powerhouse who had founded the Holy Golden Mountain had already fallen long ago.
Naturally, outside factions had begun coveting everything the Holy Golden Mountain possessed.
Even though Holy Golden Mountain Leader Oscar was a peak T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse, those factions still practically treated him as though he did not exist and dared to attack openly.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace, for example, had shown no fear whatsoever.
Most likely, they wanted to take this opportunity to weaken the native factions of the Myriad Gods Universe and lay the groundwork for eventually seizing its Universe Core.
And the Eternal Tribulation Palace was definitely not the only faction seeking the Universe Core.
At that thought, Daniel suddenly became excited.
It was easy to imagine—
The Myriad Gods Universe was about to descend into complete chaos.
And the scale of that chaos would be no less severe than what had happened in the Chaosverse.
Daniel suddenly asked,
"Is the Holy Golden Mountain preparing to relocate?"
Grand Oracle Shamir sighed.
"Most people are preparing to leave."
"Many Oracle-grade powerhouses also intend to abandon this universe."
"For example, Wujiu Oracle-grade plans to head to the Chaosverse."
"As for the other Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses, I don’t know where they intend to go, but most of them will probably leave as well."
At this point, Grand Oracle Shamir’s tone suddenly became subdued.
"When the time comes, I may also go to the Chaosverse."
"Another faction has offered me terms that are extremely difficult to refuse."
"They’re willing to give us an entire galaxy as a place to settle."
"I know you probably control a galaxy of your own as well."
"You made an excellent move there."
"You can simply relocate your entire faction directly into your own territory."
"That makes things much easier for you than for the Holy Golden Mountain."
Daniel frowned as he listened.
Suddenly, he asked,
"Senior Shamir, are you really planning to give up on the Myriad Gods Universe?"
"Why don’t we stay?"
"If the Holy Golden Mountain leaves, an enormous amount of resources will be abandoned here."
"These are the resources of an entire starfield."
"There are countless planets under its control, and the resources are practically endless."
"If we go to the Chaosverse, every galaxy already has a Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse overseeing it."
"Instead of abandoning all these resources and going somewhere else to fight others for scraps, wouldn’t it be better to stay here and continue developing what we already have?"
Grand Oracle Shamir fell silent.
Clearly, Daniel’s words had moved him somewhat.
After a while, however, he said,
"You may be right."
"There are indeed some powerhouses within the Holy Golden Mountain who are unwilling to leave."
"They would rather remain here and wait until the day the Cosmic Tribulation Source finally descends."
"But Faustus..."
"Once you enter the starry sky, there are many things beyond your control."
"I cannot remain here."
Daniel nodded.
There was nothing more he could say.
After all, he could hardly tell Shamir that he had a mission involving the disciple of an Eternal powerhouse coming to challenge him.
And that once Daniel defeated that disciple, he would be able to ask the Eternal powerhouse to remove the restriction affecting the Myriad Gods Universe.
Besides—
Even if Daniel told him, what difference would it make?
People’s hearts had already scattered.
If the Holy Golden Mountain was destined to fall apart, then so be it.
But for Daniel—
This was actually an opportunity.
"If I consolidate the forces the Holy Golden Mountain leaves behind, my overall power will increase tremendously!"
Daniel’s heart stirred.
Grand Oracle Shamir looked at him.
"You intend to stay?"
"That’s fine."
"I was actually about to inform you that the Elder Council will convene tomorrow."
"If you decide to remain here, I doubt anyone will have any reason to oppose it."
"They may even compensate you."
That was exactly what Daniel wanted.
He had a mission to complete.
He needed to remain in the Myriad Gods Universe and wait for the challenge that would soon arrive.
More importantly—
Earth was still in the Myriad Gods Universe.
Daniel had no intention of leaving.
Since remaining behind would allow him to consolidate the faction’s forces while also receiving compensation—
Why wouldn’t he do it?
Daniel had never expected things to develop this way.
He had only just obtained the Supreme Gold-Grade Token—
And the Holy Golden Mountain was already standing on the verge of dissolution.
Leader Oscar had been ambushed and killed by the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace had paid the price of losing a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse—
But Oscar had still fallen.
Before his death, Oscar had even left behind a final message.
The Holy Golden Mountain had to relocate as quickly as possible.
They needed to leave this dangerous place.
One had to understand—
The Holy Golden Mountain had always been an extremely loose organization.
Its overall faction was formed from countless independent forces.
None of them truly belonged to one another.
So when news comparable to the sky collapsing spread throughout the faction—
Many powerhouses immediately withdrew from the Holy Golden Mountain and began seeking their own paths.
Those who remained were divided into two groups.
The larger faction advocated returning to their respective homes and going their separate ways.
The smaller faction could not bear to abandon the Myriad Gods Universe.
They were willing to remain here until the day the Cosmic Tribulation Source descended.
And so—
Two meetings would be held tomorrow.
The first was an Elder Council meeting that would determine the faction’s overall direction.
The second was a general assembly within the Alternate Dimension Realm, where everyone would decide individually whether to stay or leave.
Daniel bid farewell to Grand Oracle Shamir.
But at that exact moment—
A gift from the universe that only Daniel could perceive suddenly descended upon him.
Even Daniel froze.
"What’s going on?"
He sensed an unfamiliar and indescribable Strength pouring silently into every part of his body.
That Strength...
Was different from ordinary energy.
It possessed a unique, lofty quality.
A Strength that stood above all other Strength.
The Strength of the universe itself!
"A gift from the universe?"
Daniel was completely confused.
He could neither refuse it nor ask what was happening.
He could only passively accept it.
An unknown amount of time passed.
Only then did the universe’s gift gradually weaken before finally disappearing.
Daniel immediately examined the changes within his body.
Everything seemed normal.
No—
Wait!
"The Cosmic Tribulation Source inside my body is gone!"
Daniel was unexpectedly delighted.
Back in that mysterious spacetime, every participant had been forcibly implanted with a Cosmic Tribulation Source by the universe.
It possessed the ability to reduce a powerhouse to Tribulation Ash.
And that process of being reduced to Tribulation Ash could not be expelled by any Strength or law.
After Daniel left the mysterious spacetime, the Cosmic Tribulation Source had been sealed.
So he had simply ignored it.
He had never expected that after examining himself just now—
The Cosmic Tribulation Source had completely disappeared.
"It must be related to the universe’s gift."
Realization dawned on Daniel.
"The Cosmic Tribulation Source and the universe’s gift are both forms of the same cosmic Strength."
"Naturally, one can erase the other."
Daniel continued examining himself.
Then—
His expression changed dramatically once again.
"The black-shadow poison inside me is gone too!"
This was an even greater surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 -533-The Black-Shadow Curse Dissipates
paragraphs: Previously, Daniel had fought a fierce battle against the Divine Emperor.
At the time, the Divine Emperor had threatened Daniel, telling him that the black-shadow curse afflicting his body was a powerful Sacred Art created by a peak half-step Eternal powerhouse.
Once someone became infected by it, unless an Eternal powerhouse personally paid a price to remove it, the curse would remain permanently.
At every moment, it would continuously corrode both the victim’s physical body and Divine Soul.
Even if Daniel self-destructed countless clones, it would make no difference.
The black-shadow curse was simply too vicious.
It was a Sacred Art that directly targeted the Origin itself.
And yet now—
The black-shadow curse had actually disappeared.
It was as though it had never existed in the first place.
Daniel smiled faintly.
"It was probably erased by the gift from the universe."
"The Strength of the universe itself is something even the Sacred Arts of Eternal powerhouses cannot resist."
"Let alone a mere curse left behind by a half-step Eternal."
"The universe’s gift directly erased the black-shadow curse from my body."
"At the same time, it also eliminated the Cosmic Tribulation Source inside me."
Daniel discovered that his current condition was extraordinarily good.
He even noticed that a portion of cosmic Strength had remained inside his body, quietly resting in one corner.
This cosmic Strength could actually be used.
And its applications were almost universal.
It was practically equivalent to Merit Power—
It could be used to accomplish almost anything.
Daniel immediately understood.
The universe’s gift had undoubtedly appeared because he had created his own Sacred Art.
He had created a Sacred Art.
He had also opened up an entirely new Rank, affecting countless future karmic relationships.
This was a reward personally bestowed upon him by the universe.
Thinking of this, Daniel smiled.
"The universe may seem incredibly hateful most of the time, but when a reward is due, it still has to give it."
"Otherwise, its own rules would descend into chaos and collapse."
At the same time—
Inside the Elder Council of the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters.
As a member of the Elder Council, Daniel naturally possessed the qualifications to attend.
For reasons everyone already understood, the qualifications for Elder Council membership had now been expanded.
It was no longer restricted solely to T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
Even veteran T7 Oracle-grade experts such as Grand Oracle Shamir and the Oracle-grade powerhouse of the Wu Race were now qualified to participate.
This Elder Council meeting was the largest in the history of the Holy Golden Mountain.
Dozens of members were present.
And there was only one major topic under discussion—
Whether to stay or leave.
Because the late leader had already left behind instructions calling for the majority of the faction to relocate, the general direction had effectively been decided.
After extensive discussion, the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters would be relocated into the Chaosverse.
The only two remaining T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses would serve as the new leader and deputy leader of the Holy Golden Mountain.
They would lead five or six T8 Oracle-grade powerhouses and dozens of T7 Oracle-grade experts into the new universe to establish themselves.
Looking at this scene, Daniel could not help feeling emotional.
Back when the Holy Golden Mountain had stood at its absolute peak—
T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses had taken turns preaching the Dao in the One-Origin Realm every single day.
There had been more than a dozen T8 Oracle-grade experts.
And the number of T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses had reached several hundred.
The Holy Golden Mountain treasury had practically contained an endless supply of Oracle-grade Secret Treasures.
But now—
Only two T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses remained.
They could no longer even maintain a proper supply of Oracle-grade Secret Treasures.
It was miserable.
The undisputed leading faction of an entire universe had actually fallen to such a state.
It was truly lamentable.
After determining where the headquarters would relocate, the discussion shifted toward the forces that would remain behind.
After all, the Holy Golden Mountain currently controlled an entire starfield.
And that starfield was also the largest starfield in the current universe.
It contained countless resources.
Countless Treasure Lands.
Countless Forbidden Lands.
And innumerable living beings.
The star rivers under its control also possessed extraordinarily powerful energy and immense value.
If everyone withdrew completely, then someone would still need to manage all the territory and resources they left behind.
However—
Almost none of the Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses were willing to stay.
They still wanted to preserve their lives.
They wanted to attempt T9 Oracle-grade.
Perhaps even Eternal Grade.
Why would they allow themselves to be buried alongside the Myriad Gods Universe?
"Ahem."
Suddenly, Grand Oracle Wujiu spoke.
He had remained silent throughout the earlier discussion.
"Faustus intends to stay."
Grand Oracle Wujiu looked toward the T9 Oracle-grade experts.
"In that case, why not have Oracle-grade Faustus take responsibility for the Holy Golden Mountain forces remaining behind?"
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Every gaze in the meeting instantly turned toward Daniel.
By now, all of them knew—
The powerhouse who had undergone the Golden Cosmic Tribulation within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land had been Daniel.
That was precisely why Daniel possessed the qualifications to sit on the Elder Council despite only being Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
Everyone could already imagine his future.
As long as Daniel did not die prematurely—
He would inevitably reach Eternal Grade.
He was the hope of the Holy Golden Mountain.
The newly appointed leader and deputy leader, both T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses, also regarded Daniel extremely highly.
"Oracle-grade Faustus."
The new leader looked at him.
"You truly intend to remain in the Myriad Gods Universe?"
Daniel nodded.
"I’m not leaving."
"Good!"

He immediately made his decision.
"Then Oracle-grade Faustus shall become the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain branch that remains behind."

"All powerhouses willing to continue staying with the Holy Golden Mountain, as well as every resource belonging to the Holy Golden Mountain within the Myriad Gods Universe, will fall under Oracle-grade Faustus’s jurisdiction."
"Does anyone object?"
For a moment—
The entire chamber fell silent.
Most of them were simply curious and confused.
They all knew exactly how terrifying Daniel’s potential was.
It surpassed even their own.
As long as he survived, he had a chance of reaching Eternal Grade.
That was the dream pursued by countless powerhouses!
Yet Daniel had chosen the exact opposite path from almost everyone else.
He actually intended to remain in the Myriad Gods Universe.
At that moment—
A loud shout suddenly rang through the chamber.
"I object!"
"Faustus is only a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse."
"I’m afraid his current Strength is insufficient to intimidate those with malicious intentions."
"I recommend my disciple, the T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse [Prad], as the leader of the branch!"
Daniel immediately frowned.
His gaze turned cold as he looked toward the speaker.
The man was a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse—
Grand Oracle Desolate God!
Daniel had never expected the matter to proceed completely smoothly.
In fact—
There was no way things could ever be that easy.
The territory controlled by the Holy Golden Mountain was simply too vast.
There were far too many resources.
Countless powerhouses had their eyes fixed upon this enormous piece of meat.
Those Oracle-grade experts might not be willing to remain personally—
But they could always leave their disciples behind!
As long as those disciples withdrew before the Cosmic Tribulation Source descended, who could possibly object?
And there was still some time before the Cosmic Tribulation Source arrived.
How many resources could be harvested during that period?
An incalculable amount!
Naturally, some powerhouses were unwilling to simply watch such an enormous prize fall into Daniel’s hands.
Moreover—
Resources were not the only benefit of controlling the forces that remained behind.
There were also powerhouses.
There would always be some Oracle-grade experts unwilling to abandon their homeland.
The Holy Golden Mountain was currently the largest faction in the entire universe.
And among the cultivators willing to remain—
There were several hundred Oracle-grade powerhouses!
If someone could bring those Oracle-grade experts under their control, the Strength of their own faction would undoubtedly increase tremendously.
Those were Oracle-grade experts.
Hundreds of them!
And that did not even include the Divine-grade powerhouses under those Oracle-grade experts—
Nor the races and factions standing behind them.
In short—
There were far, far too many people coveting this position.
Daniel stared coldly at the man who had just spoken.
It was Grand Oracle Desolate God.
Grand Oracle Desolate God was an existence on the same level as Grand Oracle Wujiu.
He possessed the Strength of a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
And faced with Daniel’s hostile gaze—
Grand Oracle Desolate God merely looked back with disdain.
Even though he knew perfectly well that doing this would offend Faustus—
He did not care.

At the time, the Divine Emperor had threatened Daniel, telling him that the black-shadow curse afflicting his body was a powerful Sacred Art created by a peak half-step Eternal powerhouse.
Once someone became infected by it, unless an Eternal powerhouse personally paid a price to remove it, the curse would remain permanently.
At every moment, it would continuously corrode both the victim’s physical body and Divine Soul.
Even if Daniel self-destructed countless clones, it would make no difference.
The black-shadow curse was simply too vicious.
It was a Sacred Art that directly targeted the Origin itself.
And yet now—

It was as though it had never existed in the first place.
Daniel smiled faintly.
"It was probably erased by the gift from the universe."
"The Strength of the universe itself is something even the Sacred Arts of Eternal powerhouses cannot resist."
"Let alone a mere curse left behind by a half-step Eternal."
"The universe’s gift directly erased the black-shadow curse from my body."
"At the same time, it also eliminated the Cosmic Tribulation Source inside me."
Daniel discovered that his current condition was extraordinarily good.
He even noticed that a portion of cosmic Strength had remained inside his body, quietly resting in one corner.
This cosmic Strength could actually be used.
And its applications were almost universal.
It was practically equivalent to Merit Power—
It could be used to accomplish almost anything.
Daniel immediately understood.
The universe’s gift had undoubtedly appeared because he had created his own Sacred Art.

Dozens of members were present.

It was miserable.
The undisputed leading faction of an entire universe had actually fallen to such a state.
It was truly lamentable.

After all, the Holy Golden Mountain currently controlled an entire starfield.

chapters.title: Chapter 534 -534-A Clash of Equals
paragraphs: Grand Oracle Desolate God looked at Daniel and silently thought,
"So what if you can become an Eternal powerhouse in the future?"
"What matters is the benefits right now."
"Who knows? Perhaps I’ll reach Eternal Grade before you do."
"And once I become Eternal, no matter how powerful Faustus is, could he possibly be stronger than an Eternal powerhouse?"
Grand Oracle Desolate God continued,
"Prad Oracle-grade stands at the very peak among T6 Oracle-grade powerhouses."
"He was a genius whom our Holy Golden Mountain watched grow up from childhood."
"Furthermore, he once governed an entire star river and possesses unparalleled management abilities."
"Whether in loyalty, talent, Strength, or seniority, he far surpasses Faustus."
"Therefore, I believe Prad Oracle-grade is the best candidate to become the branch leader."
As soon as those words fell, strange expressions appeared on the faces of many powerhouses present.
Their gazes shifted toward Prad Oracle-grade.
They all knew perfectly well just how explosive Faustus’s temper was.
He was someone who repaid even the slightest grievance.
For Grand Oracle Desolate God to openly say something like this—
He had clearly caused Faustus to add both himself and Prad to his list of enemies.
Prad Oracle-grade, however, seemed to have already prepared himself.
He immediately stood up and said decisively,
"I have always regarded the Holy Golden Mountain as my home."
"Naturally, I am willing to contribute my Strength to this home in its time of crisis."
After saying that, he turned toward Daniel and gave him a provocative glance.
Daniel remained expressionless.
The atmosphere throughout the meeting instantly became tense and quiet.
The new leader found himself in a difficult position.
After all—
Grand Oracle Wujiu was backing Faustus Oracle-grade.
Prad, meanwhile, had Grand Oracle Desolate God standing behind him.
Furthermore, Faustus Oracle-grade possessed astonishing potential.
He was practically a once-in-eternity genius.
But Prad was also someone the Holy Golden Mountain had watched grow up since childhood.
He was trustworthy.
For a moment, both the new leader and deputy leader were caught between the two sides.
Discussions immediately broke out throughout the chamber.
"I think Prad Oracle-grade is more suitable than Faustus Oracle-grade."
"He’s a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse, after all."
"Exactly. Faustus may be extremely talented, but he has only just reached Tier-4."
"Even if he can fight above his Rank and kill Tier-5 powerhouses, that doesn’t mean he can defeat T6 or even T7 enemies."
"Besides, none of the Oracle-grade powerhouses who come to the Myriad Gods Universe from now on will be weak."
"Faustus Oracle-grade simply won’t be able to control the situation."
"And Prad Oracle-grade was raised under the watch of our Holy Golden Mountain."
"His loyalty to us goes without saying."
"Looking at it that way, Prad Oracle-grade is obviously the more suitable candidate."
But soon, those supporting Daniel began arguing back.
"Faustus Oracle-grade is ruthless and decisive."
"His personality is actually the most suitable for taking the leading position and defending our territory."
"Furthermore, we have never truly seen Faustus Oracle-grade go all out."
"He might not be as weak as you think."
"Faustus Oracle-grade’s greatest advantage is his limitless potential."
"In the future, he will undoubtedly have a chance of reaching Eternal Grade."
"If we disappoint Faustus Oracle-grade—or even offend him—then perhaps the Holy Golden Mountain will lose a future Eternal Grade powerhouse."
"Since Faustus Oracle-grade has chosen to remain behind, he must naturally possess enough Strength to do so."
"Why should we worry for him?"
"I choose to trust him."
The chamber descended into chaos.
The newly appointed leader finally infused his voice with cosmic Strength and forcefully suppressed the entire room.
"Enough!"
"Everyone, be quiet!"
The chamber immediately fell silent.
Then he looked toward Daniel.
"Oracle-grade Faustus."
"What do you think?"
He directly threw the question back to Daniel.
That way, he would not have to offend either side himself.
Daniel glanced indifferently at Prad Oracle-grade.
"Grand Oracle Desolate God just said that my Strength is inferior to Prad Oracle-grade."
"I think he may have some misunderstanding regarding my Strength."
Boom!
Those words shocked everyone present.
What did he mean?
Could Faustus actually believe—
That his Strength surpassed that of Prad, a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse?
Faustus!
You’re only Tier-4 Oracle-grade!
Daniel swept his gaze across the many Oracle-grade powerhouses present.
"I want to have a life-and-death duel with Prad Oracle-grade."
"If I’m fortunate enough to win..."
"Then I will take control of the Holy Golden Mountain branch in the Myriad Gods Universe."
A life-and-death duel!
The winner lived.
The loser died!
Winner takes all!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The moment Daniel finished speaking, every gaze immediately turned toward Prad Oracle-grade.
Prad Oracle-grade’s expression changed instantly.
"Faustus..."
"You’re really willing to take it this far?"
Prad Oracle-grade was surprised—
But he was not afraid.
He was a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
He had experienced countless trials and adventures.
He had no idea how many times he had stood at the edge of death.
And every single time—
He had won.
That was why he was still alive today.
Meanwhile, his opponent—
Faustus—
Was only Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
There was no reason a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse should lose to a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse!
Even if Faustus was different from ordinary cultivators...
Even if he was an unprecedented genius whose Strength surpassed ordinary Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts...
Prad was still confident that, at the very least, he would not lose.
Thinking of this—
Prad Oracle-grade was already prepared.
He looked toward Grand Oracle Desolate God.
His gaze seemed to ask—
Master, what do you think?
Grand Oracle Desolate God stared deeply at Daniel and frowned slightly.
For some reason—
He could vaguely sense a strange Strength within Daniel’s body.
It was a Strength he could not understand.
Yet it gave even him a faint sense of apprehension.
However, that Strength was not particularly abundant.
There was only a tiny amount.
"Prad is the strongest T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse under my command."
"He has inherited my true teachings."
"Faustus may be powerful..."
"But I doubt he can defeat Prad."
Grand Oracle Desolate God calmly nodded toward his disciple.
Prad Oracle-grade immediately spoke.
"I accept the challenge."
"I am willing to fight Oracle-grade Faustus in a life-and-death duel!"
"I ask all the senior powerhouses present to bear witness for us."
"Life and death will be decided by fate!"
The eyes of the many powerful experts instantly lit up.
The last time they had personally seen Daniel fight—
Had been during the Holy Golden Mountain assessment.
At that time, Daniel had not even reached Oracle-grade.
Now that Faustus had become an Oracle-grade powerhouse, none of them had seen him fight yet.
As for whether Daniel or Prad would die—
That was not something they particularly cared about.
This was simply how the Endless Starfield worked.
Daniel might possess astonishing potential, and countless great powerhouses might think highly of him.
But that did not mean they would protect him everywhere he went—
Terrified that he might suffer some injury or encounter danger.
To the powerhouses of the Endless Starfield, life-and-death trials were completely normal.
Only those who experienced the boundary between life and death—
And survived—
Deserved the chance to continue growing stronger!
Hearing Prad Oracle-grade accept the challenge, the newly appointed leader nodded.
"Very well."
"You will fight your life-and-death duel in Secret Realm No. 88."
"The victor..."
"Will become the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain branch in the Myriad Gods Universe."
"Life and death will be decided by fate!"
Daniel and Prad Oracle-grade—
Were about to fight a life-and-death duel!
The battlefield—
Secret Realm No. 88.
And news of the duel gradually began spreading.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 -535-The Victor Lives, the Loser Dies
paragraphs: At this moment, many Holy Golden Mountain powerhouses were preparing to head toward Secret Realm No. 88, only to be stopped outside.
The newly appointed leader had directly sealed off the entire Secret Realm, leaving only Daniel and Prad inside.
Only the victor would be able to walk out.
The loser would remain there forever.
No other powerhouse, regardless of who they were, was allowed to interfere. Nor would anyone be permitted to create future conflicts over the outcome.
After all, this was an internal struggle within the faction rather than a battle against outsiders. No matter who won, the Holy Golden Mountain would inevitably suffer a loss.
At this moment, inside Secret Realm No. 88, after being teleported in by the T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse, Daniel immediately flew high into the sky.
His divine sense spread outward and instantly enveloped the entire Secret Realm.
Every secret within the realm fell under his perception—including the location of Prad Oracle-grade.
A sinister smile appeared on Daniel’s face.

When the T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse had teleported the two of them inside, he had not placed them together. Instead, one had been sent to the southern end of the realm and the other to the northern end.
Now, as their divine senses spread and overlapped, both sides immediately discovered the other’s presence.
Prad Oracle-grade let out a roar and rapidly shot toward Daniel’s position.
Although the Secret Realm was vast, to a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse, crossing it required only a few breaths.
At the same time, Prad activated one of the Sacred Arts within his body—
Icefire Twin Dragon Break!
Prad Oracle-grade’s Divine Soul instantly transformed into an enormous vortex possessing both ice and fire attributes.
Ice and fire intertwined and clashed against one another, producing an incomparably terrifying aura of destruction.
As a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse and a genius who had risen during the Holy Golden Mountain’s golden age, Prad Oracle-grade was practically an all-rounder.
Whether it came to Divine Soul combat or physical-body combat, he was inferior to no one.
That was precisely why Prad Oracle-grade believed he was capable of independently commanding an entire region—and why Grand Oracle Desolate God supported him.
However, the Divine Soul Secret Art that had once allowed him to casually suppress others struck Daniel’s divine sense and vanished like a stone sinking into the ocean.
There was no reaction whatsoever.
Prad frowned.
How could it be this absurd?
Even the slightest sensation of collision would have allowed him to estimate Daniel’s Strength.
Yet within his perception, Daniel’s Divine Soul resembled a bottomless abyss.
Prad’s heart immediately sank.
That could only mean one thing.
Prad Oracle-grade muttered,
"Faustus’s Divine Soul power is far stronger than mine."
On the other side, Daniel felt a faint vibration pass through his Divine Soul, as though something were attacking it.
But almost immediately, the sensation disappeared.
Daniel frowned.
It had felt no different from being bitten by a mosquito.
"Was that some kind of Divine Soul Secret Art?"
Daniel narrowed his eyes slightly.
"Good thing I have one too."
The next moment, a smile appeared on his face as he abruptly unleashed his own Divine Soul Secret Art.
How terrifying was Daniel’s Divine Soul?
It was a Supreme Divine Soul!
In a single instant, Prad Oracle-grade felt an overwhelming pressure suddenly descend upon him, suffocating him like someone drowning and unable to breathe.
Prad was instantly horrified.
"What?!"
"Faustus Oracle-grade’s Divine Soul is actually this terrifying?!"
He had believed he had already evaluated Daniel’s Divine Soul Sacred Arts highly enough.
He had never expected that he had still underestimated him.
Even more shocking was the fact that his own Divine Soul was being completely suppressed from one side.
He had absolutely no ability to resist.
And that was not all.
Wave after wave of gnawing agony swept through him.
Prad’s entire body began trembling.
It felt as though his very soul were being torn apart.
Prad Oracle-grade gritted his teeth and refused to make a sound, hurriedly withdrawing his Divine Soul.
Only after doing so did he discover—
In that incredibly brief period of time, a tiny portion of his Divine Soul had actually disappeared!
His Divine Soul had suffered irreversible damage!
Irreversible meant that even cultivation could not restore it!
Realizing this, Prad Oracle-grade felt his heart ache.
One had to understand—
The physical body was easy to cultivate.
The Divine Soul was difficult.
Even losing a tiny portion of the Divine Soul represented an enormous loss.
Under normal circumstances, such damage could at least be replenished through cultivation.
Yet for some unknown reason, Daniel’s method had actually caused irreversible damage!
Meanwhile—
Daniel sensed his own Divine Soul grow slightly stronger and smiled.
The characteristic of the Supreme Divine Soul was extremely simple and brutal.
Devour.
Endless devouring.
Infinite devouring!
It was somewhat similar to the Devouring Battle Body of the Starry Sky Behemoth race.
The difference was that the Starry Sky Behemoths’ devouring ability was an innate talent.
The Supreme Divine Soul’s devouring ability was merely one of its inherent characteristics.
"A T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse is actually a pretty good target."
Daniel suddenly seemed to remember something.
"I can use him to test the power of the Sacred Art I created."
Ever since Daniel had created that Sacred Art, he had never had a chance to use it.
A Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse clearly was not worthy of receiving such treatment.
Even a Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouse would be somewhat insufficient.
"Only a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse can properly bring out the power of this Sacred Art."
And Prad Oracle-grade just happened to be T6 Oracle-grade.
Whoosh!
Daniel also flew toward Prad Oracle-grade.
Before long, the two powerhouses could already see each other from afar.
"Go!"
Prad Oracle-grade immediately threw out several innate-grade Secret Treasures.
At the same time, one Sacred Art after another erupted from him.
Prad Oracle-grade truly deserved to be a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
His Sacred Arts were clearly far stronger than those of ordinary T6 Oracle-grade experts.
One terrifying cosmic Sacred Art after another descended with world-destroying might.
Clearly—
Prad Oracle-grade did not understand Daniel’s true capabilities.
He had yet to be taught a harsh lesson by reality.
He actually dared to use Secret Treasures in front of Daniel!
"Treasure-Lowering Basin!"
Whoosh!
The Treasure-Lowering Basin appeared.
Cosmic power circulated as ripples spread outward.
In a single instant, every Secret Treasure belonging to Prad Oracle-grade was forcibly drawn into it.
"Mystic Eye—open!"
"Five-Colored Divine Light!"
A thin slit suddenly opened at the center of Daniel’s forehead.
Within that slit was the shape of an eye.
In the next instant—
The eye abruptly opened.
Five colors of light appeared.
Orange.
Yellow.
Cyan.
Blue.
Purple.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
There was nothing the Five-Colored Divine Light could not sweep away.
How terrifying could a Mystic Eye innate Sacred Art become after being deduced to perfection by a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse?
The moment Prad Oracle-grade’s Sacred Arts encountered the Five-Colored Divine Light, they were instantly swept away and dispersed.
Only then—
Did Prad Oracle-grade finally react!
"My Secret Treasures... my Sacred Arts..."
The Secret Treasures Prad Oracle-grade had always been so proud of became completely obedient before Daniel’s Treasure-Lowering Basin.
In moments, Prad lost all connection with them and could no longer control them.
Every last one had effectively become a contribution to Daniel.
As for his Sacred Arts—
They fared even worse.
Daniel’s Five-Colored Divine Light was simply too powerful.
No matter what Sacred Art appeared, a single sweep was enough to erase it.
If that divine light were to sweep across his body...
A sudden chill rose from the depths of Prad Oracle-grade’s heart.
But Daniel clearly had no intention of giving him the chance to personally experience the Five-Colored Divine Light.
"Cosmic Reincarnation Body!"
Boom!
Suddenly, the entire Secret Realm violently trembled!
A colossal palm appeared, blotting out the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 536 -536-Inheriting the Holy Golden Mountain
paragraphs: Within the palm of that colossal hand was a complete and clearly visible galaxy, inside which countless living beings had evolved.
And every one of those living beings looked exactly like Daniel.
Behind the heads of those countless beings, halos suddenly appeared.
They were none other than Sacred Halos of Reincarnation, identical to the sacred halo behind Daniel’s own head.
At that moment, the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation behind Daniel’s head suddenly flashed.
At the same time, the countless living beings within his palm also flashed with light.
Soon, an incomparably terrifying aura spread outward.
Everywhere the colossal palm passed, space instantly shattered like glass.
As the giant palm pressed downward, the entire Secret Realm was reduced to a state of Primordial Chaos.
The Secret Realm itself actually began collapsing!
At the same time, Prad Oracle-grade, trapped beneath the palm, exhausted every method at his disposal.
He unleashed countless techniques and Sacred Arts.
Yet the instant any of them touched the colossal palm, they were reduced to nothingness.
He could only watch helplessly as the palm descended upon him.
There was absolutely no room for resistance.
Boom!
The colossal palm slammed down.
The Sacred Art powerful enough to force the universe itself to alter its rules erupted completely at this moment.
Even the Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses who had been closely observing the battle were shaken by its might.
Grand Oracle Desolate God’s expression changed dramatically.
"No!"
"Prad! My good disciple!"
The heaven-covering palm descended with a thunderous roar.
Prad Oracle-grade, a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse, had no ability to resist whatsoever.
He was directly crushed to death on the spot.
Grand Oracle Desolate God’s proudest disciple died instantly.
This Sacred Art had long since surpassed the limits of its original Rank.
Its power had already received recognition from the universe itself, forcing the universe to alter the rules governing Strength.
That was just how terrifying it was.
Daniel, despite possessing only a Tier-4 Oracle-grade Rank, had directly killed a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
And it had been an instant kill!
The moment this Sacred Art appeared, even the Secret Realm itself could not withstand its power and collapsed as a result.
The Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses could clearly sense the immense law power contained within the Sacred Art, and their expressions changed one after another.
Grand Oracle Desolate God was utterly shaken.
He could not help crying out in grief over the death of his disciple, while at the same time feeling deeply shocked by Daniel.
"The power of Faustus Oracle-grade’s Sacred Art is already no weaker than a full-power strike from a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse!"
"How is that possible?"

"You have to understand, he’s only a T7 Oracle-grade, yet he can unleash such a terrifying Sacred Art far beyond the norm. And that Sacred Art can apparently grow even stronger as its user’s Strength increases!"
"Doesn’t that mean that if Faustus Oracle-grade eventually reaches Grand Oracle-grade, he’ll be able to instantly kill all of us?"
Grand Oracle Desolate God was not the only one who thought so.
Every Grand Oracle-grade powerhouse present was equally stunned.
Grand Oracle Wujiu was also witnessing for the first time a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse unleash such a terrifying Sacred Art.
Only Faustus had ever accomplished something this absurd.
He could not help sighing inwardly,
"Faustus truly is a monster!"
"If I had been born in the same generation as him, he probably would have crushed me so thoroughly that I wouldn’t have had even the slightest bit of confidence left."
"To be born in the same era as a monster like this is both a tragedy and an honor."
"Excellent, excellent."
Grand Oracle Wujiu sighed before smiling with relief.
"If Faustus Oracle-grade possesses this level of Strength, then there’s nothing to worry about if we hand the branch over to him."
Grand Oracle Shamir, who had always believed himself to be the person who understood Daniel best, now found Faustus Oracle-grade strangely unfamiliar.
What felt unfamiliar was the Strength Daniel had just displayed.
It had completely exceeded Shamir’s understanding.
"The Sacred Art Faustus just used was already comparable to my own full-power strike."
Grand Oracle Shamir was also deeply gratified.
"To think that he grew from a Half-Saint all the way to his current Rank and obtained such Strength..."
"It truly is gratifying."
"Those powerhouses of his generation, those Half-Saints from back then, still haven’t even survived their tribulations and reached Oracle-grade."
"Yet Faustus has already traveled so far down the Oracle-grade path."
"My judgment really wasn’t wrong."
Meanwhile, the two newly appointed T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses serving as leader and deputy leader of the Holy Golden Mountain appreciated Daniel even more.
"From what I can see, although Faustus appears arrogant and domineering on the surface, he is actually an extremely cautious powerhouse."
The newly appointed leader smiled.
"He never fights a battle he isn’t confident of winning."
"He fooled all of us."
"On the surface, Prad appeared to possess an overwhelming advantage. Everyone knows that a Tier-4 Oracle-grade normally cannot defeat a T6 Oracle-grade."
"But Faustus Oracle-grade never revealed his trump card."
"Then, when the time came, he shocked everyone in a single move."
"Faustus Oracle-grade really is cunning."
The deputy leader smiled as well.
"Indeed."
"Faustus Oracle-grade may appear arrogant, overbearing, and completely unwilling to restrain himself, but that very dominance actually brings him enormous benefits."
"At the very least, very few people dare compete with him. They’re already suppressed by his aura before the fight even begins."
"In reality, he is extraordinarily cautious."
"He never does anything he has no confidence in, nor does he take risks that are too high."
"I’ve realized that Faustus Oracle-grade is extremely well suited to the Endless Starfield."
"Only someone this cunning, ruthless, merciless, forceful, and domineering can thrive in the Endless Starfield."
"I think entrusting the Holy Golden Mountain branch to him is the right choice."
At that moment—
Secret Realm No. 88 completely collapsed.
Daniel’s figure emerged from the ruins.
He flew toward the members of the Elder Council.
The newly appointed leader glanced at Grand Oracle Desolate God.
"The result has already been decided."
The new leader said,
"The leader remaining behind to oversee the Holy Golden Mountain branch in the Myriad Races Universe will be Faustus Oracle-grade."
"I assume no one has any objections now?"
Naturally, no one objected.
The one who had objected was already dead.
Grand Oracle Desolate God was a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Naturally, he would not personally step forward to challenge Daniel.
He could not afford to lose that much face.
As for the other powerhouses who coveted the position, all of them were now wary of Daniel’s Strength.
Daniel could kill a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse with a single palm strike.
Were they supposed to send a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse against him?
But T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses were unwilling to remain in the Myriad Races Universe.
Even the former leader, a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse, had been killed.
How could they possibly dare to stay behind?
With that in mind, everyone quickly accepted the decision.
Daniel officially became the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain in the Myriad Races Universe.
He had not fought for this position because he possessed any profound emotional attachment to the Holy Golden Mountain.
It was purely for his own interests.
After all, the Holy Golden Mountain controlled the territory of an entire starfield.
It also possessed vast quantities of Oracle-grade resources.
With only a little effort, Daniel could obtain all of it.
Why refuse free benefits?
Why let other factions take advantage of them instead?
Once the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters finished its discussions, it convened a general assembly.
Naturally, it was impossible to physically summon every member.
But the Alternate Dimension Realm allowed everyone to participate.
Within the Alternate Dimension Realm, tens of millions of Holy Golden Mountain members gathered.
As long as someone had reached Divine-grade, they were qualified to attend.
After all, Divine-grade was normally the minimum threshold for joining the Holy Golden Mountain.
Exceptions such as Daniel, Jun Bujian, and Jizhi were exceedingly rare.
And the outcome of this general assembly...
Would determine the future development of the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 -537-Reuniting After Many Years
paragraphs: It had now been officially decided that the newly appointed leader would lead tens of millions of members directly into the Chaosverse.
One had to understand—
This was not merely a matter involving tens of millions of individual members.
Behind every member stood their own race, clan, and affiliated species.
Among those tens of millions of members, each represented countless living beings.
Trying to relocate all of them at once was an extraordinarily difficult undertaking.
At the same time, there were also many powerhouses who wanted to remain in the Myriad Gods Universe.
Their reasons varied greatly.
But regardless of the reason—
They simply did not want to leave.
Of course, there were still tens of millions of Divine-grade powerhouses willing to remain behind and continue guarding the Sacred Land.
There were also several hundred Oracle-grade powerhouses who chose to remain within the Holy Golden Mountain branch of the Myriad Races Universe.
Naturally, these Oracle-grade experts were weaker than those who had chosen to relocate.
The strongest among them was only T6 Oracle-grade.
As for Daniel—
He had already been publicly appointed as the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain’s Myriad Races Universe branch.
From this moment onward, the Myriad Races Universe officially became a branch territory of the Holy Golden Mountain.
As for the rest of its systems—
There were no major changes.
The Holy Golden Mountain remained the same extremely loose alliance organization it had always been.
Its structure revolved primarily around missions and bounties.
It would not force any powerhouse to carry out its plans.
That was precisely why, even after the Holy Golden Mountain had declined to its weakest point, so many powerhouses were still willing to remain affiliated with it.
Because they could leave the Holy Golden Mountain whenever they wished.
There was no need to worry about violating any binding agreement.
Daniel had no intention of involving himself in the headquarters’ relocation.
Instead, he directly chose the God Realm as the new location of his branch headquarters.
The God Realm was a great world within the Chaosverse.
It was perfectly suitable to serve as the headquarters of a branch.
Daniel immediately dispatched players to inventory every resource belonging to the branch.
At the same time, he appointed players as supervisors across the various departments of the Holy Golden Mountain branch.
By now, the players were no longer ignorant outsiders who knew nothing about the Holy Golden Mountain.
They had already accumulated extensive experience throughout the Endless Starfield.
They understood their own interests better than anyone.
And their interests were deeply bound to Daniel’s.
If Daniel suffered losses—
They would suffer as well.
If Daniel rose to glory—
They would share in that glory.
Naturally, they were more than willing to work for him.
Furthermore, serving Daniel came with contribution points.
And those contribution points could be exchanged for all kinds of rare treasures.
Using swift and decisive methods, Daniel directly took control of every major department of the Holy Golden Mountain branch.
At the same time, he secured control over all of its core resources.
Next—
It was time to reform the Holy Golden Mountain’s entire system.
A cold smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
The system had been far too loose for far too long.
It was time for reform.
Either become one of his people—
Or become his enemy.
Those who followed him would prosper.
Those who opposed him would perish.
Daniel had no intention of continuing with the old loose structure.
That system did not suit him at all.
It offered him practically no benefits and only burdened him with responsibilities.
It was basically asking him to become everyone’s caretaker.
That was not Daniel’s style.
Now that the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters had already relocated, Daniel could naturally reform the branch however he wished.
Before leaving, one of the Oracle-grade powerhouses had deliberately left behind a clone to maintain contact with him.
That powerhouse had even personally left Daniel a message.
"You’ve only just taken control of the branch."
"I’m worried there may be people who refuse to accept your authority."
"So I’ll leave one of my clones here."
"It can at least help support you with my seniority and reputation."
"Furthermore, the chaos within the Myriad Races Universe is already beginning to reveal itself."
"Having the name of a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse behind you will make many things much easier."
Daniel nodded slightly.
He admitted that Jamil Oracle-grade made a great deal of sense.
Daniel also accepted this favor.
If Jamil Oracle-grade ever needed his help in the future—
Daniel would naturally be willing to lend a hand.
But the things that needed to be done still had to be done.
Inside the Chaos Star Sea—
One Starship after another sailed out from the depths of the sea.
Flying above those Starships—
Were the flags of the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
The moment other Starships saw those banners, they immediately turned around or altered their routes.
None of them wanted to come into contact with this group of lunatics.
A single Starship was equivalent to an entire world.
And now—
Dozens of Starships had been deployed.
The Strength represented by this fleet was no weaker than that of an entire galaxy.
This time, the Eternal Tribulation Palace had dispatched a massive raiding force personally led by a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
If necessary—
They could even call upon a T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse of the Eternal Tribulation Palace to descend.
Their objective was extremely clear.
The Myriad Races Universe!
Meanwhile, not far from the Eternal Tribulation Palace fleet—
Another Starship could be seen.
Only one.
A flag belonging to the Blood Sea Dao Domain hung above it.
Yet not only did the Eternal Tribulation Palace refrain from causing trouble for that Starship—
They deliberately maintained their distance from it.
They did not dare approach too closely.
The Blood Sea Dao Domain.
It was the faction belonging to Blood Sea Eternal of the Ultimate Dao Domain Sea.
An Eternal powerhouse!
Even the Eternal Tribulation Palace did not dare casually provoke such an existence.
Of course—
The Eternal Tribulation Palace itself also had Eternal powerhouses supporting it.

But the Eternal Tribulation Palace knew perfectly well that among the powers of the Ultimate Dao Domain Sea, Blood Sea Eternal was far from the only existence with designs on the Myriad Races Universe.
Myriad Laws Eternal also greatly coveted the Myriad Races Universe.
For the moment—
These were all existences the Eternal Tribulation Palace did not dare provoke.
The Endless Starfield.
The Chaosverse.
At this moment—
A tribulation was underway.
But this was not the cultivator’s first tribulation.
The Cosmic Tribulation above them was actually—
Silver!
The senior powerhouses of the tribulation-taker’s race nervously watched the tribulation grounds.
"I really don’t know whether that little girl Uriah is lucky or unlucky."
A heavily muscled, powerfully built expert suddenly sighed.
"The rules of the universe suddenly changed and added Transcendent Oracle-grade."
"We poured all of our resources into Uriah and forcibly accumulated her foundation until she reached Transcendent Oracle-grade."
"If she succeeds in surviving the tribulation, she’ll immediately become one of the strongest Oracle-grade powerhouses of her tier."
"The difficulty of the tribulation has increased as well."
"I only hope that little girl Uriah can survive."
The aura radiating from his body—
Belonged to a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Suddenly—
The phenomenon of the Cosmic Tribulation disappeared.
The tribulation was over.
Whoosh!
A figure flew out from the tribulation formation.
Uriah looked extremely miserable at this moment.
Her aura was weak, and her expression was exhausted.
Yet the T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse immediately revealed an expression of delight.
"Uriah succeeded!"
"Patriarch!"
Uriah flew over, excitement flashing through her eyes.
"I’m now a Tier-2 Oracle-grade powerhouse!"
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse nodded with satisfaction.
"Uriah, you did very well."
Then he immediately asked the question he had been most eager to know.
"Now that the Cosmic Tribulation has added Transcendent Oracle-grade, was there anything unusual about the process?"
He himself would eventually need to undergo another tribulation.
And he also intended to continue accumulating his foundation until he reached—
T8 Transcendent Oracle-grade.
That meant—
He, too, would have to undergo a Transcendence Tribulation.
When Uriah heard his question, her expression immediately became extremely strange.
"Patriarch..."
Uriah did not know whether to laugh or cry.
"The Transcendence Tribulation is really strange."
"Strange?"
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse looked puzzled.
"Mm-hmm."
Uriah nodded.
"I recognized the manifestation that appeared during the Transcendence Tribulation."
"I met that big brother several times back when I was in the Evolution Realm."
"His name is Faustus."
"He was the strongest Half-Saint in the Myriad Races Universe."
"He’s also the powerhouse who underwent that tribulation in the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land some time ago!"
Hiss—
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse drew in a sharp breath.
It was him!
Naturally, he had also heard of that existence.
Before even reaching god-grade—
Faustus’s name had already spread throughout the universe.
When he reached Half-Saint—
He had soared into the heavens in a single leap and shocked everyone.
After that came one unbelievable battle record after another.
But the most dazzling moment of all—
Was undoubtedly the tribulation within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
A Golden Cosmic Tribulation!
A tribulation so terrifying that it had provoked the furious roar of the universe itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 -538-Cosmic Reincarnation
paragraphs: This scene instantly attracted the attention of powerhouses throughout the universe. Even Eternal Grade experts crossed over from different spacetimes to watch.
To think that the powerhouse who had modified the rules last time was also this same person.
Such monstrous talent was truly terrifying.
Even the T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse could not help sighing in amazement.
However, he cared even more about something else and hurriedly asked, "Uriah, how did you survive that Transcendent Rank tribulation?"
Uriah looked completely confused. "I didn’t even undergo it. After I survived the Cosmic Tribulation, Big Brother Faustus appeared."
Uriah recalled, "Then I contacted Big Brother Faustus and asked whether he could spare my life."
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse was immediately speechless when he heard this.
What was going on?
You could actually do that?
How was this any different from children playing house?
Wait.
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse suddenly thought of something and asked in astonishment, "He really let you go in the end?"
Uriah answered as though it were only natural. "Of course. Big Brother Faustus is actually a very nice person. After I asked him, he agreed."
"But he made me owe him a favor."
"He also said that he treats different people differently. For a likable tribulation-taker like me, he’ll let me off."
"But for people he dislikes, he’ll suppress them with everything he has."
After saying that, Uriah blinked and asked, "Is there some problem, Master?"
Bajie Divine Healer was left somewhat speechless and could only say, "That Faustus is truly shameless. To think he would play tricks like this during a Cosmic Tribulation."
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse felt somewhat uneasy.
He had no idea whether Faustus would spare him when it was his turn to undergo the tribulation.
If Faustus went all out against him...
He truly did not dare imagine it.
At the same time, inside a palace somewhere in the Endless Starfield, boundless radiance suddenly erupted.
A figure appeared within it.
It was none other than God Vade.
From the throne inside the palace, a powerhouse asked, "Vade, did you survive the Transcendent Rank tribulation?"
Many Oracle-grade powerhouses stood in two rows inside the palace, all looking toward God Vade.
The T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse wore an incomparably solemn expression as he asked seriously, "How did it feel?"

God Vade looked radiant and spirited. He answered calmly, "Master, Senior Brothers, thanks to the resources you provided, my Strength successfully reached Transcendent Oracle-grade. I was fortunate enough to survive the tribulation."
After expressing his thanks, God Vade continued, "However, that Transcendent Sage Rank was truly somewhat difficult to describe."
At this point, he actually sighed, causing the other powerhouses to look puzzled.
Hadn’t he already survived the tribulation?
Why was he sighing?
Could something strange have happened during the tribulation?
God Vade calmly said, "Masters, Senior Brothers, you don’t know this, but the Transcendence Tribulation manifested by the universe took the form of an old acquaintance of mine. His name is Faustus."

"That old acquaintance once had me form a karmic connection with him. As long as I agreed to his request, he wouldn’t make things difficult for me. I had no choice. In order to survive the tribulation, I could only agree."
When they heard this, every powerhouse within the palace domain found the situation utterly ridiculous.
What was going on?
You could actually do that?
The tribulation manifestation could even threaten the person undergoing the tribulation?
Damn it!
At the same time, at the Holy Golden Mountain branch, the former God Realm had now been renamed the Gold-Grade Realm.
A female player led several hundred other female players in reporting the branch’s resources.
"Dean, this is the complete inventory of all the branch resources we have counted."
The one remaining here to receive the report was Daniel’s clone, Dan Left.
Daniel had founded the Holy Golden Mountain Academy. Once players reached a certain level, they would automatically join it, so it was only natural for them to address Daniel as Dean.
The resources left behind by the Holy Golden Mountain still exceeded Daniel’s expectations.
Although the headquarters had already taken away four-fifths of them—
The remaining one-fifth was still astonishing.
And that did not even include the resources capable of being continuously produced.

"If all of these resources are handed over to the main body, they may be enough to directly push the main body’s Strength to Tier-5 Oracle-grade, while also allowing us to construct more than a dozen Peerless Grand Formations!"
"There would even be resources left over!"
Thinking of this, Dan Left said, "You’ve worked hard. You may leave."
The players respectfully withdrew.
At that moment—
Several male players arrived to report.
"Dean, Hollen Oracle-grade of the Penglai Star River is requesting support from the branch."
"He says powerhouses from another universe are slaughtering indiscriminately throughout the Penglai Star River, seriously affecting its stability."
"Dean, Bailing Oracle-grade of the Chasing Moon Star River is requesting branch support."
"Dean, Nine-Wing Oracle-grade of the Sun-Devouring Star River is requesting branch support."
"Dean..."
For a time—
Dan Left’s ears were filled with requests for assistance.
Hearing these reports, Dan Left was not surprised at all.
He even felt like laughing.
"Excellent!"
"So the day has finally come when you need me!"
Dan Left knew exactly what the main body was thinking.
The Oracle-grade powerhouses of the Holy Golden Mountain still wanted the organization’s protection, support, and resource supply.
Yet at the same time, they wanted to continue operating under the old Holy Golden Mountain system.
Daniel would never tolerate that.
"Support can be provided."
"But they must surrender their territories."
"I’ll directly send players to participate in their management."
"Anyone who refuses gets beaten into submission!"
"For Oracle-grade powerhouses without territory, contribution-point exchanges will be restricted to once per day."
"If they want unlimited exchanges, they’ll have to sign an agreement with me!"
"That way, I can bring the Oracle-grade resources under my control."
Dan Left quickly responded according to the main body’s intentions.
For a time, the many Oracle-grade powerhouses who had remained behind with the Holy Golden Mountain suddenly realized something.
The heavens had changed!
The Holy Golden Mountain was no longer the Holy Golden Mountain of the past.
It had become Daniel’s private organization.
Those who followed him would prosper.
Those who opposed him would perish.
Penglai Star River.
Daniel’s true body directly descended upon the Xiaoyao Plane.
This was Hollen Oracle-grade’s headquarters.
Hollen Oracle-grade had just rejected the Holy Golden Mountain’s proposal.
He was unwilling to surrender his territory.
He had also decisively withdrawn from the Holy Golden Mountain organization.
Hollen was a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Compared with Prad Oracle-grade, he was somewhat ordinary.
Even so, he was still among the strongest Oracle-grade powerhouses who had remained behind with the Holy Golden Mountain.
He did not believe there was anything wrong with rejecting the Holy Golden Mountain.
After all, the Myriad Races Universe was already doomed to destruction.
The Holy Golden Mountain?
Heh!

"Hmph!" Hollen Oracle-grade sneered inside his palace. "That Faustus Oracle-grade truly has the ambition of a wolf. He actually wants to absorb all the Oracle-grade powerhouses who remained behind with the Holy Golden Mountain into his own organization!"
"I have independently guarded the Penglai Star River on behalf of the Holy Golden Mountain."
"It would be one thing if Faustus Oracle-grade refused to win me over, but now he actually wants to seize the foundation that belongs to me, Hollen!"
"Bah! Even if I die, I will never hand over my foundation!"
