"That way, I can bring the Oracle-grade resources under my control."
Dan Left quickly responded according to the main body’s intentions.
For a time, the many Oracle-grade powerhouses who had remained behind with the Holy Golden Mountain suddenly realized something.
The heavens had changed!
The Holy Golden Mountain was no longer the Holy Golden Mountain of the past.
It had become Daniel’s private organization.
Those who followed him would prosper.
Those who opposed him would perish.
Penglai Star River.
Daniel’s true body directly descended upon the Xiaoyao Plane.
This was Hollen Oracle-grade’s headquarters.
Hollen Oracle-grade had just rejected the Holy Golden Mountain’s proposal.
He was unwilling to surrender his territory.
He had also decisively withdrawn from the Holy Golden Mountain organization.
Hollen was a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Compared with Prad Oracle-grade, he was somewhat ordinary.
Even so, he was still among the strongest Oracle-grade powerhouses who had remained behind with the Holy Golden Mountain.
He did not believe there was anything wrong with rejecting the Holy Golden Mountain.
After all, the Myriad Races Universe was already doomed to destruction.
The Holy Golden Mountain?
Heh!
"Hmph!" Hollen Oracle-grade sneered inside his palace.
"That Faustus Oracle-grade truly has the ambition of a wolf.
He actually wants to absorb all the Oracle-grade powerhouses who remained behind with the Holy Golden Mountain into his own organization!"
"I have independently guarded the Penglai Star River on behalf of the Holy Golden Mountain."
"It would be one thing if Faustus Oracle-grade refused to win me over, but now he actually wants to seize the foundation that belongs to me, Hollen!"
"Bah!
Even if I die, I will never hand over my foundation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 539 -539-The Decline of Heaven and Man
paragraphs: Hollen Oracle-grade did not believe Faustus would dare do anything to him.
Ever since the Holy Golden Mountain was founded, it had been famous for Songshan, which was also why it had been able to develop so rapidly.
Even if the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters later sent someone to question him, Hollen Oracle-grade could confidently argue that Faustus Oracle-grade had been the one to break the rules first.
He had clearly sent people to request reinforcements, yet Faustus Oracle-grade had instead tried to seize the foundation belonging to him, Hollen.
Anyone in his position would have chosen to withdraw from the Holy Golden Mountain, Hollen Oracle-grade thought to himself.
At that moment, a faint voice suddenly sounded beside his ear.
Hollen Hollen did not react at first. Only afterward did his eyes suddenly snap open.
"Faustus? What is he doing here?"
He recognized the other party’s voice.
Whoosh!
In the next instant, that figure appeared directly before him.
Hollen immediately shuddered, his confidence weakening considerably.
After all, the man standing before him had instantly killed Prad Oracle-grade.
And Prad Oracle-grade had been stronger than Hollen.
In other words, if Faustus Oracle-grade wanted to eliminate him, it would be incredibly easy.
Hollen Oracle-grade forced himself to remain calm.
"I’ve already withdrawn from the Holy Golden Mountain. Why are you still coming after me?"
His face was deathly pale as he continued,
"The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters still has its rules, Faustus Oracle-grade. I advise you not to act recklessly."
Daniel stared at him coldly.
"What connections you have has nothing to do with me."
"I only have one question."
"Why did you withdraw from the Holy Golden Mountain?"
Hollen Oracle-grade immediately retorted,
"What? Hasn’t the Holy Golden Mountain always allowed people to stay if they want and leave if they want?"
"That was a rule established by our ancestors."
"If I’m unhappy here, then naturally I’m free to leave."
Daniel immediately sneered.
"Heh. The old rules are obsolete now."
"I am currently the Mountain Lord of the Holy Golden Mountain."
"If you wanted to leave, shouldn’t you at least have informed me first?"
At that point, Daniel suddenly shouted,
"I think you clearly look down on me!"
"You actually dare show contempt toward a Mountain Lord?"
"What punishment do you deserve?!"
Hollen Oracle-grade had never expected Daniel to be this forceful.
For a moment, he could not even find the words to argue back.
Daniel could no longer be bothered wasting words with him.
He suddenly cursed,
"Hollen, since you dared to show contempt toward me, you’ll have to pay the price."
"Cosmic Reincarnation Body!"
The next instant, a Divine Halo of Reincarnation appeared behind Daniel’s head.
A terrifying colossal palm suddenly manifested.
The instant the giant palm appeared, the entire palace collapsed, and the whole world began trembling.
As the colossal palm lightly swept downward—
Hollen Oracle-grade’s eyes nearly split apart from rage.
He hurriedly raised his hands to resist.
One Sacred Art and Secret Treasure after another appeared as he desperately tried to block the attack.
But he had forgotten one thing.
Prad Oracle-grade, who had been far stronger than him, had already been instantly killed by this very Sacred Art.
So what difference could it possibly make even if Hollen exhausted every method he possessed?
In 仅波 the blink of an eye, the colossal palm suppressed Hollen Oracle-grade and annihilated him into nothingness.
Thus ended Hollen Oracle-grade’s life and death.
At the same time, Daniel waved his hand, and the Sacred Art dissipated.
Before him, Hollen Oracle-grade’s corpse disappeared completely, reduced directly to powder.
He could not possibly be any more dead.
Daniel said coldly,
"This is the consequence of showing contempt toward me."
Then his figure vanished from the spot.
Before long, countless Holy Golden Mountain powerhouses received a piece of news.
T6 Oracle-grade Hollen had actually been instantly killed by Faustus Oracle-grade.
And the reason was simply that he had shown contempt toward Faustus, the branch leader.
Immediately, the several hundred Oracle-grade powerhouses who had chosen to remain behind could not help drawing in sharp breaths.
The title Great Demon King Faustus truly had not been given for nothing.
A person’s name might be wrong.
But a nickname was never wrong.
Immediately—
Those Oracle-grade powerhouses obediently handed over their territories.
Could they refuse?
Of course they could.
Hollen Oracle-grade was what happened to those who refused to hand over their territory.
Did they want the same fate?
Wave after wave of players under Daniel’s command set out and began taking control of the territories belonging to the Holy Golden Mountain’s Oracle-grade powerhouses.
It was like an ancient emperor stripping feudal lords of their domains.
Local powers were uprooted one after another as authority was centralized under the branch.
The Oracle-grade powerhouses who surrendered their territories could only return to the Gold-Grade Sacred Realm and obediently become Daniel’s resources and hired muscle.
As for those Oracle-grade powerhouses who possessed no territory—
One day, they suddenly discovered that their contribution-point exchange function had been forcibly restricted.
They could only make one exchange per day.
After making an exchange, they would then have to wait seven days, seven years, seventy years, or seven hundred years respectively before they could exchange again.
If they wanted unlimited exchanges—
They had to sign a contract with Daniel and become his workers.
Some of those Oracle-grade powerhouses withdrew.
Others reluctantly signed the agreement.
For a time, the number of Oracle-grade powerhouses within the Gold-Grade Sacred Realm skyrocketed to several hundred.
The Endless Starfield.
The Myriad Races Universe.
The former Holy Golden Mountain headquarters.
Daniel arrived here and chose to enter the largest Secret Realm within it.
The former Holy Golden Mountain headquarters contained Secret Realms opened by Eternal powerhouses.
There were countless natural Treasure Lands inside them.
The new leader had taken away many things, but Secret Realms themselves could not be moved.
They could only be left behind.
Daniel entered Secret Realm No. 1.
With a casual wave of his hand—
Countless treasures appeared before him.
The treasures piled into mountains, forming several hundred enormous peaks.
These were all resources left behind by the Holy Golden Mountain.
In any case, Daniel now completely controlled the Holy Golden Mountain from top to bottom.
His word had already become absolute.
Forget merely using some resources—
So what if he emptied the entire place?
"It’s time to undergo another tribulation."
Daniel sensed the signs of an approaching Cosmic Tribulation.
He was currently Tier-4 Oracle-grade.
If he underwent another tribulation, he would become Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
Naturally, undergoing a tribulation required preparing a grand tribulation formation.
Daniel possessed Grand Oracle Sophis’s experiences.
He was extremely familiar with Grand Oracle Sophis’s formation techniques.
Setting up the formation was not a problem.
Resources were even less of a problem.
"However, Boren and Gison are also preparing to undergo their tribulations soon and become Oracle-grade."
Daniel thought,
"My Cosmic Tribulation will arrive a little later."
"I can set up the formation for them first, let them undergo their tribulations, and then undergo mine afterward."
For both Boren and Gison, this would be their first tribulation.
The Peerless Grand Formation would be more than sufficient for them.
Throughout these years—
Boren and Gison had both been working for Daniel.
While the main body cultivated, the clones helped suppress and oversee Daniel’s territories throughout the Chaosverse.
Thinking of this, Daniel waved his hand.
The treasure mountains and precious materials before him all floated into the air and began rearranging themselves.
The tribulation formation mastered by Grand Oracle Sophis had been his own creation.
It incorporated the formation insights of countless mighty predecessors and was a formation Sophis had personally deduced and perfected.
It could be described as extraordinarily comprehensive.
Daniel had inherited Sophis’s legacy.
Naturally, he would use Sophis’s tribulation formation as well.
Before long—
After Daniel consumed most of the treasure mountains, the grand tribulation formation was finally complete.
This Secret Realm possessed natural treasure mountains whose quality was even better than those within the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land.
The grand tribulation formation connected directly to those treasure mountains, allowing it to borrow the advantages of both heaven and terrain and maximize its power.
Once the Peerless Grand Formation was complete—
Daniel notified Boren and Gison to come over.

chapters.title: Chapter 540 -540-Helping Others Survive Their Tribulations
paragraphs: Boren looked at the formation before him and could not help praising it.
"As expected of Brother Faustus. This formation truly is unparalleled. We really hit the jackpot this time."
Gison was also extremely satisfied with the formation. He nodded slightly.
"It really is impressive. Thank you."
Daniel smiled.
"Go ahead and undergo your tribulations."
"Also, Uriah and God Vade have both already reached Tier-2 Oracle-grade. You’re from the same era as them and are the same kind of geniuses. Don’t let them leave you too far behind."
Uriah and God Vade were both peerless geniuses.
Placed in any era, either of them would have been dazzling enough to shake an entire universe.
Yet in this era—
Because of Daniel’s existence, both of them had been overshadowed.
For the rest of their lives, they would inevitably live beneath Daniel’s shadow.
Compared with them, Boren and Gison were one level weaker.
Although they were geniuses as well, they were still far from the level of being able to astonish an entire universe.
Boren looked toward Gison.
"In that case, let’s begin."
"How about you go first?"
Gison did not decline.
He simply stepped into the formation.
Almost immediately, an exclamation came from inside.
"As expected of a supreme-grade formation."
At that moment—
Boom!
A thunderous roar erupted.
The Cosmic Tribulation appeared.
All kinds of strange phenomena continuously manifested before finally stabilizing at—
Silver!
Boren could not help exclaiming,
"As expected, it’s an extremely deep Silver-grade tribulation."
At the same time, however, he was somewhat worried.
After all, the higher the grade of the tribulation, the more terrifying its corresponding power would be.
Daniel merely smiled.
"There’s nothing to worry about."
"With Gison’s Strength, this is nothing."
Daniel understood the power of this grand tribulation formation better than anyone.
Combined with the fact that Gison himself was hardly weak—
Passing this tribulation was practically guaranteed.
Before long—
Gison’s Cosmic Tribulation descended.
The grand tribulation formation immediately activated, frantically drawing energy from the Secret Realm to resist the Cosmic Tribulation.
Not long afterward—
The Cosmic Tribulation gradually dissipated.
Gison flew out from the grand formation completely unharmed.
Even the usually cold and aloof Gison could not conceal the joy in his eyes.
The moment he emerged, he immediately looked toward Daniel.
"As expected of a supreme-grade grand formation. It really is useful."
Daniel smiled faintly.
This was the first time he had heard Gison say so much at once.
Although it was only a few words, Daniel clearly remembered what had happened during Gison’s tribulation.
After all, Gison had also needed to undergo the Transcendence Tribulation.
If Daniel had not created his own Sacred Art and caused the universe to modify its rules, Boren and Gison probably would have undergone their tribulations long ago.
After accumulating their foundations for some time, both of them had successfully reached Transcendent Oracle-grade.
When Gison underwent his tribulation, the universe manifested a phantom of Daniel.
Naturally—
Daniel gave Gison a free pass.
Seeing this, Boren’s eyes burned with eagerness.
He immediately waved his hand and entered the grand tribulation formation as well.
Before long—
His Cosmic Tribulation descended.
And just like Gison’s—
It ultimately stabilized at Silver.
Gison’s eyes lit up.
"Silver as well."
Boren’s Strength was roughly on the same level as his own, so naturally the universe had also judged his tribulation to be Silver-grade.
Throughout the countless years of the Endless Starfield, Silver Cosmic Tribulations had always been extraordinarily rare.
But ever since Daniel altered the rules of the universe—
They had become considerably easier to encounter.
After all, Daniel himself had been supporting both Boren and Gison.
Daniel lacked nothing.
Whatever Boren and Gison needed, he could provide at any time.
As a result, Daniel had forcibly raised the foundations of both men to an extraordinarily powerful level.
Combined with the reinforcement of the grand tribulation formation—
A Silver-grade Cosmic Tribulation was perfectly normal.
The Cosmic Tribulation began.
The grand tribulation formation activated once again and directly confronted the Cosmic Tribulation.
Crackle!
Boom!
After a barrage of violent explosions—
Boren also emerged from the grand tribulation formation unharmed.
He had successfully survived his tribulation as well.
From now on, the two of them only needed enough time to stabilize their Ranks.
Once they accumulated their foundations to Transcendent Oracle-grade again—
They could prepare for their second tribulations.
Daniel looked toward the grand tribulation formation before him.
After helping Boren and Gison undergo their tribulations, the formation had suffered considerable damage.
But that was not a problem.
Daniel took out the remaining precious materials and repaired the formation once again.
"I’m going to undergo my tribulation now."
"The fifth Cosmic Tribulation."
Daniel looked toward Boren and Gison.
After saying that—
He flew directly into the grand tribulation formation.
"Cosmic Tribulation!"
Daniel closed his eyes and immersed his consciousness, sensing the universe and summoning his tribulation.
Before long—
Within Secret Realm No. 1 of the Holy Golden Mountain—
A Cosmic Tribulation appeared for the third time.
The phenomenon in the sky suddenly began changing.
The previous two tribulations had both been Silver.
But this time—
The instant the Cosmic Tribulation appeared—
It was Golden!
Its power and grade were immediately pushed straight to the absolute maximum.
This was the universe’s special treatment for Daniel.
Extra attention!
At the same time—
Inside the grand tribulation formation.
"What form will the tribulation take this time?"
Even Daniel did not know.
The only thing he knew for certain was that every Cosmic Tribulation he underwent was an absurdly enhanced version of the normal one.
"Come!"
In the next instant—
The Cosmic Tribulation descended!
Yet strangely—
Nothing changed throughout the entire Secret Realm.
"Hmm?"
Daniel sensed the form of the Cosmic Tribulation.
Suddenly, his expression changed dramatically.
"This is bad!"
"It’s actually the legendary Celestial Exhaustion!"
Did no movement mean there was nothing to fear?
Wrong!
The absence of any movement was precisely what made it even more terrifying!
Celestial Exhaustion was one of the most horrifying forms of Cosmic Tribulation.
Under normal circumstances—
There were only the Five Decays of Heaven and Man.
But this was a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
It had forcibly added four more forms of decay—
Turning the Five Decays of Heaven and Man into the full Celestial Exhaustion.
The "decays" referred to—
Filth appearing upon one’s clothes.
The flowers adorning one’s head withering.
Sweat pouring from beneath one’s arms.
A foul odor emerging from the body.
The five senses and six perceptions becoming obscured.
Drowsiness during the day and insomnia at night.
The seven emotions and six desires being magnified.
The physical body withering.
And the Divine Soul weakening.
Daniel’s Cosmic Tribulation—
As expected—
Was anything but ordinary.
His fifth Cosmic Tribulation was actually Celestial Exhaustion.
An overwhelmingly enhanced version of the Five Decays of Heaven and Man.
Among them—
Filthy clothes.
Withered flowers upon the head.
Sweating beneath the arms.
And a foul-smelling body.
Those were still manageable.
After all, they did not have much direct impact on combat.
But the effects that came afterward—
Were completely different.
They were practically fatal!
First—
The five senses and six perceptions would be obscured.
This meant one’s vision would become muddy and unclear.
The nose would become blocked.
The tongue would become clumsy.
The ears would no longer hear.
The mouth would be unable to speak.
The divine sense would descend into chaos.
One would be unable to properly feel what they touched.
Unable to properly perceive scents.
And countless other senses would begin failing.
And even this—
Was merely the beginning.
Drowsiness during the day and insomnia at night would completely reverse the normal rhythm of day and night.
One’s essence, energy, and spirit would be continuously wasted.
If this persisted for long enough—
It would cause irreversible damage to the divine sense.
Then there was the amplification of the seven emotions and six desires.
Someone who was angry would become even angrier.
Someone grieving would fall into even deeper grief.
Someone happy would become even more ecstatic.
Someone sorrowful would become even more miserable...
In other words—
Something that would normally be completely insignificant and not worth getting angry over could suddenly provoke uncontrollable rage.
And that rage would only continue increasing.
For example—
Suppose an item fell onto the ground.
Normally, it would mean nothing.
But while affected by Celestial Exhaustion—
You would become angry.
Angry at yourself for failing to hold it properly.
Angry at the ground for being there.
Angry at the item for falling by itself.
Angry at the shopkeeper for selling you the item in the first place.
And finally—
Angry at yourself for having enough money to buy it.

As a result, Daniel had forcibly raised the foundations of both men to an extraordinarily powerful level.
Combined with the reinforcement of the grand tribulation formation—
A Silver-grade Cosmic Tribulation was perfectly normal.
The Cosmic Tribulation began.
The grand tribulation formation activated once again and directly confronted the Cosmic Tribulation.
Crackle!
Boom!
After a barrage of violent explosions—
Boren also emerged from the grand tribulation formation unharmed.
He had successfully survived his tribulation as well.
From now on, the two of them only needed enough time to stabilize their Ranks.
Once they accumulated their foundations to Transcendent Oracle-grade again—
They could prepare for their second tribulations.
Daniel looked toward the grand tribulation formation before him.
After helping Boren and Gison undergo their tribulations, the formation had suffered considerable damage.
But that was not a problem.
Daniel took out the remaining precious materials and repaired the formation once again.
"I’m going to undergo my tribulation now."
"The fifth Cosmic Tribulation."
Daniel looked toward Boren and Gison.
After saying that—
He flew directly into the grand tribulation formation.
"Cosmic Tribulation!"
Daniel closed his eyes and immersed his consciousness, sensing the universe and summoning his tribulation.
Before long—
Within Secret Realm No.
1 of the Holy Golden Mountain—
A Cosmic Tribulation appeared for the third time.
The phenomenon in the sky suddenly began changing.
The previous two tribulations had both been Silver.
But this time—
The instant the Cosmic Tribulation appeared—
It was Golden!
Its power and grade were immediately pushed straight to the absolute maximum.
This was the universe’s special treatment for Daniel.
Extra attention!
At the same time—
Inside the grand tribulation formation.
"What form will the tribulation take this time?"
Even Daniel did not know.
The only thing he knew for certain was that every Cosmic Tribulation he underwent was an absurdly enhanced version of the normal one.
"Come!"
In the next instant—
The Cosmic Tribulation descended!
Yet strangely—
Nothing changed throughout the entire Secret Realm.
"Hmm?"
Daniel sensed the form of the Cosmic Tribulation.
Suddenly, his expression changed dramatically.
"This is bad!"
"It’s actually the legendary Celestial Exhaustion!"
Did no movement mean there was nothing to fear?
Wrong!
The absence of any movement was precisely what made it even more terrifying!
Celestial Exhaustion was one of the most horrifying forms of Cosmic Tribulation.
Under normal circumstances—
There were only the Five Decays of Heaven and Man.
But this was a Golden Cosmic Tribulation.
It had forcibly added four more forms of decay—
Turning the Five Decays of Heaven and Man into the full Celestial Exhaustion.
The "decays" referred to—
Filth appearing upon one’s clothes.
The flowers adorning one’s head withering.
Sweat pouring from beneath one’s arms.
A foul odor emerging from the body.
The five senses and six perceptions becoming obscured.
Drowsiness during the day and insomnia at night.
The seven emotions and six desires being magnified.
The physical body withering.
And the Divine Soul weakening.
Daniel’s Cosmic Tribulation—
As expected—
Was anything but ordinary.
His fifth Cosmic Tribulation was actually Celestial Exhaustion.
An overwhelmingly enhanced version of the Five Decays of Heaven and Man.
Among them—
Filthy clothes.
Withered flowers upon the head.
Sweating beneath the arms.
And a foul-smelling body.
Those were still manageable.
After all, they did not have much direct impact on combat.
But the effects that came afterward—
Were completely different.
They were practically fatal!
First—
The five senses and six perceptions would be obscured.
This meant one’s vision would become muddy and unclear.
The nose would become blocked.
The tongue would become clumsy.
The ears would no longer hear.
The mouth would be unable to speak.
The divine sense would descend into chaos.
One would be unable to properly feel what they touched.
Unable to properly perceive scents.
And countless other senses would begin failing.
And even this—
Was merely the beginning.
Drowsiness during the day and insomnia at night would completely reverse the normal rhythm of day and night.
One’s essence, energy, and spirit would be continuously wasted.
If this persisted for long enough—
It would cause irreversible damage to the divine sense.
Then there was the amplification of the seven emotions and six desires.
Someone who was angry would become even angrier.
Someone grieving would fall into even deeper grief.
Someone happy would become even more ecstatic.
Someone sorrowful would become even more miserable...
In other words—
Something that would normally be completely insignificant and not worth getting angry over could suddenly provoke uncontrollable rage.
And that rage would only continue increasing.
For example—
Suppose an item fell onto the ground.
Normally, it would mean nothing.
But while affected by Celestial Exhaustion—
You would become angry.
Angry at yourself for failing to hold it properly.
Angry at the ground for being there.
Angry at the item for falling by itself.
Angry at the shopkeeper for selling you the item in the first place.
And finally—
Angry at yourself for having enough money to buy it.

chapters.title: Chapter 541 -541-The Third Tribulation
paragraphs: That was right. This kind of torment would gradually drive a person insane. Not only would the physical body wither, but even an existence once powerful enough to hold up the heavens with one hand would become weak and powerless under the effects of Celestial Exhaustion.

No matter how powerful someone had once been, they would now become a weakling incapable of even restraining a chicken. With the Divine Soul weakened, they would become vulnerable to all kinds of threats.
Under the effects of Celestial Exhaustion, every aspect of one’s Strength would be comprehensively restricted.
Without power on the same cosmic level, there was no way to break it. The only alternative was to endure it through sheer willpower until it finally passed.

Daniel took a deep breath. He had never imagined that a Cosmic Tribulation could be this vicious. In order to deal with him, the universe had even resorted to its ultimate killing move—Celestial Exhaustion.
Daniel frowned and sighed. "This is going to be somewhat troublesome."
After all, Celestial Exhaustion was different from other Cosmic Tribulations. It would not simply disappear at any moment. He would need time to slowly endure it until its effects wore away.
And no one knew exactly how long that would take.
Under normal circumstances, Celestial Exhaustion lasted at least one year. But for the Cosmic Tribulation Daniel was undergoing, it would require at least two years.
If he were outside the formation, he would have to endure it for an entire hundred years.
It was only because of the grand tribulation formation that the duration had been reduced to two years.

Two years meant that he could not leave the grand tribulation formation again. Even his clones would be affected by Celestial Exhaustion, because this Cosmic Tribulation directly targeted the Origin itself. It was cosmic-level energy, and even Daniel was powerless against it. The only exception was his Starry Sky Behemoth clone, Lexen, which he could still make use of.
Lexen had been cultivating inside the Spacetime Palace all this time, but his current Strength was still unusable.
In other words, the Strength Daniel could truly mobilize right now had effectively fallen infinitely close to zero.
He sighed. "Damn it. This Cosmic Tribulation really hates me that much."
"Still, it’s not completely hopeless. The T7 Oracle-grade clone Grand Oracle Shamir left behind for me is still here, and God Vade and Uriah both owe me favors."

"Besides, Boren and Gison can help me as well. Add Kellen of the Chaos Humans and some of the other Chaos Humans, and as long as I can hold out for these two years, once I endure this, there’ll be almost nothing left capable of threatening me."
Daniel’s eyes flickered. "The fifth tribulation is already this difficult. Future tribulations will only become even more terrifying."
"If I eventually undergo that Cosmic Quantitative Tribulation, the universe will probably want to swallow me alive."
"And if I take another step beyond that and undergo the Supreme Tribulation, the difficulty is simply unimaginable. This universe really has far too much resentment toward me."
With that thought, Daniel decisively explained his current situation to Boren and Gison.
When they heard Daniel’s voice transmission, Boren and Jason could not help drawing in sharp breaths. The tribulations Brother Faustus underwent were on a completely different level from theirs.
Celestial Exhaustion was simply too terrifying. Even Daniel had been trapped by this cosmic tribulation.
After hearing Daniel’s arrangements, the two immediately left.
Boren informed the clone Grand Oracle Shamir had left behind in the Sacred Land of the situation.
Grand Oracle Shamir immediately used the clone to contact the Holy Golden Mountain branch.

He announced that Faustus would be entering secluded cultivation to undergo his tribulation. As a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse, combined with the vast authority Daniel had granted him, no player dared oppose him.
Naturally, the former Holy Golden Mountain Oracle-grade powerhouses had even fewer objections.
They did not dare object.
Daniel had already beaten them into submission long ago. None of them even dared entertain malicious thoughts anymore.
After that, Boren went to find God Vade.
Gison went to find Kellen and Uriah.

At this point, they were all tribulation-stage powerhouses. Although they were only Tier-1 Oracle-grade, their actual Strength was no weaker than that of Tier-2 Oracle-grade powerhouses, and they could even fight Tier-3 Oracle-grade experts.
Chaosverse.
Uriah met Gison.

"What?!" The meat bun in Uriah’s mouth dropped to the ground as she opened her mouth in shock. "Big Brother Faustus wants me to repay the karma I owe him, and he also wants me to bring several Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses as bodyguards? Okay, okay! I’ll prepare to leave right away."
Karma could be either great or small.
Uriah had been troubled over how she could repay the karmic debt she owed Daniel.
Now that Daniel needed her help, she accepted without hesitation.

She immediately reported the matter to her patriarch. The patriarch himself would eventually need to undergo tribulation, and in order to establish a connection with Daniel, he generously dispatched several T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses to serve as Uriah’s guards.
Daniel had made the situation very clear.
The Myriad Races Universe was about to become extraordinarily dangerous and brutal.
All kinds of factions would become entangled there.

Not only would powerful experts and Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses from other universes come searching for opportunities, but factions such as the Eternal Tribulation Palace and the Ultimate Dao Domain Sea would also become involved.
Under ordinary circumstances, weaker Oracle-grade powerhouses would barely even be qualified to participate. Once dragged into the conflict, they would face a nine-deaths-one-life situation.
That was why Daniel had specifically instructed Uriah to bring Grand Oracle-grade guards.
The patriarch was extraordinarily generous, partly because he valued Uriah and partly because of Daniel.
"Uriah, take our race’s supreme treasure with you," the patriarch instructed. "Come back alive."
"Mm-hmm!" Uriah nodded heavily.
Chaosverse, Chaos Humans.
Gison and Uriah found Kellen.
Kellen was also a Tier-1 Oracle-grade powerhouse at this point.
He had undergone his tribulation earlier than Boren and Gison, doing so shortly after Daniel’s tribulation.
He had simply missed the emergence of Transcendent Oracle-grade.
Gison did not explain anything aloud. Just as when inviting Uriah, he directly handed Daniel’s letter to Kellen.
But Kellen’s letter was different from Uriah’s.
Uriah’s letter had only mentioned repaying karma and the changes that were about to occur in the Myriad Races Universe.
Kellen’s letter explained the entire cause and sequence of events.

"Celestial Exhaustion..." Kellen drew in a sharp breath and immediately understood how urgent the situation was. "As long as Faustus can endure these two years, he’ll be fine. I definitely have to help with this."
"However, the Chaos Humans have suffered heavy losses in our recent war against the Heaven-Equaling Universe."
"We don’t have any spare T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses available."
"But I can still bring several Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouses."
With that thought, Kellen immediately invited several Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts with whom he had close relationships, and together they set out for the Myriad Races Universe.
Meanwhile—
Boren arrived in the Rune Universe.
He successfully invited God Vade as well.
At the same time, God Vade’s teacher arranged for two T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses to accompany him as guards.
Their destination—
The Myriad Races Universe!
God Vade also needed to repay his karmic debt, while his teacher valued Daniel’s control over the tribulations undergone by cultivators.
If they helped Daniel now, then when his students underwent tribulations in the future, things would become much easier for them.
Faustus absolutely could not be offended.
And when Faustus needed help, they absolutely had to help him—even if doing so required paying an enormous price.
Complete Westernized Replacement Version for Fantasy Text
The true terror of Celestial Exhaustion did not lie in the Cosmic Tribulation itself.
It lay in its duration.
Throughout the period in which it remained active, the tribulation-taker’s Strength would be weakened to the absolute limit.
That alone was an extraordinarily dangerous situation.
After all, anyone who had spent enough time out in the world would inevitably have a few enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 -542-Trapped Within the Formation
paragraphs: Daniel would not be able to leave anytime soon. His only choice was to remain inside the grand tribulation formation and endure this calamity until the end.
If he went outside, the duration of the tribulation would multiply without limit. For the time being, the Holy Golden Mountain could only be managed by the clone of Xavier Oracle-grade.

Boren, Gison, God Vade, and Uriah had all arrived in the Myriad Races Universe according to Daniel’s message. None of them were weak, and each had brought a group of guards, instantly turning them into high-end combat forces.
For now, they were responsible for deterring Oracle-grade powerhouses who coveted this starfield.
Gures Oracle-grade was a long-famous T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
He had been born in the Abyss Universe and was a member of one of its top factions. He had traveled with that faction into the Myriad Races Universe in search of opportunities.

However, the Oracle-grade experts in that group were not particularly powerful. Before long, Gures chose to leave the group on his own, taking several Oracle-grade subordinates with him and venturing out independently.
Not long afterward, he arrived at the Garo Starfield.
His Starship stopped directly at the outer edge of the Garo Starfield and went no farther.
A Tier-3 Oracle-grade servant reported, "My Lord, is currently the largest region in the universe, and its top faction, the Holy Golden Mountain, is also located here."
"However, some time ago, the Eternal powerhouse backing the Holy Golden Mountain fell. Their leader also died in, so they all relocated into the Chaosverse."
"The current leader of the Myriad Races Universe branch is an Oracle-grade powerhouse named Faustus."
After hearing this, Gures Oracle-grade revealed a cautious expression.
Whenever he arrived somewhere new, he would send servants to gather relevant intelligence so that he would not accidentally provoke someone he could not afford to offend.
At the same time, he would specifically investigate whether any opportunities existed nearby.
After listening to his servant’s report, a smile appeared on his face.
"So the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters has already relocated."

"And they still want to occupy this entire starfield? I’ve heard of this Faustus. He once triggered a Golden Cosmic Tribulation inside the Sacred Origin Forbidden Land, but right now he’s at most only a Tier-4 Oracle-grade powerhouse. He’s nothing worth mentioning."
With that thought, Gures Oracle-grade asked, "Are there any worthwhile opportunities in the Garo Starfield?"

The Oracle-grade servant immediately replied, "Master, the Pulan Star River within the Garo Starfield contains the extremely famous Holy Spirit Waterfall. It is said that seven-colored divine water frequently flows from the waterfall, and it is extremely beneficial for nourishing one’s Sacred Domain and strengthening the soul. There are also several other wonders within the region."
As Gures Oracle-grade listened, greed appeared in his eyes.
"Then let’s go."
"We’ll visit the Pulan Star River first and directly seize that Holy Spirit Waterfall for ourselves."
The next instant, the Starship activated and vanished into the star sea like a streak of light moving at extreme speed.
Only a short while later, within the Pulan Star River, Gures Oracle-grade and his Oracle-grade servants arrived beneath the Holy Spirit Waterfall.
Before him stood an astonishing waterfall, its waters flowing with a deep, seven-colored radiance. The sight was incomparably magnificent.
Gures Oracle-grade’s eyes burned with desire.
He could sense that the waterfall was filled with extremely pure Holy Spirit Power.
At that moment, three figures appeared before him.
They were Uriah and the two T7 Oracle-grade guards accompanying her.
One of Uriah’s guards spoke coldly.
"This place is territory belonging to the Holy Golden Mountain."
"Who are you?"
"Leave immediately."

Back when Uriah underwent her tribulation, Daniel had personally spared her. She now owed him a favor and a karmic debt. Naturally, Uriah had come personally to repay that karma, temporarily joining the Holy Golden Mountain and guarding its territory for two years.
Uriah naturally intended to repay this karmic debt. She had agreed to temporarily join the Holy Golden Mountain and defend Daniel’s territory for two years.
Two years in exchange for repaying one favor.
No matter how she looked at it, she would not lose out.
Uriah was perfectly willing.
The moment she received word that an outside Oracle-grade powerhouse had invaded the Pulan Star River, she immediately rushed over with her T7 Oracle-grade guards.
Gures Oracle-grade frowned and examined the two T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses before him.
He automatically ignored Uriah.
"I’m a peak T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse."
"Those two T7 Oracle-grade experts look like nothing more than ordinary powerhouses."
"I should... have a chance of winning... right?"
This was precisely why he had the confidence not to fear the Holy Golden Mountain.
According to his intelligence—
The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters had already relocated, and all of its true experts had left.
At most, a few T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses remained behind.
And he was not afraid of T7 Oracle-grade experts.
Thinking of this, Gures Oracle-grade said,
"What if I refuse to leave?"
"I’ve taken a liking to this Holy Spirit Waterfall."
Gures Oracle-grade spoke indifferently.
"I advise you to understand the situation and obediently step aside."
"Otherwise, don’t blame me for being impolite."
"Heh!"
The two guards sneered simultaneously.
"You’re courting death!"
Whoosh!
The two guards attacked at the same time.
They raised their fists as law power immediately circulated around them.
"Petty tricks."
Gures Oracle-grade sneered disdainfully.
With a wave of his hand, he unleashed a Sacred Art.
Countless miniature stars suddenly appeared and linked together, forming a Starfield Meteor Formation.
"Kill!"
The two guards simultaneously smashed their fists into the Starfield Meteor Formation.
Boom!
A deafening explosion erupted!
Yet their fists were actually unable to shake the Starfield Meteor Formation.
Whoosh!
The Starfield Meteor Formation pressed toward them with unstoppable momentum.
At the same time—
The Nether Abyss Gourd behind Gures Oracle-grade suddenly flew out.
Pop!
The stopper of the gourd opened by itself, and a mass of black baleful energy sprayed toward Uriah and the other two powerhouses.
"The substance sprayed by this Secret Treasure is Abyssal Prison Nether-Ash Sand from a Forbidden Land within the Chaos Star Sea."
"There is nothing it cannot destroy!"
Uriah and the two guards now had to face not only the Starfield Meteor Formation but also the gourd Secret Treasure.
For a moment, they were in an extremely dangerous situation.
But at that moment—
Whoosh!
A basin-shaped treasure suddenly appeared.
Law ripples spread outward and reached the gourd.
The gourd immediately began trembling.
Then, as though suddenly becoming obedient, it flew directly into the Ruinfall Sacred Bowl.
The Ruinfall Sacred Bowl!
A Ruinfall Sacred Bowl specifically designed to seize all kinds of Secret Treasures!
Gures Oracle-grade’s eyes widened in alarm.
He hurriedly tried to reconnect with his gourd Secret Treasure, but no matter what he did, he could no longer sense it.
The imprint he had left on the Secret Treasure had clearly been erased.
"My innate supreme treasure!"
Gures Oracle-grade felt his heart ache unbearably.
But it was not over yet.
An eye suddenly appeared.
The eye had originally been closed.
Now, it abruptly opened.
A hazy beam of light shot toward the Starfield Meteor Formation and actually shattered it directly.
Myriad-Eye Art.
There was nothing it could not break!
Uriah smiled, two tiny dimples appearing at the corners of her mouth.
"Kill!"
The guards beside her immediately charged forward.
Uriah’s race specialized most in close combat.
This time, the two guards held nothing back and directly drew their weapons.
Gures Oracle-grade frowned.
With a wave of his hand, countless Law Sacred Arts erupted.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The Myriad-Eye Art continuously fired beams of light, shattering Gures Oracle-grade’s Sacred Arts one after another.
And because of the Ruinfall Sacred Bowl, Gures Oracle-grade no longer dared to use any Secret Treasures.
At the same time, he still had to face the joint assault of two powerhouses of the same Rank.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The Myriad-Eye Art continued supporting their attacks.

With that thought, Gures Oracle-grade asked, "Are there any worthwhile opportunities in the Garo Starfield?"
The Oracle-grade servant immediately replied, "Master, the Pulan Star River within the Garo Starfield contains the extremely famous Holy Spirit Waterfall.
It is said that seven-colored divine water frequently flows from the waterfall, and it is extremely beneficial for nourishing one’s Sacred Domain and strengthening the soul.
There are also several other wonders within the region."
As Gures Oracle-grade listened, greed appeared in his eyes.
"Then let’s go."
"We’ll visit the Pulan Star River first and directly seize that Holy Spirit Waterfall for ourselves."
The next instant, the Starship activated and vanished into the star sea like a streak of light moving at extreme speed.
Only a short while later, within the Pulan Star River, Gures Oracle-grade and his Oracle-grade servants arrived beneath the Holy Spirit Waterfall.
Before him stood an astonishing waterfall, its waters flowing with a deep, seven-colored radiance.
The sight was incomparably magnificent.
Gures Oracle-grade’s eyes burned with desire.
He could sense that the waterfall was filled with extremely pure Holy Spirit Power.
At that moment, three figures appeared before him.
They were Uriah and the two T7 Oracle-grade guards accompanying her.
One of Uriah’s guards spoke coldly.
"This place is territory belonging to the Holy Golden Mountain."
"Who are you?"
"Leave immediately."
Back when Uriah underwent her tribulation, Daniel had personally spared her.
She now owed him a favor and a karmic debt.
Naturally, Uriah had come personally to repay that karma, temporarily joining the Holy Golden Mountain and guarding its territory for two years.
Uriah naturally intended to repay this karmic debt.
She had agreed to temporarily join the Holy Golden Mountain and defend Daniel’s territory for two years.
Two years in exchange for repaying one favor.
No matter how she looked at it, she would not lose out.
Uriah was perfectly willing.
The moment she received word that an outside Oracle-grade powerhouse had invaded the Pulan Star River, she immediately rushed over with her T7 Oracle-grade guards.
Gures Oracle-grade frowned and examined the two T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses before him.
He automatically ignored Uriah.
"I’m a peak T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse."
"Those two T7 Oracle-grade experts look like nothing more than ordinary powerhouses."
"I should... have a chance of winning... right?"
This was precisely why he had the confidence not to fear the Holy Golden Mountain.
According to his intelligence—
The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters had already relocated, and all of its true experts had left.
At most, a few T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses remained behind.
And he was not afraid of T7 Oracle-grade experts.
Thinking of this, Gures Oracle-grade said,
"What if I refuse to leave?"
"I’ve taken a liking to this Holy Spirit Waterfall."
Gures Oracle-grade spoke indifferently.
"I advise you to understand the situation and obediently step aside."
"Otherwise, don’t blame me for being impolite."
"Heh!"
The two guards sneered simultaneously.
"You’re courting death!"
Whoosh!
The two guards attacked at the same time.
They raised their fists as law power immediately circulated around them.
"Petty tricks."
Gures Oracle-grade sneered disdainfully.
With a wave of his hand, he unleashed a Sacred Art.
Countless miniature stars suddenly appeared and linked together, forming a Starfield Meteor Formation.
"Kill!"
The two guards simultaneously smashed their fists into the Starfield Meteor Formation.
Boom!
A deafening explosion erupted!
Yet their fists were actually unable to shake the Starfield Meteor Formation.
Whoosh!
The Starfield Meteor Formation pressed toward them with unstoppable momentum.
At the same time—
The Nether Abyss Gourd behind Gures Oracle-grade suddenly flew out.
Pop!
The stopper of the gourd opened by itself, and a mass of black baleful energy sprayed toward Uriah and the other two powerhouses.
"The substance sprayed by this Secret Treasure is Abyssal Prison Nether-Ash Sand from a Forbidden Land within the Chaos Star Sea."
"There is nothing it cannot destroy!"
Uriah and the two guards now had to face not only the Starfield Meteor Formation but also the gourd Secret Treasure.
For a moment, they were in an extremely dangerous situation.
But at that moment—
Whoosh!
A basin-shaped treasure suddenly appeared.
Law ripples spread outward and reached the gourd.
The gourd immediately began trembling.
Then, as though suddenly becoming obedient, it flew directly into the Ruinfall Sacred Bowl.
The Ruinfall Sacred Bowl!
A Ruinfall Sacred Bowl specifically designed to seize all kinds of Secret Treasures!
Gures Oracle-grade’s eyes widened in alarm.
He hurriedly tried to reconnect with his gourd Secret Treasure, but no matter what he did, he could no longer sense it.
The imprint he had left on the Secret Treasure had clearly been erased.
"My innate supreme treasure!"
Gures Oracle-grade felt his heart ache unbearably.
But it was not over yet.
An eye suddenly appeared.
The eye had originally been closed.
Now, it abruptly opened.
A hazy beam of light shot toward the Starfield Meteor Formation and actually shattered it directly.
Myriad-Eye Art.
There was nothing it could not break!
Uriah smiled, two tiny dimples appearing at the corners of her mouth.
"Kill!"
The guards beside her immediately charged forward.
Uriah’s race specialized most in close combat.
This time, the two guards held nothing back and directly drew their weapons.
Gures Oracle-grade frowned.
With a wave of his hand, countless Law Sacred Arts erupted.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The Myriad-Eye Art continuously fired beams of light, shattering Gures Oracle-grade’s Sacred Arts one after another.
And because of the Ruinfall Sacred Bowl, Gures Oracle-grade no longer dared to use any Secret Treasures.
At the same time, he still had to face the joint assault of two powerhouses of the same Rank.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The Myriad-Eye Art continued supporting their attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 -543-Casual Slaughter
paragraphs: "Kill!!!"
The two Tier 7 Oracle-grade guards launched their full-strength attacks at once, instantly forcing Gures Oracle-grade into a desperate situation.
At the same time, Uriah joined the battle as well. His opponents were none other than Gures Oracle-grade’s servants.

Those servants were Tier 3 Oracle-grades, but Uriah showed no fear whatsoever. Although he himself was only a Tier 2 Oracle-grade, whether in divine abilities or cultivation, he was far stronger than ordinary Tier 3 Oracle-grades.
This was precisely what made a Transcendent Oracle-grade so terrifying.
They could break through the limitations of the conventional rank system.
Carrying a massive saber even taller than himself, Uriah rushed forward and killed one of the servants in only a few exchanges.
Meanwhile, the longer Gures Oracle-grade fought, the more alarmed he became.
Before long, that alarm turned into despair.
His two opponents possessed physiques so terrifyingly powerful that they fought as though they had no regard for their own lives.
Combined with the Myriad Eyes Art, Gures Oracle-grade only managed to hold out for a short while before the two Tier 7 Oracle-grades joined forces and killed him.
Just like that, Gures Oracle-grade, a peak Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse, died here.
Uriah glanced indifferently at the corpse before casually swinging his saber and severing the man’s head.
He handed the head of the Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse to one of the Holy Golden Mountain players and ordered,
"Hang this at the entrance to the starfield.
"Let every powerhouse who dares challenge Holy Golden Mountain see what awaits them.
"Whoever comes to cause trouble dies."
The severed head of a Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse was already enough to intimidate the overwhelming majority of people.
Uriah’s race had always handled matters this way.
If they wanted to put an end to future trouble, the simplest solution was to use the crudest and most direct form of deterrence.
And more often than not, it worked remarkably well.
Uriah had clearly picked up the same habit.
The Holy Golden Mountain players did not dare delay and immediately went to display Gures Oracle-grade’s head as ordered.
At the same time, another player collected Gures Oracle-grade’s corpse.
After all, the body of a Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse was a treasure from head to toe. Its value was astonishing and was in no way inferior to an Innate Supreme Treasure.
Uriah rested his enormous saber over his shoulder before putting away the Sacred Body and the Illusory Eye Art.
Both treasures had been lent to him by Daniel for dealing with enemies.
Their effectiveness had clearly exceeded expectations.
Uriah grinned and sighed.
"The treasures Big Brother Faustus owns really are incredible.
"I probably won’t be able to obtain even one treasure of this level in my entire life."
Compared to those treasures, the things he carried on himself seemed almost laughable.
Meanwhile, within the Moon Seven Star River, a chaotic battle had already erupted.
One side had two Tier 7 Oracle-grades and dozens of other Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The opposing side consisted of Holy Golden Mountain’s current main force.
Nearly every Holy Golden Mountain powerhouse above Tier 3 Oracle-grade had arrived, including Boren, Gison, Kellen, and Kellen’s Oracle-grade friends.
Shamir Oracle-grade had even personally led the group into battle.
With both sides combined, more than a hundred Oracle-grade powerhouses were fighting.
The battle was exceptionally fierce.
Shamir Oracle-grade alone was fighting two opponents at once.
The laws throughout the area ran wild as all sorts of Oracle-grade abilities and visions repeatedly illuminated the starry sky.
Blood spilled across the battlefield almost every moment.
After fighting for some time, Camille finally led Holy Golden Mountain’s forces in forcing the attackers to retreat.
Once the battlefield was cleared and the casualties were counted, several Oracle-grades on the enemy side had died.
Holy Golden Mountain had also lost several Oracle-grade powerhouses.
Even so, the battle had thoroughly frightened the opposing force.
It was unlikely they would dare return anytime soon.
Recently, however, the Myriad Races Universe had indeed become increasingly chaotic.
Large numbers of powerhouses from foreign universes had appeared.
They behaved like bandits, taking whatever caught their eye.
With the lifespan of the Myriad Races Universe approaching its end, anything of value had become irresistible prey in their eyes.
At the same time, the native factions had already begun evacuating in large numbers.
Naturally, these outsiders no longer took them seriously.
Many starfields had fallen into complete disorder after the factions that once governed them departed.
At present, only the Jialuo Starfield under Holy Golden Mountain’s branch remained relatively stable.
Yet even here, Holy Golden Mountain had to deal with powerhouses from foreign universes almost every day.
Battles were practically a daily occurrence.
Shamir ordered his men to clean up the battlefield before leading the group of Oracle-grades back to the Gold-grade Realm.
"Faustus... it’s almost been two years."
"The Myriad Races Universe is becoming more chaotic by the day."
"How are you doing now?"
Shamir Oracle-grade was gradually beginning to feel exhausted.
Throughout this entire period, his nerves had remained taut.
He had barely allowed himself a moment of relaxation.
He was constantly worried that something might suddenly go wrong.
After all, when Daniel handed this territory over to him, it had been completely intact.
If Daniel returned only to find part of it gone, Shamir would be far too ashamed to face him.
Boren and Gison were equally exhausted during this period.
Most of their energy had been spent fighting one battle after another.
Although their strength had steadily improved through those battles, they were also constantly worried about Daniel.
In theory, once someone endured the Decline of Heaven and Man, everything would be over.
But—
There were always exceptions.
A powerhouse did not rely on strength alone.
They also had to confront their own heart.
If an ordinary person suddenly became blind, mute, or crippled, their mental state would inevitably suffer.
There were even plenty who chose to end their own lives.
That was why they were also worried about Daniel’s state of mind.
A Starship departed from the Silent Annihilation Starfield of the Myriad Races Universe.
Behind it lay the devastated starfield.
Countless living beings within had been wiped out.
Its energy had been drained away, while nearly every valuable treasure and material had been plundered.
Not a single useful resource had been left behind.
Anything that could not be taken away had simply been destroyed.
A flag belonging to the Eternal Tribulation Palace flew above the Starship.
There was a famous saying about the Eternal Tribulation Palace throughout the Endless Starfield:
"Where the Eternal Tribulation Palace passes, not even grass remains!"
After the Eternal Tribulation Palace fleet entered the Myriad Races Universe, it split into several groups.
Each group headed toward a different starfield to plunder it.
Most of the major factions in the Myriad Races Universe had already evacuated.
The avatars and forces they had left behind were nowhere near strong enough to oppose the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace was like a pack of wolves thrown among a flock of sheep.
For them, this was practically paradise.
Inside one of the Starships, Tier 6 Oracle-grade Demon Lord Vasu looked toward the Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse beside him—
Kellen.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace had even dispatched Tier 8 Oracle-grade powerhouses for this operation.
Demon Lord Vasu was not qualified to accompany a Tier 8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Even so, the Starship he was currently aboard had three Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
All three stood at the peak of Tier 7 Oracle-grade.
Among them, Kellen Oracle-grade was the strongest.
He possessed enough power to instantly kill other Tier 7 Oracle-grades of the same rank.
"Kellen Oracle-grade."
Demon Lord Vasu spoke respectfully.
"This junior has heard that the Jialuo Starfield is the largest and most prosperous starfield in the entire Myriad Races Universe.
"It is said to contain countless treasures."
He spoke tentatively while carefully watching Kellen Oracle-grade’s expression.
The moment Demon Lord Vasu noticed the flicker of interest in Kellen Oracle-grade’s eyes, he was delighted.
He had received intelligence some time ago.
Faustus—the man who had once injured him and robbed him—was currently in the Myriad Races Universe.
And now, he was the leader of Holy Golden Mountain’s branch.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 -544-On the Eve of the Final Battle
paragraphs: For years, Demon Lord Vasu had never been able to forget Faustus.
Faustus had practically become the greatest obstacle on his cultivation path during this period, to the point that he had already turned into an inner demon.
If he could not eliminate this inner demon, then Demon Lord Vasu’s cultivation path would be completely severed.
When Demon Lord Vasu first learned that the person in the Abyss Forbidden Land was actually Faustus, he had immediately believed that he would never have another chance at revenge.
After all, the other party had triggered a gold-grade Cosmic Tribulation.
Back when Faustus was only Divine-grade, he had already been capable of fighting Demon Lord Vasu, who was a Tier 6 powerhouse.
By now, Faustus could probably kill him with a casual strike.
For a time, Demon Lord Vasu had fallen into utter despair.
He had never expected that he would actually get a chance to attack Faustus in the Myriad Races Universe this time.
More importantly, he was accompanying Kellen Oracle-grade, a peak Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Calling Kellen Oracle-grade a half-step Tier 8 powerhouse would not be an exaggeration.
He could casually insta-kill ordinary Tier 7 Oracle-grades of the same rank.
With strength like that, he would definitely be able to suppress Faustus and finally help Demon Lord Vasu break free from his inner demon.
Thinking of this, Demon Lord Vasu continued,
"I’m sure you’ve heard about it as well. Holy Golden Mountain’s headquarters has already relocated to the Chaosverse.
"The branch they left behind in the Myriad Races Universe is filled with nothing more than the old, weak, sick, and crippled.
"They barely have any real strength, yet they still dare occupy such a valuable starfield.
"With your overwhelming strength, you can definitely help us suppress that damned Faustus and completely wipe out Holy Golden Mountain’s branch."
Kellen Oracle-grade glanced sideways at Demon Lord Vasu but did not answer immediately.
After a moment, he said indifferently,
"Vasu, I heard that the Faustus currently stationed at Holy Golden Mountain’s branch is an old enemy of yours.
"You aren’t trying to borrow my blade to kill someone for you, are you?"
Demon Lord Vasu’s expression changed drastically when his intentions were exposed.
He hurriedly denied it.
"No, no, no! How would I dare think such a thing?"
Kellen Oracle-grade snorted coldly, a faint smile appearing on his face.
"I know what I’m doing.
"I don’t need you teaching me how to handle matters.
"Understand?"
Demon Lord Vasu was scared out of his wits and hurriedly nodded.
"I understand. I understand."
His entire back was already drenched in cold sweat.
At the same time, he was secretly alarmed.
As expected, no one who had cultivated to the Great Sage level was easy to deal with.
Every single one of them was incredibly shrewd.
With little more than a glance, they could often see straight through another person’s intentions.
Although Demon Lord Vasu had been reprimanded by Kellen Oracle-grade, he did not dare feel even the slightest resentment.
The difference in strength between them was simply far too great.
He no longer dared provoke the man and obediently shut his mouth.
Demon Lord Vasu hurriedly slapped himself twice before nodding respectfully.
"Everything on this journey will be decided by you.
"I will obey every order you give.
"This subordinate truly spoke too much just now. I deserve punishment."
Kellen Oracle-grade did not even bother looking at him.
His gaze was already fixed ahead, his thoughts unknown.
A short while later, he turned toward another Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse beside him and ordered,
"Turn around.
"We’re heading to the Jialuo Starfield."
The Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse immediately replied,
"Understood, Leader."
The Starship then changed course and began flying deeper into the Myriad Races Universe.
Demon Lord Vasu had originally thought that after Kellen Oracle-grade saw through his scheme, the man would refuse to follow his suggestion.
Unexpectedly, Kellen Oracle-grade had still agreed.
He had actually been persuaded into changing course toward the Jialuo Starfield.
A sinister smile gradually appeared on Demon Lord Vasu’s face.
He secretly rejoiced.
Faustus.
It seems I really will get my revenge this time.
Now, come and resolve this inner demon of mine.
Holy Golden Mountain’s former headquarters.
Secret Realm No. 1.
The formation was still continuously resisting the Cosmic Tribulation.
Daniel had spent an enormous amount of resources constructing this tribulation-crossing formation.
Moreover, the Cosmic Tribulation he was currently facing was the Decline of Heaven and Man, which consumed relatively little energy from the formation.
Because of this, the formation could continue operating on its own for a very long time.
Inside the formation, Daniel sat cross-legged.
At present, he could no longer perceive anything.
And that was precisely what made the situation so dangerous.
However, Daniel’s Dao of Battle was finally displaying its true value.
The Dao Heart.
The true purpose of a Dao Heart was revealed at moments like this.
Whether facing favorable circumstances or desperate adversity, the Dao of Battle allowed Daniel to maintain a clear mental state without losing himself.
He could no longer sense the passage of time.
There was only one thing he knew.
He could not leave.
He had to remain inside the formation.
As long as he continued enduring, he would definitely survive the tribulation.
As for when exactly the tribulation would end—
The Decline of Heaven and Man might disappear in the very next second.
Or it might last another month.
Regardless, the light at the end would eventually appear.
All he needed was patience.
Jialuo Starfield.
A Starship flying the banner of the Eternal Tribulation Palace appeared.
The Starship stopped at the outer edge of the Jialuo Starfield.
Countless severed heads floated near the various entrances to the starfield.
Among them were the heads of Divine-grade powerhouses.
There were even heads belonging to Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
All of them belonged to enemies Holy Golden Mountain had killed.
They served as a warning to every faction and powerhouse harboring malicious intentions.
Anyone who wished to challenge Holy Golden Mountain’s authority would have to pay a price.
The price of their life!
"Hmph."
Inside the Starship, Demon Lord Vasu looked at the scene with disdain.
Kellen Oracle-grade was nothing like those people.
Unless Holy Golden Mountain currently had a Tier 8 Oracle-grade powerhouse stationed here, Kellen Oracle-grade alone would be enough to suppress the entire Holy Golden Mountain branch.
Those severed heads certainly possessed some deterrent effect.
Unfortunately, they could not intimidate the powerhouses of the Eternal Tribulation Palace, who had long since grown accustomed to slaughter.
They were beings who practically lived for killing.
Demon Lord Vasu’s expression turned cold.
He suddenly waved his hand.
A gigantic palm manifested in the void and swept away all the severed heads floating in front of the Starship.
Kellen Oracle-grade glanced at Demon Lord Vasu before calmly ordering,
"Continue forward."
At that exact moment, two beams of light suddenly shot out from his eyes.
The twin beams streaked toward a distant location within the Endless Starfield.
Crash!
A Mystic Azure Mirror hidden in the distance was instantly shattered by Kellen Oracle-grade’s divine ability.
Meanwhile, countless miles away in the Gold-grade Realm, a player hurriedly flew out from one of the buildings.
He immediately reported the information to his superior.
That superior contacted someone higher up.
The intelligence continued being passed upward layer by layer.
Eventually, it reached Shamir Oracle-grade.
"A Starship flying the banner of the Eternal Tribulation Palace..."
Shamir Oracle-grade’s heart sank heavily.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace!
Those people were a bunch of lunatics!
Shamir Oracle-grade’s eyelids twitched uncontrollably.
A powerful sense of foreboding rose in his heart.
"I’ll use the Great Evolution Divination Art to calculate whether this is auspicious or disastrous."
Shamir Oracle-grade gritted his teeth.
At the cost of sacrificing part of his lifespan, he raised his hand and began making calculations with his fingers.
Suddenly—
Shamir Oracle-grade’s fingers froze.
"Urgh!"
He spat out a mouthful of blood.
The divination had caused a backlash.
However, at the same time, he had managed to glimpse part of the truth.
"The Eternal Tribulation Palace force is actually being led by Kellen Oracle-grade.
"He is an extremely terrifying Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
"And beneath him are two more late-stage Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouses, along with many other Oracle-grades.
"The Jialuo Starfield is facing a major disaster this time."
Shamir Oracle-grade’s eyes flickered.
"And I...
"This avatar of mine will most likely perish as well."
That was the result he had calculated.
