By now, Faustus could probably kill him with a casual strike.
For a time, Demon Lord Vasu had fallen into utter despair.
He had never expected that he would actually get a chance to attack Faustus in the Myriad Races Universe this time.
More importantly, he was accompanying Kellen Oracle-grade, a peak Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Calling Kellen Oracle-grade a half-step Tier 8 powerhouse would not be an exaggeration.
He could casually insta-kill ordinary Tier 7 Oracle-grades of the same rank.
With strength like that, he would definitely be able to suppress Faustus and finally help Demon Lord Vasu break free from his inner demon.
Thinking of this, Demon Lord Vasu continued,
"I’m sure you’ve heard about it as well.
Holy Golden Mountain’s headquarters has already relocated to the Chaosverse.
"The branch they left behind in the Myriad Races Universe is filled with nothing more than the old, weak, sick, and crippled.
"They barely have any real strength, yet they still dare occupy such a valuable starfield.
"With your overwhelming strength, you can definitely help us suppress that damned Faustus and completely wipe out Holy Golden Mountain’s branch."
Kellen Oracle-grade glanced sideways at Demon Lord Vasu but did not answer immediately.
After a moment, he said indifferently,
"Vasu, I heard that the Faustus currently stationed at Holy Golden Mountain’s branch is an old enemy of yours.
"You aren’t trying to borrow my blade to kill someone for you, are you?"
Demon Lord Vasu’s expression changed drastically when his intentions were exposed.
He hurriedly denied it.
"No, no, no!
How would I dare think such a thing?"
Kellen Oracle-grade snorted coldly, a faint smile appearing on his face.
"I know what I’m doing.
"I don’t need you teaching me how to handle matters.
"Understand?"
Demon Lord Vasu was scared out of his wits and hurriedly nodded.
"I understand.
I understand."
His entire back was already drenched in cold sweat.
At the same time, he was secretly alarmed.
As expected, no one who had cultivated to the Great Sage level was easy to deal with.
Every single one of them was incredibly shrewd.
With little more than a glance, they could often see straight through another person’s intentions.
Although Demon Lord Vasu had been reprimanded by Kellen Oracle-grade, he did not dare feel even the slightest resentment.
The difference in strength between them was simply far too great.
He no longer dared provoke the man and obediently shut his mouth.
Demon Lord Vasu hurriedly slapped himself twice before nodding respectfully.
"Everything on this journey will be decided by you.
"I will obey every order you give.
"This subordinate truly spoke too much just now.
I deserve punishment."
Kellen Oracle-grade did not even bother looking at him.
His gaze was already fixed ahead, his thoughts unknown.
A short while later, he turned toward another Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse beside him and ordered,
"Turn around.
"We’re heading to the Jialuo Starfield."
The Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse immediately replied,
"Understood, Leader."
The Starship then changed course and began flying deeper into the Myriad Races Universe.
Demon Lord Vasu had originally thought that after Kellen Oracle-grade saw through his scheme, the man would refuse to follow his suggestion.
Unexpectedly, Kellen Oracle-grade had still agreed.
He had actually been persuaded into changing course toward the Jialuo Starfield.
A sinister smile gradually appeared on Demon Lord Vasu’s face.
He secretly rejoiced.
Faustus.
It seems I really will get my revenge this time.
Now, come and resolve this inner demon of mine.
Holy Golden Mountain’s former headquarters.
Secret Realm No.
The formation was still continuously resisting the Cosmic Tribulation.
Daniel had spent an enormous amount of resources constructing this tribulation-crossing formation.
Moreover, the Cosmic Tribulation he was currently facing was the Decline of Heaven and Man, which consumed relatively little energy from the formation.
Because of this, the formation could continue operating on its own for a very long time.
Inside the formation, Daniel sat cross-legged.
At present, he could no longer perceive anything.
And that was precisely what made the situation so dangerous.
However, Daniel’s Dao of Battle was finally displaying its true value.
The Dao Heart.
The true purpose of a Dao Heart was revealed at moments like this.
Whether facing favorable circumstances or desperate adversity, the Dao of Battle allowed Daniel to maintain a clear mental state without losing himself.
He could no longer sense the passage of time.
There was only one thing he knew.
He could not leave.
He had to remain inside the formation.
As long as he continued enduring, he would definitely survive the tribulation.
As for when exactly the tribulation would end—
The Decline of Heaven and Man might disappear in the very next second.
Or it might last another month.
Regardless, the light at the end would eventually appear.
All he needed was patience.
Jialuo Starfield.
A Starship flying the banner of the Eternal Tribulation Palace appeared.
The Starship stopped at the outer edge of the Jialuo Starfield.
Countless severed heads floated near the various entrances to the starfield.
Among them were the heads of Divine-grade powerhouses.
There were even heads belonging to Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
All of them belonged to enemies Holy Golden Mountain had killed.
They served as a warning to every faction and powerhouse harboring malicious intentions.
Anyone who wished to challenge Holy Golden Mountain’s authority would have to pay a price.
The price of their life!
"Hmph."
Inside the Starship, Demon Lord Vasu looked at the scene with disdain.
Kellen Oracle-grade was nothing like those people.
Unless Holy Golden Mountain currently had a Tier 8 Oracle-grade powerhouse stationed here, Kellen Oracle-grade alone would be enough to suppress the entire Holy Golden Mountain branch.
Those severed heads certainly possessed some deterrent effect.
Unfortunately, they could not intimidate the powerhouses of the Eternal Tribulation Palace, who had long since grown accustomed to slaughter.
They were beings who practically lived for killing.
Demon Lord Vasu’s expression turned cold.
He suddenly waved his hand.
A gigantic palm manifested in the void and swept away all the severed heads floating in front of the Starship.
Kellen Oracle-grade glanced at Demon Lord Vasu before calmly ordering,
"Continue forward."
At that exact moment, two beams of light suddenly shot out from his eyes.
The twin beams streaked toward a distant location within the Endless Starfield.
Crash!
A Mystic Azure Mirror hidden in the distance was instantly shattered by Kellen Oracle-grade’s divine ability.
Meanwhile, countless miles away in the Gold-grade Realm, a player hurriedly flew out from one of the buildings.
He immediately reported the information to his superior.
That superior contacted someone higher up.
The intelligence continued being passed upward layer by layer.
Eventually, it reached Shamir Oracle-grade.
"A Starship flying the banner of the Eternal Tribulation Palace..."
Shamir Oracle-grade’s heart sank heavily.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace!
Those people were a bunch of lunatics!
Shamir Oracle-grade’s eyelids twitched uncontrollably.
A powerful sense of foreboding rose in his heart.
"I’ll use the Great Evolution Divination Art to calculate whether this is auspicious or disastrous."
Shamir Oracle-grade gritted his teeth.
At the cost of sacrificing part of his lifespan, he raised his hand and began making calculations with his fingers.
Suddenly—
Shamir Oracle-grade’s fingers froze.
"Urgh!"
He spat out a mouthful of blood.
The divination had caused a backlash.
However, at the same time, he had managed to glimpse part of the truth.
"The Eternal Tribulation Palace force is actually being led by Kellen Oracle-grade.
"He is an extremely terrifying Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
"And beneath him are two more late-stage Tier 7 Oracle-grade powerhouses, along with many other Oracle-grades.
"The Jialuo Starfield is facing a major disaster this time."
Shamir Oracle-grade’s eyes flickered.
"And I...
"This avatar of mine will most likely perish as well."
That was the result he had calculated.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 -545-Settling Old Scores
paragraphs: Because the one Grand Oracle Shamir had divined was Kellen, he naturally suffered backlash. Even after sacrificing a portion of his lifespan, he still could not escape the punishment of that backlash.
At that thought, he could not help thinking of Faustus.
Grand Oracle Shamir worriedly muttered, "Faustus, how much longer will it be before you appear?"
He sighed, then quickly regained his composure and began contacting the many powerhouses he knew. He directly issued the highest-level mobilization order.
"Everyone, follow me to face the Eternal Tribulation Palace!"
This time, the Holy Golden Mountain could truly be said to have mobilized every available powerhouse.

Every Oracle-grade expert had been summoned by Grand Oracle Shamir, whom Daniel had personally appointed as acting leader. At the same time, all the outside reinforcements Daniel had previously called in had already arrived.
Grand Oracle Shamir personally led the force, preparing to intercept the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
Before long, the two sides encountered each other in a starfield.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace’s Starship simply stopped in the middle of the starfield.
It showed absolutely no intention of withdrawing.
Under normal circumstances, both sides would put away their Starships before a battle began.
But the Eternal Tribulation Palace did no such thing.
That alone showed that they did not take the Holy Golden Mountain seriously at all.
The Oracle-grade powerhouses below stared coldly at the Starship opposite them, their hearts sinking into an icy abyss. They had already prepared themselves to fight to the death.
Grand Oracle Shamir spoke first.
"Eternal Tribulation Palace, this is territory belonging to our Holy Golden Mountain. You are forbidden from advancing even one step farther."
His voice clearly reached the powerhouses of the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
The moment he finished speaking, however, the Holy Golden Mountain powerhouses behind him summoned their Secret Treasures and unleashed all kinds of Sacred Arts.
If the other side dared advance even a single step, they would attack instantly.
At that moment—
The Starship suddenly disappeared.
One hundred powerhouses appeared in its place.
Every last one of them belonged to the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
Although they were fewer in number than the Holy Golden Mountain force, in terms of quality and sheer presence, they completely overwhelmed the Holy Golden Mountain.
Kellen Oracle-grade glanced at Grand Oracle Shamir across from him and sneered.
"Shamir, if I remember correctly, the leader of the Holy Golden Mountain used to be at least T9 Oracle-grade, didn’t they?"
"And now you’ve fallen so far that someone like you has to take charge?"
"The mighty faction once hailed as the strongest force in the entire Myriad Races Universe has actually declined to this state."
"Do you even have any reason to continue existing?"
Grand Oracle Shamir immediately snorted coldly.
"Heh. Kellen Oracle-grade, you were once part of the Myriad Races Universe yourself, yet now you’ve joined the Eternal Tribulation Palace and come back to plunder your own universe. Truly shameless."
"When the Holy Golden Mountain was at its peak, I never saw a petty villain like you daring to bring these lackeys here to run wild."
"Only after the Holy Golden Mountain suffered disaster and declined did you dare take advantage of the situation and loot us while we’re weakened."
"And you dare call yourself a king?"
"Have you no shame?"
Kellen Oracle-grade merely shrugged indifferently and laughed.
"Shamir, stop indulging in wishful thinking."
"The Chaosverse is even more chaotic than the Myriad Races Universe right now."
"Do you really think your headquarters has any spare Strength to send here and support you?"
"Forget anything else. They probably can’t even spare the clone of a single T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse, can they?"
"I’ll tell you something else. The Eternal Tribulation Palace’s next target is the Chaosverse."
"We’ll destroy your headquarters there as well."
"And as for the clone you left here..."
"It’s time for me to destroy that too."
Shamir’s heart immediately turned cold when he heard this.
He had never expected the situation to have developed this far.
Before the battle, he had indeed contacted the Holy Golden Mountain headquarters and requested support from a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Even a clone would have been enough.
But just as Kellen had said—
There had been no response whatsoever.
Grand Oracle Shamir’s true body was currently in the Chaosverse, though it was not inside the headquarters itself.
The Chaosverse had already descended into unimaginable chaos as well, with even its greatest forces locked in confrontation.
When existences of that level fought—
The outcome could never be decided in a short period of time.
The same was true of wars between two great universes.
The Abyss Universe was currently at war with numerous factions of the Chaosverse.
Without several million or even tens of millions of years of fighting, the situation would never become clear.
Even a war lasting hundreds of millions of years would be perfectly normal.
The Holy Golden Mountain headquarters had settled in the Chaosverse.
The side it had chosen was naturally the native factions of the Chaosverse.
They were now locked in war against the Abyss Universe.
How could they possibly have time to care about matters in the Myriad Races Universe, a universe whose lifespan was already approaching its end?
So what if this was a branch?
Calling it a branch sounded nice.
To put it more harshly—
It was nothing more than an abandoned piece!
And Grand Oracle Shamir had now learned something even worse about the Eternal Tribulation Palace’s plans.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace actually intended to interfere in the Chaosverse as well.
They even arrogantly claimed they would destroy the various factions there one by one.
These parasites of the Endless Starfield!
Grand Oracle Shamir gritted his teeth.
The headquarters would send no reinforcements.
So now—
They could only rely on themselves.
Grand Oracle Shamir reached into the void with his right hand.
A sword woven entirely from countless laws appeared out of thin air and fell into his grasp.
"Kellen, come fight me!"
Law power surged around Kellen Oracle-grade as a suit of armor instantly covered his entire body.
At the same time—
A Blood-Ash Demon Spear appeared in his hand.
No one knew what material the spear had been forged from, but every inch of it radiated terrifying baleful energy.
That baleful aura surged into the heavens.
Even nearby Oracle-grade powerhouses were affected by the Blood-Ash Demon Spear. Their eyes turned blood-red, and their emotions became increasingly violent.
Even the surrounding void began trembling under the spear’s influence.
"A supreme-grade innate treasure!"
Grand Oracle Shamir’s pupils contracted sharply when he saw the spear.
Kellen Oracle-grade truly was difficult to deal with.
"Shamir, today I will definitely cut down your clone right here!"
Kellen Oracle-grade was brimming with confidence as he suddenly roared,
"Eternal Tribulation Palace—kill!"
The moment his voice fell—
The many Oracle-grade powerhouses behind him attacked simultaneously.
"Holy Golden Mountain—kill!"
Whoosh!
Grand Oracle Shamir transformed into a streak of light and charged straight toward Kellen.
The many Oracle-grade powerhouses of the Holy Golden Mountain attacked as well.
To the Endless Starfield—
This battle was merely a tiny fragment within the River of Time.
It was merely one bloody clash between Oracle-grade powerhouses somewhere in one universe of the Endless Starfield.
It was merely a contest between two factions.
Perhaps, before the universe itself—
They were nothing more than two groups of ants clumsily fighting each other.
But only the Oracle-grade powerhouses caught in the slaughter truly understood.
This was a brutal battle.
A brutal battle in which even T7 Oracle-grade powerhouses could fall.
Let alone the rest of them!
The former Holy Golden Mountain headquarters.
Secret Realm No. 1.
Inside the grand tribulation formation.
The phenomena of the Cosmic Tribulation still lingered across spacetime.
Yet at this moment, Daniel opened his eyes.
Law power continuously flowed within his pupils.
The aura surging around his entire body was deep and powerful, far stronger than before.
Tier-5 Oracle-grade!
That was the aura of someone whose Strength had advanced to the next Rank.
Daniel had successfully survived his tribulation!
The Celestial Exhaustion Tribulation.
He had endured it slightly faster than he had expected.
It had lasted a little over a year.

There was no need to explain how terrifying the Celestial Exhaustion Tribulation had been. Otherwise, Daniel would never have been suppressed by the universe to the point that he could not move at all.
However, after successfully surviving the tribulation, his gains were equally enormous.
Daniel’s Dao Heart had become even more stable.
His Divine Soul and physical body had grown even stronger.
As a result, after surviving the tribulation, Daniel had already reached Tier-5 Oracle-grade without needing any further accumulation!

chapters.title: Chapter 546 -546-A Miracle Appears
paragraphs: However, at this moment, the phenomena of the Cosmic Tribulation within the Secret Spacetime had still not disappeared.
A smile immediately appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
As expected, it was another Multiple Cosmic Tribulation.
He still had to continue undergoing tribulations.
He could sense that yet another Cosmic Tribulation was about to descend.
This would most likely be his sixth Cosmic Tribulation.
As long as he survived it, he would directly become T6 Oracle-grade.
This was also one of the advantages of walking an unconventional cultivation path.
As long as one’s accumulation was deep enough, the ordinary tribulations undergone separately by Divine-grade powerhouses were nothing worth mentioning.
The deeper his foundation, the safer he would be when undergoing tribulation, and the higher his chances of success.
At that moment—
The Cosmic Tribulation descended!
The spacetime phenomena rapidly transformed.
Daniel sensed the nature of this Cosmic Tribulation.
It was called the Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation.
A Golden Reincarnation Tribulation!
An ordinary Reincarnation Tribulation was known as the Soul Reincarnation Tribulation, while the Golden-grade version was the Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation.
At this moment, an endless Sea of Reincarnation Suffering almost completely surrounded him.
An ordinary Reincarnation Tribulation only required one to endure 9,999 lifetimes before passing.
But the Golden-grade Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation increased that number ten-thousandfold.
Just thinking about it was enough to drive someone into despair.
Even Daniel could not help frowning.
"As expected, this is somewhat troublesome."
This Reincarnation Tribulation was actually somewhat similar to the Celestial Exhaustion Tribulation.
Both required an enormous amount of time and could only be overcome by enduring the torment until the end.
Daniel was only Tier-5 right now, yet he had already encountered such a terrifying calamity.
The tribulations awaiting him in the future would probably be even more horrifying.
He sighed.
"This really is troublesome."
"The Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation... I’ll have to endure for another enormous length of time."
"I wonder how the Holy Golden Mountain outside is doing right now."
Daniel took a deep breath.
Even before he began undergoing his tribulation, the Myriad Races Universe had already practically fallen into a state of lawlessness.
Powerhouses from foreign universes and ambitious factions from every side had already decided to interfere in the Myriad Races Universe.
Daniel had practically relied on his own Strength to integrate the Holy Golden Mountain’s resources and defend its final starfield.
In a sense, he was resisting the tide of an age of chaos.
But the tide of an era could not be resisted.
Even the Holy Golden Mountain was as insignificant as a grain of sand before it.
Daniel was worried that without him present, the Holy Golden Mountain might be swallowed directly by that tide and destroyed by countless powerhouses.
Unfortunately, because of the Cosmic Tribulation, he could not spare any attention for outside matters.
Even though his clones were outside, he could not use them, because the cosmic power was acting directly upon his Origin.
Daniel’s eyes flickered slightly.
He could already feel himself about to be dragged into the Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation.
Under normal circumstances, that was exactly how events should have progressed.
The previous Celestial Exhaustion had been his fifth tribulation.
This Cosmic Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation would be his sixth.
But at that moment—
Something suddenly changed with the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation!
The Cosmic Tribulation was actually forcibly absorbed clean by the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation!
It transformed into pure law power and flowed back into Daniel, nourishing him instead.
Very quickly, Daniel’s Reincarnation Law achieved a breakthrough.
It actually advanced directly to mid-grade!
Among all the law powers Daniel currently controlled, this was the only one that had reached mid-grade.
A look of delight immediately appeared on Daniel’s face.
He had never imagined that he would pass his sixth tribulation this easily as well.
As long as the phenomena of the Cosmic Tribulation disappeared, his tribulation would count as successfully completed.
At this moment, he had already reached T6 Oracle-grade.
And the cosmic phenomena were on the verge of being completely devoured.
But suddenly—
A pair of eyes appeared within the void.
Those eyes were incomparably indifferent.
They were none other than the Eye of the Universe!
Because of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation, Daniel’s sixth tribulation had been forcibly disrupted.
The universe seemed to have noticed something.
At this moment, the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation was like a cheat program that had suddenly appeared within the tribulation process.
Or perhaps—
A virus.
How could the universe possibly tolerate such a thing?
Daniel sensed the purpose behind the appearance of the Eye of the Universe.
His heart immediately jolted.
"Originally, I only needed to survive two tribulations."
"But now the universe is adding another Cosmic Tribulation for me."
"In other words, I still need to undergo one more—the seventh Cosmic Tribulation!"
"If I survive it, I’ll reach T7 Oracle-grade!"
Hiss—
Daniel drew in a sharp breath.
The entire rhythm of his advancement had now been disrupted.
The sudden eruption of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation had been completely unexpected.
Not only had the universe been caught off guard—
Daniel himself had been caught off guard as well.
Originally, he only needed to reach the sixth tribulation.
Now, for no reason, an extra tribulation had been added!
Was this supposed to be the universe’s punishment?
The Eye of the Universe suddenly disappeared.
The spacetime phenomena appeared once again.
At the same time—
The Sacred Halo of Reincarnation flew back behind Daniel’s head.
Boom!
The seventh Cosmic Tribulation appeared!
"Annihilation Thunder Tribulation!"
Daniel sensed the form of the Cosmic Tribulation, and his heart began pounding violently.
Annihilation Thunder Tribulation was the name of the ordinary-grade version.
The Golden-grade Cosmic Tribulation was known as—
The Nirvana Firmament Divine Thunder Tribulation!
The Nirvana Firmament Divine Thunder Tribulation was an external tribulation.
It was formed from a combination of one hundred and eight of the strongest thunder tribulations.
Its destructive power could reach the ultimate stage of the Law of Destruction!
Destroying an entire star river would be effortless.
And this—
Was the tribulation Daniel now had to face.
Boom!
Within the spacetime of the Secret Realm—
A mass of thunderclouds suddenly appeared.
The thunderclouds blotted out the sky.
Within them, terrifying thunder might was rapidly gathering.
The entirety of Secret Realm No. 1 began trembling.
One had to understand—
Secret Realm No. 1 had been personally opened by an Eternal powerhouse.
Yet now, even this Secret Realm was beginning to struggle beneath the might of the Cosmic Thunder Tribulation.
One could imagine just how terrifying this thunder tribulation truly was.
Daniel took a deep breath and slowly rose to his feet.
His eyes were filled with fighting spirit as he stared at the thunderclouds overhead.
At that moment—
The Sacred Halo of Reincarnation behind Daniel’s head began shining.
The Power of Reincarnation Traversal activated!
Through the Power of Reincarnation Traversal, Daniel borrowed the Strength of a hundred years from his past and future selves.
The already vast aura surrounding him instantly surged upward.
It reached an extreme.
After the Reincarnation Law advanced—
Daniel could borrow even more Strength from his past and future.
A hundred years!
If his Spacetime Law advanced as well, this limit could be increased dramatically.
Borrowing tens of thousands of years of Strength would not be out of the question.
Daniel extended his palm.
"Universal Firmament Oracle Palm!"
A colossal palm appeared.
A world existed within its palm, automatically evolving countless living beings identical to Daniel.
Behind the head of every one of those beings was a Sacred Halo of Reincarnation.
Together, they gathered their Strength into one.
Before the thunderclouds could even unleash the tribulation lightning, the colossal palm smashed directly toward them.
"So what if it’s a Cosmic Tribulation?!"
Daniel’s gaze was razor-sharp.
"I’ll beat it down all the same!"
The Sacred Art violently collided with the thunderclouds.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
A continuous series of deafening explosions erupted.
Although the thunderclouds enveloped the Sacred Art, enormous explosions continued to thunder from within.
At an almost imperceptible rate, the thunderclouds weakened slightly.
They had actually been diminished by a small amount.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Daniel did not stop.
One colossal palm after another smashed toward the thunderclouds.
He intended to forcibly beat the entire mass of thunderclouds apart!

sentences.text: However, at this moment, the phenomena of the Cosmic Tribulation within the Secret Spacetime had still not disappeared.
A smile immediately appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
As expected, it was another Multiple Cosmic Tribulation.
He still had to continue undergoing tribulations.
He could sense that yet another Cosmic Tribulation was about to descend.
This would most likely be his sixth Cosmic Tribulation.
As long as he survived it, he would directly become T6 Oracle-grade.
This was also one of the advantages of walking an unconventional cultivation path.
As long as one’s accumulation was deep enough, the ordinary tribulations undergone separately by Divine-grade powerhouses were nothing worth mentioning.
The deeper his foundation, the safer he would be when undergoing tribulation, and the higher his chances of success.
At that moment—
The Cosmic Tribulation descended!
The spacetime phenomena rapidly transformed.
Daniel sensed the nature of this Cosmic Tribulation.
It was called the Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation.
A Golden Reincarnation Tribulation!
An ordinary Reincarnation Tribulation was known as the Soul Reincarnation Tribulation, while the Golden-grade version was the Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation.
At this moment, an endless Sea of Reincarnation Suffering almost completely surrounded him.
An ordinary Reincarnation Tribulation only required one to endure 9,999 lifetimes before passing.
But the Golden-grade Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation increased that number ten-thousandfold.
Just thinking about it was enough to drive someone into despair.
Even Daniel could not help frowning.
"As expected, this is somewhat troublesome."
This Reincarnation Tribulation was actually somewhat similar to the Celestial Exhaustion Tribulation.
Both required an enormous amount of time and could only be overcome by enduring the torment until the end.
Daniel was only Tier-5 right now, yet he had already encountered such a terrifying calamity.
The tribulations awaiting him in the future would probably be even more horrifying.
He sighed.
"This really is troublesome."
"The Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation...
I’ll have to endure for another enormous length of time."
"I wonder how the Holy Golden Mountain outside is doing right now."
Daniel took a deep breath.
Even before he began undergoing his tribulation, the Myriad Races Universe had already practically fallen into a state of lawlessness.
Powerhouses from foreign universes and ambitious factions from every side had already decided to interfere in the Myriad Races Universe.
Daniel had practically relied on his own Strength to integrate the Holy Golden Mountain’s resources and defend its final starfield.
In a sense, he was resisting the tide of an age of chaos.
But the tide of an era could not be resisted.
Even the Holy Golden Mountain was as insignificant as a grain of sand before it.
Daniel was worried that without him present, the Holy Golden Mountain might be swallowed directly by that tide and destroyed by countless powerhouses.
Unfortunately, because of the Cosmic Tribulation, he could not spare any attention for outside matters.
Even though his clones were outside, he could not use them, because the cosmic power was acting directly upon his Origin.
Daniel’s eyes flickered slightly.
He could already feel himself about to be dragged into the Myriad-Lifetime Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation.
Under normal circumstances, that was exactly how events should have progressed.
The previous Celestial Exhaustion had been his fifth tribulation.
This Cosmic Sinking Reincarnation Tribulation would be his sixth.
But at that moment—
Something suddenly changed with the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation!
The Cosmic Tribulation was actually forcibly absorbed clean by the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation!
It transformed into pure law power and flowed back into Daniel, nourishing him instead.
Very quickly, Daniel’s Reincarnation Law achieved a breakthrough.
It actually advanced directly to mid-grade!
Among all the law powers Daniel currently controlled, this was the only one that had reached mid-grade.
A look of delight immediately appeared on Daniel’s face.
He had never imagined that he would pass his sixth tribulation this easily as well.
As long as the phenomena of the Cosmic Tribulation disappeared, his tribulation would count as successfully completed.
At this moment, he had already reached T6 Oracle-grade.
And the cosmic phenomena were on the verge of being completely devoured.
But suddenly—
A pair of eyes appeared within the void.
Those eyes were incomparably indifferent.
They were none other than the Eye of the Universe!
Because of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation, Daniel’s sixth tribulation had been forcibly disrupted.
The universe seemed to have noticed something.
At this moment, the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation was like a cheat program that had suddenly appeared within the tribulation process.
Or perhaps—
A virus.
How could the universe possibly tolerate such a thing?
Daniel sensed the purpose behind the appearance of the Eye of the Universe.
His heart immediately jolted.
"Originally, I only needed to survive two tribulations."
"But now the universe is adding another Cosmic Tribulation for me."
"In other words, I still need to undergo one more—the seventh Cosmic Tribulation!"
"If I survive it, I’ll reach T7 Oracle-grade!"
Hiss—
Daniel drew in a sharp breath.
The entire rhythm of his advancement had now been disrupted.
The sudden eruption of the Sacred Halo of Reincarnation had been completely unexpected.
Not only had the universe been caught off guard—
Daniel himself had been caught off guard as well.
Originally, he only needed to reach the sixth tribulation.
Now, for no reason, an extra tribulation had been added!
Was this supposed to be the universe’s punishment?
The Eye of the Universe suddenly disappeared.
The spacetime phenomena appeared once again.
At the same time—
The Sacred Halo of Reincarnation flew back behind Daniel’s head.
Boom!
The seventh Cosmic Tribulation appeared!
"Annihilation Thunder Tribulation!"
Daniel sensed the form of the Cosmic Tribulation, and his heart began pounding violently.
Annihilation Thunder Tribulation was the name of the ordinary-grade version.
The Golden-grade Cosmic Tribulation was known as—
The Nirvana Firmament Divine Thunder Tribulation!
The Nirvana Firmament Divine Thunder Tribulation was an external tribulation.
It was formed from a combination of one hundred and eight of the strongest thunder tribulations.
Its destructive power could reach the ultimate stage of the Law of Destruction!
Destroying an entire star river would be effortless.
And this—
Was the tribulation Daniel now had to face.
Boom!
Within the spacetime of the Secret Realm—
A mass of thunderclouds suddenly appeared.
The thunderclouds blotted out the sky.
Within them, terrifying thunder might was rapidly gathering.
The entirety of Secret Realm No.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 -547-The Seventh Tribulation
paragraphs: The thunderclouds roared without end as countless bolts of lightning flashed within them.
The lightning shone in seven colors. Each bolt was only as thin as a strand of hair, yet in an instant, they spread throughout the entire Secret Realm.
Even Daniel’s colossal palms could not withstand the overwhelming force of the tribulation.
The Cosmic Tribulation crashed down, countless lightning serpents striking Daniel’s body.
His flesh was quickly torn open, and the stench of scorched meat spread through the air.
In the blink of an eye, his entire physical body had been charred black. In some places, even his bones could faintly be seen.

Daniel felt pain that penetrated deep into his marrow and could not help frowning. The agony did not affect only his physical body—his Divine Soul was being injured at the same time. The pain originating from the depths of his soul could not be blocked at all.
Fortunately, both Daniel’s Divine Soul and physical body were extraordinarily powerful, comparable to Oracle-grade Secret Treasures, and were further supported by numerous laws.
Combined with the assistance of the grand tribulation formation, he was barely able to endure.

By now, the grand tribulation formation had already activated at full power. Most of its Sacred Power had been divided into two portions: one was used to repair Daniel’s injuries, while the other suppressed the growth of the Cosmic Tribulation.
At this point, Daniel had already been struck into a genuine rage by the lightning.
These were the most severe injuries he had suffered since beginning cultivation.
How could someone as arrogant and domineering as Daniel tolerate being beaten into such a state?
He immediately roared,
"Sacred Body—descend!"
The next moment, Daniel’s physical body expanded explosively, swelling to a height of tens of millions of miles in an instant.
His enormous body directly pierced through the thunderclouds.
Then Daniel gritted his teeth and roared, unleashing Sacred Palm after Sacred Palm. One strike after another smashed into the thunderclouds formed by the Cosmic Tribulation.
At the same time, with the assistance of the grand tribulation formation, Daniel’s injuries recovered faster and faster.
Every time his body healed, it became slightly stronger than before.
Meanwhile, the Cosmic Tribulation was being weakened with every blow.
Under Daniel’s relentless palm strikes, the thunderclouds were gradually suppressed.
Before long—
They were completely beaten apart and vanished.
Daniel’s seventh Cosmic Tribulation had been passed in this brutally straightforward manner.
In other words—
Daniel had now truly reached T7 Oracle-grade!
Although his physical body was riddled with wounds, those injuries had been inflicted by mid-grade Law of Destruction power.
Moreover, with the grand tribulation formation assisting him, his wounds were rapidly being repaired.
At the same time, Daniel’s Law of Destruction finally advanced as well.
It reached mid-grade!
A mid-grade Law of Reincarnation allowed Daniel to directly reach a hundred years into both his past and future, drawing upon two hundred years of his own Strength.
Meanwhile, the mid-grade Law of Destruction pushed his destructive power to the absolute extreme.
Even if he encountered an Eternal Grade powerhouse, he could now fight for a time.
During this single tribulation session, Daniel had leapt directly from Tier-5 Oracle-grade to T7 Oracle-grade, crossing three major Ranks in succession.
He had now truly entered the ranks of the Grand Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The phenomena of the Cosmic Tribulation gradually dissipated, seemingly filled with unwillingness.
Daniel’s towering body stood within the Secret Realm, law power flowing endlessly through his eyes.
He thought to himself,
"I’ve finally reached T7 Oracle-grade."
"T8 Oracle-grade is still some distance away."
"Looks like I’ll remain at T7 Oracle-grade for a while."
Daniel sensed the universe around him.
There were no further abnormalities.
There probably would not be another Cosmic Tribulation this time.
Then his gaze turned toward the void beyond the Secret Realm.
"It’s about time I went out."
"I wonder what things are like outside now."
"I hope they managed to hold on until I could return."
He sensed his Secret Treasures.
They were still there.

"Now that I’ve reached T7 Oracle-grade, instantly killing opponents of the same Rank is no problem at all." Daniel smiled. "I’ll be able to defend the Garo Starfield much more easily while waiting for Kru to come challenge me."
Garo Starfield.
Whoosh!
A sword beam stretched across billions of miles, piercing through the Endless Starfield as law power surged within it.
The sword energy spilling outward forced countless Oracle-grade powerhouses to hurriedly retreat.
That was the full-powered strike of a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
They had no choice but to dodge.
Suddenly—
A spear shadow appeared.
The blood-red spear streaked through the void and collided with the sword beam, shattering it apart.
Shamir swung his sword.
Countless sword beams appeared, blotting out the heavens.
The spear shadow danced through the void and shattered every sword beam.
Kellen, holding the long spear, stared across the battlefield at Shamir.
"Shamir—die!"
Kellen charged straight toward him.
Kellen cultivated the physical-body path.

His incomparably powerful body, combined with a supreme-grade innate treasure as his weapon and his profound comprehension of numerous laws, allowed him to maintain the upper hand over Shamir from beginning to end.
Shamir remained expressionless.
He charged toward Kellen as well.
Sword shadows danced.
The spear struck like a dragon.
No other Oracle-grade powerhouse dared approach the battlefield where these two Grand Oracle-grade experts were fighting.
Velyn continuously used the Star-Eclipse Storage Vessel Daniel had lent her to seize tribulation treasures.
But her heart was sinking.

"The quality of the Eternal Tribulation Palace’s powerhouses is simply too high," Velyn thought. "They have far too many Tier-5 and T6 Oracle-grade powerhouses, while the quality of the Holy Golden Mountain’s Oracle-grade forces is wildly uneven."
"This is looking bad."
At that moment—
One of the Oracle-grade powerhouses whose tribulation treasure had been seized by Velyn used a Void Concealment Assassination Art and came to assassinate her.
The assassin vanished into the deeper layers of the void.
Suddenly—
A violent aura of battle erupted from within the void layer!
Boom!
The assassin was blasted backward out of the void.
A streak of light followed immediately behind and pierced straight through the assassin’s brain.
It was Daniel’s Starfall Sacred Crystal.
The powerhouse hidden within the void was Gilos.
Using the Starfall Sacred Crystal Daniel had lent him, Gilos had killed a Tier-5 Oracle-grade powerhouse of the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
"You’re courting death!"
A T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse roared toward the void and unleashed a Sacred Art, attempting to force Gilos out.
The Law Sacred Art transformed into an enormous ferocious beast tens of millions of feet tall.
Its two pairs of razor-sharp claws seized the void itself, preparing to tear it apart.
But at that moment—
One figure after another appeared.
It was Kaino!
Countless Kainos manifested, blocking the enormous beast.
Layers upon layers of shields covered his body—there seemed to be hundreds of millions of them.
And above his head floated the Firmament Protection Stele that Daniel had lent him!
The Firmament Protection Stele stood before him.
Impervious to all laws!
"Break!"
Kaino was not someone who could only passively endure attacks.
He controlled the Firmament Protection Stele and smashed it toward the ferocious beast formed from the Law Sacred Art.
Whoosh!
The Firmament Protection Stele slammed down and shattered the beast apart.
At that moment—
The Myriad-Eye Art above Velyn’s head opened its eye and fired a beam of light that struck the T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
"Argh!"
The powerhouse immediately screamed in pain.
He turned to flee.
"Spatial Imprisonment Formation!"
Whoosh!
A Spatial Imprisonment Formation appeared above Misius’s head.
Law power rippled outward, sealing spacetime and leaving the powerhouse with nowhere to escape.
At the same time, several T6 Oracle-grade powerhouses beside Misius attacked, charging toward the Eternal Tribulation Palace’s T6 Oracle-grade expert!
Several peerless-genius-level powerhouses, relying on the heaven-defying tribulation treasures Daniel had lent them, forced a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse into a desperate situation.
The several T6 Oracle-grade powerhouses of the Chaos Humans then easily killed the Eternal Tribulation Palace expert.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 -548-Clash at the Peak
paragraphs: Even so, the Eternal Tribulation Palace did not care about losing a single T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
To them, it was hardly a serious loss.
The situation on the Holy Golden Mountain’s side, however, was completely different.
Their casualties were far more severe.
Nearly two-thirds of the low-tier Oracle-grade powerhouses had been killed in an instant. Even the Tier-5 Oracle-grade experts had suffered heavy losses.
Their situation had already become precarious.
But at that very moment—
The battle between Shamir and Kellen finally reached its conclusion!
Shamir’s body was blasted backward through the void.
Blood continuously poured from his mouth, while even his body itself began burning.
It was obvious that the situation had already slipped completely beyond his control.
Seeing this, Kellen revealed a cold smile.
"You think burning yourself will help?"
The next instant—
He abruptly raised his spear.
Whoosh!
The spear transformed into a streak of light and instantly pierced straight through Shamir’s body.
The blood-baleful aura surrounding the spear was incomparably dense.
As it surged outward, terrifying Law of Destruction power began frantically ravaging Shamir’s already badly damaged body.
Shamir lowered his head and looked at the spear piercing through him.
Blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
Then he raised his eyes, filled with fury, toward Kellen.
"Kellen!"
"Don’t think you’ve won!"
The next instant, a sword of sacred light condensed in his hand.
Shamir raised the sword and slashed viciously toward Kellen.
Kellen did not dodge.
He simply allowed Shamir’s sword to strike him.
Buzz!
A layer of armor suddenly appeared over Kellen’s body, firmly blocking the attack.
This was the effect of an innate-grade treasure.
It was powerful enough to withstand the full-powered strike of any T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Kellen’s aura continued surging.
The Blood-Ash Demon Spear in his hand radiated such dense murderous blood energy that it almost seemed ready to overflow, while Law of Destruction power continuously intertwined around its surface.
He smiled faintly.
"Shamir, you’re only a clone."
"And you still dare act so arrogantly?"
"Do you really think I can’t instantly kill you?"
The next moment—
Kellen’s body suddenly expanded.
He violently tore Shamir’s clone into countless fragments!
Kellen sneered.
"You receive barely any offerings throughout the year, yet you’re willing to fight this desperately?"
"What, do you really think you’re some kind of loyal minister?"
Everything had happened in an instant.
By the time the Holy Golden Mountain powerhouses realized what had happened—
It was already too late to save Shamir.
Their only leader—
Shamir—
Had fallen!
Everyone’s heart instantly turned cold.
This was bad!
Shamir was currently the only person capable of acting as leader of the Holy Golden Mountain branch.
With Daniel still absent, only Shamir had been capable of stabilizing morale.
Rumors outside had long claimed that Walter had entered secluded cultivation and left all affairs in Shamir’s hands.
Everyone had therefore treated Shamir as their leader.
Only he could keep all of them under control.
But now—
The strongest Oracle-grade powerhouse publicly standing at the front of the Holy Golden Mountain had fallen!
All the Oracle-grade powerhouses immediately felt overwhelming fear and grief.
Their minds trembled.
It felt as though the heavens themselves had collapsed.
The branch could no longer survive.
Without this leader, how could they possibly maintain their former morale?
Weiling gritted his teeth and cursed under his breath.
"Damn it!"
Shamir had been the central pillar of the branch.
As long as he remained, everyone could unite around him and keep their morale intact.
But now that he was dead, the remaining dozen or so Sacred Domain cultivators could never continue staying here and obeying orders.
They would inevitably scatter in every direction and flee for their own lives.
There was no chance of victory left in this battle.
Defeat was already inevitable.
Unless—
Faustus appeared right now!
Kaino, Gilos, and Misius had witnessed the entire battle.
Their hearts were equally cold.
T7 Oracle-grade Shamir had already died.
Even if this was only a clone, his true body was far away and could never arrive in time to reinforce them.
The situation was lost!

One was Faustus, who had remained in secluded cultivation.
The other was Shamir, who had served as its acting backbone.
Now—
One was hidden.
The other was dead.
Morale completely collapsed.
"Run! If we wait any longer, we’ll all die here!"
"The Eternal Tribulation Palace is too powerful! We can’t fight them at all!"
"The Holy Golden Mountain is finished! Even if Faustus comes out of seclusion, it won’t change anything!"
Countless cultivators began thinking of retreat.
Several quick-reacting Oracle-grade powerhouses were already secretly withdrawing from the battlefield.
Most of them looked down upon Faustus in their hearts.
Faustus was only Tier-5 Oracle-grade.
Even T7 Oracle-grade Shamir had died.
If Faustus emerged now, wouldn’t he merely be delivering himself to his death?
"Hold the line!"
Kaino suddenly shouted, forcibly stabilizing the panicking crowd.
"Everyone, maintain formation!"
"I’ve received word—Faustus is already on his way to the battlefield!"

But he understood perfectly well that once the Holy Golden Mountain completely collapsed, the branch would be finished.
He could only fabricate the message and forcibly stabilize morale.
"Faustus?"

His face was filled with mockery as he sneered coldly.
But at that moment—
A colossal palm suddenly descended from above!
It blotted out the heavens and instantly enveloped Demon Lord Vasu and more than a dozen Eternal Tribulation Palace Oracle-grade cultivators beside him.
Absolute suppression!
"Vasu."
"You dare look down on me?"
A distant, deep voice slowly descended from beyond the Nine Heavens.
It reverberated throughout the entire battlefield.
The moment everyone heard it, their bodies trembled.
The newcomer was none other than—
Faustus!
The Faustus who was rumored to still be in secluded cultivation!
Faustus’s Strength had surpassed everyone’s expectations.
It had already exceeded T9 Oracle-grade—
Infinitely approaching Eternal Grade!
Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade?!
When the many mighty powerhouses of the Chaosverse thought of how terrifying Faustus was, they instinctively retreated several steps.
Boom!
A realm-protecting grand formation capable of resisting Eternal-level powerhouses activated.
Gu, Tenglong, and several other peak T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses finally breathed sighs of relief.
The realm-protecting formation could not be broken by anything below Eternal Grade.
Even the current Faustus probably could not break it...
Right?
Daniel stared at them coldly.
His face was expressionless.
If they dared resist—
Then Daniel dared suppress every last one of them.
"Faustus!"
High-grade Oracle-grade Tenglong spoke.
"Is there room to negotiate this matter?"
"That’s right, Faustus."
High-grade Oracle-grade Gu also spoke.
"The Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade powerhouses of the Eternal Tribulation Palace and the Ultimate Dao Domain Sea will arrive soon."
"Why don’t we join forces?"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
The Eternal Tribulation Palace?
The Ultimate Dao Domain Sea?
Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade powerhouses?
"Heh."
The corner of Daniel’s mouth curled into a cold smile.
"I’ll give you only two choices."
"Either submit—"
"Or die!"
Daniel’s gaze instantly turned cold.
"There is no third option!"
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The faces of high-grade Oracle-grade Gu and high-grade Oracle-grade Tenglong immediately turned deathly pale.
Not a trace of blood remained.
It seemed Faustus had truly made up his mind to conquer the Chaosverse.
They did not dare openly refuse.
But neither were they willing to submit.
"We have the realm-protecting grand formation. Faustus can’t do anything to us."
Some Oracle-grade powerhouses thought to themselves.
"Besides, two Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade powerhouses from the Eternal Tribulation Palace and the Ultimate Dao Domain Sea are about to arrive."
"Maybe we can stall..."
Stall until Faustus and those two Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade powerhouses decided the victor.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 -549-The Truth Revealed
paragraphs: The people of the Chaosverse still clung to a faint hope. They had all retreated into the plane, and not one of them dared speak.
Daniel looked at them, then turned his gaze toward the realm-protecting grand formation before him.
He smiled faintly. "Still unwilling to give up? Fine, then."
The next moment, he raised a hand and flicked a finger.
A beam of light instantly appeared.
The light rapidly evolved, and among vast galaxies and star rivers, countless races and divine beings manifested within it.
Boom!
The light struck the protective grand formation directly.
The formation collapsed instantly as though it were made of paper.

This was absolute suppression in terms of Strength. The Oracle-grade powerhouses were not even given the chance to reinforce the grand formation. It was as simple as an elephant crushing ants beneath its foot—the disparity in Strength was simply too enormous.
They had mistakenly believed their formation could withstand a half-step Eternal powerhouse.
Yet Daniel’s Strength far exceeded their imagination. With a casual strike, he shattered the supposedly impregnable defense they had trusted in, completely destroying their final illusion.
Daniel looked down upon them from above.
In his eyes, these people were already no different from ants.
He spoke indifferently.
"Do you want to die, or do you want to live?"
The many high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouses of the Chaosverse had now lost their final protection.
None of them wanted to die here.
Before long, one high-grade Oracle-grade powerhouse reluctantly said, "I am willing to submit to Faustus Oracle-grade."
"I am willing as well."

The two of them were the strongest among the Oracle-grade powerhouses present. Once they spoke, the remaining Oracle-grade experts immediately followed suit, all expressing their willingness to submit to Faustus.
Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
"Very good. In that case, swear a Cosmic Oath."
"You will serve me for one hundred years. After one hundred years, you may regain your freedom."
"If you refuse to swear, you die here."
How could the many powerhouses dare resist?
They all nodded and agreed.
They had never expected Daniel’s terms to be so lenient.
It was only one hundred years.
To an Oracle-grade powerhouse living within the endless void, there was practically no difference between a hundred years and a single day.
One after another, they began swearing Cosmic Oaths.
Only after every one of them had finished did Daniel speak again.

"Your task is to plunder every treasure, treasure mountain, and precious resource within the Chaosverse, transport all of those resources to the Holy Golden Mountain Academy, and then use them to strengthen the Myriad Races Universe."
Daniel directly revealed his objective.
The powerhouses did not understand what Daniel intended to do. They only felt that this would completely drain the Chaosverse dry.
But they had already sworn their oaths and could only accept it.
At worst, they could simply live in the Myriad Races Universe afterward. They did not possess much sense of belonging to this place anyway.
After issuing his orders, Daniel left behind a clone and had it arrange missions for the players to conquer small and medium-sized worlds.
Small and medium-sized worlds were protected by the universe, preventing existences above Divine-grade from entering.
But they were extremely suitable for players.
Their true bodies were all located within the Origin, so they were completely unaffected.
Daniel’s main body, meanwhile, headed toward the headquarters of the Abyss Universe.
The Abyss Universe headquarters was quite similar to the Chaosverse headquarters.
Daniel attacked directly, shattered its protective grand formation, and conquered the entire Abyss Universe as well.

Afterward, he ordered the many powerhouses of the Abyss Universe to return to the Cosmic Abyss and required the Abyss Universe to send batches of reinforcements to the Myriad Races Universe at regular intervals.
He also left behind a group of powerhouses to help strengthen the Myriad Races Universe.
But at that moment—!!!
Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade Kellen and the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace appeared.
The instant the two of them entered the Chaosverse, Daniel sensed their arrival.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
"So this is the Chaosverse?"
Kellen Oracle-grade expanded his Divine Soul and sensed the Chaosverse, a smile appearing on his face.
"As expected of a newborn universe. I can even sense the aura of its birth."
"If Blood Sea Eternal can obtain the Chaosverse and use it as a template to construct his own universe, he will definitely be able to break through and reach Eternal Supreme Divine-grade!"
The Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace gave a perfunctory smile.
"Indeed. Everything is for Blood Sea Eternal."

"I think splitting up would be more efficient. I’ll go to the headquarters of the Chaosverse forces, while you go to the headquarters of the Abyss Universe forces. Afterward, we’ll regroup. How does that sound?"
"Agreed," Kellen Oracle-grade said.
But very soon, his Divine Soul detected something unusual.
His expression immediately turned solemn.
"A powerhouse is approaching. His Strength is no weaker than ours."
Hearing this, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace immediately expanded his Divine Soul.
His expression suddenly changed dramatically.
"The one coming is Faustus!"
The moment those words fell—
A figure abruptly appeared.
Whoosh!
Daniel blocked the path of the two Pre-Eternal Oracle-grade powerhouses and calmly examined them.
He sensed the auras of the two experts.
They were indeed much deeper than those of ordinary T9 Oracle-grade powerhouses.
But that was all.
Compared with Daniel, they were far too weak to even be mentioned in the same breath.

Kellen Oracle-grade and the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace were also studying the man before them—the powerhouse whose name had shaken the Endless Starfield and astonished countless eras.
They actually could not sense the limits of Daniel’s Strength.
It was as though his power had no upper bound.
Although he had not yet reached Eternal Grade—
He was already no different from an Eternal!
That was terrifying!
Kellen Oracle-grade and the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace silently exchanged horrified looks, as though saying the same thing to one another.
Faustus was even stronger than they had expected!
How could this possibly be T7 Oracle-grade?!
This was a powerhouse with half his body already stepped into the Eternal Rank!
The Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace looked utterly bewildered.
He truly could not understand how Daniel’s Strength had risen so quickly.
It had already shattered his understanding of cultivation.
One had to understand—
He himself had cultivated for countless years and endured an unknown number of hardships before finally reaching his current level.
The journey had been unimaginably difficult.
Yet Faustus’s rise to power seemed almost inevitable, as though it were simply natural.
"Faustus!"
The Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace stared at him solemnly.
"Why are you blocking our path?"
Daniel looked at him indifferently and replied coldly,
"I’m not only going to block your path."
"I’m going to take your lives as well!"
"This is bad! Run!"
Whoosh!
The Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace suddenly swung his hand.
But he did not attack Daniel.
Instead, he struck Kellen Oracle-grade with his palm, sending Kellen flying toward Daniel, then immediately turned and fled at full speed!
"Pfft!"
Completely unprepared, Kellen Oracle-grade was instantly injured and spat out a large mouthful of blood.
"Eternal Tribulation Palace—damn you!"
At that moment, Kellen Oracle-grade truly understood what betrayal meant.
He understood just how sinister others could be.
His fury toward the Eternal Tribulation Palace now surpassed even his fear of Daniel.
He wanted nothing more than to tear the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace apart with his bare hands.
Daniel remained expressionless as he coldly watched the fleeing Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace.
"Run?"
"Did you ask me first?"
He swept out his hand.
The Law of Spacetime activated.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 -550-Shaking the Heavens
paragraphs: Seeing that the situation had turned against them, the Eternal Tribulation Palace powerhouses immediately chose to flee.
The Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace had betrayed Kellen with ruthless decisiveness and without the slightest burden on his conscience.

Every man for himself, or heaven and earth would destroy him. Besides, for someone capable of becoming the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace, methods like these were nothing more than instincts he could employ at any moment.

After all, the Eternal Tribulation Palace was the largest criminal faction in the Endless Starfield. As its leader, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace was naturally no benevolent soul. Only someone like this could intimidate powerful experts from every side.
At this moment, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace had only one thought in his mind—run.
Run as far away as possible.
Better yet, never encounter Daniel again for the rest of his life.
This man was simply too monstrous. He was absolutely not someone the current Palace Lord could handle.
Suddenly, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace felt his vision blur.
When his sight returned, Daniel’s figure was already standing directly in his path.
"Damn it! How?!"
The Palace Lord’s face turned deathly pale, and his heart went completely cold. He suddenly realized that Daniel had used the Law of Spacetime.
Although he himself was also proficient in the Law of Spacetime, the difference between his attainments and Daniel’s was like the difference between clouds and mud.
Before Daniel could even attack, Kellen behind him struck first.
Burning with rage, Kellen unleashed a Sacred Art and attacked the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace without holding back in the slightest.
Just moments ago, they had been comrades fighting side by side.
In the blink of an eye, they had become mortal enemies—all because the Palace Lord had betrayed Kellen without hesitation in order to save his own life.
The hatred in Kellen’s heart had already surpassed his fear of Daniel.
Daniel, however, could not be bothered watching this ridiculous internal conflict.
He simply raised his hand and unleashed the Sacred Palm.
With a single palm strike, the Great Dao of Myriad Tribulations instantly spread outward and enveloped the two half-Eternal powerhouses.
The two half-Eternal powerhouses had no ability whatsoever to resist such a terrifying Sacred Art and were completely suppressed in an instant.
The renowned Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace died on the spot, and Kellen Oracle-grade also fell then and there.
Daniel looked at their corpses and said softly, "The corpses of half god-grade powerhouses are all supreme treasures. They absolutely cannot be wasted."
The eye of the Auric Divine Emperor that Daniel had obtained earlier recorded that by gathering the remains of multiple half-Eternal powerhouses, one could refine them into an unparalleled treasure.
With that thought, Daniel removed both arms and the hearts of the two corpses. He then removed a pair of sharp horns from the remains of Logan Oracle-grade and activated the Myriad Evolution Art.
In an instant, the various severed remains fused together and transformed into a brand-new Chaos Supreme Treasure—the Seed of Spacetime.
Daniel’s breathing quickened slightly as he immediately checked the treasure panel.
[Clock of Spacetime] (Chaos Supreme Treasure)
Type: All-Purpose
Law: Law of Spacetime
Grade: Chaos Supreme Treasure
Traits:

Complete Cosmic Inscriptions of the Law of Spacetime. Allows unrestricted use of all powers of the Law of Spacetime. Impervious to All Laws. The Law of Spacetime stands above the laws of the myriad heavens. Untainted by Karma. Killing living beings will not incur any karmic cause and effect. Temporal Origin Tracing. Can erase a target living being from any point in time. Spatial Traversal. Can travel unhindered across the myriad heavens and spacetime.

Description: A ceiling-level Chaos Supreme Treasure with endless wondrous uses. It can be used for direct combat and slaughter, can assist in comprehending the Origin, and to control the Law of Spacetime is to control the power of the universe’s Origin...
After reading the treasure description, brilliant light erupted in Daniel’s eyes.
"What an extraordinary treasure!"
"Unfortunately, it still cannot transcend the universe."
The Spacetime Origin Law was the cultivation foundation of Eternal powerhouses. This supreme treasure was still limited to the Eternal level and had yet to reach the supreme realm of transcendence.
Whoosh!
Daniel’s figure flashed, and he appeared at the Eternal Tribulation Palace headquarters.
Above his head, the Clock of Spacetime gently hummed.
Its chime spread outward and instantly froze the entire region of spacetime.
The many powerhouses left behind to guard the Eternal Tribulation Palace were immediately suppressed by spacetime power and rendered completely unable to move.

Daniel unleashed his Divine Soul at full power, enveloping the entire Eternal Tribulation Palace. He forcibly invaded the seas of consciousness of every powerhouse left behind and searched through all their memories.
Countless memory fragments flooded into his mind.
Very soon, he locked onto his target.
"The Eternal Tribulation Palace treasury..."
Daniel’s figure flashed, and in the next instant, he appeared in an empty region of the void.
At first glance, there seemed to be absolutely nothing here.
"The Eternal Tribulation Palace treasury is an entire independent Secret Realm."
The third eye on Daniel’s forehead opened, divine light blazing as it pierced through all falsehood.

"This Secret Realm is hidden within the endless void and contains the massive amount of resources the Eternal Tribulation Palace has plundered over countless ages. Its defenses are extreme, and ordinary methods cannot discover it at all."
Daniel smiled faintly.
"But I don’t need ordinary methods!"
"Clock of Spacetime!"
Dong!
A deep bell toll resounded.
Ripples of the Law of Spacetime surged outward and enveloped an area spanning countless billions of miles.
The Secret Realm hidden deep within the void slowly revealed its true form, its outline becoming increasingly clear.
This Secret Realm had restrictions personally arranged by an Eternal powerhouse and was also the Eternal Tribulation Palace’s greatest foundation for standing among the myriad heavens.
"Dong! Dong! Dong!"
The Clock of Spacetime vibrated rapidly.
Endless law power washed down and instantly shattered every Eternal restriction.
Even defenses laid down by an Eternal powerhouse were unable to withstand a Chaos Supreme Treasure.
Daniel flew directly into the Secret Realm and spread his Divine Soul across the entire treasury.
"Hiss—"
Even the current Daniel could not help drawing in a sharp breath.
The entire Secret Realm was piled high with rare treasures of the myriad heavens and endless precious resources, all accumulated by the Eternal Tribulation Palace through countless ages of plunder.
Its wealth had reached an unimaginable extreme!
Daniel did not hesitate and collected everything.
After being enhanced by his Millionfold Boost system, the quality of every treasure rose layer by layer, and the accumulated foundation instantly doubled.
The gains from this battle were truly astonishing.
"With such an enormous amount of resources, I can strengthen the Myriad Races Universe to a terrifying degree!"
After collecting every treasure, Daniel turned back and returned to the Myriad Races Universe.
At this point, he no longer needed to act personally.

Thousands of Oracle-grade powerhouses from the Myriad Races Universe, the Abyss Universe, and the Chaosverse all obeyed his commands, doing everything they could to deduce and strengthen the foundation of the Myriad Races Universe.
Origin resources from the Chaosverse poured madly into the Myriad Races Universe.
The Chaos Origin continuously weakened, while the Myriad Races Universe grew stronger with every passing moment.
Daniel’s cultivation and Strength also soared in step with the advancement of the universe.
"Strengthening the universe will take quite some time."
"This is the perfect opportunity to comprehend the Ultimate Realm of Laws."
"Kru once pushed his laws to the Supreme Ultimate Realm. Now, I can do the same!"
With his decision made, Daniel activated the Clock of Spacetime, reversed the flow of time, and began deducing the past in which Kru had broken through to the Ultimate Realm of Laws.

The Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace had betrayed Kellen with ruthless decisiveness and without the slightest burden on his conscience.
Every man for himself, or heaven and earth would destroy him.
Besides, for someone capable of becoming the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace, methods like these were nothing more than instincts he could employ at any moment.
After all, the Eternal Tribulation Palace was the largest criminal faction in the Endless Starfield.
As its leader, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace was naturally no benevolent soul.
Only someone like this could intimidate powerful experts from every side.
At this moment, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace had only one thought in his mind—run.
Run as far away as possible.
Better yet, never encounter Daniel again for the rest of his life.
This man was simply too monstrous.
He was absolutely not someone the current Palace Lord could handle.
Suddenly, the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace felt his vision blur.
When his sight returned, Daniel’s figure was already standing directly in his path.
"Damn it!
How?!"
The Palace Lord’s face turned deathly pale, and his heart went completely cold.
He suddenly realized that Daniel had used the Law of Spacetime.
Although he himself was also proficient in the Law of Spacetime, the difference between his attainments and Daniel’s was like the difference between clouds and mud.
Before Daniel could even attack, Kellen behind him struck first.
Burning with rage, Kellen unleashed a Sacred Art and attacked the Palace Lord of the Eternal Tribulation Palace without holding back in the slightest.
Just moments ago, they had been comrades fighting side by side.
In the blink of an eye, they had become mortal enemies—all because the Palace Lord had betrayed Kellen without hesitation in order to save his own life.

They absolutely cannot be wasted."
